text.body:
<1> oṃ kriyādhikāraḥ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ pitā yasya yasya mātā haripriyā| bhṛgvādimunayaḥ śiṣyāstasmai vikhanase namaḥ || 1 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ṛṣipraśnottaram āśrame samyagāsīnamṛṣiṃ sarvatitodyatam| ṛṣayo'bhyāgatāssarve praṇipatyedamabruvan || 2 || bhagavan kena mārgeṇa kaṃ devaṃ pūjayanti vai| ācakṣva santo brahmarṣe sarvametatsavistaram || 3 || bhṛguruvāca yuṣmābhiḥ paripṛṣṭaṃ yattatsarvabhṛṣisattamāḥ| vakṣyāmi sāvadhānena śṛṇudhvaṃ matprabodhitam || 4 || hṛdisthitigataṃ pīṭhaṃ caturaśraṃ hiraṇmayam| nānāmaṇigaṇajvālāduṣprekṣyaṃ śubhamujjvalam || 5 || tasya madhyagataṃ dhyāyennārāyaṇamanāmayam| śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ param || 6 || āsanādyupacārāṇi manasā tasya bhāvayet| eṣā tu mānasī pūjā berapūjā tu vakṣyate || 7 || uktapramāṇapratimāṃ hāṭakādividhiṃ parām| pratiṣṭhāpyārcayetsā tu berapūjeti coditā|| 8 || dhyātvā'gnimaṇḍalaṃ tasya dhyāyenmadhye prabhāṃ śubhām| prabhāmadhyagataṃ dhyāyedāsīnaṃ vā janārdanam || 9 || taptahāṭakasaṅkāśaṃ catuśśrṛṅgaṃ dviśīrṣakam| saptahastaṃ tricaraṇaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ saptajihvakam || 10 || sruksruvau cākṣamālāṃ ca śaktiṃ dakṣiṇapāṇiṣu| cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ caiva ghṛtapātraṃ ca vāmataḥ || 11 || dhyātvā yathoktahaviṣā yajettaddhomapūjanam| yathopayogaśakyatvātkartaṃ puṣpādipūjanam || 12 || cakṣuṣaḥ prītikaraṇānmanaso hṛdayasya ca| prītyā sañjāyate bhaktirbhaktasya sulabho hariḥ || 13 || tasmātattrayāṇāmeteṣāṃ berapūjā viśiṣyate| berapūjādvaividhyam gṛhārcā cā'layārceti berapūjā ca sā dvidhā || 14 || balyutsavādibhirdivyaiḥ pūrṇatvātsarvavigrahaiḥ| pramīte yajamāne'pi tvavicchinnapravartanāt || 15 || sādhāraṇatvātsarveṣāṃ tadgrāmādiṣu vāsinām| mukhyamāha purā brahmā berapūjanamālaye || 16 || alayārcādvaividhyam ālayārcāvidhisso'pi dvidhā viṣṇoḥ prakīrtitaḥ| vaikhānasaḥ pāñcarātro vaidikastāntriḥ kramāt || 17 || vidhistu vedamūlaśca dīkṣāyuktastu tāntrikaḥ| kevalāmuṣmikaphalo vedavaidikavardhanaḥ || 18 || kārayedvaidikenaiva grāmādiṣu ca vāstuṣu| nadītīre'driśṛṅge vā vane vā'nyatra nirjane || 19 || pūjayettāntrikeṇaiva grāmādau na kadācana| anulomanivāseṣu tāntrikeṇaiva pūjayet| || 20 || vrātyāntarālaprabhṛtipratilomanivāsane| ubhābhyāṃ nārcayedviṣṣumiti pūrvajaśāsanam || 21 || ācāryalakṣaṇam evaṃ manasi sañjāte yajamāno mudānvitaḥ| vaikhānasena sūtreṇa niṣekādikriyānvitam || 22 || vipraṃ svādhyāyasaṃyuktaṃ vedatattvārthadarśinam| saumyaṃ jitendriyaṃ śuddhaṃ viṣṇavarcanaparāyaṇam || 23 || ūhāpohavidhānena dhvastasaṃśayamānasam| patnyapatyayutaṃ śāntaṃ snānaśīlaṃ ca dhārmikam || 24 || āhūya devavatpūjya sarvakāryopadeśakam| ācārya varayitvā tu tenoktaṃ sarvamācaret || 25 || aṅkurārpaṇam tasmāttu divasātpūrvaṃ navame vā'tha saptame| pañcame'hani vā kuryāttṛtīye vāṅkurārpaṇam || 26 || athavā tvarayāyuktaḥ kuryāttatsadya eva vā| amāvāsyāvyavahite kuryātsadyo'ṅkurārpaṇam || 27 || saṅkramavyavadhāne'pi sadya eveti kecana| karmaṇāṃ sādhivāsānāṃ sadyaścedaṅkurārpaṇam || 28 || ārambhakālātpūrvaṃ tu pūrvāṃ niścitya kārayet| athavā sthāpana kālātpūrvameva tvarānvitaḥ || 29 || kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ sadyo jalādiṣvadhivāsya ca| agnyāghārādi karmāṇi kṛtvāvā''hya ca pūrvavat || 30 || puṇyāhaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā pūjayediti kecana| bahukriyāṇāmekāhe tvekamevāṅkurārpaṇam || 31 || tadarthaṃ pālikāḥ kumbhāñcharāvānapi cā'haret| ṣoḍaśa dvādaśā'ṣṭau ca caturaśca pṛthakpṛthak || 32 || varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ caturo'thavā| nava vā pañca vaikaṃ vā sadyaḥ kālāṅkurārpaṇe || 33 || dinasaṃkhyākramātkecidvadanti munisattamāḥ| pūrvoktalakṣaṇopetānkalpayitvā yathābalam || 34 || yajamānagṛhe cāpi caiśānyeṣvitareṣu vā| anyasminvā śucau deśe gṛhe vā grāmakartṛke || 35 || caturdiśaṃ caturhastaṃ gomayenopalipya ca| prāgantaṃ cotṛtarāntaṃ ca ṣaṭsūtrāṇi samarpayet || 36 || upapīṭhe padaṃ caikaṃ brahmapīṭhāya kalpayet| caryārthaṃ parito'ṣṭau ca paṅktyartha ṣoḍaśetare || 37 || tatpadāntargataṃ paṅktyāṃ brahmapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet| śeṣādīnāṃ tu pīṭhāni paṅktyāmeva prakalpayet || 38 || marīciḥ caṅktibāhye'pi teṣāṃ pīṭhāni coktavān| ṣaḍaṅgulasamutsedhaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyatam || 39 || trivedisahitaṃ kuryāt ṣaṇṇāṃ vīṭhaṃ pṛthākpṛthak| yajamānagṛhārcāyāṃ sthaṇḍile vā tathaiva ca || 40 || devadevaṃ samabhyarcya saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ | pādau prakṣālya cācamya madhye brahmāṇamarcayet || 41 || prāgdvārāduttare śeṣaṃ vakratuṇḍantu dakṣiṇe| dakṣiṇadvārapūrve tu garuḍaṃ ca samarcayet || 42 || sudarśanaṃ paścime ca vidhinaiva samarcayet| ṣaṅktīśaṃ paścimadvārāddakṣiṇe ca vidhānataḥ || 43 || uttare bhūtabhartāramarcayitvā yathāvidhi| pūrvasminnuttaradvārātsomaṃ śāntaṃ samarcayet || 44 || aindrādi ca tathaiśāntaṃ jayādyapsaraso'rcayet| haviṣā ca samāyuktaṃ sarveṣāmuttamaṃ pṛthak || 45 || brahmādīnāṃ tu ṣaṇṇāṃ vai madhyamaṃ tatprakīrtitam| brahṛmaṇaśca tu śeṣāṇāṃ balirevādhamaṃ bhavet || 46 || mṛddhirvā sikatābhirvā pālikādīndrapūrayet| teṣāṃ madhye kuśairvāpi veṣṭayettantunā'thavā || 47 || prāṅmukhaḥ prayato bhūtvā vinyasettu krameṇa vai| brahmaṇaḥ paritaḥ paṅktyāṃ gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ japan || 48 || cintayenmedinīṃ devīṃ tāṃ sarveṣu samarcayet| sauvarṇe rājate pātre tāmre kāṃsyamaye tathā || 49 || uddhṛtya toyamagnāni kṣīraprakṣālitāni vai| bījāni pūrayitvā tu somaṃ tatra samarcayet || 50 || tatkāle tūryaghoṣaiśca ghoṣayitvā samāhitaḥ| paridhāyāhataṃ vastraṃ sottarīyāṅgulīyakaḥ || 51 || ācāryo yajamāno vā vāpayedaṅkurān śubhān| 'somaṃ rājāna' mityuktvā viṣṇusūktaṃ ca sañjapan || 52 || strīśūdrau kārayetāṃ cettābhyāṃ vāpaṃ na kārayet| vāruṇaṃ mantramuccārya jalasekaṃ ca kārayet || 53 || navavastreṇa sañchādya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ| jalena secayonnityaṃ dīpaṃ ca parirakṣayet || 54 || yathāṅkurassusaṃpaṃnnastathā yatnena rakṣayet| śyāmalāśca tathā raktā ye ca tiryaggatā api || 55 || aṅkurāścāprarūḍhāśca varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ| śyāmeṣu dravyanāśaḥ syādrakteṣu kalaho bhavet || 56 || tiryaggarteṣu rogassyādaprarūḍheṣu vai mṛtiḥ| śubhaṃ pīteṣu śukleṣu ṛjūrdhvagatirohiṣu || 57 || kartuḥ kārayituścāpi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ| evameva krameṇaiva maṅgalāyāṅkurārpaṇam || 58 || pañcame'hanyayukte tu sadyaḥ kartā tvarānvitaḥ| tṛtīye'hani vā tadvadaṅkurānarpayedbuḥ || 59 || aśaktastaṇḍḍulaiśśuddhaiḥ sadyaścaiva śubhāṅkuraiḥ| pālikādīnprapūryaiva pañcabhirvā'tha varṇakaiḥ || 60 || alaṅkatya ca padmādyaiḥ puṣpairvā''pūrya vinyaset| aṅkuroktikriyāssarvāstaistaireva samācaret || 61 || aṅkurāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ candraḥ prokto'dhidaivatam| naiva prīṇāti bhagavānaṅkurārpaṇamahri cet || 62 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rātrāvevāṅkurārpaṇam || 63 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre agnidhyānā'cāryatnakṣaṇāṅkurārpaṇavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<2> oṃ dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ bhūparīkṣā aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhva bhūmiṃ samyakparīkṣayet| yajamānagṛhe devaṃ saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 1 || pūjayitvā japannagre 'priyatāṃ bhagavā' niti| praṇamya devadeveśaṃ 'prasī' detyanumānya ca || 2 || varṇajāṃ kanyakāmekāmalaṅkatya yathocitam| pāyasaṃ prāśayitvā tāṃ śvetavastrānulepanām || 3 || padmadīpakarāmagre gamayetsarvamaṅgalaiḥ| śākunaṃ sūktamuccārya svastisūktaṃ samuccaran || 4 || ācāryo yajamānaśca toyadhārāpurassaram| gatvā bhūmiṃ samuddiṣṭāmārūḍhatarujantubhiḥ || 5 || gandhavarṇākṛtirasaiśśakunaiśca yathāvidhi| samyakparīkṣya pṛthivīṃ bhūsūktaṃ bhūmidaivatam || 6 || japan bhūmiṃ gṛhītvā tu śobhanāṃ doṣavarjitām| 'apakrāmantu bhūtāni devatāścāsurādayaḥ || 7 || vimānārthaṃ gṛhīteyaṃ bhūmirviṣṇo' riti bruvan| udvāsya devatāssarvā bhūmiṃ tatra samarcayet || 8 || vimānaṃ śilpinā sārdhamagramaṇḍapasaṃyutam| niścityā'varaṇairyuktaṃ tṛṇagulmāni śodhayet || 9 || ācāryavaraṇam bhūmiḥ parīkṣitā yena guruṇā vidhipūrvakam| karṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhānte karma tenaiva kārayet || 10 || tadabhāve tu tatputraṃ pautraṃ naptārameva vā| tathaiva bhrātaraṃ śiṣyaṃ praśiṣyaṃ gurumeva vā || 11 || sabrahmacāriṇaṃ vāpi pūrvābhāve tathottaram| tadanujñātamanyaṃ vā ācāryārthaṃ niyojayet || 12 || anyathā cenmahādoṣo rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati| kṣīyante varṇadharmāśca jāyate varṇasaṃkaraḥ || 13 || agnayaśca na siddhyanti svādhyāyo na pravartate| viparītāni cānyāni bhaviṣyatyadharottaram || 14 || tasmātsarvapratnena prāyaścittaṃ khiloktavat| kārayitvā ca tenaiva sarvakarmāṇi kārayet || 15 || sarvatra gururityuktaḥ tattatsthānapravartakaḥ| sakathañcidayuktaścedmuktenānyena kārayet || 16 || tatkarmaṇo'vasāne tu tasmai dadyācca dakṣiṇām| sthānācāryaḥ pradhānaḥ syāttanniyukto'nya eva vā || 17 || ācaretsarvakarmāṇi tadvaṃśajanito'pi vā| śilpilakṣaṇam śilpinastrividhāḥ proktāstattatkarmopajīvinaḥ || 18 || kulālastakṣakaścaiva tathā pāraśavastviti| traivastukāni verāṇi śailordhve citrakarma ca || 19 || sudhākarma vimānordhve bhittau citrakriyādikam| evaṃ kulālakaḥ kuryānmaṭhādyābhasakarma yat || 20 || tattu pāraśavaḥ kuryāttakṣakassarvameva tat| lohāśmadārūberāṇi cāṣṭabandhādikāṃ kriyām || 21 || grāmādivāstuvinyāsaṃ varṇināṃ gṛhakarmaṃ ca| prāsādamaṇḍapadvāraprākārāṇāṃ ca kalpanam || 22 || ācarettakṣakassarva kuryuśśilpina eva tat| anyathā yadi sa grāmo rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati || 23 || karṣaṇam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi paraṃ karṣaṇalakṣaṇam| ukteṣviṣṭadine śuddhe kartuścāpyanukūlake || 24 || ṣaṭsvāṣāḍhādimāseṣu karṣaṇaṃ samyagācaret| yugalāṅgalaklṛptyarthamuktavṛkṣaṃ samāharet || 25 || saṃśodhya vṛkṣamūlaṃ ca gomayenopalipya ca| rudrabhūtendrakīnāśān mātṝssomaṃ ca vīrakam || 26 || aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya baliṃ datvā ca tadvane| rudrendrayamavṛkṣendrānvṛkṣamūle tathā'rcayet || 27 || vanaspatibhya ityuktvā kumārībhya udīrya ca| vṛkṣarājebhya ityuktvā paritaśca baliṃ dadet || 28 || sarvakāmapradebhyaśca paścāddhomaṃ samācaret| agnaye vanarājāya somāyaṃ ca yamāya ca || 29 || śākhāya sthūlalākṣāya vyādhāya mṛgarūpiṇe| vanaspatibhyaḥ kumārībhyo vallībhyaḥ kusumāya ca || 30 || śalāṭave bṛhattvace puṇyāyāmṛtatejasa| sūryāya harirūpāya śrṛṅgiṇe bhūtarūpiṇe || 31 || nāgahastāya divyāya trihastāya tathaiva ca| vighnāya vidhnarūpāya vināyakamudīrya ca || 32 || prasāriṇe muruṇḍāya nyarṇāyeti samuccaran| nāgebhyo bhūtarājebhyaścāraṇebhya iti bruvan || 33 || divā naktaṃcerabhyaśca saṃdhyābhyaśca tathaiva ca| sandhyācarebhya ityuktvā apsarobhyastathaiva ca || 34 || yakṣībhyaśca kumārībhyo'dhyāsurībhyastathaiva ca| rākṣasībhyaḥ piśācebhyo vanāya sthalacāriṇe || 35 || juhuyādvṛkṣadevebhyaḥ sthānadevebhya eva ca| rūpibhyo mithunebhyaśca sukhebhyaśca juhoti ca || 36 || vyāhatīśca tathā hutvā 'nirdagdha' miti coccaran| paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā vṛkṣasya ca punaryatet || 37 || sarveśvarāya mātṛbhyo vakratuṇḍāya mūrtibhiḥ| hutvā mātṛstathā somaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca pūjayet || 38 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu badhdvā pratisaraṃ tathā| rātriśeṣaṃ tato nītvā prātassnātvā yathāvidhi || 39 || chedayitvā taruṃ samyagyugādīnparikalpayet| lakṣaṇaṃ tu yugādīnāṃ khiloktavidhinā caret || 40 || prācyāmudīcyāṃ vā sthitvā prāgādiṣu suvinyaset| baliṃ datvā samāhṛtya gandhodairabhiṣicya ca || 41 || devadevaṃ samabhyarcet saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ| caturviśatimāyāmaṃ caturaśraṃ sulakṣaṇam || 42 || ṣaḍaṅgulasamutsedhaṃ ratnimātraṃ trimekhalam| anyatrāpi samuddiṣṭaṃ pīṭhamevaṃ tathārcane || 43 || devebhyaścāpi bhūtebhyo nāgayakṣebhya eva ca| piśācebhyarsvabhūtebhyo rākṣasebhyastathaiva ca || 44 || vairocanagaṇebhyaśca parito nikṣipedvalim| madhye nāgabaliṃ datvā kṛtvā puṇyāhamatvaraḥ || 45 || balīvardāvalaṅkatya rūpyaśṛṅgakhurau śubhau| dakṣiṇe pūrvapāde tu badhnīyātkautukaṃ tayoḥ || 46 || rātriśeṣaṃ ninīyaiva prātaḥ snātvā vidhānataḥ| tasya paścimadeśe taṃ devadevaṃ samarcayet || 47 || cakravīśāmitaissārdhamabhyarcyā'camanāntakaiḥ| 'priyatāṃ medi' nītyuktavā pañcabhirbhūmidaivataiḥ || 48 || praṇamya bhūmiṃ deveśaṃ praṇamyaivānumānya ca| 'namo varuṇa' ityadbhiḥ kṛtvā sīmāvinirṇayam || 49 || 'akṣairmādīvya' ityuktvā prokṣayetkarṣakaṃ punaḥ| dakṣiṇe 'tvaṃ vṛṣe tyuktvā 'saurabheye' ti vāmataḥ || 50 || kuśarajjvā yuge badhdvā 'yugaṃ yu' iti bruvan| yuge tnāṅgalamābaddhya kuśarajjvā smaran harim || 51 || 'ṣiṃ gṛhaṇāmi' mantreṇa gṛhaṇīyādṛṣimatvāraḥ| 'viṣṇurmā' muccaran mantramātmarakṣāṃ prakalpya ca || 52 || 'ye'smindeśe' iti japan karṣaṇaṃ tatra kārayet| savarvavījāni cā'hṛtya 'ime bījā,' iti spṛśan || 53 || 'devi tva' yīti mantreṇa pradakṣiṇavaśena tu| uptvā tu sarvabījāni jalasekaṃ ca kārayet || 54 || dakṣiṇoktavidhānena dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| sadyaḥkarṣaṇ evaṃ kartumaśaktaśca sadyaḥ kuryāttvarānvitaḥ || 55 || bhūmiṃ parīkṣya sadyastu karṣayitvā yathāvidhi| bījāni ca samāhṛtya brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya ca || 56 || tṛṇapūjalaṃ palālaṃ vā samāstīrya ca sarvataḥ| gogaṇāṃstatra cānīya gogaṇebhyo nivedayet || 57 || 'bhuñjantu devā' ityuktvā baliṃ tatra samarpayet| devāyārdhyaṃ nivedyaiva praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 58 || padakatpanam ekāśītipadaṃ kṛtvā sampūjya padadevātāḥ| garbhālayaṃ samuddiśya upapīṭhapadaṃ nayet || 59 || nāgādi pañcabhūtāntaṃ pañca pañca padābhipāḥ| prāgudakpañcasūtrasthāssandhisthā devatā imāḥ || 60 || śeṣādīn bahirabhyarcya paścimādi vahirmukhān| kusturuṇḍādayaḥ pujyā āgneyādi pradakṣiṇam || 61 || kiṣkindhādi hitāntāśca madhye prāgādi dikṣvapi| aṅkaṇe tu samabhyarcya saktvapūpairbaliṃ dadet || 62 || piśācebhyaśca bhūtebhyo baliṃ datvā jalānvitam| brahmapadmavidhiṃ kṛtvā parīkṣya ca śubhāśubhe || 63 || aśubhe śāntihomānte śubhe karma sāmācerat| grāmakalpanam grāmamānaṃ viniścitya kṛtvā''yādiparīkṣaṇam || 64 || prāguttarānanaissūtrairdaśabhissaptabhiryutaiḥ| padaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ caturguṇam || 65 || tyaktvā brāhmaṃ ca paiśācaṃ viprāvāsaṃ prakalpayet| brāhme vāyavyabhāge tu prāṅgukhaṃ viṣṇumandiram || 66 || īśānānalanīleṣu sabhāgoṣṭhāpaṇān kramāt| paścime yadi kuryāccedbrahmasūtrāttathottare || 67 || visṛjya bhāgaṃ paiśācaṃ bahirantarathāpi vā| vimānaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ kuryāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || 68 || yadi paiśācabhāgasthaṃ devadevasya mandiram| ādhivyādhyādibhissarve pīḍyante vāstuvāsinaḥ || 69 || catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāge tu bahirāvaraṇe tathā| bhadrakālīṃ haraṃ cāpi śāstāraṃ bahiraṃśake || 70 || bahirmukhān kramātkuryātsarve'nye tadvahiḥ sthitāḥ| mānuṣe'bhyantare'rdhāṃśe gṛhaśreṇīṃ prakalpya ca || 71 || paiśāce bahirardhetu gṛhanāḍīṃ prakalpayet| evaṃ deśaṃ viniścitya vimānaṃ parikalpayet || 72 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānasaṃ bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre karṣaṇādipadavinyāsavidhirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<3> oṃ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ vimānavidhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vimānavidhimuttamam| mūlālayādathaiśānyāṃ saumye vāyavya eva tā || 1 || prathamataruṇālayaḥ bālālayaṃ prakalpyaiva pratiṣṭhāpya ca keśavam| tato'rcanamavicchinnaṃ kurvan dhāma prakalpayet || 2 || utsavaṃ kartukāmaśca prathame taruṇālaye| dhvajaṃ bālālayāgre tu samāropyotsavaṃ caret || 3 || jalāntaṃ vā śilāntaṃ vā khātvā bhūmiṃ samantataḥ| vālukābhiḥ prapūryaiva jalena sahitaṃ śanaiḥ || 4 || musalairhastipādaiśca dārutuṇḍairbṛhattaraiḥ| dṛḍhīkṛtya tu sarvatra jalenaiva prapūrayet || 5 || prācīsādhanam tatra śaṅkuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dikparicchedamācaret| tena prācīṃ viniścitya śaṅkunā śravaṇena vā || 6 || yathoktavidhinā tatra kṛtvā ca prathameṣṭakām| ārabheta vimānaṃ tu pañcahastādibhedataḥ || 7 || mānalakṣaṇam paramāṇuraṇūreṇuḥ keśā likṣāstilā yavāḥ| kramādaṣṭhaguṇairetairmānāṅgulamudāhṛtam || 8 || svahastenāṣṭatālo yassa vai madhyamapūruṣaḥ| tasya dakṣiṇahastasya madhyamāṅgulimadhyamam || 9 || parva dīrghaṃ tataṃ vā'pi mātrāṅgulamudāhṛtam| mānamātrāṅgule caite uttame parikīrtite || 10 || tadaṣṭāṃśaikahīnaṃ tu madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam| saptāṃśaikavihīnaṃ tu kaniṣṭhāṅgulamīritam || 11 || caturviśatyaṅgalibhiḥ hastaḥ kiṣkuriti smṛtaḥ| aṅgulaiḥ pañcaviṃśādbhiḥ prājāpatya udāhṛtaḥ || 12 || ṣaḍviṃśadbhirdhanurmuṣṭiḥ saptaviṃśairdhanurgrahaḥ| bhūmerdevālayādīnāṃ mānaṃ mānāṅgulena vai || 13 || gṛhaṃ śayyā''sanaṃ yānaṃ pātramāyudhameva ca| idhmasruksruvajuhvādīn kuryānmātrāṅgulena vai || 14 || bhedo mātrāṅgulasyaiva śākhāṅgulasamāhvayaḥ| muṣṭimadhyaprameyaḥ syātso'gnikuṇḍādikalpane || 15 || tasya mātrāṅgulasyaiva madhyamādhamakalpane| pañcahastādahīnaṃ tu vimānaṃ parikalpayet || 16 || vistāradviguṇotsedhaṃ kalpayettu vidhānavit| ekāṃśakaṃ tadaṣṭāṃśaṃ daśamaṃ ca galāntakāḥ || 17 || aṃśakau pādaśikharau kalpayecchilpinā''layam| gaṇyālaṃkārabhedādi vāsādhikaraṇoktavat || 18 || garbhanyāsoktamārgeṇa garbhanyāsaṃ samācaret| samāpte tu vimāne tu punarmūrdheṣṭakāṃ nyaset || 19 || dhruvaberakalpanaprakāraḥ śūlasthāpanamārgeṇa śūlaṃ vā śailameva vā| saṃsthāpya ca yathāmārgaṃ dhruvaberaṃ prakalpayet || 20 || dhruvaberānurūpañca kautukaṃ parikalpayet| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 21 || sadyaścettvaritaḥ kartu śarīrānityatādinā| lauhaṃ vā dāravaṃ vāpi bimbamarcitameva vā || 22 || yāgaśālāṃ prakalpyaiva pañcagnīnparikalpya ca| bālālayapratiṣṭhārthamācāryaṃ parikalpya ca || 23 || bālālayapratiṣṭhārthamiṣṭakārthaṃ tathaiva ca| śūlasaṃsthāpanārtha ca kalpayedṛtvijaḥ pṛthak || 24 || sambhṛtya sarvasambhārāṃstathā śūlāṃstatheṣṭakāḥ| pūrvarātrau viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā sadyo'ṅkurārpaṇam || 25 || kramācca gārhapatyādikuṇḍeṣvāghāramācaret| kṛtvā jaṅgumaberasya netronmeṣādhivāsane || 26 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā saptabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ punaḥ| sopasnānaiśca saṃsnāpya kumbhaṃ cāpi prapūjayet || 27 || tatkumbhoditatīrthaiśca vidhinā prokṣaṇādanu| hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya nirupyājyā'hutīryajet || 28 || bālālayapratiṣṭhoktahomaṃ pūrvaṃ juhoti ca| iṣṭakā vā śilā vā'tha snāpayetkalaśaistathā || 29 || iṣṭakāśca pṛthagvedyāmadhivāsya yathāvidhi| proktaṃ yatheṣṭakānyāse tathā homaṃ samāpayet || 30 || śūlaṃ vā śailaberaṃ vā snāpayetkalaśaistathā| badhdvā pratisaraṃ tadvacchayane śāyayetpṛthak || 39 || nṛttairgītaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ ninīya ca| prātassnātvā vidhānena sūktāni ca japettathā || 32 || muhūrte samanuprāpte pūrvaṃ bhūmiṃ parīkṣya ca| karṣayitvā samāstīrya tṛṇaṃ gobhyo nivedya ca || 33 || bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya punarādyeṣṭakāṃ nyaset| garbhagehaṃ viniścitya tadghanaṃ ddaḍhakuṭṭimam || 34 || adhiṣṭhānāvasānāntaṃ kalpayitvā tu tatra vai| śūlaṃ vā śailaberaṃ vā sthāpayetpūrvatsudhīḥ || 35 || paritaḥ pañjaro kṛtvā vimānaṃ kalpayedvahiḥ| athavā yāgaśālāyāṃ madhye dedīḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 36 || bālālayeṣṭakāśūlasthāpanārthaṃ tathaiva ca| tasya tasya mukhe sabhyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā pṛthakpṛthak || 37 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya saṃsnāpya hutvā saṃsthāpayetkramāt| evaṃ kartumaśaktaśceddhruvaberaṃ ca kautukam || 38 || śailaṃ dhruvārcāberaṃ vā pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet| brāhmādipaiśācānteṣu yogādīn nikṣipetkramāt || 39 || sarvāṅgasundaraṃ beraṃ kṛtvā coktaprakārataḥ| akṣyunmeṣādhivāsau ca kārayitvā yathāvidhi || 40 || śūlasthāpanamārgeṇa pūrvaṃ saṃsthāpya śilpinā| mahāpratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 41 || ekaberapratiṣṭhāṃ ca sadyaḥ kartuṃ yadīcchati| pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa rātrau homaṃ samāpya ca || 42 || prātarbhūmiṃ parīkṣyaiva karṣayitvā tathā bhuvam| ghanabhittiṃ ca kṛtvā tu tatra saṃkalpayetpunaḥ || 43 || pañjaraṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā vimānaṃ kalpayedvahiḥ| vimānasamavistāramaṃgramaṇḍapamuttamam || 44 || tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ vdyantare'ṣṭāṃśabhājite| ekaikāṃśādhikaṃ caiva navadhā mukhamaṇḍapam || 45 || trayāṇāmuttamādīnāmantarālaṃ prakalpayet| maṇḍapaṃ tatra vargāḍhyaṃ kalpayitvā yathāvidhi || 46 || vimānasamavistāraṃ prathamāvaraṇaṃ smṛtam| purastāddivaguṇaṃ tasmādagramaṇḍapapūrvataḥ || 47 || dviguṇaṃ caścimaṃ kecidicchanti munisattamāḥ| vimānadvāradigdvāraṃ prathamāvaraṇaṃ smṛtam || 48 || anyathā yadi kurvīta rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati| grāmasya yajamānasya mahatī ca vipadbhavet || 49 || tasmātsarvaprapatnena prathamāvaraṇakramam| vimānadvāradigdvāraṃ prāsādārdhasamucchrayam || 50 || avakāśavaśāddavāraṃ dvitīyāvaraṇādiṣu| vimānagarbhagehasya snāpanasyālayasya ca || 51 || tathaiva yāgaśālāyāḥ prākāreṣu mahānase| dvāramantarmukhaṃ vidyādanyeṣāṃ tu bahirmukham || 52 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre bhūparīkṣādipratiṣṭhoktasarvakarmaṇāṃ sadyovidhirnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<4> oṃ caturtho'dhyāyaḥ mūlāgārakalpanam pañcahastādibhedaistu bālagehasvarūpakam| vimānaṃ parikalpyaiva sarvālaṅkāramarpayet || 1 || saptāṃśeṣvaṃśite tāre rasabāṇayugādhikam| dviguṇaṃ dviguṇādūrdhve vasubāṇakrameṇa ca || 2 || pañcadhotsedhamuddiṣṭaṃ śāntikādikrameṇa vai| śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ jayyamadbhutaṃ sārvakāmikam || 3 || āyādisaṃgrahaḥ triguṇe'ṣṭahṛte tāre smṛtaṃ yonirdhvajādikam| nāhe navahate saptahṛte saurādikaṃ dinam || 4 || utsedhe'ṣṭaguṇe saptaviṃśatyapahṛte dinam| nāhe triguṇite triṃśaddhṛte tithirudāhṛtā || 5 || utsedhe'ṣṭaguṇe bhānuhate cāyurvinirdiśet| tāre navaguṇe cāṣṭahṛte śeṣaṃ vyayo bhavet || 6 || guṇairyoniṃ vyayādhikyaṃ vārān bhaumarkibhāsvatām| vaināśikaśaśāṅkāṣṭavipatpratyaranaidhanān || 7 || martyāsurarkṣayogaṃ ca yatnataḥ parivarjayet| gaṇayetkartṛbhāntaṃ vā vāstubhāntamato'nyathā || 8 || siddhāmṛtavarairyogaistyājyā api śubhāvahāḥ| ekabhṛmau śāntikādilakṣaṇam śāntike'rdhāṣṭabhāgantu pūrvoktaṃ gaṇyamarpayet || 9 || munibhistadvadevoktaṃ sarvadeśikamandiram| navāṃśe pauṣṭikotsedhe sārdhapādāṃśakaṃ talam || 10 || vdyaṃśakaṃ caraṇaṃ sārdhapādāṃśaṃ ca caturguṇam| ekāṃśaṃ galamānaṃ syāt vdyaṃśakaṃ śikharodayam || 11 || ekāṃśaṃ sthūpikotsedhamevaṃ pauṣṭikakalpanam| daśāṃśe jayadotsedhe sthūpikā prastaraṃ tathā || 12 || ekāṃśaṃ sārdhanayanaṃ caraṇaṃ śikharo'gnayaḥ| sardhāśantu galotsedhamevaṃ jayadamīritam || 13 || rudrāṃśe sadanotsedhe sapādāṃśaṃ talodayam| sārdhākṣamaṅghrituṅgaṃ syādekāṃśaṃ prastarodayam || 14 || grīvodayaṃ ca sārdhāśaṃ sārdhāśaṃ śikharodayam| sapādaṃ śikharotsedhamevamadbhutamīritam || 15 || dhātvaṃśe harmyatuṅge syāttalaṃ taddviguṇeṃśakam| tryaṃśakaṃ śikharotsedhamekāṃśaṃ sthūpikodayam || 16 || sārvakāmikamitṛyetadekabhūmau viśeṣataḥ| dvitale śāntikādi dvitale śāntikotsedhe catussaptāṃśabhājite || 17 || āyiṣṭhānaṃ tribhirbhāgaṃ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ cakramagnibhiḥ| pādodayaṃ tu pañcāṃśaṃ dvyaṃśakaṃ mañcamīritam || 18 || vitardikā śaśī grīvā dvibhāgaṃ śikharodayaḥ| adhyarghacaturaṃśaṃ syāsthūpikā sārdhamaṃśakam || 19 || pauṣṭike dvitalotsedhe catustriṃśadvibhājite| sārdhāśakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ caraṇodayam || 20 || sāgnayaṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ caraṇodayam| tadardha mañcatuṅgaṃ syādvedikaikena kalpyate || 21 || sārdhāgnayaṃśaṃ galotsedhaṃ śarāṃśaṃ śikharodayam| sārdhāśaṃ sthūpituṅgaṃ syādetatsarvasukhāvaham || 22 || jayadasya trayastriṃśadbhāge sārdhānalaṃ dharā| saptāṅghristalamaṃśaṃ syādrasāṅghrirmañcamagnibhiḥ || 23 || vedikaikaṃ galaṃ sārdha dṛkcharāṃśaṃ tu mūrdhani| sārdhāśaṃ sthūpituṅgaṃ syājjayadālayamīritam || 24 || ṣaḍbhāge tvadbhutotsedhe caturaṃśaṃ talodayam| saptāṃśaṃ caraṇotsedhaṃ mañcotsedhaṃ triyaṃśakam || 25 || vedikaikaṃ galaṃ tryaṃśaṃ bhūtāṃśaṃ śikharodayam| sthūpikā sārdhapādaṃ syādevamadbhutamīritam || 26 || catvāriṃśadbhagike harmyatuṅge vedā bhūmāvaṣṭapādau ca mañcam| pādenārdha saptabhāgaṃ talo'gniḥ vedirdvābhyāṃ vahribhiḥ kandharoccam || 27 || saptāṃśaṃ śikharotsedhaṃ sārdhāśaṃ sthūpikodayam| adbhute śāntikaṃ gaṇyaṃ yojayetsarvadeśikaḥ || 28 || tritale śāntikādi tritale śāntikotsedhe caturviśatibhājite| adhiṣṭhānaṃ vdyaṃśakaṃ syādvedabhāgaṃ padodayam || 29 || akṣāṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ satripādāgniraṅghrayaḥ| sārdhabhāgaṃ tu mañcaṃ syātsārdhāgniścacaraṇodayam || 30 || sapādāṃśantu mañcoccaṃ satribhāgaṃ vitardikā| grīvotsedhaṃ śivāṃśaṃ syācchikharaṃ sārdhavahribhiḥ || 31 || ekāṃśaṃ sthūpikotsedhamevaṃ tritalaśāntikam| pauṣṭike sadanotsedhe caturviśatibhājite || 32 || adhiṣṭhānaṃ dviyaṃśaṃ syādvekāṃśaṃ caraṇodayam| prastarotsedhamaṣṭāṃśaṃ satripādāgniraṅghrayaḥ || 33 || mañcaṃ sārdhāśakaṃ pādaṃ sāgniradhyardhakaṃ talam| ekāṃśaṃ vedikotsedhaṃ grīvāṃmānaṃ tathaiva ca || 34 || triyaṃśaṃ śikharotsedhaṃ pādonāṃśaṃ śikhodayam| jayade harmyatuṅge tu saptaviṃśatibhājite || 35 || mukhodayaṃ dvyaṃśatalaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ ca caraṇodayam| dviyaṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ caturbhiścaraṇodayam || 36 || pādahīnaṃ dvibhāgena prastarotsedhamiṣyate| sārghāgnyaṃśaṃ tu pādoccamadhyardhāśantu mañcakam || 37 || somāṃśaṃ vedikāmānaṃ galamānaṃ dvibhāgataḥ| vedāṃśaṃ śikharotsedhaṃ sapādāṃśaṃ śikhodayam || 38 || adbhute sadanottuṅge dvicatavāriṃśattadaṃśake| sārdhāmagnayaṃśamadhiṣṭhānaṃ saptāṃśaṃ caraṇodayam || 39 || adhiṣṭhānasamaṃ mañcaṃ sārdhaṣaṭ caraṇodayam| agnyaṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ pādamānaṃ ṣaḍaṃśakam || 40 || prastaraṃ sārdhamakṣāṃśaṃ somāṃśaṃ vedikodayam| grīvāmānaṃ dvibhāgena pañcāṃśaṃ śikharodayam || 41 || pakṣāṃśaṃ sthūpimānaṃ tu śālādīnsarvadeśikaḥ| sārvakāmikaharmyocce ṣaḍaṣṭāṃśavibhājite || 42 || pādāṃśaṃ tu dharātuṅgaṃ pādasyārdhāṣṭakāṃśakaḥ| adhiṣṭhānasamaṃ mañcamaṣṭāṃśaṃ caraṇaṃ tataḥ || 43 || mañcaṃ pādonavedāṃśaṃ pādapādādhikācalam| adhyardhāgnyaṃśakarṇa ca śivāṃśā vedikā bhavet || 44 || vdyaṃśaṃ galaṃ śarāṃśantu śikharaṃ sthūpikāvaniḥ| gaṇyetvanyonyasaṃkīrṇe grāmakartṛvināśanam || 45 || vistāraṃ pādabāhyaṃ syāt khurāsthūpyantamunnatam| agnibhāgaikabhāgaṃ vā bhūtabhāge'gnibhāgakam || 46 || yugāṃśamṛṣibhāge tu pañcāṃśaṃ vā navāṃśake| ṛtvaṃśaṃ rudrabhāge tu vasvaṃśaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśake || 47 || navāṃśaṃ saptapaṅktyaṃśe vyāsārdha garbhagehakam| śeṣaṃ kuḍyaviśālaṃ syādekabhūmivimānake || 48 || navāṃśe dhāmavistāre hāraṃ caikāṃśakena tu| hārāntaraṃ tathaikāṃśāmekāṃśaṃ bhittivistaraḥ || 49 || tryaṃśakaṃ garbhagehaṃ syānmandire tu dvibhūmike| vistāre rasabhāge tu somāṃśaṃ kūṭavistaram || 50 || śālātāraṃtu vdyaṃśaṃ syāccheṣaṃ pañjarahārake| evaṃ dvitalavinyāsaṃ tritalaṃ śṛṇu tatpṛthak || 51 || rudrabhāgeṃ'śakaṃ hāraṃ tārahārāntaraṃ tathā| kuḍyasya samamekāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ bhavet || 52 || ādibhūmighanaṃ kecidicchanti munisattamāḥ| tāre'ṣṭāṃśe karṇakūṭaṃ śivāṃśaṃ śālamucyate || 53 || sapañjaraṃ sārdhabhāgaṃ śeṣaṃ hāraṃ tathaiva ca| tadūrdhvaṃ nāsikoṣṭhaṃ ca nīḍaṃ vā pañjarasya ca || 54 || ūrdhvabhūmau rasāṃśe tu kūṭamekāṃśakaṃ bhavet| vdyaṃśaṃ koṣṭhaṃ śivaṃ nīḍaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavet || 55 || ūrdhvabhūmyagnibhāge tu madhye bhadraṃ śivāṃśakam| evaṃ tritalavinyāsamuktamuddeśamānataḥ || 56 || vāsādhikāre yatproktamanuktaṃ śilpaśāstrataḥ| adhiṣṭhānodaye bhūtabhāgaṣaḍbhāgabhājite || 57 || somākṣyagnicaturbāṇaṣaṭsaptāṃśakocchritam| sādhāraṇe tu pūrvārdhamatropetaṃ tataḥ param || 58 || upapīṭhe talādhastājjāṃgale tanna kalpayet| pādamārge gale'dhastādvedikāṃ parikalpayet || 59 || vedikārahitaṃ kecitpādavargaṃ vadanti hi| ṛjubhittimadhiṣṭhanaṃ kecidāhussapaṭṭikam || 60 || maṇḍapaṃ tattrivargāḍhyamṛjubhittikameva vā| ṛjubhititale pādaṃ kevalaṃ syātsabodhikam || 61 || madhyastambhavihīnaṃ ca lupācchannaṃ ca maṇḍapam| tanmadhye snapanaśvabhramāpāsanavidhānataḥ || 62 || tṛtīyāṃśe tṛtīye tu kuryādāsthānamaṇḍapam| caturthāvaraṇe vā'tha pañcamāvaraṇe'thavā || 86 || dvitīyāṃśe taṭākaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ ca taduttare| paritaḥ puṣpavṛkṣāṃśca kalpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 87 || nityaṃ nṛttaṃ prakurvīta nityasnapanamaṇḍape| āsthānamaṇṭapaṃ caiva tathā snapanamaṇṭapam || 88 || dakṣiṇāmukhamaiśānye saumye vā'pi prakalpayet| śrībhūtañcaiva garuḍaṃ kuryātsopānamaṇḍape || 89 || catussopānasaṃyuktaṃ kuryātsnapanamaṇḍapam| prāksopāne kumbhapūjāṃ vidadhyādyāmye homaṃ vāruṇe tailakarma| kṛtvodīcyāṃ tailamokṣaṃ vidhijñaḥ śvabhre madhye sthāpayet snāpayecca || 90 || homādvā prācyapādādvā bhityabhyantaramuttamam| madhyamaṃ bhittamadhyaṃ syādbhittibāhyamathādhamam || 99 || kuryācchalāṃ trivargāḍhyāmṛjubhittimathāpi vā| vimānotsedhatulṛyāṃ vā tripādaṃ vodayaṃ matam || 92 || iti śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre śāntikādivimānālaṅkāravidhirnāma kriyādhikāre śāntikādivimānālaṅkāravidhirnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5> oṃ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ādyeṣṭakānyāsaḥ vakṣyāmyādyeṣṭakānyāsaṃ vimānādiprakalpane| vāstuhomāvasāne tu pañcāgnīn parikalpayet || 1 || āghārānte yajetteṣu devaṃ dhyāyaṃśca vaiṣṇavam| hotavyaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktamaindramāhavanīyake || 2 || āgneyaṃ ca vidhānena vyāhṛtyantaṃ pṛthak pṛthak anvāhārye viṣṇusūktaṃ yāmyaṃ naiṛtameva ca || 3 || vaiṣṇavaṃ gārhapatyāgnau vāruṇaṃ vāyudaivatam| saumyamīśānadaivatyamāvasathye savaiṣṇavam || 4 || sabhye tu sarvadaivatyaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ savaiṣṇavam| prācyāmāhavanīyāgneḥ śvabhre saṃsthāpya tāśśilāḥ || 5 || samabhyarcya caturvedāṃstāsu vai prāgupakramāt| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairiṣṭakāstāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 6 || paścimasyāṃ tatasmabhyāddhānyarāśyapuri kramāt| pañcavastrāṇi cāstīrya vāsasā veṣṭayecca tāḥ || 7 || samāropyārcayettatra caturvedādhidevatāḥ| baddhvā pratisaraṃ tāsāṃ śāyayettāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 8 || dvārāgre puṣpasaṃyuktaṃ vastrairācchādya copari| prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena muhūrte tu śubhe bale || 9 || gṛhītvā sthāpakāstāstāḥ grāmamālayameva vā| japantaḥ śākunaṃ sūktaṃ svastisūktasamanvitam || 10 || parītyāntaḥ praviśyaiva devaṃ dhyāyanta eva vai| dvāradakṣiṇabhāge tu sthāpayediṣṭakāśśilāḥ || 11 || ekākṣarātsūktānte caturvedādimantrataḥ| uttarāgraṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ prāgagraṃ caivadakṣiṇe || 12 || pratīcyāmuttarāgraṃ syādudīcyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣakam| madhye ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā dhruvasūktaṃ japannyaset || 13 || athātaḥ śayanātprācyāmagnāvāhavanīyake| paurūṣaṃ viṣṇasūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tatraḥ param || 14 || ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca digdaivatyasamanvitam| daśakṛtvastathā hutvā sarva pūrvavadācaret || 15 || tathaiva gopurāṇāñca sannsodvāradakṣiṇe| praveśadakṣiṇe nyāso gopurāṇāṃ viśiṣyate || 16 || prākārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmaiśānye nairṛte'thavā| prāgdvārāddakṣiṇe kuryādiṣṭakāssnapanālaye || 17 || āsthānamaṇḍapādīnāmaiśānye prathameṣṭakām| nāsti cettatra tadbhittiḥ bhittyaiśānye'thavā nyaset || 18 || śālāśrayāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ nācaretprathameṣṭakām| mahānasasya cāgneyyāṃ kalpayetprathameṣṭakām || 19 || śālādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sabhyamaupāsanaṃ tu vā| prākāreṣu yajettattatparivārādhidaivatam || 20 || dvāreṣu dvārapālānāṃ yajenmantrāṃśca gopure| caturvedādimantrāṃśca vāruṇaṃ snapanālaye || 21 || śrībhūmisūktamantrāstu yajedāsthānamaṇḍape| havīrakṣakadaivatyaṃ śrībhūsūktaṃ mahānase || 22 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| prākārādiṣu sarveṣu caikāmeva śilāṃ nyaset || 23 || ālaye parivārāṇāṃ tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā sannyaseccaturiṣṭakāḥ || 24 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ khiloktavat| garbhanyāsaprakāraḥ gopuravyatiriktānāṃ garbhanyāsaṃ prakalpayet || 25 || kecinmahānasasyāpi garbhamāhurmunīśvarāḥ| nyasedgopuragarbhe tu sauvarṇadvāradevatāḥ || 26 || garbhe mahānasasyāpi pañcāgnīn havirakṣakam| garbhāṇi cālayoktāni phelāyāṃ pūrvavannyaset || 27 || khiloktenaiva mārgaiṇa garbhaphalāṃ prakalpya ca| garbhadravyāṇi cāhṛtya tatra sannyasya mantrataḥ || 28 || pidhāya ca pidhānena dhānyarāśyupari nyaset| rātrāveva nidhātavyaṃ śubhāṃśe ca sthirodaye || 29 || ūrdhvānane śubhairyukte rāśau śuddhe'ṣṭame vyaye| brāhmaṇaḥ paṭṭikordhve tu upānordhve tu bhūmipaḥ || 30 || tathaikaikāṃgulanyūne sannyasedvaiśyaśūdrayoḥ| dvārasya dakṣiṇe bhāge bhittimadhye tribhāgataḥ || 39 || dhātussamīpe nyastavyamiti śāstrasya śniścayaḥ| tatra viṣṇuṃ smaran buddhyā snapanaṃ cārcanaṃ tathā || 32 || adhivāsaṃ ca homaṃ ca khiloktividhinā caret| mūrdheṣṭakānyāsaḥ samāpte tu vimāne tu punarmūrdheṣṭakāṃ nyaset || 33 || pūrvoktalakṣaṇopetāḥ śilā vā pañcaveṣṭakāḥ| gṛhītvā sthūpiśūlaṃ ca sarvamādyeṣṭakoktavat || 34 || adhivāsaṃ ca homaṃ ca snapanaṃ cārcanādikam| nyakṣādīn dhānyapīṭhe tu pūjayetprāgupakramāt || 35 || sthūpyādhāreṣṭakāyāṃ tu pūjayetprakṛtiṃ parām| prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena sragvastrālaṃkṛto gurūḥ || 36 || pūrvoktairevamantraistu sannyasenmūrdhni ceṣṭakāḥ| bhūmisūktaṃ samuccārya sthūpyādhāreṣṭakāṃ nyaset || 37 || 'ātvāharṣe' ṇa sūktena sthūpiśūlaṃ punarnyaset| tattaddikṣu vimāneśān samāvāhyā rcayetpunaḥ || 38 || vimānadevatā kalpanam dakṣiṇādidiśi dvāre dvārāgre nyakṣamarcayet| tadvaśenetarānkuryātsarvānetānbahirmukhān || 39 || dvāreṣu dvārapālāṃśca prakalpyā'vāhya pūjayet| dvārāpālān prakurvīta kiṃciddvāranirīkṣakān || 40 || antarālaṃ yadi bhavettatra vaipārśvayoḥ kramāt| vakratuṇḍaṃ ca durgā ca bahirbhittau prakalpayet || 41 || agramaṇṭapabhittau vā pādavarge prakalpayet| pādavarge gale caiva vimāne paritaḥ kramāt || 42 || prāgādi puruṣārdīstān pādavarge prakalpayet| upānārdhāṃśamātreṇa vimāneśānprakalpayet || 43 || indraṃ ca dakṣiṇāmūrti nārasiṃhaṃ pitāmaham| prāgādi kalpayedetān gale lakṣaṇasaṃyutān || 44 || athavā puruṣādīṃstu vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhakam| sukhāsīnaṃ hayagrīvaṃ kalpayedathavā gale || 45 || dhruvaberasamaṃ vāpi pādahīnamathāpi vā| ardhaṃ tribhāgādekaṃ vā teṣāmutsedha ucyate || 46 || tathā koṇeṣu garuḍaṃ prastaropari kalpayet| ālayeṣvanyadevānāṃ vāhanāni prakalpayet || 47 || mṛgendramathavā kuryāt sarvadevālayeṣu ca| teṣāmabhimukhe kuryāt kuṇḍamaipāsanaṃ tathā || 48 || kumbhaṃ ca sādhayitvaiva kalaśaiḥ prokṣya saptabhiḥ| hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhinā tattanmantraṃ śatāṣṭakam || 49 || vaiṣṇavena samāyuktaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ juhoti vai| prātaḥ snātvā samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet || 50 || saptaviṃśatibhogaiśca nityamarcanamuttamam| trayodaśopacauśca madhyamaṃ pūjanaṃ smṛtam || 51 || puṣpamamannasamāyuktaṃ nirvapedadhame balim| yatra yatraiva vā bhaktiryajamānasya jāyate || 52 || pratiṣṭhāpyārcanaṃ nityaṃ kārayettatra tatra vai| dvāreśān pādavargeṣu gopureṣu prakalpayet || 53 || gale vimāne tān devān kalpayitvā samarcayet| athavā nārasiṃha vā durgī vāpi sudarśanam || 54 || kalpayitvā samāvāhya nityaṃ pūrvavadarcayet| eteṣāṃ kautukaṃ caiva kartumicchati cettathā || 55 || kautukaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya tadagre nityamarcayet| kalpayitvā'thavā pīṭhaṃ tattatparśve samarcayet || 56 || prāgādicaturo vedān pūjayetsnapanālaye| tathaiva yāgaśālāyāṃ śakramāsthānamaṇḍape || 57 || varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ nāthaṃ jalakrīḍārthamaṇḍape| maṇḍapeṣvadhavā'nyeṣu tattaddikpālasaṃyutam || 58 || viṣvaksenaṃ samabhyarcya yathāśakti nivedayet| eteṣu ca samāpteṣu vāstuhomāvasānake || 59 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam| vyāhṛtyantaṃ yajitvā tu punarāvāhya pūjayet || 60 || maṇḍapādiṣu deveśaṃ saṃsthāpya ca śubhodaye| saptaviṃśatibhorgaśca sampūjyāntaḥ praveśayet || 61 || ādhāya yāgaśālāyāṃ muhūrte havyavāhanam| vaiṣṇavena śataṃ hutvā nityahomaṃ samācaret || 62 || havīrakṣakamāgneyyāṃ pūjayettu mahānase| devadevaṃ samabhyarcya paścātpākakriyāṃ caret || 63 || maṇḍapādiṣu kuḍyeṣu sudhākarmakriyopari| devasya vijayakrīḍāvigraheṣu yathāruci || 64 || yadyadicchativai kartā tattadābhāsakarmaṇā| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kalpayitvā'tisundaram || 65 || amantrakākṣyunmeṣānte vāstuhomaṃ juhoti ca| akṣyunmeṣaṃ tathā kṛtvā pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ || 66 || dhruvaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā tu kuṇḍamaupāsanaṃ nyaset| kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā kalaśaiḥ prokṣya saptabhiḥ || 67 || kumbhaṃ vedyāṃ samārepya tasminpratisaraṃ tathā| aupāsanaṃ ca kṛtvaiva hautraṃ caiva praśaṃsayet || 68 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| hutvā taduktamantrāṃśca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 69 || prātarāvāhya sampūjya havīṃṣi ca nivedayet| trivedisahitaṃ pīṭhaṃ tattadagre prakalpayet || 70 || tatrā'vāhya samabhyarcya pūjanānte visarjayet| evameva paṭābhāsabimbānāṃ sthāpanārcane || 71 || evaṃ mūrdheṣṭakānyāse vimānasya kṛte sati| śūlagrahaṇarmoṇa gṛhītvā śūlamatra tu || 72 || śūlaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivat dhruvaberaṃ prakalpayet | gṛhītvā vā śilāṃ samyaksthāpayitvā taduktavat || 73 || bereṣuyogādibhedāḥ kārayeddhruvaberaṃ tu yogabhogādibhedataḥ| āsanaṃ śayanaṃ caiva sthānakaṃ ceti tattrithā || 74 || caturvidhaṃ tadekaikaṃ yogaṃ bhogaṃ tathaiva ca| vīraṃ ca virahaṃ caiva pūrvameva mayoditam || 75 || cakuśaṅkhadharaṃ devaṃ yogaṃ bhogaṃ prakalpayet| cakraśaṅkhagadāyuktaṃ vīramārgeṇa kalpayet || 76 || gadāṃ vāme vare pāṇau kalpayedvijayāya vai| nirāyudhaṃ tathā devaṃ virahaṃ parikalpayet || 77 || tāmrajaṃ dhruvaberaṃ cedvyaktaṃ sarvāṅgasundaram| kārāyitvā pratiṣṭhāpya tathā parvaṇi parvaṇi || 78 || suddhodairabhiṣicyaiva vastrādyairapi bhūṣayet| ekabairapratiṣṭhā cedvarṇahīnaṃ śilāmayam || 78 || lauhaṃ vā brāhmabhāge tu sthāpayitvā samarcayet| ekaberavidhānena lohabere pratiṣṭhite || 79 || arcyamāne punarguṃpte coraśatrubhayādibhiḥ| sthāne tasya yathālābhapramāṇena śilāmayam || 80 || saṃsthāpya jaṅgamaṃ tasmin nityapūjāṃ samācaret| coraśatrubhaye śānte samuddhrutya purātanam || 81 || śilāberātsamāvāhya lohabere samarcayet| athavā lauhaberasya pramāṇena śilāmayam || 82 || kṛtvā'calaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhruvārcāsthāpanoktavat| laihaberaṃ ca tattasmin utsavā parikalpayet || 83 || dhruvasthityanurodhena parivārāṃśca tān sarvān tattadāvaraṇeṣu ca| dhruve sthite sthitānkuryā dāsīnānāsane sthitān || 84 || āsīnānvā sthitānvāpi śayane parikalpayet| viṣvaksenaśca vidhneśo rohiṇyo mātarastathā || 85 || jyeṣṭhā ca sarvadā''sīnā iti pūrvajadarśanam| vāhvantaṃ vā stanāntaṃ vā nābhyantaṃ vā dhruvasya ca || 86 || brahmeśāvamitaṃ sūrya tatsamānvā prakalpayet| tattribhāgaikabhāgādimānaiḥ kuryācca kautukam || 87 || deveśādhikamānena parivārānna kalpayet| berāṇāmupādāna dravyaniyamaḥ dhruvaberaṃ tu yaddravyaṃ taddravyeṇa ca pārṣadān || 88 || viṣvaksenaraviskandāḥ durgā garuḍa eva ca| śaile'pi vā na doṣassyāditi pūrvajadarśanam || 89 || dhruvakautukasaṃyukte tathā vai pariṣadgaṇāḥ| dhruvārcanaṃ dhruvārcāyāṃ viparītaṃ na kārayet || 90 || berāṇāṃ sthānaniyamaḥ beraviśeṣāṇāṃ mukhaniyamaḥ dvārapālāḥ prakatravyāḥ kiṃcidvāranirīkṣakāḥ| bahirmukhā vimāneśāḥ prāsādāśrayamandirāḥ || 91 || īśānasomayormadhye dakṣiṇābhimukho'mitaḥ| śrībhūtāridhvajāmbhojayūtheśāścākṣahā tathā || 92 || kalpyā bahirmukhā eva vīśastvabhimukho mataḥ| devāgre sthāpayedetāṃstattadāvaraṇe pṛthak || 93 || anapāyinaḥ śrībhūtaścaiva garūḍaḥ prathamāvaraṇe sthitau| cakradhvajābjayūtheśā dvitīyāvaraṇādiṣu || 94 || ete'napāyinaḥ proktā viṣvaksenasamanvitāḥ| prākārāśrayavāsāḥ syuranye vāstunirīkṣakāḥ || 15 || taptahāṭakasaṅkāśāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇām| tisṛbhiḥ puṣpacūḍābhirlalāṭopariśobhitām || 96 || sapadmavāmahastāntāṃ kakṣyābaddhaghanastanīm| prasāritetarakarāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 97 || śrīvatsādimabījāṃ tāṃ phālgune cottarodbhavām| śriyaṃ dakṣiṇapārśve tu haṃsaniryākhyavāhinīm || 98 || vāmapārśve mahīṃ śyāmāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām| vaiśākhe revatījātāṃ dadhatīṃ dakṣiṇe'mbujam || 99 || prasāritetarakarāṃ prasannendunibhānanām| mahācātakavāhāṃ tāṃ lakṣmīpūrvākṣarānvitām || 100 || śrībhūmyoḥ kecidicchanti vyatyayena karadvayam| mārkaṇḍeyabhṛgū ekajānukramāsīno bhittimūle tu dakṣiṇe || 101 || sopavīto jaṭāmauliḥ rohiṇīśo'tha phālgune| taptahāṭakasaṃkāśo mārkaṇḍeyastu pūjakaḥ || 102 || vāmapārśve bhṛguḥ kāryo jātihiṅgulikaprabhaḥ| vaiśākhe rohiṇījātaḥ khyātīśaḥ puṣpapāṇikaḥ || 103 || atrānuktaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ purāṇasyoktavadbhavet| brahmaśaṃṅkarau padmāsane samāsīno rukmavarṇaścaturmukhaḥ || 104 || kalaśākṣamālāpāṇiḥ jaṭāmauliścaturbhujaḥ| haṃso'sya vāhanaṃ proktaṃ sāvitrabhpatirucyate || 105 || caitre'bhijiti sañjātoṃ'barīṣaśśauṣikasyatu | kamaṇḍaludhvajaścāpi brahmākhyo dakṣiṇe dhruvāt || 106 || uttare dhruvaberasya pravālāgninibho bhavet| ṭaṃkaiṇadhṛt caturbāhurvyāghracarmāmbaro haraḥ || 107 || so'rdhacandrajaṭāmauliḥ piṅganetraistribhiryutaḥ| ārdrājo mārgaśīrṣe tu śivaścaṇḍīśaśaiṣikaḥ || 108 || dakṣiṇābhimukhaścaiva vṛṣabhadhvajavāhanaḥ| pārvatīśaśśūlapāṇiḥ pūjyaścātra pinākavān || 109 || kautukadvitīyāvaraṇe śivādayaḥ śivaḥ śubheśvaraḥ śyāmaḥ savārikalaśadhvajaḥ| bherīśabdaravo raktavāsāśca gajavāvahanaḥ || 110 || viśvaḥ śyāmanibhaścaiva śuddeśo vediketukaḥ| hayaśca vāhanaṃ tasya mitraśśyāmo'ruṇāmbaraḥ || 111 || sruvadhvajaśca mitreśaḥ atriḥ śyāmassatīśvaraḥ| juhudhvajo raktavarṇo ruruvāhana eva ca || 112 || māghamāse tu rohiṇyāṃ jātāste tu bahirmukhāḥ| sanatkumārasanakasanātanasandatāḥ || 113 || hemābhāḥ śuklavasanāḥ taiṣyamāse tu puṣyajāḥ| kūrcadhvajā iti dhyeyāssarve te brahmacakhariṇaḥ || 114 || dhātrādayo dvāradevāḥ veṇupatranibho dhātā rathayāna udaṅmukhaḥ| puṣpaketuḥ sandhinīśo raktavastrañca dakṣiṇe || 115 || vidhātā śukapatrābha ūrdhveśo gajavāhanaḥ| sarpadhvajaḥ śuklavastraḥ pūjyāvetau kavāṭayoḥ || 116 || bhuvaṅgo dakṣiṇaśirā uttarāṅghriḥ khalocanaḥ| prītīśo'gniśikhāketurnīlotpaladalaprabhaḥ || 117 || hastajo māghamāse tu hadī vṛṣabhavāhanaḥ| pataṅgo'dhomukhaścordhvaḥ śuklābhaḥ pauṣyahastajaḥ || 118 || bharaṇīśa uttaraśirāḥ aśvayānadhvajastathā| kavāṭordhvaśilāśliṣṭaḥ pūjyo raktāmbaro'malaḥ || 119 || patiro hemavarṇābhaḥ kiñciddhāṭakamiśritaḥ| udaṅmukho raktavastro vṛṣāṅko gajavāhanaḥ || 120 || nāgeśo māghamāse tu tathā hastarkṣajaḥ smṛtaḥ| varaṇo hemapadmābhaḥ kiñciddhāṭakamiśritaḥ || 121 || dharaṇīśaḥ phālgune tu hastajo rathavāhanaḥ| śaradhvajo'tra pūjyaśca dvārabhāge tu vāmataḥ || 122 || dvāre dvāre tu dhātrādīn ṣaḍetānsamyagarcayet| maṇikādayo dvārapālāḥ maṇikaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca śukapatrāmbaraṃ tathā || 123 || upavītājinoddīptaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ jaṭādharam| hṛdaye'ñjalisaṃyuktaṃ sandhyānāthaṃ sruvadhvajam || 124 || sthitaṃ dvāraṃ samīkṣyaiva dvāranirgamadakṣiṇe| caitre māse ca rohiṇyāṃ jātaṃ dvibhujamarcayet || 125 || vāme sandhyāṃ ca hemābhāṃ hṛdaye'ñjalisaṃyutām| saumyajāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi dvibhujāṃ kusumāmbarām || 126 || tasya dvitīyadvārasya bahiḥ pārśve ca dakṣiṇe| śātātapaṃ ca divyeśaṃ kuśadhvajamṛṣīśvaram || 127 || caitre tu rohiṇījātaṃ jaṭāmauliṃ caturbhujam| sphaṭikābhaṃ nīlavastraṃ ruruvāhanamarcayet || 128 || tāpasaṃ vāmapārśve tu śyāmābhaṃ ruruvāhanam| phālgune puṣyajaṃ kūrcadhvajaṃ sandhīśamarcayet || 129 || śrībhūtaḥ raktāmbaradharaṃ caiva dvibhujaṃ jaṭilaṃ tathā| sopānamadhye śrībhūtamarcayedvahirānanam || 130 || virājeśaṃ bhūtaketuṃ jyeṣṭhamāse dhaniṣṭhajam| nyakṣādayaḥ nyakṣo dūrvāṅkurābhaśca prajñāptīśo'ruṇāmbaraḥ || 131 || śyenayānadhvajo daṇḍapāṇirvīraravadhvaniḥ| rohiṇyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu māsi jāto bahirmukhaḥ || 132 || vivasvān raktavarṇaśca tathaivotsādinīpatiḥ| bhiṇḍivāladhvajaścaiva daṇḍī gavayavāhanaḥ || 133 || proṣṭhapāde maghodbhūto dvibhujo nīlavastrakaḥ| mitro bahuprajānātho śarabhāṇḍanibhastathā || 134 || kapotavāhanaścaiva meghanādaravastathā| dvibhujo raktavarṇaśca pūpaketurhalāyudhaḥ || 135 || jyeṣṭhājo māsi vaiśākhe dhāmapālastu paścime| eṣa paṅktīśanāmāṃ hi bhittāvabhimukhe'rcayet || 136 || kṣattā padmanibhaścaiva vāṇīnāthissatāmbaraḥ| kuśadhvajaścakrahetissāvādrāṇākavāhanaḥ || 137 || śrāvaṇe śravaṇodbhūto dvibhujaḥ pūjya uttare| haviḥ pāla haviḥ pālo'sito vidyutpatiḥ kālāgniśūladhṛt || 138 || rohiṇyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu jāto raktāmbarastathā| puṣpeśaḥ puṣpeśaḥ puṣpavacchyāmaḥ tathāpi naravāhanaḥ || 139 || puṣpāyudho mānaketuḥ cetre'nūrādhajastathā| balīśo bālikeśo'dridhvajo daṇḍī sitāsitaḥ || 140 || mṛgendravāhanaścaitre saumyajo raktavastradhṛt | indrādayo lokapālāḥ indrassasyanibhaḥ śyāmo dvibhujaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ || 141 || śacīśaḥ pītavastraśca jyeṣṭājaḥ śrāvaṇe tathā| kirīṭī mukuṭī daṇḍī cakhasīnaścennirāyudhaḥ || 142 || sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ| veṇudhvajo medharavo gajavāhaśśacīpatiḥ || jakārabījasayuktaḥ indraśśacyāḥ patistathā| puruhūtastathā proktaḥ purūndaramathārcayet || abhyantaramukhañcaiimindra caiva samarcayet| āgneyyā kārtike māsi vahrijā'tassa eva hi || kiṃśukīpuṣpasaṅkāśaśśaktipāṇiśca kuṇḍalī| keyūrābharaṇaścaiva śukapiñchāmbarastathā || kapidhvajo meṣavāha svāhāpatirathāpi vā| rakārabījasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadamukhastathā || āsīnañca praṇamyaiva pūjayecca viśeṣataḥ| yāmye mithunamāse tu bharaṇyāṃ jāta eva ca śyāmābho raktavastraśya vyāladhvajasamanvitaḥ| mahiṣo vāhanañcaiva phakāraṃ bījameva ca || śukāṅgīdevīsahitaḥ ghaṇṭānādaravastathā| kirīṭī mukuṭī daṇḍī pāśahastastathaiva ca || iti pāṭho dṛśyate| kṛttikāsvanale jāto mārgaśīrṣe tu māsi vai| kiñjatkapuñjasadṛśo lohitākṣo'javāhanaḥ || 143 || devyau svāhā svadhā tasya śaktirāyudhamasya vai| phālgune bharaṇījāto yamo nīlotpalaprabhaḥ || 144 || satyavratāpatirdaṇḍī pāśī mahiṣavāhanaḥ| ārambhādhipatistaiṣye mūlajo bhañjanīpatiḥ || 145 || śārdūlavāhanaścaiva śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ| caitre śatabhiṣagjāto varuṇo nīlavarṇakaḥ || 146 || daṇḍapāśakaro raktāmbaro dviradavāhanaḥ| kanakeśassiṃhaketuḥ pratīcyāṃ prāṅṛmukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 147 || vāyuḥ svacchāmbusaṅkāśaśśūlapāṇiśca khaḍgadhṛt| svātijaḥ kārtike māsi devī tasyāñjanā matā || 148 || pītāmbaradharo vīraḥ kṛṣṇasārarathadhvajaḥ| kubero daṇḍapāṇistu sahaṃsarathavāhanaḥ || 149 || tripādyavanalānāthaḥ śraviṣṭhājaśca kārtike| śyāmo raktāmbaradhara udīcyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ, || 150 || ārdrāyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu jāta īśāna ucyate| pāṭalīkusumābhastu vṛṣabhadhvaja vāhanaḥ || 151 || trilocano'mbikānāthaḥ śūlapāṇiścacarmadhṛt| mārtāṇḍaḥ padmahastaśca pṛṣṭhe maṇḍalasaṃyutaḥ || 152 || catuṣpādo dvipādo vā palāśakusumaprabhaḥ| śrāvaṇe hastajo devyai reṇukā ca suvarcalā || 153 || saptasaptisamāyukto ratho vāhanamucyate| anūrussārathissarpo dhvajasturaga eva vā || 154 || viṣvaksenaḥ śāntassomeśayormadhye hyāsīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ| śrīvatsaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca vinā sarvaṃ hareriva || 155 || pralambasūtra padavyutpattiḥ pralambāsurasaṅgāme hyapavītaṃ tu śārṅgiṇaḥ| tadāyudhaparicchinnamekasūtraṃ pralāmbitam || 156 || tadabhyarthanayā tacca tathaiva dhṛtameva hi| lambayajñopavītitvaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti śārṅgiṇaḥ || 157 || tadasādhāraṇaṃ nāma loke'smin prathitaṃ pṛthu | tatsūtraṃ lambitaṃ chedādgatvā'dho dakṣiṇastanāt || 158 || ākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmaṃ pādaṃ prasārya ca| jayayā sārdhamāsīnaḥ puṣpahasto'gnisannibhaḥ || 160 || gadāśaktikaro vā'tha pūjyaḥ sthānābhivṛddhaye| caturbhujo yadi bhavencchaṅkhacakre gadāvarau || 161 || sasyaśyāmanibhau devyau sarvamanyacca pūrvavat| pūrvāṣāḍhāsamudbhūto māsi bhādrapade tathā || 162 || dhruvakautukasaṃyuktamuttamaṃ paricakṣate| madhyamaṃ caikaberaṃ syādadhamaṃ pīṭhapūjanam || 163 || grāmasya yajamānasya cānukūlapramāṇataḥ| viṣvaksenaṃ prakurvīta mūlaberavaśāttu vā || 164 || āyādayo na kartavyā mūlaberavaśādyadi| garūtmān garuḍo vedamūrtistu taptahāṭakasannibhaḥ || 165 || śupiñchāmbaradharo jhallarīkhalāyutaḥ| kiṅkiṇījālasaṃyuktaḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadahāraghṛt || 166 || channavīrottarābaddhaḥ kauberamakuṭojjavalaḥ| taiṣye svātidine jātaḥ tathā śvasanavāhanaḥ || 167 || trivṛttasya śirassāma gāyatraṃ cakṣureva ca| ātmā stomāhvayaṃ sāma vāmadevyaṃ tanustathā || 168 || bṛhadrathantare pakṣau yajñāyajñiyapucchakaḥ| chandāṃsyaṅgāni vai tasya yajūṃṣi ca śaphāḥ smṛtāḥ || 169 || evaṃ dhyātvā'rcayedvīśaṃ vāhanānāṃ tu vṛddhaye| vakratuṇḍaḥ pravālābhaścaturbāhurekadaṃṣṭro gajānanaḥ || 170 || caitre māse śraviṣṭhājaḥ kadalīmodakekṣughṛt| anantaḥ dakṣiṇe gopurādvāhye vāme'nantassitaprabhaḥ || 171 || āśreṣājaśca vaiśākhe dvibāhuśca surāpatiḥ| phaṇāmaṇḍalamadhyasthaḥ prāñjalirbhujagādhipaḥ || 172 || bhaumaḥ śaktipāṇistathā bhaumaḥ kadambakusumaprabhaḥ| devī ca kumudā tasya varāho vāhanaṃ tathā || 173 || pūrvāṣāḍhāsamudbhūto jyeṣṭhamāse kujastathā| śanaiñcaraḥ sauriṃ kṛṣṇanibhaṃ kuryāt kuśacīrāmbaraṃ tathā || 174 || māghamāse tu revatyāṃ jātaṃ nīlotpaladhvajam| syandanaṃ vāhanaṃ tasya varāhoragasaṃyutam || 175 || bṛhaspatiḥ kuryādbuhaspatiṃ pītaṃ kadalovanamadhyagam| kuśadhvajaṃ haṃsarathaṃ puṣpaśyāmāmbarojjvalam || 176 || āṣāḍhe tiṣyasambhūtaṃ tārāṃ devīṃ ca tasya vai| budhaḥ budhaṃ sasyanibhaṃ kuryāccharabāṇāsanānvitam || 177 || buddhādevīsamāyuktaṃ vāmadevāśvavāhanam| śrāvaṇe ca śraviṣṭātajaṃ darpaṇaṃ dhvajameva ca || 178 || śukraḥ śukro rajitavarṇaśca jaṭābhṛdvalkalāmbaraḥ| jayantīśo'mbararatho māghamāse tu bhāgyajaḥ || 179 || jāhravī jāhravīṃ śvetaraktābhāṃ pītavastrāṃ tathaiva ca| vibhajyaikadalaṃ hastenā'ghrāyantīṃ tadambujam || 180 || aśvayuṅmāsi revatyāṃ jātāṃ tāṃ lohitadhvajām| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ gaṅgāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 181 || candraḥ ātreyaṃ harivatkuryācchīttamaṇḍalamadhyagam| tatra ruvakmanibhaṃ śvetamiśramāvartakaṃ smṛtam || 182 || rājānaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuryādrohiṇīvallarbhaṃ tathā| caitre mṛgaśirojātaṃ sāśvasyandanavāhanam || 183 || padmapīṭhe samāsīnāṃ maṇḍale cordhvakarṇikai| tathā prasṛtike kuryāddervī dhṛtakuśeśayām || 84 || śātakumbhamayaiḥ kumbhairdiggajairabhiṣecitām| krīḍantīṃ viṣṇunā vā'tha śrīdevīṃ kārayedabudhaḥ || 185 || saptarohiṇyaḥ mayūravāhā rohiṇyaḥ kṛkalāsadhvajapriyāḥ| puṣpāmbarāḥ puṣpahastāḥ śukakañcukasaṃyautāḥ || 186 || rohiṇīsambhavāstaisye nitṛyaṃ lokaprasādakāḥ| dhātrī kuryāddhātrīṃ mahīraudrīṃ daṃṣṭrābhyāmapyalaṅkatām || 187 || bālamaulyuttarāsaṅgāṃ tāṃ triśūlāṃ ca ṣaḍbhujām| raktogranayanāpāṅgīṃ bhrūbhaṅgavikaṭograkām || 188 || narastrīṇāmiva tanumatiraudrīṃ samācaret| jyeṣṭhā kapālavāmahastāṃ ca raktakuñcitamūrdhajām|| 189 || uṣṭrapīṭhe samāsīnāmaṭṭahāsasamanvitām| caitre yāmyarkṣasañjātāmulkādhvajasamanvitām || 190 || tripīṭhakākhyāpīṭhe ca jyeṣṭhāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ| prasārāsanagāṃ sthāne na daive mānuṣāṃśake || 191 || vāmahastena sampūrṇaṃ vahantīṃ nidhibhājanam| dakṣiṇaṃ puṣpahastaṃ ca kiṃcillambodarīṃ śubhām || 192 || saraktapuṣpavastrāṃ tāmatipīnacalastanīm| tasyāśca dakṣiṇe putraṃ tasyā vāhupramāṇataḥ || 193 || pītaṃ samṛṣakaṃ nāma śuklavarṇā'hitāmbaram| tadāsane sahāsīnaṃ daṇḍapāṇikamunnatam || 194 || vṛṣabhāgaṃ śirastasya pūrvoktaṃ kiñcḷdunnatam| vāme sumāñjaliṃ tasyāssutāṃ paramalālitām || 195 || ardhasācīkṛte tasyāḥ svārdhāsanasamāsthite| raktanīlaparītāṅgīṃ raktotpalakarāmbujām || 196 || ekapādaprasārāṃ tāmekamākuñcitāsanām| pañcāśatkharasaṃyuktarathastasyāstu vāhanam || 197 || kṛṣṇakākadhvajāṃ jyeṣṭhāsambhavāṃ mārgaśīrṣake| bhṛgvādayaḥ saptarṣayaḥ navārdhatālamānena māṃ ca kuryāccaturbhujam || 198 || brāhmamāsanamāsīnaṃ brahmāñjalikaradvayam| aṅke vāmamathottānaṃ prasṛtaṃ tasya copari || 199 || hastaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ tasmāduparyuttānamācaret| ātmanāsāgragā dṛṣṭiryogadṛṣṭiriti smṛtā || 200 || dakṣiṇe cordhvage haste kalaśaṃ dhārayet bhṛguḥ| vāme sa śikyaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ brahmadaṇḍaṃ ca vaiṇavam || 201 || jātihiṅgulikābhaṃ vai sajaṭāmakuṭojjavalam| tāmrāsyanayanaṃ kuryātsumukhaṃ mṛgacarmiṇam || 202 || brahyāsane samāsīnaṃ marīcimanalaprabham| ṣaḍaṅghrivāhanaṃ mālāyudhaṃ sumatimañjalim || 203 || tasyotpattiḥ tathā''ṣāḍhe nakṣatraṃ pūrvaphalgunī| dhvajaśca brahmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvamanyad bhṛgoriva || 204 || pulastyaḥ kāñcanābho'yamāsīno brāhmamāsanam| prītīśaśśaṅkhahetiśca tathā ṣaṭpadavāhanaḥ || 205 || caitre'nūrādhasañjātaḥ ūrvāṇākhyo dhvajastathā| pulahastāmravarṇo'yamāsīnaśca pulastyavat || 206 || kṣamādhīśaḥ kṣamādhairyastulādhāro'sya vāhanam| hastajaścāśvayuṅmāsi sarvamanyadbhṛgoriva || 207 || sannatīśaḥ ṛtuśśuklo vaiśākhe māsi hastajaḥ| baḍabā bāhanaṃ proktaṃ sarvamanyadbhṛgoriva || 208 || vasiṣṭho'tha haridrābho'runghatīśastathaiva ca| ūrvāṇādhvajasaṃyukto vaṣaṭkārākhyavāhanaḥ || 209 || taiṣye puṣyarkṣasañjāto brahmadaṇḍāyudhastathā| anasūyāpatistvatrirmadhuvarṇo'sya vāhanam || 210 || vaṣaṭkāraśca ūrvāṇadhvajaḥ śravaṇasambhavaḥ| kārtikyāṃ māsi sambhūtaḥ sarvamanyadbhṛgoriva || 211 || dvibāhavo marīcyādyā aṅke vāmakaraṃ tathā| tadūrdhve dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimūttānaṃ parikalpayet || 212 || marīciḥ pulahaścaiva pulastyaḥ kratureva ca| vasiṣṭho'trirahaṃ caivamṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 213 || sambhūtiśca kṣamā prītiḥ sannatyūrjā'nasūyakāḥ| arundhatī kramādetāḥ kartavyāstaissahāsane || 214 || gaviṣṭhaḥ gaviṣṭho hi mahābhūtaścendīvaradalaprabhaḥ| makuṭī pītavāsāśca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 215 || sa satyalocaneśaśca daṇḍī kumbhakavāhanaḥ| bheruṇḍaketussaṃprokto mārudravarasaṃ tathā || 216 || caitre citrarkṣasambhūto yoṣāsyātsatsatyalocanā| vāyuḥ vāyuśśyāmo'sipāṇistu plavakākhyāhivāhanaḥ || 217 || śaṅkhadhvajo hraṃsaravo māghe svātīdinodbhavaḥ| udāyinīśvaraścaiva pītavastra iti smṛtaḥ || 218 || agnissuvarṇarṇe'yamarciṣkeśaśca śaktibhṛt| vaḍabāvāhanaścaiva svāheśo vānaradhvajaḥ || 219 || proṣṭhapāde'gnibhodbhūto nīlavastrastathaiva ca| eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ devyaśca pṛthaksthāne samācaret || 220 || toyam toyaṃ cāñjanavarṇañca tathā vṛṣabhavāhanam| haripiñjaravāsaḥ syādbhūtametaccaturguṇam || 221 || toyaṃ napuṃsakaṃ ceti muniśśātātapo'bravīt| galakākhyaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva tathodagraravadhvaniḥ || 222 || ūrmyāyutaṃ tathā''ṣāḍhe saumyanakṣatrasambhavam| hariṇīṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ tāṃ śvetavastrāṃ kirīṭinīm || 223 || padmahastāṃ kṣamāṃ devīṃ padmanetrāṃ subhūṣitām| sāvitrī sāvitrīṃ dhvajinīṃ cāpi śvetavastrāṃ susaṃsthitām| vidyāṃ caturbhujāṃ kuryādraktāmṛtakuśeśayām || 225 || dakṣiṇe tvakṣamālāṃ ca kare vāme kamaṇḍalum| jñānamudrāṃ dakṣiṇe'tha kare vāme'tha pustakam || 226 || taiṣye punarvasūdbhūtā tatra pūjyādhikena sā| sarveśvaraḥ sarveśvaro'mbuvāhābhaṣṣaṅghidhvajavāhanaḥ || 227 || śvetavastradharo daṇḍī kumbhaśabdaravastathā| taiṣye puṣyabhavaḥ śvetavastraścaivorūṣṭravāhanaḥ || 228 || saptamātaraḥ brahmaṇīṃ piṃgalāñcaiva caturvaktrāṃ caturbhujām| kalaśākṣamālāṃ dadhatīṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitām || 229 || darbhadhvajāṃ haṃsarathāṃ caitre yāmyadinodbhavām| saritpriyāṃ śyāmavārṇāṃ śūlahastāṃ caturbhujām || 230 || tasyā haṃso dhvajaḥ proktaḥ saurabheyī ca vāhanam| vaiśākhe revatījātāṃ raktavastrāṃ trilocanām || 239 || maulau veṇīsamāyuktāṃ bhīmarūpāṃ bhayānakām| vaiśākhinī svarṇanibhā śaktihastā caturbhujā || 232 || kṛkalāsadhvajā raktavasanā ca guhādhipā| jyeṣṭhamāse tathā devī kṛktikarkṣasamudbhavā|| 233 || śaṅkhacakradharā śyāmā vaiṣṇavī nīlavāsinī phālgune śravaṇodbhūtā garuḍadhvajavāhanā|| 234 || vārāhī kṛṣṇavarṇā ca varāhavadanā tathā| śaṅkhacatradharā caiva varāhadhvajavāhanā || 235 || pauṣe śravaṇasambhūtā raktavastrā saturbhujā| indraṇī yavasaśyābhā vajrahastā caturbhujā|| 236 || śvetavastrasamāyuktā śukatuṇḍākhyavāhanā| veṣṇupatradhvajā māghe jyeṣṭhānakṣatrasambhavā|| 267 || kālī karālavadanā kālāṅgī coṣṭravāhanā| piśācāṅkadhvajā caiva vahrijvālābhamūrdhajā || 238 || proṣṭhapāde yamodbhūtā śūlapāśakapālinī| raktogranayanāpāṅgā bhūbhaṅgavikṛtānanā || 239 || narastrīṇāmiva mukhaṃ daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ samalaṅkatam| trinetryardhendumakuṭā nāgābharaṇasaṃyutāḥ || 240 || prasārāsanamāsīnāssaptamātara īritāḥ| prasārāsanalakṣaṇam dakṣiṇaṃ pādamākuñcya vāmaṃ pādaṃ prasārya ca || 241 || prasārāsanamityuktaṃ strabhṇāṃ sāmānyameva tat| skandaḥ skandaḥ palāśapuṣpābhaḥ ṣaṭbhujo vā caturbhujaḥ || 242 || bālo maulisamāyuktaḥ devayānīpatistathā| mayaravāhanaśśāktidharaḥ kukkuṭaketukaḥ || 243 || phālgune kṛttikodbhūto hastī vā tasya vahanam| hastī navahastamitaṃ kuryādutsedhaṃ saptahastakam || 244 || āyāmārdhaṃ tataḥ pādaṃ śeṣaṃ nāhamudāhṛtam| prādeśikaṃ tato vidyā cchirasoraskatastayoḥ || 245 || nāhenārdhaparīṇāhaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu gātrayoḥ | gātrāntareṣu teṣāṃ vai sarva boddhavyamityataḥ || 248 || airāvataṃ vinā'nyeṣāṃ nīlavarṇamudāhatam| kaṇṭheṣu dvādaśāyāmaṃ kariṇāṃ parirucyate || 249 || satālanavahastaḥ syādutsedhaḥ kariṇāṃ pateḥ| akṣimocanam pratiṣṭhoktadinātpūrva pañcame'hyakṣimocanam| prapāyāṃ maṇḍape vā'tha kūṭe vā'bhimukhe kṛte || 63 || aupāsanāgnimādhāya paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ kṛtvā bimbasya śodhanam || 44 || devaṃ dviratnivistāre dhānyapīṭhe niveśya ca| aupāsanāgnimādhāya kṛtvā''ghāraṃ yathāvidhi || 65 || kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'pi cāṅgahomassuhūyatām| bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāṃ mantrairapi ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 66 || sūktena pauruṣeṇāpi jayādyaiśca tathaiva ca| sthūpyādyupānaparyantamaṅgānāṃ nāmabhistathā || 67 || varṇaṃ suvarṇapātreṇa hematūlikayā''haret| devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sthitvā''cārya udaṅmukhaḥ || 68 || navenaivāmbareṇaiva pracchādyābhimukhe hareḥ| varṇe mahīṃ samabhyarcya tatpātre ca divākaram || 69 || tūlikāyāṃ tathā candramātmasūktaṃ japettataḥ| varṇaṃ tūlikayā'dāya sūktaṃ pauruṣamuccaram || 70 || dakṣiṇe nayane vāme 'tvato di vaiṣṇavam| pakṣma varma ca raktaṃ ca śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca taijasam || 71 || maṇḍalāni ṣaḍeteṣāṃ mahābhūtāni pañca ca| daiktaṃ paramātmānaṃ kramātsmṛtvā samācaret || 72 || pracchannapaṭamuddhṛtya darśanīyāni darśayet| darśanadravyadarśanam dhānyarāśiṃ tu kutvā tu tilarāśiṃ prakalpayet || 73 || ājyaṃ dadhi madhu kṣīraṃ prasthamātraṃ pṛthak pṛthak| kāṃsyapātre gṛhītvaiva suvarṇakalaśānvitam || 74 || daṇḍake dhānyapīṭhe tu sthāpayedutṛtarādikam| sāmavedaṃ yajurvedamṛgvedātharvedakau pa || 75 || krameṇa devatāḥ pūjyā gāmekāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām| svarṇaśṛṅgāṃ raupyakhurāṃ savastrāṃ kāṃsyadohanām || 76 || savatsāṃ pūrṇapuṣṭāṃṅgo devāgre sthāpayedbudhaḥ| dhānyarāśau tathā somaṃ tilarāśau pitṝnapi || 77 || gosāvitrī japtvā 'śuddhā ima iti gosāvitrīmanusmaran| pūjayettattadaṅgeṣu taduktā devatā api || 78 || tatṛṇamuṣṭiṃ pradāyā'syai gosūktenābhimṛśya ca| gosūktam atra 'gāvo hima' iti gosūktamabhidhīyate || 79 || 'imā oṣadhaya' ityuktā tiladhānye ca darśayet| ājyaṃ sāmādimantreṇa yajurvedādinā dadhi || 80 || madhva 'gnimīla' ityukṛtā kṣīraṃ 'śanna' iti bruvan| godānasūktam godānasūktamuccārya 'āgodānātpaṭhe' diti || 81 || savatsāṃ caiva gāmuktāṃ darśayitvā'tisundarīm devyauśca darśanīyāni darśayecca pṛthak pṛthak || 82 || śailabimbānāṃ viśeṣaḥ śailasya varṇahīnasya lohajānāṃ tathaiva ca| kṛtvā dṛḍhakarīṃ sūcīṃ tābhyāṃ pakṣmādimaṇḍalam || 83 || mantreṇa kalpayedanyat dhruvaberokṛtavadbhavet| dravyāṇi darśanīyāni pṛthageva prakalpayet || 84 || parivārāṇāmakṣimocanam munyādidiparivārāṇāṃ tattanmatraṃ pṛthak pṛthak| hutvā tu daśakṛtvastu tanmntrairakṣimocanam || 85 || pātreṣu darśayetteṣāṃ pañcagavyaṃ pṛthakpṛthak| sahadevaṃ na cetteṣāṃ pṛthagdhomaṃ na kārayet || 86 || śilpisparśaśuddhiḥ śūlagrahaṇamārabhya yāvadevākṣimocanam| śilpisparśaviśuddhyarthamakṣyunmeṣādanantaram || 87 || ṣoḍaśaprasthasampūrṇaṃ kumbhaṃ sūtreṇa veṣṭayet| pūrayitvā tathā toyairvastrābhyāmabhiveṣṭayet || 88 || pallavāni kuśāgrāṇi dūrvāgrāṇi tathā'kṣatam| suvarṇaṃ puṇyapuṣpāṇi viṣṇugāyatriyā nyaset || 89 || uttarābhimukhaḥ paścādvāhmamāsanamāsthitaḥ| caturvedādimantrāṃśca 'āpa undantu' vai kramāt || 90 || japan puruṣasūktañca mantrānapi ca vaiṣṇavān| kūrcenaiva tu tattoyamabhimṛśya samāhitaḥ || 91 || sakāñcanena kūrcena tatkumbhasthena vāriṇā| 'āpo hiraṇyavarṇā dyaiḥ pavamānādibhistribhiḥ || 92 || 'śanno devī' ti mantreṇa puṃsūktena ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ| śuddyarthaṃ prokṣayedveraṃ puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 93 || evaṃ citrapratiṣṭhāyāṃ citrābhāse ca kārayet| adhivāsāḥ bimbānāṃ kautukādīnāmadhivāsanamārabhet || 94 || pañcagavyādhivāsaḥ ālayasyottare pārśve prapāyāmavaṭe kṛte| laghuberaṃ jaladroṇyāṃ pañcagavyādibhiḥstṛte || 95 || ājyaṃ 'śukrama' sītyuktvā ṣoḍaśaṃśaṃ pragṛhya ca| 'dadhikrāvṇṇa' ityukvā kṣipatvā tavddiguṇaṃ dadhi || 96 || 'āpyā' sveti mantreṇa triguṇaṃ kṣīramāharet| 'gandhadvā' reti mantreṇa gomayañca caturguṇam || 97 || ṣaḍguṇaṃ caiva gomūtraṃ gāyatryā tatra nikṣipet| 'vasoḥ pavitra' mityuktvā tenāpūryāvaṭaṃ punaḥ || 98 || pañcagavye 'śivaṃ śarvamīśamavyakta' marcayet| viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya prākchirastatra śāyayet || 99 || atīte taddine bimbaṃ viṣṇusūktena coddharet| 'vārī ścatastra' ityuktvā śuddhodairabhiṣicca ca || 100 || kṣīrādhivāsaḥ saṃśoddhyaiva jaladroṇīṃ 'śanno devī' ti mantrataḥ| kṣīreṇa pūrayitvā'tra 'atharvaṃ kṣīra' mityapi || 101 || 'pavitraṃ puṇya' mityukvā kṣīre'tharvāṇamarcayet| padmotpalādipuṣpāṇi samāstīrya ca tatra vai || 102 || śayanāni ca pañcātra samāstīrya kuśaissaha| kṣīraṃ kṣīrodadhiṃ tatra śāyinaṃ śeṣaśāyinam || 103 || devadevaṃ smaraṃstatra pūrvavacchāyayeddharim| atīte taddine bimbaṃ paścāduddhṛtya pūrvavat || 104 || saṃsnāpya bhūṣayitvaiva navavastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ| jalādhivāsaḥ nadītaṭākavāpīṣu pūrvālābhe tathottare || 105 || prapāṃ kṛtvā tu paritaḥ pañcaraṃ jālakākṛtim| kārayitvā tu rakṣārthaṃ vitānādyupaśobhitam || 106 || navavastrāṇi cāstīryadarbhapuṣpakuśaissaha| 'puṇyaṃ tortha śivaṃ toya' miti tatra samarcayet || 107 || pūrvavacchayane devaṃ śāyayedapramādataḥ| 'evaṃ kartumaśaktaścettridinaṃ kevale jale || 108 || dinamekamaharvā'tha yāmaṃ vā kālameva vā| mantravadvimbaśuddhyarthamadhivāsaṃ samācaret || 109 || aśakyaverasyasnāpanam peñcagavyaiśca kṣīreṇa kuśodaiśca pṛthakpṛthak || 110 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ kumbhān pūrayitvā'tra devatāḥ| pūrvavatpūjayitvaiva mantrairevābhiṣecayet || 111 || pratiṣṭhādinapūrvadinakṛtyam sāyaṃ homāvasāne tu ācāryādyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 112 || prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā japtvā sūktāni pūrvavat| tathā'nuṣṭitakarmāṇaṃ yajamānaṃ tato guruḥ || 113 || 'aṇoraṇīyā' nityuktvā prokṣayevddijamatvaraḥ| ṛtvijastāntsamāhūya niyuñjīta svakarmasu || 114 || vāstuśuddhiḥ tasyā''layasyottarataḥ kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'thavā| vāstuhomaṃ tathā hutvā garbhagehādisarvataḥ || 115 || paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ puṇyāhenāpi śodhayet| agnimathanam devālayasyābhimukhe pañcavarṇairalaṅkate || 116 || dhānyarāśyupari nyasya tvaraṇī prāṅmukhaśśuciḥ| manthadaṇḍe hariṃ dhyāyedaraṇyāṃ medinīṃ tathā || 117 || ūrdhvāyāmagnibhyarcca mauñjīrajjau ca vāsukim| japan vaiśvānaraṃ sūktaṃ rajjvā manthaṃ ca veṣṭayet || 118 || 'jātavedasa' mucacārya mathanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| karīṣaṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā tatsūktenāharetpunaḥ || 119 || 'ayaṃ ta idhma' ityuktvā prakṣipedindhanāni ca| 'ghṛtapratīka' ityuktvā prajvālyāgniṃ praṇamya ca || 120 || 'āyurdā' iti mantreṇa tvapramādaṃ nidhāpayet || 121 || mathanāgnyalābhe katravyam athavā śrotriyāgarādagnimāhṛtya vai tathā| tatra vaiśvānaraṃ sūktaṃ yajediti ca kecana || 122 || vāstvagneḥkāryāntara yopayatābhāvaḥ tatsarvamaśubhaṃ karma tamagniṃ ca nirasya ca || 123 || mathitaṃ śrotriyāgārādāhṛtaṃ vā nidhāya ca| śāntihomāvasāne tu yathoktaṃ homamācaret || 124 || pañcagniṣu agnipraṇayanam 'gārhapatyāgni' mityuktvā 'yajñadaivata' mityapi || 125 || 'tartrau bhūḥ puruṣaṃ' ceti 'acyutaṃ' ceti kīrtayan| āvāhya juṣṭākārañca svāhākārañca kārayet || 126 || tasmādagniṃ samādāya dakṣiṇāgnau tataḥ param| 'jātaveda' iti procya praṇīyāgniṃ yathāvidhi || 127 || 'anvāhāryāgni' mityuktvā 'yajñadaivata' mityapi| 'oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣaṃ satyaṃ' kuryādāvāhanādikam || 128 || agniṃ tu gārhapatyāgne 'ragna āyāhi' mantrataḥ| praṇīyā'havanīyāgnau vadannāhavanīyakam || 129 || 'yajñadaivata' mityuktvā oṃ suvaḥ paruṣaṃ' tviti| uccaran 'puruṣaṃ' ceti kuryādāvāhanādikam || 130 || 'ayaṃ te yoni' rityagnimāvasathye praṇīya ca| 'āvasthyāgni' mityuktvā 'yajñadaivata' mityapi || 139 || 'oṃ mahaḥ puruṣaṃ' ceti devama 'pyaniruddhakam'| ityevamāvasathyāgnau kuryādāvāhanādikam || 132 || 'miya gṛhaṇāmi' mantreṇa sabhye cāgniṃ praṇīya ca| sabhyāgniṃ yajñade' veti 'oṃ janaḥ puruṣaṃ' tathā || 133 || 'viṣṇu' māvāhayāmīti sabhyasyāvāhanādikam| 'ghṛtapratīkaṃ ityagniṃ pauṇḍarīke praṇīye ca || 134 || 'pauṇḍarīkāgni' mityuktvā 'yajñadaivata' mityapi| 'oṃ tapaḥ puruṣaṃ' ceti 'vāsudeva' mataḥ param || 135 || 'oṃ tapaḥ puruṣaṃ' ceti 'nārāyaṇa' miti bruvan| evamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā nirupyājyā''hutīryajet || 136 || sarvāgnīnāṃ praṇayanaṃ prakuryādgārhapatyataḥ| agnidhyānam brāhmamānasamāsīnaṃ kuṇḍamadhye hutāśanam || 137 || pratyaṅmukhaṃ raktavarṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham svāhāsvadhābhyāmāsīnaṃ sarvadevātmakaṃ param || 138 || ekaṃ vai hṛdayaṃ tasya trayaḥ pādāśśirodvayam| catuśśrṛṅgaṃ caturnetraṃ saptajihvaṃ dvināsikam || 139 || dakṣiṇā'sye catustrastu tistro jihvāstathottare| sapmatahastaṃ smarannagniṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 140 || kṛṣṇājinottarāsaṅgaṃ mauñjīdaṇḍasamanvitam| strukstruvākṣasrajaśśaktiṃ dadhataṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ || 141 || cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ cā'jyapātraṃ vai vāmabāhubhiḥ| bimbañca yajñamūrtestu dhyāyedevamiti śrutiḥ || 142 || agneḥ saptajihvāḥ hiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva vasuprabhā| atiraktā bahurūpā jihvāssapta prakīrtitāḥ || 143 || īśānendrāgninirṛtivaruṇānilamadhyagāḥ| āghārānte vaiṣṇavahomaḥ āghārānte tu hotayaṃ saptajihvāsu vaiṣṇavam || 144 || jihvābhedena hiraṇyāyāṃ samiddhomaṃ kanakāyāṃ yajeddhṛtam| sarṣapāṃścaiva raktāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ lājameva ca || 145 || vasuprabhāyāṃ devantaṃ dhyātvā''pūpaṃ juhoti ca| hotavyamatiraktāyāṃ tilaṃ carvāmarapriyam || 146 || anyāni bahurupāyāṃ juhoti manasā smaran| havirviśeṣahome agnibhāvanāprakāraḥ samiddhome sthito vahriśśete sa ca ghṛtā''hutau || 147 || āsīnaścaruhome'pi tilasarṣapasaktuṣu| anyathā'gnau hutaṃ yattat sarva bhavati niṣphalam || 148 || havirbhedena āhutipramāṇam caturaṅgulisaṃsrāvāpyavicdinnā ghṛtāhutiḥ| aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrā tu gṛhītā'nnāhutiḥ smṛtā || 149 || annamakṣapramāṇaṃ syāllājaṃ muṣṭimitaṃ bhavet| tilasarṣapasaktūnāṃ śuktimātrā'hutirbhavet || 150 || homadravyādhidevāḥ ataḥ paṃra pravakṣyāmi homadravyādhidevatāḥ| sikatāyāṃ mṛdaśyaiva pṛthivī ādhidevatā || 151 || sthaṇḍilaṃ somadaivatyaṃ kuṇḍavedyā yathākramam| ūrdhvavedyadhipo brahmā madhyavedyāḥ prajāpatiḥ || 152 || sabhye ca pauṇḍarīke ca somo'dhovodidevatā| daleṣu vasavaḥ proktāḥ khananaṃ pitṛdaivatam || 153 || lekhāḥ skandādhidevatyāḥ ṛṣayassaptabarhiṣām| havyavāḍindhanādhīśo vihāro vāyudaivataḥ || 154 || pañcabhūtādhidaivatyaṃ karakaṃ samudāhṛtam| kūrcāgragraṃnthimūleṣu brahmaviṣṇavīśvarāḥ kramāt || 155 || catvāro viṣṇudaivatyāḥ paristaraṇakūrcakāḥ| paścimaḥ paridhiḥ proktastathā gandharvadaivataḥ || 156 || dakṣiṇaścendradaivatyaḥ paridhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ| uttaraḥ paridhiḥ prokto mitrāvaruṇadaivataḥ || 157 || tathordhvasamidhordevaḥ juhvādiṣu divākaraḥ || 158 || brahmasomau tu samproktau tathā praṇidhipātrayoḥ| varṣiṣṭhasamidhoragnirājyasthālyāṃ vaṃsundharā || 159 || toyasya varuṇo devaścājyasya ca hutāśanaḥ| carurindrāgnidaivatya evaṃ dhyātvā juhoti ca || 160 || homadravyaviśeṣe pātraviśeṣaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyājjuhvā caruṇā'gniṣu ṣaṭsvapi| ājyamapyagnikuṇḍeṣu sruveṇa cajuhuyāditi || 161 ||
ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre mahāpratiṣṭhākālanirṇayasaṃbhārāharaṇa-akṣimocanādhivāsatrayāśakyabimbādhivāsā''cāryānujñā'gnimathanāgnipraṇayanāgnidhyānāgnijihvāsthānanirṇayahomadravyapramāṇahomadravyādhidevanirṇayo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
<7> oṃ saptamo'dhyāyaḥ kumbhapūjāprakāraḥ jalāharaṇam prāṅgamukha prayato bhūtvā 'dhārā'sviti ca mantrataḥ| puṇyanadyāṃ jalaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhapātre samāharet || 1 || snātvā gurūḥ prasannātmā śvetagandhānulepanaḥ| uttarīyāṅgulīyaśadyairbhūṣaṇairapi bhūṣitaḥ || 2 || pādau prakṣālya cā'camya śvetamālyapariṣkṛtaḥ| kumbhalakṣaṇam dvātriṃśatprasthasampūrṇaṃ lauhaṃ mṛṇmayamevaṃ vā || 3 || pakvālakaṃphalākāraṃ khaṇḍasphuṭitavaṃrjitam| kumbhasaṃskāraḥ 'iṣe tvorje tve'ti japan 'svasti de' tyathavā punaḥ || 4 || 'indraṃ naro na' iti vā tantunā pariveṣṭayet| 'śucī vo havyā' ityuktvā prakṣālyādbhistu sarvataḥ || 5 || vastreṇotpūya tattoya 'midamāpaśśivā' iti| kuśaiḥ paścātsamutpūya kumbhaṃ tenaiva vāriṇā || 6 || 'āpa unda'ntviti japan pūrayetsusamāhitaḥ| 'āpo hi' ṣṭhetyabhimṛśetsarvagandhādhivāsitam || 7 || ratnāni gajatākṣyau ca maṅgalānyāyudhānyapi| kūrmarupaṃ ca saivarṇaṃ kuśapuṣpākṣatāni ca || 8 || sruksuvau varṇavṛddhyarthaṃ śvetacchatradhvajādikam| sannyasedviṣṇugāyatryā aṣṭaniṣkakṛtaṃ pṛthak || 9 || tāni dyaṅgulamātrāṇi sauvarṇānyeva nikṣipet| kṣaumābhyāmathavā dvābhyāṃ sūkṣmavastradvayena vā || 10 || kumbhasya veṣṭayetkaṇṭhaṃ tathā kusumadāmabhiḥ| aśvatthapallavaṃ kūrcaṃ nyaseddūrvāṅkurāṇyapi || 11 || kumbhe ratnādi prakṣepaṇaprayojanam asthi ratnaṃ sirāstanturmāṃsaṃ mṛtsnā prakīrtitā| śoṇitaṃ raktamṛttatra jalaṃ medastathaiva ca || 12 || śuklaṃ tu kūrcamityuktaṃ camā syādveṣṭanāmbaram| saptadhātava ityete kumbheṣu kalaśeṣu ca || 13 || eteṣvekaṃ vihīnaṃ cennāsti tatrā'syaṃ sannidhiḥ| ratnimātrāyate ramye tālotsedhe trivedike || 14 || devasya purataḥ kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhai tu sannyaset| akṣaranyāsaḥ veṣṭataṃ praṇavairdikṣu bījamādiṃ hṛdi nyaset || 15 || dhyānam ātmasūktaṃ tato captvā pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| nārāyaṇānuvākaṃ ca hṛdaye bhāvayejjapet || 16 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśamardhacandrasamākṛtim| vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhyāyetpūte kumbhasthavāriṇi || 17 || gurūpadeśasaṃsiddho bhagavaddhyānatatparaḥ| ācāryassuprasannātmā dhyānakarma samārabhet || 20 || svastikāsanamāsīno jitendriya udaṅgmukhaḥ| dakṣiṇaṃ pādamūrdhvañca vāmapādamadhastathā || 21 || jānvantare tadaṅguṣṭhau dvau ca samyaṅnigṛhya ca| aṅke vāmaṃ nyasetpāṇimanyañcottānamūrdhvataḥ || 22 || ṛjukāyo nivātasthapradīpa iva niścalaḥ| evaṃmāsanamāsīno nāsāntāhitalocanaḥ || 23 || prāṇānāyamya vidhinā recapūrakakumbhakaiḥ| viṣayebhyaśca sarvebhyaḥ pratyāhṛtyendriyāṇi ca || 24 || ekāgraṃ ca manaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ paśyetsamādhinā| padmakośapraṃtīkāśe viśvasyāyatane pṛthau || 26 || hṛdeya'gniśikhāmadhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ| nivāta iva dīpārcirvidyullekheva cāmbare || 27 || īśvarasyātṛmano jyotirya eṣa puruṣo'kṣaraḥ| śuddhajñānātṛmakaṃ brahma tadakṣaramudāhṛtam || 28 || yadoṅkāramayaṃ brahma samyaghghṛdi nidhāya ca| taccintanaparaṃ dhyānaṃ tadvrahmārpaṇamucyate || 29 || brahmabhūte ca dehe'smin dṛḍhaṃ kuryānmano'rpaṇam| tatrācalaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā dhāraṇāṃ sampraviśya ca || 30 || nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ nityamakṣaraṃ sarvakāraṇam| niṣkalaṃ sakanalaṃ devaṃ tejobhāsurabhāsitam || 31 || viṣṇuṃ taṃ manasā dhyāyan bhattyaiva parayā mudā| taṃ rukmavarṇaṃ raktāsyaṃ raktanetraṃ sukhodvaham || 32 || kirīṭahārakeyūrapralambabrahmasūtriṇam| kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ śrīvatsāṅkaṃ caturbhujam || 33 || śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradam| kaṭinyastetarakaraṃ śukapicchāmbaraṃ param || 34 || evaṃ taṃ paramātmānaṃ praṇavātmakamavyayam| ekāgramanasā bhaktyā sakalīkṛtya bhāvayan || 35 || kumbhe'mbhasi tato bhakyā devamāvāhayet tataḥ| āsanādibhirabhyarcedarghyādyācamanāntakaiḥ || 36 || āvāhanaśabdārthaḥ sarvatra vyāpinastasya parasya paramātmanaḥ| āvāhanaprakārabhedāḥ ekatra smaraṇaṃ yattadāvāhanamudīritam || 37 || araṇyāṃ vyāpito vahrirekatra jvalito yathā| tathā dhyānena bhakṛtasya hṛdi viṣṇuḥ prakāśate || 38 || mantrairāvāhito bere sthale kūrce jale'thavā| bhaktānukamṛpayā sthitvā pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti pūjitaḥ || 39 || vadantyāvāhanaṃ keciddharerādityamaṇḍalāt| devena saha tatkumbhe devyau dhyāyedyathāvidhi || 40 || mūlālayapratiṣṭhā cennītvā bālālayāddharim| devaṃ viśīṣato'bhyarcca havissamyaṅ nivedayet || 41 || tadvimbasaṃsthitāṃ śāktiṃ kumbhe kūrcena vinyaset| dhruvānurūpaṃ tadvimbaṃ yadi doṣavivajirtatam || 42 || tadeva kautukaṃ kuryānnānurūpaṃ tu laukikam| saṃsthāpya laukikādīnāṃ sthānādanyatra pūjayet || 43 || sadoṣaṃ bimbamambhodhau nadyāṃ vā vidhinā tyajet| bhūparīkṣādikarmārthamanyasthānasthalaukikam || 44 || yācitaṃ cetpradātavyaṃ karmānte tadyathā purā| sthāpayeddhāmni pūrvasmin utsavārthamathāpi vā || 45 || bālālayapratiṣṭhārthaṃ yācayediti kecana| anyālayadhruvasyaitadanurūpaṃ bhavedyadi || 46 || kautukaṃ cautsavā vāpi sthāpayediti kecana| snapanodyogaḥ vadan śakunasūktaṃ tu kumbhaṃ bimbaṃ samānayet || 47 || kautukaṃ pūrvato devyāvautsavaṃ snāpanaṃ kramāt| ācāryaśśirasā kumbhaṃ dhārayannagrato vrajet || 48 || sthāpakā bimbamādāya gacdeyuranu taṃ gurum| viṣṇusūktena deveśaṃ śvabhramadhye niveśya ca || 49 || śvabhrasya dakṣiṇe dhānyapīṭhe hastatalāyate| ṣaḍaṅgulasamutsedhe nyasecchvabhrasamīpataḥ || 50 || dhānyapaṅktiḥ devyāvapyautsavaṃ bimbaṃ snāpanaṃ ca tathā nyaset| paṅktiṃ tadagrato dhānyairdakṣiṇādyuttarāntakam || 51|| kuryāddhastatrayāyāmāṃ hastavistārasaṃyutām| kalaśanyāsaḥ snapanadravyāṇi uttarādi nyasettatra kalaśān tantuveṣṭitān || 52 || kṣīrājyamadhusidvārthākṣatodakuśacandanaiḥ| pūritāṃśca sakūrcāṃśca sopasnānānyathākramam || 53 || tadardhapādahīnāni siddhārthādīni nikṣipet| dadhyājyamadhudugdhānāmāḍhake sati durlabhe || 54 || tripādamardhahīnaṃ vā pādārdhaṃ vā yathodayam| sannyaseduttarādyeva deveśābhimukhāṃstathā || 55 || upasnānakalaśa nyāsaḥ,kalaśādhi devārcanam tadupasnānakalaśāṃstattatṛpṛṣṭe ca sannyaset| atharvasāmaṛgvedāḥ ādityaḥ kāśyapastathā || 56 || ṛtavo munayaścaiva sapta dravyādhidevatāḥ aśvinau vatsarā vāyuḥ apsarā marutastathā || 57 || takṣako vāyavaścaiva saptopasnānadevatāḥ| trayodaśopacāraistāṃstattannāmabhirarcayet || 58 || snapanaprakāraḥ 'śanno devī' 'ragna āyā-hyagnimīla' iti kramāt| 'pūtasta-syemā oṣadhayaḥ 'abhitvā śūra' ityapi || 59 || 'catvāri vā' giti japan snāpayetsaptabhiścataiḥ| 'vārīścatasra' ityuktvā sarvopasnānamācaret || 60 || dravyāṇi prokṣya cādāya gāyatrayā praṇavena vā| svalalāṭāntamuddhṛtya trissakṛdvā pradakṣiṇam || 61 || tattanmantrāvasāne tu snāpayetpañcamūrtibhiḥ| pūrva kumbhañca samprokṣya tattaddravyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 62 || sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ davyo pariṣadāmapi| tattatpradhānamantrānte tattanmūrtibhirācaret || 63 || 'iṣe tvorje' tveti japan 'āpaunda' ntviti kramāt| śodhayedgandhatoyena snāpayecca yathāvidhi || 64 || śvabhrādādāya deveśaṃ pīṭhe saṃsthāpya nairṛte| 'mitrassuparṇa' ityūktvā plotena vimṛjetpunaḥ || 65 || navāmbarottarīyasragbhūṣaṇairapi bhūṣayet| devyoścaivautsavādīnāṃ tattaddevyorapi kramāt || 66 || sarveṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ snāpanaṃ pṛthageva vā| madhye coṣṇodakasnānaṃ pravadanti maharṣayaḥ || 67 || kṣīrājyādīni saṃśodhya snāpyālaṅkāramarpayet| śayanādhivāsārambhaḥ śayyāvedyāstu madhye ca 'vedāha' miti mantrataḥ || 68 || tilataṇḍulaśālīnāṃ rāśiṃ kṛtvā virpyayāt| tadūrdhve carmajādīni 'vedāha' miti mantrataḥ || 79 || savrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulānāñca rāśimāstīrya cordhvataḥ| śayanāni samāstīyaṃ krameṇaivaṃ pṛyakpṛthak || 70 || pañcaśayanani carmajai romajaiścaiva muṇḍajairaṇḍajaistathā| vāmajaiśca susampannaṃ śayanaṃ tatpracakṣate || 71 || vyāghrādicarmaṇākluptaṃ carkhmajaṃ śayanaṃ smṛtam| romabhiścāvivikādīnāṃ kṛtaṃ tadromajaṃ smṛtam || 72 || kārpāsena kṛtaṃ yattanmuṇḍajaṃ tvabhidhīyate| pakṣipiñchaiḥ kṛtaṃ yattadaṇḍajaṃ parikīrtitam || 73 || kauśeyaṃ kṣaumasaṅkalṛptaṃ vāmajaṃ tvabhidhīyate| alābhe carmajādīnāṃ pañcavastrāṇi vā tathā || 74 || śayanaṃ kalpayedevaṃ dhānyarāśyupari kramāt| śiraḥ pādopadhāne dve devyoścāpi pṛthakpṛthak || 75 || pūrṇakumbhāṅkurāndīpānmaṅgalānparito nyaset| śayane pūjayeccheṣaṃ phaṇāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 76 || mitrādīṃśca jayādīṃśca prāgādyabhyarcya vai bahiḥ| śayanadhivāsaḥ devaṃ śakunasūktena sthāpayecchayanopari || 77 || dakṣiṇe ca śriyaṃ devīṃ sthāpayedvāmato mahīm| snāpanaṃ cautsavaṃ cāpi nyaseddakṣiṇavāmayoḥ || 78 || śayanantvekavedyāntu pṛthagāstṛṇuyāttayoḥ| devavacca smaram kumbhaṃ bhaktyā devāgrato nyaset || 79 || aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya devaṃ kumbhañca vai pṛthak| ācāryaḥ sthāpakairyuktaḥ puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 80 || pratisarabandhaḥpūritañca nyasetpātramāḍhakāhīnataṇḍulaiḥ| sauvarṇaṃ tāntavaṃ vā'tha tatra pratisaraṃ nyaset || 81 || 'kuṇuṣva pā' ityuktvā'bhimṛś 'svasti' deti ca| badhnīyāt kautukaṃ haste devadevasya dakṣiṇe || 82 || vāmahaste ca badhnīyāddevyoḥ pratisaraṃ kramāt| snāpane cautsave bimbe balibere tathaiva ca || 86 || dhruve ca bandhayetpūrvaṃ krameṇaiva samācaret| 'svastidā' iti mantreṇa 'viṣṇustvā' miti mantrataḥ || 84 || etābhyāṃ devadevasyāpyācāryasyartvijāmapi| tattanmantreṇa devyośca bandhayedvāmahastake || 85 || ācāryasyartvijāñcaiva bandhayeddakṣiṇe kare| pratiṣṭhāyāmutsave vā kuryātkautukabandhanam || 86 || rakṣābandhanahīne ca sarvaṃ kāryaṃ vinaśyati| 'yadvaiṣṇavaṃ' samuccārya śayane śāyayedvibhum || 87 || tattanmantreṇa devyau ca śāyayetpārśvayostathā || 88 || prāgdvāre devatāgāre devo'pi prākcchirā bhavet| dakṣiṇādiṣu dikṣvevaṃ yatā dvāraṃ tataśśiraḥ || 89 || uttarācchādanaṃ kuryādahatenaiva vāsamā| dhruvabere tu badhnīyāt kautukaṃ tadvadeva hi || 90 || kautukārcautsavākhyāpanāṃ tattaddevyostathaiva ca| pṛthaksarvañca kartavyaṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ vinā'nalam || 91 || athavā puruṣādīnāṃ tatpradhānāgnireva vā| sthāpite kautuke paścātsnāpanasyautsavasya ca || 92 || tayossaha pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pañcānīṃśca sahaiva hi| sabhyañca pauḍarīkañca dvāvagnī iti kecana || 93 || tayornityāgnimādhāya hutvā homāvasānake| sabhyakuṇḍe tu sabhyāgnimādadhīta yathā purā || 94 || nityahomavihīne tu kṛtvā kuṇḍāni pañca ca| praṇīya gārhapatyāgniṃ sarvāgniṣu juheti ca || 95 || tayorapi pṛthaktvetu pṛthagagniṃ prakalpayet| yathoktahomaṃ juhuyaḥ kumbhaṃ sampūjya pūrvavat || 76 || devasyābhimukhe nyasya tatraivāvāhayeddhruvāt| snapanaṃ śayanaṃ hautraṃ homaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 97 || nācareddevatāhvānaṃ sarvadevārcanaṃ tathā| dhruvabere samāvāhya tasmādāvāhayettayoḥ || 98 || bālālaye tayoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhā yadi kautukāt| āvāhanaṃ tathā proktaṃ sarvamanyatsamaṃ bhavet || 99 || caturvedādhyayanam hautrapraśaṃsanam prāgādi caturau vedān adhyāpayati vai kramāt| hotāraṃ samalaṅkuryāt vastrapuṣpāṅgulīyakaiḥ || 100 || sottarīyairyathāśakti so'pi hotā supūjitaḥ sabhyātpratyaṅmukhaḥ prācyāṃ hautramevaṃ praśaṃsati || 101 || adhvaryuḥ 'hotare' hīti hotāramabhisaṃvaṃdet| 'adhvarvo devatā' śceti so'dhvaryuṃ pratibhāṣate || 102 || paścādāyamya kūrcañca gṛhītvā paścimāmukhaḥ| 'namaḥ pravaktrā' ityādi tiṣṭhannuccaissamuccaret || 103 || eva 'mo' miti mantrānte hotā śarmāntameva ca| svakaṃ nāma dvitīyānta 'mamu' mityeva yojayet || 104 || 'bhūte bhaviṣyati' ca 'hiṃ rbhuvassuvaro' miti| vadan sa prāṅgmukho 'pravo vā' jetyṛcaṃ vadet || 105 || 'pravo vāje' tyṛcaṃ cādā 'vājuhote' ti cāntataḥ| tridhā vācye tato'nyāstu praṇavena samaṃ tataḥ || 106 || hotrā tenoktamoṅkāraṃ śrutvā'dhvaryurviśeṣataḥ| 'oṃ svā' heti vadan idhmamājyāktaṃ juhuyābdudhaḥ || 107 || sāmidhenīstathā śaṃseddhotā saptadaśa kramāt| 'brāhmaṇa bhāra' tetyantamuktvaivāgniṃca bodhayan || 108 || yajamānasya gotraṃ ca pravadetpravaraṃ kramāt| 'deveddho manviddha' iti punarāha tathaiva ca || 109 || grāmastu yajamānaścetkāśyapapravaraṃ vadet| purohitasya pravaraṃ brūyātkartā nṛpo yadi || 110 || ācāryapravaraṃ vā'tha kāśyapapravaraṃ tu vā| brāhmaṇavyatiriktānāṃ sarveṣāmiti kecana || 111 || hotā hautrakrameṇaiva hautramevaṃ praśaṃsya ca| 'āyā'tviti samuccārya mūrtimantrairanukramāt || 112 || taṃ devaṃ 'māva' hetyuktvā adhvaryuñca prayojayet| adhvaryurapi tatkāle dakṣiṇapraṇidhau jale || 113 || ādimūrtyādiśarvāntaṃ mūrtimantraiḥ kramāttadā| 'āvāhayā'mītyāvāhya cottarapraṇidhau tataḥ || 114 || dhātrādiviṣṇubhūtāntaṃ devānāvāhayebdudhaḥ| āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet || 115 || homadravyabhedena hastabhedaḥ sāṅguṣṭhayānāmikayā sruvamālambaya yatnataḥ| pradeśinīṃ madhyamāṃ ca sruvasyādhaḥ prasārya ca || 116 || kaniṣṭhikāṃ visṛjyaiva samālambaya sruvādikam| vedāṅgulapramāṇāñca yajedājyāhutiṃ budhaḥ || 117 || aṅguṣṭhānāmikāmadhyaissamidhaṃ juhuyāccarūm| apūpatilalājāśca saktavo ghṛtamiśritāḥ || 118 || sarveṣvagniṣu hotavyā mahāśāntirihoditā| mahāśāntihomaḥvaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca || 119 || pratyekaṃ viṃśatīrhutvā vyāhṛtyantaṃ pratiprati| śarkarājyadadhikṣīraṃ samabhāgaṃ pragṛhya ca || 120 || juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgnāvupajuhvā smaran harim| kuṇḍeṣu lokapālānāṃ tattanmantraṃ yathākramam || 121 || pratyekaṃ viṃśatīrhutvā svanāmadapūrvakam| sabhyāgniṃ pariṣicyaiva juhuyātpañcavāruṇam || 122 || jayādī 'nyaddevādīṃśca vyāhṛtyantaṃ pratiprati| sarvadevārcanam paścātsamarcayeddevānparitaḥ svasvanāmabhiḥ || 123 || viṣṇuṃ pūrvavadabhyacrya śrībhūmisahitaṃ kramāt| mārkaṇḍeyaṃ vidhiṃ savye bhṛguṃ vāme'rcayedbhavam || 124 || śālādvāreṣu dhātrādīn maṇikaṃ sandhyayā saha| tāpasaṃ siddhidaṃ vā'thaṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakramathāpi vā || 125 || śrībhūtamarcayedagre bahirmukhamanusmaran| indrārkaśrīhaviḥ pālānagniṃ vai paścimāmukhān || 126 || caitrādiṣaṭsu māseṣu kramāduttarato ravim| prācyāmabhyarcya bhaumañca guhaṃ durgā yamaṃ śanim || 127 || rohiṇīṃ saptamātśca dakṣiṇe cottarāmukhāḥ| nīlaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ dhātrīṃ viṣṇuṃ ca varuṇaṃ budham || 128 || jyeṣṭhāṃ phallañca vāyuñca paścime prāṅgamukhānimān| śukraṃ saptaṛṣīn gaṅgāṃ dhanyaṃ candraṃ tathaiva ca || 129 || pañca bhūtāmiteśānānudīcyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhān| aṣṭamūrti śivaṃ caiva balirakṣaṃ sarasvatīm || 130 || indradvārasya vāme tu paścimābhimukhānkramāt| nyakṣañca bharataṃ mitraṃ kṣattāraṃ prāgupakramāt || 131 || bahirmukhān samabhyarcya nyakṣaṃ devāgra evavai| pīṭhagopurayormadhye garuḍaṃ samyagarcayet || 132 || bahirvighneśanāgeśau dvāradakṣiṇavāmayoḥ| cakraṃ dhvajañca śaṅkhañca yūthanāthākṣahāvapi || 133 || dvārāgre pūjayedetānprāgantānbahirānanān| trayodaśopacaustānpūjayecca pṛthak pṛthak || 134 || śayānaṃ devamāsādya praṇamyaivānumānya ca| suvarbhuvarbhū'rityuktvā mūrdhanābhipadān spṛśan || 135 || sabhyāgniṃ pariṣicyātha tāṃ sahasrāhutiṃ yajet| svasti caiveha svā' heti 'prajāpataya' ityapi || 136 || 'agnirdhīmataye' caiva 'mādityebhya' iti bruvan| 'viśvebhyo devebhya' iti 'gaṇebhyo marutā' miti || 137 || mantrairetairyajedājyaṃ mahāvyātibhissaha| śatakṛtvo yajedetairyajedvyāhṛtibhiḥ punaḥ || 138 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca sūktaṃ pairuṣameva ca| śrīsūktañca 'śriye jāto' bhūsūktaṃ bhūmidaivatam || 139 || yajecaca sarvadaityaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ pṛthakpṛthak| athavā navadhā mārge yanmārgamavalambate || 140 || tanmārge pariṣaddevānāvāhya parito'rcayet| vinaiva sarvadaivatyaṃ tattanmantraistathā yajet || 141 || pradhānahomaḥ juhuyātpairuṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥ param| yaddevādyaistato hutṛvā vaiṣṇañca suhūyatām || 142 || juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ prācyāmāhavanīyake| anvāharye suhotavyaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ yathāvidhi || 143 || gārhapatye suhotavyaṃ brāhmamekākṣarādikam| āvasathye suhotavyaṃ 'tvamagne rudra' ityapi || 144 || pāramātmikamabjāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakam| vyāhatṛyantaṃ ca juhuyādathavā munisattamāḥ || 145 || pañcāgniṣūktahāmaḥ devatāvāhanānte tu sarvadevārcanaṃ caret| sabhyamagniṃ paristīrya pālāśedhmān ghṛtāplutān || 146 || juhuyādviṣṇugāyatryā aṣṭottarasahastrakam| pālāśedhmaiśca hetavyaṃ punaṣṣaṅbhiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 147 || sūktena vaiṣṇavenājyaṃ yajedupabhṛtā budhaḥ| vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyājjuhvā carumājyamataḥ param || 148 || viṣṇornukādyaissūktena pauruṣeṇa ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ| 'hiraṇyavarṇā' mityuktvā 'bhūmibhūmne' ti ca kramāt || 149 || ṛtvikkṛtvo'kakṛtvo vā daśakṛtvo'thavā yajet| tāṃ sahastrāhutiṃ hutvā dhātādyaiḥ pañca vāruṇaiḥ || 150 || jayādibhiśca kūṣmāṇḍairjuhuyāttadanu kramāt| tathaiva sarvadaivatyaṃ tattanmārgānusārataḥ || 151 || vaiṣṇavairviṣṇusūktena mindāhutyā tathaiva ca| vicchinnāhutibhiścāpi mahāvyāhṛtibhistathā || 152 || 'nārāyaṇāya vidmeti hutvā ṣaṅvaiṣṇavo ṛcaḥ| yajedāhavanīyāgnau narasūktaṃ smaran harim || 153 || anvāhārye viṣṇusūktaṃ brāhmamantradvayaṃ tathā| vaiṣṇavañca 'śriye jāto-medinī' ti samuccaran || 154 || gārhapatye suhotavyamāvasathye tataḥ param| ekākṣarādisūktena rudramantradvayena ca| caturagniṣu caiteṣu mantrairetairyathoditam || 155 || ājyaṃ ṣoḍaśakṛtvaśca yajeddavādaśa vā daśa| payodadhighṛtairuktairupajuhvā yathākramam || 156 || juhuyādviṣṇusūktena pañcāgniṣu salājakam| ājyaṃ srucā gṛhītvaiva juhuyāt vaiṣṇavairapi || 157 || juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgrau 'ato devā' di vaiṣṇavam| śvetamabjaṃ tataḥ paścādghṛtāktaṃ juhuyādvudhaḥ || 158 || japanvai viṣṇugāyatrīṃ raktābjaṃ bilvameva vā| ājyena juhuyātsamyaksūktaiḥ pauruṣavaiṣṇavaiḥ || 159 || pāramātmikamantraiśca devaṃ dhyāyan juhoti ca| indrādīnāñca homeṣu tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam || 160 || ājyaṃ viṃśatikṛtvaśca sruveṇa juhuyāditi| ṛṣiratriruvācaivaṃ juhuyādevameva vā || 161 || athavā hautraśaṃsānte vaiṣṇavaiḥ pañcavāruṇaiḥ| jayādibhiśca kūṣmāṇḍairhutvā tatpariṣadgaṇān || 162 || samabhyarcya yathāmārga saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ| trayodaśopacārairvā paścāddhomaṃ samācarret || 163 || sabhyamagniṃ paristīrya tāṃ sahasrāhutiṃ yajet| abjāgnau viṣṇugāyatryā ghṛtāktaṃ śvetapaṅkajam || 164 || śatakṛtvo yajedājyaṃ juhuyātpāramātmikam| yajedāhavanīyagnau pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 165 || anvāhārye viṣṇusūktaṃ brāhmaṃ vyāhṛtisaṃyutam| vaiṣṇavaṃ gārhapatyāgnau cāvasathye tu vaiṣṇavam ||
