166 || juhuyā drudrasūktañca devadevamunasmaran| yajetṣo'śakṛtvastu tenaiva caturagniṣu || 167 || jayādīṃśca sakṛddhutvā aindrādīnāmathāgniṣu| ekaviṃśatikṛtvastu tattanmantrairjuhoti ca || 168 || vīśaśaiṣikayormantraiśśatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| eteṣāṃ mūrtimantraiśca juhuyātsakṛdagniṣu || 169 || sabhye tu sarvadaivatyaṃ hutvā vai vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| viṣṇusūktañca juhuyānmindāhutisamanvitam || 170 || 'āśrāvitā' dimantraiśca juhuyāditi kāśyapaḥ| sabhyāgnihomamācāryassvayameva samācaret || 171 || anyathā juhuyāccettu sarvamāśu vinaśyati nṛtairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedvudhaḥ || 172 ||
ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre māhapratiṣṭhātantra śayanāstaraṇa pratisara hautrapraśaṃsāhavanīyādihoma vidhānaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
<8> oṃ aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ratnayāsaḥ prātassnātvā vidhānena jatvā sūktāni pūrvavat| praviśya yāgaśālāñca devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 1 || tatassuptaṃ hariṃ kiñcidoṅkāreṇa prabodhayet| praṇamya 'bhūḥ prapa' dyeti viṣṇusūktena coddharet || 2 || vyapohma vastramālyādīn punaranyaiśca bhūṣayet| trayodaśopacauśca samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 3 || ratnāni dhātubījāni gṛhītvā'ntaḥ praviśca ca| arcāpīṭhe'vaṭaṃ kṛtvā sopapīṭhapadaṃ tathā || 4 || upapīṭhapadañceti pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ smṛtam| 'tamekane' mimityuktvā ratnādīnyabhimṛśya ca || 5 || 'prajāpateḥ prathama' miti raukmaṃ kūrmantu sannyaset| 'tamekanemi' mantreṇa sauvarṇaṃ dantinaṃ nyaset || 6 || 'śatadhāra' miti procya sauvarṇaṃ garuḍaṃ tathā| brahmasthāne brahmamaṇiṃ 'brahmā devā' dimuccaran || 7 || 'indraṃ praṇayanta' riti procya tvāgneyyāṃ mauktikaṃ kṣipet || 8 || 'yamo dādhā' mantreṇa yāmye vaiḍūryamākṣipet| 'vasavaḥ prathama' ityuktvā naiṛtyāṃ śaṅkhajaṃ kṣipet || 9 || caturbhirvāruṇairmantraiḥ sphāṭikaṃ vāruṇe nyaset| 'marutaḥ paramā' tmeti vāyavye puṣyakaṃ kṣipet || 10 || 'somaṃ rājāna' mityuktvā candrakāntamathottare| 'īśānassarva' mantreṇa nīlamīśānadiśyapi || 11 || 'śanno nidhatta' mityuktvā vāsukeramṛtāśmakam| 'dhātā dhātṛṇā' miti ca sādhyebhyo lohitāśmakam || 12 || 'viśve devasya' mantreṇa viśvadevebhya utpalam| 'adhibrahmā yata' teti siddhānāntu pravālakam || 13 || 'imāṃ mūrdhanyā ityuktvā gandharvebhyo manaśśilām| 'apsarassu' bruvanvidvānapsarobhyo'tha śuktijam || 14 || 'yaṃ kādraveyā' ityuktvā nāgebhyo vimalaṃ māṇim| 'aryamṇa' iti mantreṇa aryamṇe kuruṃvindakam || 15 || 'tattrīṇye' ṣeti ca vadan bhūtebhyo nīlamuttamam| amṛtāśmakādiratnāni madhye'vāntaradikṣvapi || 16 || 'śanno nidhattā' mityādyairmantraiḥ kṣiptvā yathākramam| tato bījāni dhātūṃśca nyasenmadhyapade'ṣṭake || 17 || sauvarṇaṃ gairikaṃ madhye haritālaṃ manaśśilām| añjanaṃ śyāmakāsīsaṃ rasaṃ saurāṣṭrakaṃ tathā || 18 || gorocanaṃ caturdikṣu tattanmantraiśca sannyaset| sarvagandhayutaṃ sarvabījaṃ brāhme tu sannyaset || 19 || aindre tu puṣṭikānvrīhīnnyasenmāṣakulutthakau| yāmye godhūmamudrau ca tilatilvau ca nairṛtau || 20 || yavadvayaṃ tu vāruṇyāṃ nīvārañca priyaṅgukam| saumye tu mudgagodhūmāvīśānye sarvabījakam || 21 || pūrvoktaireva mantraistu krameṇaitānbahirnyaset| brahmasthānasya paritaḥ vinyasedaṣṭamaṅgalān || 22 || bhūyāma' iti mantreṇa śrīvatsaṃ caindrake nyaset| āgneyyāṃ pūrṇakumbhantu 'namassulomi' mantrataḥ || 23 || yāmye bherīṃ nyasettatra 'sa eko'bhū' diti bruvan| nairṛtyāṃ vinyasetpaścā 'ddevasya' tveti darpaṇam || 24 || vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccārya vāruṇyāṃ matsyayugmakam| vāyavyāmuṅkuśaṃ paścāt 'kṣmāmekā' miti ca bruvan || 25 || 'tanmā yaśogra' ityuktvā śaṅkhaṃ saumye tu nikṣipet| 'brahmā deve' ti caiśānyāmāvartaṃ nidadhīta vai || 26 || gadācakrāsiśaktīśca śaraṃ madhye'tha dakṣiṇe| 'bhūmānano'gra' ityuktvā pratyekaṃ ca vinikṣipet || 27 || vāmabhāge tathā śakhaṃ śārṅga kheṭakameva ca| 'tanmā yaśo'gra' ityuktvā pratyekaṃ ca vinikṣipet || 28 || sruvādivarṇacihrāni tattadvarṇavivṛddhaye| śrīrūpaṃ ca śriyaḥ sthāne 'śriye jāta' iti bruvan || 29 || hariṇīṃ hariṇīsthāne medinyādi samuccaran| 'prajāpati' miti procya kūrmaṃ copari vinyaset || 30 || yathāśakti suvarṇena sarvāṇyetāni kalpayet| alābhe pratinidhiḥ ratnalālābhe suvarṇaṃ vā bījānāṃ yavameva vā || 31 || dhātūnāṃ pāradaṃ vā'pi tattatpratinidhiṃ haret| kṣaumeṇācchādya tacchvabhraṃ sudhayopari lepayet || 32 || pīṭhe purātane pūrvaṃ ratnādau supratiṣṭhite| tattadratnādikaṃ brudhdvā mantrāṃstāntsamudīrya ca || 33 || 'apo hiṣṭhā' dibhirgantraiḥ prokṣayecca kuśodakaiḥ| pūrṇāhutiḥ mahāśāntiḥ yajñaśālāṃ tato gatvā deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca || 34 || juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgnau viṣṇugāyatriyā śatam| śvetapadmaṃ ghṛtāsiktaṃ raktābjaṃ bilvameva vā || 35 || narasūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca 'yaddevā' di tathaiva ca| brāhmaindravāruṇān hutvā rātrisūktasamanvitam || 36 || juhuyādviśvajitsūktaṃ mahāśāntiriyaṃ smṛtā| sabhye tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ puruṣasūktakam || 37 || ekākṣarādi hutvā tu vyāhatyantaṃ pratiprati| samidghṛtābhyāṃ jaruṇā devadevamanusmaran || 38 || dakṣiṇādānam dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāvidhi| sadanapradakṣiṇam devaṃ devīsamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkaraṇaissaha || 39 || japanvai śākunaṃ sūktaṃ toyadhārāpurassaram| ācāryaśśirasā kumbhaṃ gṛhītvā pūrvato vrajet || 40 || tato'nu devaṃ devyau ca nayanti sthāpakāstathā| bimbasthāpanaprakāraḥ bahuberapratiṣṭhā cettattadverakramānnayet || 41 || bahubhumipratiṣṭā cettattadvuddhā samāhitaḥ| tale tale vidhānena yathocitamathācaret || 42 || parītya mandiraṃ paścādgarbhagehaṃ praviśya ca| viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya sthāpayitvā tataḥ param || 43 || dhruvasūktaṃ tato jatvā pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca sthāpayeyussamāhitāḥ || 44 || dakṣiṇe brahmasūtrasya beramadhyaṃ yathā tathā| devadevaṃ jagadyoniṃ sthāpayedviṣṇamuvyayam || 45 || sthāpayedanyadevāstu tadvāme beramadhyamam| sūtrasandhau na kurvīta sarveṣāṃ beramadhyamam || 46 || sthāpitaṃ cettadajñānātsarvamāśu vinaśyati| autsavaṃ kauttukādvāme dakṣiṇe snāpanaṃ tathā || 47 || autsavaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme snāpanantviti kecana| garbhālayasya saṅkoce tvathavā mukhamaṇḍape || 48 || pratiṣṭhāpyāntarāle vā pūjayediti cāṅgirāḥ| ācāryaḥ purataḥ kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe susanyaset || 49 || vyahatinyāsādi nyasedvimbasya mūrdhādi pādāntaṃ vyāhṛtitrayam| yakāraṃ pādayormadhye tvakāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 50 || praṇavena samāveṣṭya mūdhniṃ ca praṇavaṃ nyaset| ātmasūktaṃ tato japtvā kūrcenādāgaya vai tataḥ || 51 || āvahanaprakāraḥ kumbhācchaktiyutaṃ toya 'māyātu bhagavā' niti| 'viṣṇumāvāhayā' mīti srāvayedvimbamūrdhani || 52 || prāgādi 'puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāniruddhakam'| bimṛbamūrdhni samāvāhya pīṭhe tu paritaḥ kramāt || 43 || tatṛtaddikṣa sumāvāhya puṣpanyāsoktadevatāḥ| śrīdevīhṛdaye kṛtvā śrīvatsādikamakṣaram || 54 || lakṣmīpūrvākṣaraṃ mantraṃ hṛdaye ceva vinyaset| sānusvārañca vinyasya 'śriye jāta' iti śriyam || 55 || medinyādīn samucacārya mahīmāvāhayetamkamāt| garbhālayasthitān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān || 56 || vimāneśān lokapālānanapāyina eva ca| tattanmantraissamāvāhya tato vai kautukādiṣu || 57 || kṛtvā mantrākṣaranyāsau dhruvādāvāhayetkramāt| bhrāvāhane viśeṣaḥ yadyatra laukikaṃ beraṃ prādurbhāvādayo dhruvāḥ || 58 || pratiṣṭhāpya kramātteṣāṃ tasmādāvāhayeddhruvāt| yatrālaye tu yadveraṃ dhruvahīnaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 59 || āvāhya taddhruvādeva tattadvidhivadarcayet| pṛthagevāthavā kumbhaṃ saṃsādhyāvāhayettataḥ || 60 || āsanādibhirabhyarcca havīṃṣyapi nivedayet| pratiṣṭhāntotsavaḥ balau balyutsavaṃ kuryātsnāpane snapanaṃ caret || 61 || taddine sāyamārabhya cautsave cotsavaṃ caret| ghoṣaṇaṃ sadya evātra kuryādityāha pūrvajaḥ || 62 || aṅkurārpaṇavikalpāḥ pratiṣṭhāntotsavārambhadhvajasnāpakarmasu| naivāṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryādekāhe bahukarmaṇām || 63 || pūrvīsminneva divase caikamevāṅkurārpaṇam| pṛyakpṛthakprakartavyaṃ bhinnakartṛkakarmaṇām || 64 || aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhādivasādadhaḥ| karmaṇāṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ na kuryātpṛthagaṅkuram || 65 || viniyuktasambhārāṇāṃ viniyogaḥ devayāgopayuktāni tāni dravyāṇi yāni vai| gṛhaṇīyādupayojyāni gururevākhilāni ca || 66 || sruksruvādīni pātrāṇi tvaraṇī maṅṛgalāṣṭakam| punaśca karmayogyāni yānamāsanameva ca || 67 || vitānaṃ ca dhvajaṃ chatraṃ cāmaravyajanādikam| grāhyaṃ punaśca karmārtha haviraharyādipātrakam || 68 || anyānyanupayojyāni dāhyānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| brahmasthāne śilāberapratiṣṭhā evaṃ kartumaśaktaścedvarṇahīnaṃ śilāmayam || 69 || brahmasthānepratiṣṭhāpya pūjayediti kecana| vakṣyāmi tatkramaṃ beraṃ citraṃ sarvāṅgasundaram || 70 || kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ paścādamantrakamataḥ param| tattatpade pratiṣṭhāpya śilāsthāpanamārgataḥ| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu tatra vai || 71 || samantrakākṣimokṣānte pañcagavyādipūritān| kumbhāṃstriyaṣṭiyogena sarandhrānberamūrdhani || 72 || pateddhārā yathā tasmāttathā sannyasya tānkramāt| adhivāsakriyāṃ kuryādabhiṣekānvitaṃ pṛthak || 73 || athavā'bhimukhe kṛtvā pañcagavyādipūritān| aṣṭottaraśataṃ jatvā tattanmantrānyathākramam || 74 || abhyukṣya snāpayeddevaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāvayejjalaiḥ| mahāpratiṣṭhāmārgeṇā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 75 || autsave balibere ca tasmādāvāhanaṃ smṛtam| athavā tvaritaḥ kartumekaberavidhiṃ yadi || 76 || beraṃ kṛtvā'kṣimokṣānte gavyādiṣvadhivāsya ca| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva kumbhapūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 77 || rātrau samāpya vidhinā prātaḥ snātvā yathāvidhi| brahmasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya ratnanyāsapurassaram || 78 || śilpisparśaviśuddhyartha vāstuhomāvasānake| dhruvaberoktavacchuddhiṃ kṛtvā berasya mantravit || 79 || kumbhācchaktiṃ samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet| brahmasthane'thavā kṛtvā ratnādinyāsamatvaraḥ || 80 || pīṭhasaṃṅghātarmoṇa tatra saṃsthāpya śilpinā| amantrakākṣimokṣaṃ ca kṛtvodvāsya ca śilpinam || 81 || aṣṭabandhe dṛḍhe paścādanukūle śubhe dine| akṣyunmeṣādhivāsādi pratiṣṭhāmācarettathā || 82 || rāṣṭrāntarānīta bimbādipratiṣṭā rājā rāṣṭāntaraṃ jitvā beraṃ yadi samānayet| tadvimbañca samuddiśya svarāṣṭre ca manorame || 83 || dhruvaṃ tasyānurūpaṃ ca vimānamapi kārayet| saṃsthāpya pūrvavattatra kuryāttatrārcanaṃ budhaḥ || 84 || dhruvaberānurūpañcedathavā mandire kvacit| autsavaṃ snāpanaṃ vā'tha sthāpayediti kecana || 85 || athavā nānurūpaṃ cellaukikaṃ vā'tha kutracit| sthāpya trayāṇāṃ bimbānāṃ sthānādanyatra pūjayet || 86 || sa labhediṣṭakādināṃ phalaṃ dviguṇameva ca| nītamāgneyabimbaṃ cetsaptāhaṃ padmakuṇḍake || 87 || mahāśāntiṃ ca juhuyādadhivāsādi pūrvavat| kārayitvā tu vidhinā laukikaṃ sthāpayetpunaḥ || 88 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā samāvāhyārkamaṇḍalāt| kumbhāttasmintsamāvāhya pūjayediti śāsanam || 89 || bhūmiṃ parīkṣya vidhinā sadyaḥ kartu tvarānvitaḥ| brahmāpadmāvasāne tu garbhagehe viśeṣataḥ || 90 || adhiṣṭhānodayānte tu ghanaṃ bhittiṃ prakalpayet| pañcaraṃ ca bahiḥ kṛtvā tatra beraṃ yathāvidhi || 91 || prāyaścittaviśeyāḥ śraddhābhaktī puraskṛtya tvarito yena kenacit| akṛtvā bhūparīkṣādin vinā'cāryaṃ padārthibhiḥ || 92 || sthāpanānuktanakṣatramāsādau sthāpayedyadi| sumāsapakṣanakṣaṃtramuhūrteṣu yathāvidhi || 93 || māsaṃ pakṣaṃ captāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā tryahantu vā| trikālaṃ pauṇḍarīkāgnaumahāśāntiṃ juhoti vai || 94 || tattanmantrajapaṃ kuryādbhūparīkṣādakarmaṇām| kṛtvā'ṅkarārpaṇaṃ paścānnayanonmīlanaṃ tathā || 95 || pañcagavyādhivāsādi kuryādyatnena pūrvavat| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 96 || snāpanautsavayoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāmācaredyadi| sabhyañca pauṇḍarīkañca dvāvagnī iti kecana || 97 || balibepratiṣṭhāyāṃ sabhyamekāgnimeva vā| tatra praṇīya nityāgniṃ homaṃ hutvā yathāvidhi || 98 || ādadhīta pratiṣṭhānte nityakuṇḍe tu pūrvavat| nāsti cettatra nityāgniḥ pañcāgnīm parikalpayet || 99 || tatkuṇḍādgārhapatyākhyātpraṇīya juhuyāttathā| devyoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kuṇḍamaupāsanoktavat || 100 || pratyekaṃ kalpayitvā tu tantrayitvaikameva vā| snapanaṃ kumbhapūjāñca śayanañca gṛthakpṛthak || 101 || tattatsūktañca tanmantraṃ vaiṣṇavena śataṃ yajet| eṣa eva viśeṣassyātsarvamanyatsamaṃ bhavet || 102 || dhruvārcāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ vimānārambhataḥ pūrva sthāpite ceddhruvārcanam| paritaḥ pañcaraṃ kṛtvā śilpisparśanivāraṇam || 103 || tathā''layagatān devān tathaivā''vāhya pañjare| vimānaṃ kārayecchīghraṃ paritaḥ pañjarāhiḥ || 104 || śilpisparśaviśuddhyartha tatkriyoparatau punaḥ| vāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paryagniñcaiva kārayet || 105 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya puṇyāhamapi vācaret| snāpayetkalaśairdevaṃ yathāśakti mudānvitaḥ || 106 || devālayasyābhikhe pauṇḍarīke viśeṣataḥ| mahāśāntiṃ tathaikāhaṃ hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 107 || sabhyābjakuṇḍe kṛtvā'gre tatrāghāraṃ juhoti ca| rātripūjāvasāne tu devaṃ kumbhe niveśya ca || 108 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairbimbaṃ kumbhasamanvitam| dhānyapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya bimbaṃ snnyasya paścime || 109 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhinā hotā hautrakrameṇa vai| tadalayagatāndevāntsamāvāhya yathāvidhi || 110 || āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 111 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīsūktaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam| jayādibhiśca kūṣmāṇḍaissahasrāhutibhistathā || 112 || tadālayagatānāñca mantraiḥ pariṣadāmapi| mindāhutibhyāṃ vicchinnairviṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 113 || tathaiva viṣṇugāyatryā padmahomaṃ juhoti ca| tathā''gneyyāntu padmāgnau juhuyātpāramātmikam || 114 || prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena kumṛbhamantaḥ pragṛhya ca| kumbhādvimbe samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet || 115 || tadālaye samāvāhya devānpañjaragānapi| vyapohya pañjaraṃ sarvaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 116 || dhruvārcādiniruktiḥ dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ dhruvārcanamiti kramāt| sthāpanaṃ taddivadhā proktaṃ devadevasya śāṅgirṇaḥ || 117 || patanādiṣu sarveṣu prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam| dhruvasya kautukasyāpi vidhivatsthāpanañca yat || 118 || dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ taduvāca pitāmahaḥ| padeṣūkteṣu yatsthāpyaṃ taddhruvārcanamīritam || 119 || dhruvañca kautukañcaikaṃ dhruvārcanamudāhṛtam| tadeva devīhīnañcedekaberamiti smṛtam || 120 || ekaberañca tatprāhuḥ kevalāmuṣmikapradam| iti saṅkṣepataḥ proktaṃ sthāpanaṃ munisattamāḥ || 121 || iti ḥśrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre mahāpratiṣṭhā ratnanyāsāvāhanāgnisamāropaṇa rāṣṭrāntarānītaberasthāpanānuktakālapratiṣṭhā prāyaścittādi vidhirnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
<9> oṃ aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ratnayāsaḥ prātassnātvā vidhānena jatvā sūktāni pūrvavat| praviśya yāgaśālāñca devadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 1 || tatassuptaṃ hariṃ kiñcidoṅkāreṇa prabodhayet| praṇamya 'bhūḥ prapa' dyeti viṣṇusūktena coddharet || 2 || vyapohma vastramālyādīn punaranyaiśca bhūṣayet| trayodaśopacauśca samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 3 || ratnāni dhātubījāni gṛhītvā'ntaḥ praviśca ca| arcāpīṭhe'vaṭaṃ kṛtvā sopapīṭhapadaṃ tathā || 4 || upapīṭhapadañceti pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ smṛtam| 'tamekane' mimityuktvā ratnādīnyabhimṛśya ca || 5 || 'prajāpateḥ prathama' miti raukmaṃ kūrmantu sannyaset| 'tamekanemi' mantreṇa sauvarṇaṃ dantinaṃ nyaset || 6 || 'śatadhāra' miti procya sauvarṇaṃ garuḍaṃ tathā| brahmasthāne brahmamaṇiṃ 'brahmā devā' dimuccaran || 7 || 'indraṃ praṇayanta' riti procya tvāgneyyāṃ mauktikaṃ kṣipet || 8 || 'yamo dādhā' mantreṇa yāmye vaiḍūryamākṣipet| 'vasavaḥ prathama' ityuktvā naiṛtyāṃ śaṅkhajaṃ kṣipet || 9 || caturbhirvāruṇairmantraiḥ sphāṭikaṃ vāruṇe nyaset| 'marutaḥ paramā' tmeti vāyavye puṣyakaṃ kṣipet || 10 || 'somaṃ rājāna' mityuktvā candrakāntamathottare| 'īśānassarva' mantreṇa nīlamīśānadiśyapi || 11 || 'śanno nidhatta' mityuktvā vāsukeramṛtāśmakam| 'dhātā dhātṛṇā' miti ca sādhyebhyo lohitāśmakam || 12 || 'viśve devasya' mantreṇa viśvadevebhya utpalam| 'adhibrahmā yata' teti siddhānāntu pravālakam || 13 || 'imāṃ mūrdhanyā ityuktvā gandharvebhyo manaśśilām| 'apsarassu' bruvanvidvānapsarobhyo'tha śuktijam || 14 || 'yaṃ kādraveyā' ityuktvā nāgebhyo vimalaṃ māṇim| 'aryamṇa' iti mantreṇa aryamṇe kuruṃvindakam || 15 || 'tattrīṇye' ṣeti ca vadan bhūtebhyo nīlamuttamam| amṛtāśmakādiratnāni madhye'vāntaradikṣvapi || 16 || 'śanno nidhattā' mityādyairmantraiḥ kṣiptvā yathākramam| tato bījāni dhātūṃśca nyasenmadhyapade'ṣṭake || 17 || sauvarṇaṃ gairikaṃ madhye haritālaṃ manaśśilām| añjanaṃ śyāmakāsīsaṃ rasaṃ saurāṣṭrakaṃ tathā || 18 || gorocanaṃ caturdikṣu tattanmantraiśca sannyaset| sarvagandhayutaṃ sarvabījaṃ brāhme tu sannyaset || 19 || aindre tu puṣṭikānvrīhīnnyasenmāṣakulutthakau| yāmye godhūmamudrau ca tilatilvau ca nairṛtau || 20 || yavadvayaṃ tu vāruṇyāṃ nīvārañca priyaṅgukam| saumye tu mudgagodhūmāvīśānye sarvabījakam || 21 || pūrvoktaireva mantraistu krameṇaitānbahirnyaset| brahmasthānasya paritaḥ vinyasedaṣṭamaṅgalān || 22 || bhūyāma' iti mantreṇa śrīvatsaṃ caindrake nyaset| āgneyyāṃ pūrṇakumbhantu 'namassulomi' mantrataḥ || 23 || yāmye bherīṃ nyasettatra 'sa eko'bhū' diti bruvan| nairṛtyāṃ vinyasetpaścā 'ddevasya' tveti darpaṇam || 24 || vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccārya vāruṇyāṃ matsyayugmakam| vāyavyāmuṅkuśaṃ paścāt 'kṣmāmekā' miti ca bruvan || 25 || 'tanmā yaśogra' ityuktvā śaṅkhaṃ saumye tu nikṣipet| 'brahmā deve' ti caiśānyāmāvartaṃ nidadhīta vai || 26 || gadācakrāsiśaktīśca śaraṃ madhye'tha dakṣiṇe| 'bhūmānano'gra' ityuktvā pratyekaṃ ca vinikṣipet || 27 || vāmabhāge tathā śakhaṃ śārṅga kheṭakameva ca| 'tanmā yaśo'gra' ityuktvā pratyekaṃ ca vinikṣipet || 28 || sruvādivarṇacihrāni tattadvarṇavivṛddhaye| śrīrūpaṃ ca śriyaḥ sthāne 'śriye jāta' iti bruvan || 29 || hariṇīṃ hariṇīsthāne medinyādi samuccaran| 'prajāpati' miti procya kūrmaṃ copari vinyaset || 30 || yathāśakti suvarṇena sarvāṇyetāni kalpayet| alābhe pratinidhiḥ ratnalālābhe suvarṇaṃ vā bījānāṃ yavameva vā || 31 || dhātūnāṃ pāradaṃ vā'pi tattatpratinidhiṃ haret| kṣaumeṇācchādya tacchvabhraṃ sudhayopari lepayet || 32 || pīṭhe purātane pūrvaṃ ratnādau supratiṣṭhite| tattadratnādikaṃ brudhdvā mantrāṃstāntsamudīrya ca || 33 || 'apo hiṣṭhā' dibhirgantraiḥ prokṣayecca kuśodakaiḥ| pūrṇāhutiḥ mahāśāntiḥ yajñaśālāṃ tato gatvā deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca || 34 || juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgnau viṣṇugāyatriyā śatam| śvetapadmaṃ ghṛtāsiktaṃ raktābjaṃ bilvameva vā || 35 || narasūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca 'yaddevā' di tathaiva ca| brāhmaindravāruṇān hutvā rātrisūktasamanvitam || 36 || juhuyādviśvajitsūktaṃ mahāśāntiriyaṃ smṛtā| sabhye tu vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ puruṣasūktakam || 37 || ekākṣarādi hutvā tu vyāhatyantaṃ pratiprati| samidghṛtābhyāṃ jaruṇā devadevamanusmaran || 38 || dakṣiṇādānam dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāvidhi| sadanapradakṣiṇam devaṃ devīsamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkaraṇaissaha || 39 || japanvai śākunaṃ sūktaṃ toyadhārāpurassaram| ācāryaśśirasā kumbhaṃ gṛhītvā pūrvato vrajet || 40 || tato'nu devaṃ devyau ca nayanti sthāpakāstathā| bimbasthāpanaprakāraḥ bahuberapratiṣṭhā cettattadverakramānnayet || 41 || bahubhumipratiṣṭā cettattadvuddhā samāhitaḥ| tale tale vidhānena yathocitamathācaret || 42 || parītya mandiraṃ paścādgarbhagehaṃ praviśya ca| viṣṇusūktaṃ samuccārya sthāpayitvā tataḥ param || 43 || dhruvasūktaṃ tato jatvā pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| ekākṣarādisūktaṃ ca sthāpayeyussamāhitāḥ || 44 || dakṣiṇe brahmasūtrasya beramadhyaṃ yathā tathā| devadevaṃ jagadyoniṃ sthāpayedviṣṇamuvyayam || 45 || sthāpayedanyadevāstu tadvāme beramadhyamam| sūtrasandhau na kurvīta sarveṣāṃ beramadhyamam || 46 || sthāpitaṃ cettadajñānātsarvamāśu vinaśyati| autsavaṃ kauttukādvāme dakṣiṇe snāpanaṃ tathā || 47 || autsavaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme snāpanantviti kecana| garbhālayasya saṅkoce tvathavā mukhamaṇḍape || 48 || pratiṣṭhāpyāntarāle vā pūjayediti cāṅgirāḥ| ācāryaḥ purataḥ kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe susanyaset || 49 || vyahatinyāsādi nyasedvimbasya mūrdhādi pādāntaṃ vyāhṛtitrayam| yakāraṃ pādayormadhye tvakāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 50 || praṇavena samāveṣṭya mūdhniṃ ca praṇavaṃ nyaset| ātmasūktaṃ tato japtvā kūrcenādāgaya vai tataḥ || 51 || āvahanaprakāraḥ kumbhācchaktiyutaṃ toya 'māyātu bhagavā' niti| 'viṣṇumāvāhayā' mīti srāvayedvimbamūrdhani || 52 || prāgādi 'puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāniruddhakam'| bimṛbamūrdhni samāvāhya pīṭhe tu paritaḥ kramāt || 43 || tatṛtaddikṣa sumāvāhya puṣpanyāsoktadevatāḥ| śrīdevīhṛdaye kṛtvā śrīvatsādikamakṣaram || 54 || lakṣmīpūrvākṣaraṃ mantraṃ hṛdaye ceva vinyaset| sānusvārañca vinyasya 'śriye jāta' iti śriyam || 55 || medinyādīn samucacārya mahīmāvāhayetamkamāt| garbhālayasthitān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān || 56 || vimāneśān lokapālānanapāyina eva ca| tattanmantraissamāvāhya tato vai kautukādiṣu || 57 || kṛtvā mantrākṣaranyāsau dhruvādāvāhayetkramāt| bhrāvāhane viśeṣaḥyadyatra laukikaṃ beraṃ prādurbhāvādayo dhruvāḥ || 58 || pratiṣṭhāpya kramātteṣāṃ tasmādāvāhayeddhruvāt| yatrālaye tu yadveraṃ dhruvahīnaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 59 || āvāhya taddhruvādeva tattadvidhivadarcayet| pṛthagevāthavā kumbhaṃ saṃsādhyāvāhayettataḥ || 60 || āsanādibhirabhyarcca havīṃṣyapi nivedayet| pratiṣṭhāntotsavaḥ balau balyutsavaṃ kuryātsnāpane snapanaṃ caret || 61 || taddine sāyamārabhya cautsave cotsavaṃ caret| ghoṣaṇaṃ sadya evātra kuryādityāha pūrvajaḥ || 62 || aṅkurārpaṇavikalpāḥ pratiṣṭhāntotsavārambhadhvajasnāpakarmasu| naivāṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryādekāhe bahukarmaṇām || 63 || pūrvīsminneva divase caikamevāṅkurārpaṇam| pṛyakpṛthakprakartavyaṃ bhinnakartṛkakarmaṇām || 64 || aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhādivasādadhaḥ| karmaṇāṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ na kuryātpṛthagaṅkuram || 65 || viniyuktasambhārāṇāṃ viniyogaḥ devayāgopayuktāni tāni dravyāṇi yāni vai| gṛhaṇīyādupayojyāni gururevākhilāni ca || 66 || sruksruvādīni pātrāṇi tvaraṇī maṅṛgalāṣṭakam| punaśca karmayogyāni yānamāsanameva ca || 67 || vitānaṃ ca dhvajaṃ chatraṃ cāmaravyajanādikam| grāhyaṃ punaśca karmārtha haviraharyādipātrakam || 68 || anyānyanupayojyāni dāhyānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| brahmasthāne śilāberapratiṣṭhā evaṃ kartumaśaktaścedvarṇahīnaṃ śilāmayam || 69 || brahmasthānepratiṣṭhāpya pūjayediti kecana| vakṣyāmi tatkramaṃ beraṃ citraṃ sarvāṅgasundaram || 70 || kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ paścādamantrakamataḥ param| tattatpade pratiṣṭhāpya śilāsthāpanamārgataḥ| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu tatra vai || 71 || samantrakākṣimokṣānte pañcagavyādipūritān| kumbhāṃstriyaṣṭiyogena sarandhrānberamūrdhani || 72 || pateddhārā yathā tasmāttathā sannyasya tānkramāt| adhivāsakriyāṃ kuryādabhiṣekānvitaṃ pṛthak || 73 || athavā'bhimukhe kṛtvā pañcagavyādipūritān| aṣṭottaraśataṃ jatvā tattanmantrānyathākramam || 74 || abhyukṣya snāpayeddevaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāvayejjalaiḥ| mahāpratiṣṭhāmārgeṇā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 75 || autsave balibere ca tasmādāvāhanaṃ smṛtam| athavā tvaritaḥ kartumekaberavidhiṃ yadi || 76 || beraṃ kṛtvā'kṣimokṣānte gavyādiṣvadhivāsya ca| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva kumbhapūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 77 || rātrau samāpya vidhinā prātaḥ snātvā yathāvidhi| brahmasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya ratnanyāsapurassaram || 78 || śilpisparśaviśuddhyartha vāstuhomāvasānake| dhruvaberoktavacchuddhiṃ kṛtvā berasya mantravit || 79 || kumbhācchaktiṃ samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet| brahmasthane'thavā kṛtvā ratnādinyāsamatvaraḥ || 80 || pīṭhasaṃṅghātarmoṇa tatra saṃsthāpya śilpinā| amantrakākṣimokṣaṃ ca kṛtvodvāsya ca śilpinam || 81 || aṣṭabandhe dṛḍhe paścādanukūle śubhe dine| akṣyunmeṣādhivāsādi pratiṣṭhāmācarettathā || 82 || rāṣṭrāntarānīta bimbādipratiṣṭā rājā rāṣṭāntaraṃ jitvā beraṃ yadi samānayet| tadvimbañca samuddiśya svarāṣṭre ca manorame || 83 || dhruvaṃ tasyānurūpaṃ ca vimānamapi kārayet| saṃsthāpya pūrvavattatra kuryāttatrārcanaṃ budhaḥ || 84 || dhruvaberānurūpañcedathavā mandire kvacit| autsavaṃ snāpanaṃ vā'tha sthāpayediti kecana || 85 || athavā nānurūpaṃ cellaukikaṃ vā'tha kutracit| sthāpya trayāṇāṃ bimbānāṃ sthānādanyatra pūjayet || 86 || sa labhediṣṭakādināṃ phalaṃ dviguṇameva ca| nītamāgneyabimbaṃ cetsaptāhaṃ padmakuṇḍake || 87 || mahāśāntiṃ ca juhuyādadhivāsādi pūrvavat| kārayitvā tu vidhinā laukikaṃ sthāpayetpunaḥ || 88 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā samāvāhyārkamaṇḍalāt| kumbhāttasmintsamāvāhya pūjayediti śāsanam || 89 || bhūmiṃ parīkṣya vidhinā sadyaḥ kartu tvarānvitaḥ| brahmāpadmāvasāne tu garbhagehe viśeṣataḥ || 90 || adhiṣṭhānodayānte tu ghanaṃ bhittiṃ prakalpayet| pañcaraṃ ca bahiḥ kṛtvā tatra beraṃ yathāvidhi || 91 || prāyaścittaviśeyāḥ śraddhābhaktī puraskṛtya tvarito yena kenacit| akṛtvā bhūparīkṣādin vinā'cāryaṃ padārthibhiḥ || 92 || sthāpanānuktanakṣatramāsādau sthāpayedyadi| sumāsapakṣanakṣaṃtramuhūrteṣu yathāvidhi || 93 || māsaṃ pakṣaṃ captāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā tryahantu vā| trikālaṃ pauṇḍarīkāgnaumahāśāntiṃ juhoti vai || 94 || tattanmantrajapaṃ kuryādbhūparīkṣādakarmaṇām| kṛtvā'ṅkarārpaṇaṃ paścānnayanonmīlanaṃ tathā || 95 || pañcagavyādhivāsādi kuryādyatnena pūrvavat| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 96 || snāpanautsavayoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāmācaredyadi| sabhyañca pauṇḍarīkañca dvāvagnī iti kecana || 97 || balibepratiṣṭhāyāṃ sabhyamekāgnimeva vā| tatra praṇīya nityāgniṃ homaṃ hutvā yathāvidhi || 98 || ādadhīta pratiṣṭhānte nityakuṇḍe tu pūrvavat| nāsti cettatra nityāgniḥ pañcāgnīm parikalpayet || 99 || tatkuṇḍādgārhapatyākhyātpraṇīya juhuyāttathā| devyoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kuṇḍamaupāsanoktavat || 100 || pratyekaṃ kalpayitvā tu tantrayitvaikameva vā| snapanaṃ kumbhapūjāñca śayanañca gṛthakpṛthak || 101 || tattatsūktañca tanmantraṃ vaiṣṇavena śataṃ yajet| eṣa eva viśeṣassyātsarvamanyatsamaṃ bhavet || 102 || dhruvārcāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ vimānārambhataḥ pūrva sthāpite ceddhruvārcanam| paritaḥ pañcaraṃ kṛtvā śilpisparśanivāraṇam || 103 || tathā''layagatān devān tathaivā''vāhya pañjare| vimānaṃ kārayecchīghraṃ paritaḥ pañjarāhiḥ || 104 || śilpisparśaviśuddhyartha tatkriyoparatau punaḥ| vāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paryagniñcaiva kārayet || 105 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya puṇyāhamapi vācaret| snāpayetkalaśairdevaṃ yathāśakti mudānvitaḥ || 106 || devālayasyābhikhe pauṇḍarīke viśeṣataḥ| mahāśāntiṃ tathaikāhaṃ hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 107 || sabhyābjakuṇḍe kṛtvā'gre tatrāghāraṃ juhoti ca| rātripūjāvasāne tu devaṃ kumbhe niveśya ca || 108 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairbimbaṃ kumbhasamanvitam| dhānyapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya bimbaṃ snnyasya paścime || 109 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhinā hotā hautrakrameṇa vai| tadalayagatāndevāntsamāvāhya yathāvidhi || 110 || āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 111 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śrīmahīsūktaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam| jayādibhiśca kūṣmāṇḍaissahasrāhutibhistathā || 112 || tadālayagatānāñca mantraiḥ pariṣadāmapi| mindāhutibhyāṃ vicchinnairviṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 113 || tathaiva viṣṇugāyatryā padmahomaṃ juhoti ca| tathā''gneyyāntu padmāgnau juhuyātpāramātmikam || 114 || prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena kumṛbhamantaḥ pragṛhya ca| kumbhādvimbe samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet || 115 || tadālaye samāvāhya devānpañjaragānapi| vyapohya pañjaraṃ sarvaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 116 || dhruvārcādiniruktiḥ dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ dhruvārcanamiti kramāt| sthāpanaṃ taddivadhā proktaṃ devadevasya śāṅgirṇaḥ || 117 || patanādiṣu sarveṣu prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam| dhruvasya kautukasyāpi vidhivatsthāpanañca yat || 118 || dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ taduvāca pitāmahaḥ| padeṣūkteṣu yatsthāpyaṃ taddhruvārcanamīritam || 119 || dhruvañca kautukañcaikaṃ dhruvārcanamudāhṛtam| tadeva devīhīnañcedekaberamiti smṛtam || 120 || ekaberañca tatprāhuḥ kevalāmuṣmikapradam| iti saṅkṣepataḥ proktaṃ sthāpanaṃ munisattamāḥ || 121 || iti ḥśrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre mahāpratiṣṭhā ratnanyāsāvāhanāgnisamāropaṇa rāṣṭrāntarānītaberasthāpanānuktakālapratiṣṭhā prāyaścittādi vidhirnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
<10> oṃ daśamo'dhyāyaḥ arcanāṅgopacārāḥ athopacārānvakṣayāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ| devopacārahatutvādupācārāḥ prakīrtitārāḥ || 1 || pūjanārtha viśeṣeṇa grahaṇādvigrahāśca te| catuppapṭyupacārāṃśca pañcapañcāśadeva ca || 2 || catvāriṃśatsahāpṭabhirdvicatvāriṃśadeva ca| ṣaṭtriṃśacca catustriṃśat dvātriṃśannavaviṃśatiḥ || 3 || saptaviṃśatirityete navadhā parikīrtitāḥ| ālayārcāvidhāvete havirhīne trayodaśa || 4 || dravyadevārcane caiva parivārārcane tathā| ekādaśopacārāḥ syuśśivādīnāṃ tathā'rcane || 5 || pratidravyārcane proktāssnapane tvaṣṭavigrahāḥ| home ṣaḍvigrahāḥ proktā avatāreṣu ṣoḍaśa || 6 || bālālaye dhruvārcāyāṃ pañcaviṃśativigrahāḥ| dvā vigrahāvaśaktānāmeko vigraha eva vā || 7 || ityeteṣāñca sarveṣāmādyamāvāhanaṃ tathā| sāmānyamarcanānte ca tathaivodvāsanaṃ smṛtam || 8 || tābhyāṃ vinaiva saṅkhyātamāsana svagataṃ tathā| uttamakalpe cuṣṣaṣṭyupacārā anumānañca pādyañca tathaivācamanaṃ punaḥ || 9 || puṣpaṃ gandhañca dīpañca dīpārdhyācamanāni ca| snānaṃ plotañca vastrañca uttarīyañca bhūṣaṇam || 10 || upavītañca pādyañca tathaivā'camanaṃ punaḥ| puṣpaṃ gandhañgha dhūpañca dīpamācamanaṃ tathā || 11 || havimrantrābhidhānaṃ syātpānīyācamanaṃ punaḥ| mukhavāso'ṣṭapādyādi darpaṇaṃ chatracāmarau || 12 || tālavṛntaṃ dhvajagajarathāśvā nṛttageyakau| vādyamāyudhasevā ca maṅgalānāṃ pradakṣiṇam || 13 || vedapārāyaṇa dikṣu purāṇastutireva ca| mātrā ca madhuparkañca havirhomau tataḥ param || 14 || pānīyācamane caiva mukhavāsamataḥ param| baliścaiva praṇamaśca puṣpāñjalirataḥ param || 15 || stutiśca dakṣiṇā paścādanumānañca bhaktitaḥ| catuṣṣapaṣṭyupacārāsyuruttamottamapūjane || 16 || pañcapañcāśadupacārāḥ gajadhvajarathāśvaiśca maṅgalairāyudhairapi| vinevāpyanumānena stutyā dakṣiṇayā tathā|| 17 || vigrahāḥ pañcapañcāśat proktā uttamamadhyame| ṣaḍbhiśca dakṣiṇāpūrvaiḥ puṣpasyāñjalinā vinā || 18 || aṣṭacatvāriśadupacārāḥ bhogāṣṣaḍaṣṭasaṅkhyātā uttamādhamapūjane| madhyamakalpe tato mantrahaviḥ pūvairvināṣaḍbhiśca vigrahaiḥ || 19 || dvicatvāriṃśadupacārāḥ dvicatvāriṃśaduddiṣṭā madhyamottamapūjane| ṣaṭtriṃśadupacārāḥ stotreṇa ca vinā vedairmadhuparkeṇa mātrayā || 20 || chatreṇa vyajanenāpi tataṣṣaṭtriṃśadīritāḥ| paṭtriṃśadvigrahā ete proktā madhyamamadhyame || 21 || cutastriśadupacārāḥ madhyamādhamapūjāyāṃ vinā darpaṇacāmarau| vigrahāśca catustriṃśannṛttageyavivarjitāḥ || 22 || adhamakalpe dvātriṃśadvigrahāḥ proktā adhamottamapūjane| dvātriṃśadupacārāḥ vinaiva vādyahomābhyāṃ dīpāntācamanena ca || 23 || ekonatriṃśadupacārāḥ navaviṃśatibhogāste proktā adhamamadhyame| saptaviṃśatyupacārāḥ vinā balipraṇāmābhyāṃ saptaviṃśativigrahāḥ || 24 || adhamādhamapūjāyāṃ navadhā vigrahāḥ smṛtāḥ| kautukādīnāmupacārāḥ anyeṣāñca havirlābhe saptaviṃśativigrahāḥ || 25 || arcāyāmautsave vāpi laukikeṣvitareṣu vā| vihitaṃ pūjanaṃ sadbhiḥ saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 26 || havirhone prayoktavyāste trayodaśa vigrahāḥ| ardhyādyācamanāntāḥ syurāsanādyāśca vigrahā || 27 || puṣpāñjalinamaskārayutā ete trayodaśa| puṣpāñjalinamaskārahīnā ekādaśaiva te || 28 || aṣopacārāḥ pādyādyā arghyādyācamanāntakaiḥ| puṣpādayaste ṣaṭ proktāḥ homadhyānārcanāya vai || 29 || ekādaśopacārāste cayurbhirhavirādibhiḥ| praṇāmena ca saṃyuktāḥ proktāṣṣoḍaśa vigrahāḥ || 30 || haviḥ pānīyamācamo mukhavāso balistathā| homaścaiva praṇāmaśca tathā puṣpāñjaliḥ stutiḥ || 31 || ekaberārcane ekaberārcane proktāḥ pañcaviṃśativigrahāḥ| upacārāḥ puṣpāñjalipraṇāmau dvau praṇāmastvekavigrahaḥ || 32 || prādu rbhāvāyāṃ poḍaśopacārāḥ pādyādyaṣṭopacārānte catvāro havirādayaḥ || 33 || baliścaiva praṇāmaśca stutiḥ puṣpāñjalistathā| ālayārcāvidhāne tu pūrvoktavidhinā'rcayet || 34 || upacārāṇāṃ cāturvidhyam spṛśyā dṛśyāstathā śrāvyā bhojyāścaiva caturvidhāḥ| āsanaṃ pādyādānañca puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ tathaiva ca || 35 || arghyaṃ snānādayāṣṣaṭ va mātrā ca madhuparkakam| puṣpāñjaliprayogaśca spṛśyā dakṣiṇayā saha || 36 || bhojyā eva samuddiṣṭāścatvāro havirādayaḥ| devasya dakṣiṇe haste dadyāttānardhyasaṃyutān || 37 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ tathā vedāḥ purāṇaṃ stutireva ca| śrāvyā eva samuddiṣṭā dṛśyāścāṣṭopacārakāḥ || 38 || dhūpārghyamadhuparkāṇi āghreyāṇīti kecana| upacārā iti proktāstatprayogakramādikam || 39 || svarūpañca khile proktaṃ vijñeyaṃ vidhivittamaiḥ| dhruvaberapūjāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ bhaktayā'thavā dhruve bere pūjāṃ kartu yadīcchati || 40 || snānānulepanaslotairvinā'nyaiḥ sarvavigrahaiḥ| pūjayenmukhavāsāntaiḥ dhruvaberantu kecana || 41 || kautuke nityapūjā, upacārasamarmaṇaprakāraḥ nityapūjāṃ viśeṣeṇa kuryātkautuka eva vai| tattanmantrāvasāne tu pañcabhirmūrtibhiḥ pṛthak || 42 || dravyanāma ca saṃyojya 'dadā' mīti vadandadet| vastrottarīyopavītabhūṣaṇādīn yathāvidhi || 43 || saṃyojya pañcamūrtibhyo dadyādityāha kāśyapaḥ| vastūnā marcanārthānāmādhāvamadhikaṃ smṛtam || 44 || arcane tu vihīnaṃ yattattattoyena prakalpayet| prātaḥkālārcanāhaṃ puṣpāṇi paṅkajañca pālāśañca tulasī navamālikā|| 45 || nandyāvartañca mandāraṃ mādhavī campakaṃ tathā| punnāgaṃ ketakī cāpi prātaḥkālārcane daśa || 46 || madhyāhrakālārcanārha puṣpāṇi śvetābjaṃ karavīñca palāśaṃ tulasī tathā| utpalaṃ bilvapatrañca raktotpalamathāpivā || 47 || kovidāraikapatrañca tāpasāṅkurameva ca| proktānyetāni puṣpāṇi daśa madhyāhrapūjane || 48 || sāyamarcanārha puṣpāṇi raktājabjaṃ kumudañcaiva mallikā jātimālatī| mādhavī karavīrañca hrīberaṃ gajakārṇikā || 49 || tathā damanakañcaiva sāyaṃkālārcane daśa| sarvakālārcanārhapuppāṇi dūrvā ca tulasī bilvaṃ karevīrañca campakam || 50 || sarvakālārcanārhāṇi viṣṇukrāntañca bhadrayā| tulasīmahimā varjya paryuṣitaṃ puṣṣaṃ vajarya paryuṣitaṃ jalam || 51 || na varjyaṃ tulasīpatraṃ na varjyaṃ jāhravījalam| kapitthadalapraśaṃsā bilvapatrāsamaṃ rātrau kapitthadalamucyate || 52 || yadyatpuṣpāṇi coktāni tattatpatreśca pūjayet| arcako cāri dīpañca puṣpametaccatuṣṭayam || 53 || grāhyaṃ sāmānyatastena sampūrṇa pūjanaṃ bhavet| pañcaṅgamarcanam dhruvagerārcanaṃ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ śāntapūjanam || 54 || kautukābharyanaṃ paścādbhūtapīṭhārcanaṃ param| pañcamaṃ balipūjā syādetaiḥ pañcabhirarcanaiḥ || 55 || sampūrṇamarcanaṃ yuktamayuktaṃ vikalārcanam| dhruvaberārcanātsiddhyet sāyujyaṃ padamakṣayam || 56 || sarvalokādhipatyaṃ vai sārūpyaṃ śāntapūjayā| aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarva bhuktvā sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 57 || kautukaubhyarcanādvāpi bhūtapīṭhārcanāttataḥ| sarvaśatrujayaṃ dīrghamāyurārogyameva ca || 58 || śriyaṃ putrasamṛddhiñca sālokyaṃ padamāpnuyāt| sarvaloke'pi vikhyātiṃ sāmīpyaṃ balipūjayā|| 59 || tattatpratiṣṭhākartṛṇāṃ tattapphala mudāhṛtam| bere caiva vimāne ca bhūtapīṭhe tathaiva ca || 60 || sadā sannihito viṣṇuḥ chāyayordhāmaberayoḥ| pradakṣiṇavidhāvetallaṅghanantu na doṣakṛt || 61 || yugmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādayugmaṃ tvābhicārikam| naiva pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādantare devaśāntayoḥ || 62 || deva pīṭhāntare caiva na kuryāditi kecana| eṣa eva viśeṣasyādanyatsarva khiloktavat || 63 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguprokṛtāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre upacārabhedapuṣpanirṇayavidhānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
<11> oṃ ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ daśāvatārakalpaḥ matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca nārasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ| rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca kṛṣṇaḥ kalkīti te daśa || 1 || āvirbhāvāḥ pañca pūrve prādurbhāvāstathā'pare| matsyakūrmau dvidhā proktau vārāhastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || pañcadhā nārasiṃhastu dvividho vāmanaḥ smṛtaḥ| ekadhā bhārgavo rāmo rāghavo dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 3 || dvividho balabhadraśca kṛṣṇo'saṅkhyātavigrahaḥ| ekadhā kalkirūpaśca teṣāṃ śrṛṇuta lakṣaṇam || 4 || matsyaḥ mahājalaughapralaye carācarajagatkṣaye| tattoyamupasaṃhartumāsītprathamamattsyakaḥ || 5 || tadromakūpavivare pramitaḥ pralayārṇavaḥ| kalpāvasānapralayalīnavedopadeśakaḥ || 6 || matsya āsīddvi tīyaśca devadevo janārdanaḥ| taptahāṭakasaṅkāśaḥ prathamo'nyo'ñjanaprabhaḥ || 7 || raktapadmāsanāruḍhau vitastivisṛtau tathā| vistāradviguṇāyāmau kuryānmatsyau yathāvidhi || 8 || pauṇḍarīkaḥ pradhānāgniranyatsarva khiloktavat| kūrmaḥ svasthānacalitakṣoṇībharaṇāyādikacchapaḥ || 9 || dvitīyaścāmṛtoddhāramananthamandaradhārakaḥ| añjanābhaṃ tayo rūpaṃ catuśrāsanasthitiḥ || 10 || gārhapatyaḥ pradhānāgniranyatsarva khiloktavat| vārāhaḥ pātālamagnāṃ vasudhāmuddhartuprathamastathā || 11 || āsīdādivarāhākhyastasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam| nararūpo varāhaśca sasyaśyāmaścaturbhujaḥ || 12 || dakṣiṇassusthitaḥ pādaḥ pīṭhe vāmastu kuñcitaḥ| pañcatālapramāṇena tadūrau śyāmalāṃ mahīm || 13 || prāñjalīkṛtahastāṃ tāṃ prasāritapadadvayām| puṣpāmbarāṃ samudvīkṣya vrīlāharṣasamanvitām || 14 || devo dakṣiṇahastena devyoḥ pādau pragṛhya ca| vāmamādhāravatkṛtvā devyā bāhvoradhopari || 15 || pātālamagnāṃ vasudhāṃ tāmudbhṛtya samutthitaḥ| parābhyāñca karābhyāñca śaṅkhacakradharaṃ param || 16 || jighranmūrdhni tathā devīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām| śvetapadmasitābhau tu puṇyatīrthau tadarcakau || 17 || brahmarājaśriyau śvetaraktābhau dvārapālike| śvetābhāśca caturvedāḥ vāhanasthānamāśritāḥ || 18 || pulindaṃ śaiṣikaṃ śyāmaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret| pralaye'vāntarodbhūte tañca saṃhartumudyataḥ || 19 || vārāhaḥ pralayākhyo'bhūtpūrvavacca kiṭermukham| taptahāṭakasaṅkāśaṃ nīlāmbaradharaṃ param || 20 || abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalambitam| śaṅkhacakradharāvūrdhvamanyatsarva ca pūrvavat || 21 || devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve mahīṃ devīṃ prakalpayet| devadevyau sukhāsīnau tasya siṃhāsanādadhaḥ || 22 || nāradaṃ raktavarṇañca vīṇāhastaṃ prakalpayet| pūjakau bhṛgupuṇyau tāvanyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 23 || hiraṇyākṣāsuraṃ hatvā sarvayajñavināśakam| yajñasya sthāpanaṃ kartumāsīdyajñavarāhakaḥ || 24 || śveto varṇo'khilañcānyatpralayākhyavarāhavat| siṃhāsane sukhāsīnaḥ śrībhūmisahitaḥ paraḥ || 25 || uktau kanakayajñākhyau pūjakau rukmasannibhau| teṣāṃ sabhyaḥ pradhānāgniranyatsarvakhiloktavat || 26 || 'kṣmāmekā' miti mantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| nārasiṃhabhedāḥ girijaḥ sthūṇajaścaiva sudarśananṛsiṃhakaḥ || 27 || tathā lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaśca pātālanarasiṃhakaḥ| iti pañcavidhaḥ prokto nārasiṃho manīṣibhiḥ || 28 || girijasthūṇajau proktau khile vistarato mayā| sudarśananṛsiṃhaḥ sudarśananṛsiṃhasya lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate || 29 || koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ cakraṃ vimalamujjavalam| bṛhadbhānupuradvandaṃ cakramadhye prakalpayet || 30 || tasya madhye susāsīnaṃ nṛsiṃhamaruṇaprabham| atyantabhīṣaṇākāraṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 31 || cakrāyudhaṃ caturbāhuṃ devadevaṃ prakalpayet| tasya siṃhasanādhastāddakhiṇetarapārśvayoḥ || 32 || vadantau kopaśāntyarthaṃ brahmarudrau prakalpayet| 'yo vā nṛsiṃha' ityuktvā cakramantradvayena ca || 33 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ homamanyatsarva nṛsiṃhavat| lakṣmīnṛsihaḥ vakṣye lakṣmīnṛsiṃhasya lakṣaṇaṃ munisattamāḥ || 34 || siṃhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ vāmapādaṃ prasārtha ca| āsane nihitaṃ pādaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kuñcitaṃ tathā || 35 || devasyorau prakurvīta lakṣmīṃ sarvāṅgasundarīm| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ vrīlāharṣasamanvitām || 36 || prāñjalīkṛtahastāntāṃ padmakiñjalkasannibhām| prasāritapadāṃ devīṃ pañcatālapramāṇataḥ || 37 || varadābhayahastāṃ vā udyatpadmadharāntu vā| dakṣiṇenaiva hastena kurvāstadupagūhanam || 38 || vāmamūrau niveśyaiva parābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakrabhṛt| bhuktimuṣmikataphalāpekṣīṃ kuryādevaṃ yathāvidhi || 39 || kevalāmuṣmikāpekṣī lakṣmīṃ vāme prakalpayet| vāmabhāge tu kuryāccedvāmorau tāṃ niveśya ca || 40 || vāmena tāṃ pariṣvajya dakṣiṇenābhayapradam| parābhyāñca karābhyāñca śaṅkhacakradharaṃ tathā || 41 || evaṃ samparikalpyainaṃ brahmeśāvapi pūjayet| aupāsanāgnikuṇḍañca kuryāddevyāḥ pṛthak śriyaḥ || 42 || ekakuṇḍe'tha vā homaṃ kuryādasyāśca kecana| lakṣmyāḥ śrīsūktasaṃyuktaṃ 'śriye jāta' iti bruvan || 43 || 'śaṃ sā niyacchatī' tyuktvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| 'śriyaṃ dhṛtiṃ pavitrīñca lakṣmī' miti ca mūrtibhiḥ || 44 || pṛthakkuṇḍaṃ yadi bhavetpuruṣasūktasamanvitam| pūrvavannārasiṃhasya sarvaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 45 || nṛsiṃhasthāpane viśeṣaḥ sudarśananṛsiṃhañca sthūṇajañca vinetarān| sarvatra kalpayetpuṣṭyai grāmādiṣu ca vāstuṣu || 46 || grāmamadhye yadi bhavet taddṛṣṭyā sarvanāśanam| tasmātsarvaprayatnena caturdvārāṇi kārayet || 47 || sudarsananṛsiṃhañca sthūṇajañja yathāvidhi| sthāpayedvāmabahyeṣu grāmābhimukhameva vā|| 48|| pātālanarasiṃhañca pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ| vāmajānu samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇenaiva jānunā || 49 || āsīnaṃ garūḍaṃ kuryāccaturbhujasamanvitam| ubhābhyāmapi pāṇibhyāṃ hṛdaye'ñjalisaṃyutam || 50 || karābhyāmitarābhyāñca dadhānaṃ śeṣavigraham| bhogibhogatrivalayaṃ skandhe kuryādgarutmataḥ || 51 || uttamāṅgaṃ samuddhṛtya phaṇāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam| kalpayettatphaṇādhastānnārasihaṃ yathāvidhi || 52 || kuñcitaṃ vāmapādantaṃ śeṣabhoge nidhāya ca| āsīnaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vīśaksandhe prasārya ca || 53 || aṣṭabāhusamāyuktamabhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ karam| śeṣaiścakraṃ śaraṃ khaḍgaṃ dadhataṃ bāhubhistribhiḥ || 54 || vāme śaṅkhañca śārṅgañca kheṭakañca gadāmapi| śeṣa pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃkāraye dvudhaḥ || 55 || gārūḍaṃ śeṣadaivatyaṃ juhuyādekaviṃśatiḥ| 'yo vā nṛsiṃha' ityuktvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 56 || nārasiṃhapratiṣṭhāyāmagnāvāhavanīyake| hautraṃ praśaṃsyatanmūrtyā nirūpyājyāhutīryajet || 57 || anyatsarva khile proktaṃ tatra jñātvā samācaret| nārasiṃhavikalpāśca bahudhā parikīrtitāḥ || 58 || teṣāṃ tālavibhāgaśca mantrā mūrtaya eva ca| kuṇḍañca parivārāṇāṃ girijasyoktavadbhavet || 59 || vāmanaḥ vairocane balavati balino'surapuṅgavāt | kāśyapādvāmano'dityāmapahartu jagacchalāt || 60 || āsīttasya pravakṣyāmi pratiṣṭhāmarcanādikam| trivikramaḥ sa evāsīttrilokakramaṇodyataḥ || 61 || trivikramastridhā proktaḥ prathamaśca dvitīyakaḥ| tṛtīyaśceti tadrūpaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kārayedvudhaḥ || 62 || aṣṭabāhuṃ caturbāhuṃ daśatālakrameṇa vai| gadācakrāsiśaktīśca śaraṃ śaṅkhañca śārṅgakam || 63 || dadhataṃ śyāmadehañca mahārūpadharaṃ harim| sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapādena vāmapādaṃ prasārya ca || 64 || harṣavegasamāyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| aṣṭabāhuṃ prakurvīta pravakṣyāmi caturbhujam || 65 || parābhyāñca karābhyāñca śaṅkhacakradharaṃ param| dakṣiṇaṃ hastamādāya pādamanyatprasāritam || 66 || vāmamūrdhve prasāryāṅghriṃ dakṣiṇenaiva susthitam| tatprasāritapādordhve hastaṃ samyakprasāritam || 67 || indraṃ chatradharaṃ kuryādākāśasthaṃ yathāvidhi| pārśvayośca yamaṃ samyagvaruṇaṃ vyājanau tathā || 68 || jānamumātroddhṛte pāde prathamastu vidhīyate| nābhimāne dvitīyaḥ syāttatīyassyāllalāṭake || 69 || brahmāṇaṃ kalpayedūrdhve tatpādakṣālanodyatam| tato gaṅgo prakurvīta brahmalokātparisrutām || 70 || prāñjalīkṛtahastāntāṃ nābherūrdhve śarīriṇīm| tasya pādordhvataḥ kuryānnamuciṃ bhramamāṇakam || 71 || śukaṃ vighnakaraṃ kuryātsthitapādasya vāmataḥ| muṣṭinā praharantaṃ tadūrdhve vīśaṃ prakalpayet || 72 || taddakṣiṇe sthitaṃ kuryāt vaṭurūpañca vāmanam| chatradaṇḍadharaṃ puṇyaṃ śikhākaupīnasaṃyutam || 73 || tatpārśve balinaṃ kuryādgṛhītakarakaṃ tathā| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ harṣayuktaṃ prakalpayet || 74 || nīlābhaṃ jāmbavantañca kalpaye dvānarākṛtim| indraṃ śyāmanibhaṃ kuryādyamamañjanasannibham| || 75 || varuṇaṃ śyāmavarṇañca bhāskarañcāgnisannibham| śvetaṃ niśākaraṃ kuryādvrahmāṇaṃ hāṭakapavrabham || 76 || gaṅgāṃ śvetaprabhāṅkuryānnamuci śyāmameva ca| śukraṃ śvetanibhaṃ kuryādyamamañjanasannibham || 77 || cakraṃ śvetanbhiṃ kuryādvaruḍaṃ pañcavarṇakam| vāmanañca tatha śyāmaṃ balinaṃ kanakaprabham || 78 || evaṃ tribhedato rūpaṃ svecchayā kārayedvudhaḥ| anvāhārye pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret || 79 || 'yo vā trimūrti' rityekaṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ yajet| sthāpanādīni sarvāṇi viṣṇusūktena kārayet || 80 || vāmano na pṛthak sthāpyassarvamanyatkhiloktavat| paraśurāmaḥ mahābalakṣatravadhādbhūbhārasya nirāsakaḥ || 81 || jamadagnisuto rāmo babhūvātyantadāruṇaḥ| kalpayedvijaṃ rāmaṃ daśatālapramāṇataḥ || 82 || dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste vāmamuddeśakaṃ tathā| raktavarṇaṃ prakurvīta jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam || 83 || nīlāmbaradharaṃ devamāsīnaṃ sthitameva vā| tadrūpaṃ kautukaṃ kuryādṛṣīṃstatparito likhet || 84 || anvāhārye pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret| 'viṣṇurvariṣṭha' ityuktvā saptatyekottaraṃ yajet || 85 || śiṣṭāni sarvakāryāṇi pūrvavatsamyagācaret| dāśarathirāmaḥ devahiṃsākarān hantuṃ rāvaṇādyāṃśca rākṣasān || 86 || āsīddāśarathī rāmaḥ sāyudhāṅgo nirāyudhaḥ| sārdhāṣṭatālamānena rāghavaṃ samprakalpayet || 87 || śyāmalaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuryāttribhaṅgena ca susthitam| śaraṃ dakṣiṇahastena cāpaṃ vāmena bibhratam || 88 || sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kirīṭamakuṭojjvalam| sītāñca dakṣiṇe pārśve pītavarṇāṃ prakalpayet || 89 || sapadmavāmahastāñca samprasāritadakṣiṇām| dakṣiṇaṃ susthitaṃ pādaṃ vāmaṃ kiṃcicca kuñcitam || 90 || pādaṃ hastaṃ prakurvīta viparītamathāpi vā| vāmato lakṣmaṇaṃ kuryādaṣṭatālena rukmabham || 91 || bālakuntalasaṃyuktamanyatsarvañca rāmavat| vārtāvijñāpanaparaṃ hanūmantañca dakṣiṇe || 92 || rukmābhaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva pāṇinā pihitānanam| prahvāṅgamūrdhvavadanaṃ vāmenāpi dhṛtāmbaram || 93 || evaṃ sāyudha uddiṣṭo vakṣyāmyanyaṃ nirāyudham| siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ devaṃ devīṃ yathāvidhi || 94 || vāmato lakṣmaṇaṃ kuryātprāñjalīkṛtya susthitam| kārayetkautukaṃ tadvadāsīnaṃ sthitameva vā || 95 || sāyudhe sāyudhaṃ tadvatkautukañca samācaret| ekasminneva kumbhe tu trayāṇāṃ dhyānamācaret || 96 || tasya devasaya devyāśca śayanakrama ucyate| tadvedyāṃ lakṣmaṇasyāpi śayanaṃ tu pṛthagbhavet || 97 || anvāhārye pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret| 'rāyāmīśa' iti japan saptatyekottaraṃ yajet || 18 || śrīvatsarvañca sītāyā yuktyā buddhyā samācaret| balabhadrarāmaḥ vakṣyāmi balabhadrākhyarāmaṃ yadukulodbhavam || 99 || dānavendravadhātso'pi bhūmibhārāpanodakaḥ| hastipṛṣṭhavimāne vā somacchande'thavā punaḥ || 100 || kṛṣṇasyārdhāsanāsīnaṃ sthāpayetpṛthageva vā| śaṅkhendukundadhavalaṃ dvibhujaṃ nīlavāsasam || 101 || musalaṃ dakṣiṇe haste halaṃ vāme ca kalpayet| itṛyevaṃ sāyudhaḥ proktaḥ pravakṣyāmi nirāyudham || 102 || vāmapādaṃ samākuñcya dakṣiṇaṃ samprasārya ca| savyañcābhayahastantu vāmamūruniveśitam || 103 || revatīṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve nīlotpaladalaprabhām| padmaṃ dakṣiṇahastena gṛhītvā'nya tathaiva ca || 104 || ūrau niveśya cāsīnāṃ revatīñca prakalpayet| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ devaṃ devīsamanvitam || 105 || evañca kautukaṃ kuryātthāpanārambhamācaret| agnāvāhavanīye tu hautraśaṃsanamācaret || 106 || 'kṣmāmekā' miti mantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| anyatsarva viśeṣeṇa viṣṇoriva samācaret || 107 || kṛṣṇaḥ kūṭe vā gopurākāre kumbhākāre''laye| navatālapramāṇena kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā samarcayet || 108 || śyāmalaṃ triṇataṃ raktavāsasaṃ dvibhujaṃ tathā| pāṇinā dakṣiṇenaiva krīḍāyaṣṭidharaṃ param || 109 || vāmenotkrīḍanakaraṃ sthilayaiva ca sulītam| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sundaraṃ saumyalocanam || 110 || rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāñca devyau dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ| śyāmaraktanibhe kṛṣṇapītavastravibhūṣite || 111 || garutmān bāhusīmāntamānena kārayedbhūṣaṇojjvalam| kalpayetprāñjaliṃ vīśaṃ vāmapārśve tu tatra vai || 112 || dhruvaberānurūpaṃ vai kautukañca samācaret| siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ devībhyāṃ tu nirāyudham || 113 || pūrvoktena vidhāne sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam| navanītanaṭaṃ vā'tha tathā kālīyamardanam || 114 || gopālavigrahaṃ vā'tha pārthasārathimeva vā| rūpāṇyanyānyasaṅkhyāni kṛṣṇasya munisattamāḥ || 115 || śilpaśāstroktavidhinā tattadrūpāṇi kalpayet| dakṣiṇaṃ kuñcitaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu susthitam || 116 || tasya kuñcitapādantu vāmapārṣṇiniveśitam| gṛhītaveṣṇuṃ hastābhyāṃ veṇurandhrāhitānanam || 117 || varhivarhāvataṃsañca kuryādgopālavigraham| yuttvatyāvuddhyā samūhyaiva kutyāttadrūpakalpanam || 118 || krīḍāyaṣṭidharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā gopālavigraham| vinānyānyasya rūpāṇi devīvirahitāni vai || 119 || krīḍāyaṣṭidharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cautsavaṃ viṣṇumeva vā| jñātvā ca harivatsarvānparivārānprakalpayet || 120 || sundaraṃ nāmagopālaṃ vidhivatsthānamāśritam| dvibhujaṃ puṣpavahaṃ caiva kuryānnirmālyahāriṇam || 121 || pauṇḍarīke pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret| 'satyassatyastha' ityuktvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 122 || hareriva samastāni sthāpanādīni kārayet| caturbhujakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ kecidicchanti munisattamāḥ || 123 || pūrvavatpūrvahastau tu śaṅkhacakradharau parau| kṛṣṇādimūrtayaḥ proktāḥ vāsudevapurassarāḥ || 124 || sarvamanyatsamaṃ proktamiti pūrvajaśāsanam| kalkī yugāntasamaye viṣṇuḥ kalkināmā bhaviṣyati || 125 || khaḍgakheṭakahastastu mlecchādīn saṃhaniṣyati| bhinnāñjananibhaṃ raktavāsasaṃ samprakalpayet || 126 || pauṇḍarīke pradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret| 'ṛtaṃ sa' tyeti mantreṇa śataṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 127 || avatārārcane antarāle'thavā viṣṇordakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ| avatārārcane vikalpāḥ kalpayedrāmakṛṣṇau tu mukhamaṇḍama eva vā || 128 || athāntarmaṇḍale vā'pi tathā''varaṇamāṇḍape| saṃsthāpya kautukaṃ beramarcayediti kecana || 29 || nārasiṃhaṃ varāhañca vāmanañca trivikramam| dhruvaberaṃ vinā kṛtvā kautukaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 130 || sthāpayitvā tathā viṣṇuṃ pūjayedagramaṇḍape| pādyamācamanaṃ snānamalaṅkāraṃ tathaiva ca || 131 || pādyamācamanaṃ puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpamataḥ param| dīpārdhyācamanānyeva haviḥ pānīyameva ca || 132 || tayaivācamanaṃ paścānmukhavāsamataḥ param| parapradhānabimbānāmete ṣoḍaśa vigrahāḥ || 133 || svapradhānāvatārāṇāṃ hareriva samācaret| sthānaṃ daśāvatārāṇāṃ dhruvakautukasaṃyutam || 134 || antarālayake kecidicchanti munasattamāḥ| sthānāśrayāvatārāṇāṃ mukhavāsantamarcanam || 135 || tattatpradhānamantrānte tattanmūrti samuccaran| arcanaṃ snāpanañcaiva kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ || 136 || āvirbhāvāvatārāḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyāvirbhāvāśca śārṅgiṇaḥ| trailokyamohanañcaiva hariśaṅkarameva ca || 137 || pūrvameva mayā proktāḥ khile vistaratastathā| matsyakūmravarāhāṇāṃ nārasiṃhasya kalkinaḥ || 138 || lakṣmīnarāyaṇaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vakṣye sarvasampatkaraṃ varam| vīśaskandhe samāsīna nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 139 || sarvamāsīnavatkṛtvā tasyorau dakṣiṇe tathā| devīṃ śriyaṃ prakalpyaiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 140 || prāñjalīkṛtahastāṃ tāṃ vrītalāharṣasamanvitām| deveśenopagūḍhāṃ tāṃ dakṣiṇāparapāṇinā || 141 || vāmāparabhujo viṣṇoḥ samyagūrau niveśitaḥ| eṣa eva viśeṣassyādanyatsarva hareriva || 142 || vāmorau kārayellakṣmīmiti kecidvadanti ca| vīśaskandhaṃ vinā kecidevamāsīnamāsane || 143 || sabhyahome pradhānāgnau pratiṣṭhektāhutīḥ kramāt| nārāyaṇānuvākañca śriyaḥ sūktaṃ tayaiva ca || 144 || yajedaṣṭottaraśatamanyeṣvagniṣu pūrvavat| 'śriye jāta' iti japan padmāgnau padmahomakam || 145 || lakṣmīnāyaṇāravyantu yajedviṣṇavādimūrtibhiḥ| viśeṣātsthāpane tatra viṣṇumūrtiṃ prakalpayet || 146 || autsavaṃ baliberañca viṣṇuṃ vā tadvadeva vā| pūrvamaṣṭopacāraistu dhruvamabhyarcya mantrataḥ || 147 || dvātriṃśadvigrahaiḥ pūjāṃ 'kautuke tu samācaret| niṣkalārcāvicāraḥ 'nārāyaṇaparaṃ brahma' paramātmeti kīrtyate || 148 || tadrapaṃ paramaṃ sūkṣma makṣaraṃ niṣkalañca yat| tatsthānīyaṃ dhruvaṃ proktamaśakyaṃ niṣkalārcanam || 149 || tatpuṣpanyāsamātraṃ syāddhbavaberārcanaṃ matam| viṣṇoryatsakalaṃ rūpaṃ sthūlaṃ sarvasya kāraṇam || 150 || tatsthānīyaṃ kautukaṃ syāttatra pūjāṃ samācaret| yayopayogaśakyatvātkartu puṣpādipūjanam || 151 || sālambanatvādvihitaṃ sakalatvāñca pūjanam| dhruvasya niṣkalatvāñca nirātambanahetunā || 152 || aśakyatvāttatra kartuṃ snānagandhādivigraham| ādikālavyavacchedānneṣyate tad dhruvārcanam || 153 || tathāpi pūjanaṃ kartu dhruvabere yadīcchati| snānaplotau vinā sarvairucārairyathāvidhi || 154 || 'ṛtaṃ satye' ti mantreṇa pūjayediti kecana| nārāyaṇānuvākena punaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet || 155 || ravimaṇjñaḍalamadhyasthaṃ taptahāṭakasannibham| śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ prasannendunibhānanam || 156 || abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalambitam| canrmaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhām || 157 || agnimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayet| cakram ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mahācakrasya lakṣaṇam || 158 || svatantraṃ sthāpayennaiva mahācakraṃ viśeṣataḥ| devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve naiṛte vā prakalpayet || 159 || yamanaiṛtayormadhye sthāpayedālayāśrayam| upānātthūpiparyantaṃ vṛttamevāsya mandiram || 160 || ekaberavidhānena sthāpayettaddhruvārcanam| aṣṭottaraśatajvālaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvā'sya madhyame || 161 || agninamaṇḍalayugmāntargataṃ cakraṃ prakalpayet| uttame ṣoḍaśabhujaṃ madhyame'ṣṭabhujaṃ tathā || 162 || adhame ca caturbāhuṃ kalpayedvā sudarśanam| cakrañca paṭṭasaṃ kuntaṃ daṇḍāṅkuśahavirbhujaḥ || 163 || kṣurikāñcaiva śaktiñca savyairdadhatamaṣṭabhiḥ| śaṅkhaṃ śarañca cāpañca pāśaṃ halamataḥ param || 164 || vajraṃ gadāṃ tomarañca dadhadvāmaiśca bāhubhiḥ| ityuktaṣṣoḍaśabhujastvaṣṭabāhuḥ pravakṣyate || 165 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmusanalāṅkuśa pāśinam| cāpinaṃ kalpayeccakramaṣṭavāhudharaṃ param || 166 || śaṅkhakradharañcaiva gadāpadmadharaṃ param| caturbāhuṃ dvibāhuṃ vā yathāśakti prakalpayet || 167 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ arkendvagnivilocanam| ājaṅghāntāvalambañca skandhātkiṅkiṇimālayā || 168 || rājamānamudārāṅgaṃ sarvaśatruvidāraṇam| śrīvatsakaustubhodbhāsivakṣasaṃ bhaktavatsalam || 169 || vahnijvālāvṛtañcāpi kirīṭamakuṭojjavalam| śaroṅgārāgnisaṅkāśaṃ śukapatranibhāmbaram || 170 || evaṃ kṛtvā mahācakraṃ sthāpanārambhamācaret| akṣyunmeṣādikaṃ kṛtvā cakramantradvayena ca || 171 || adhivāsya yathāśāstraṃ pañcagavyādiṣu kramāt| kumṛbhe dhyātvā samāvāhya saṃsnnāpya kalaśaistathā || 172 || aupāsanāgnau vidhinā hautraṃ samyakpraśaṃsya ca| vaṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 173 || caturāvartya hutvā tu cakramantradvayena ca| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā juhuyāccakramūtribhiḥ || 174 || prātarmuhūrte saṃsthāpya samāvāhya samarcayet| etadvaidikamuddiṣṭaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 175 || kevalaṃ bhuktimāścet smarenmaṃtraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram| sarvānkṛtvā vidhānena homakāle viśeṣataḥ || 176 || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tanmantramāvartya hūyatām| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvañca cakravat || 177 || ityārṣe śrīvairavānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre daśāvatāralakṣmīnārāyaṇamahācakrasthāpanavidhānaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
<12> oṃ dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ snāpanautsavayoḥ pṛthakpratiṣṭā snāpanautsavayoḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāṃ pravadāmyaham| kautuke sthāpite pūrvaṃ śaktau satyāṃ punastathā|| 1 || autsavaṃ snāpanaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayedvibhavārhataḥ| bimbaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā saṅghātaṃ vidhinā caret || 2 || akṣyunmeṣādhivāsau ca kṛtvā tasya yathāvidhi| sabhyābjakuṇḍe vā kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavaccaret || 3 || anyāgnivihitaṃ homaṃ sabhya eva samācaret| tatra praṇīya nityāgniṃ homakarma samācaret || 4 || kuryānnityāgnivicchede pañcakuṇḍāni pūrvavat| tatrāpi gārhapatyāgneḥ praṇīyānyeṣu hūyatām || 5 || pūrvedyureva śarvaryāṃ rātripūjāvasānake| devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya havissamyaṅnivedayet || 6 || dhruvabere samāvāhya praṇamyaivānumānya ca| saṃsādhya vidhinā kumbhaṃ tatrā'vāhya dhruvāttathā || 7 || kumbhaṃ bimbasya pārśve tu snānaśvabhre niveśca ca| snāpanaṃ śayanārohaṃ tathā kautukabandhanam || 8 || hautraṃ homaṃ tathā kṛtvā prātassaṃsthāpya pārśvayoḥ| kṛtvā mantrākṣaranyāsau pūrvamāvāhya kautuke || 9 || paścāccaivotseve'rcāyāṃ samāvāhya tathā dhruvāt| āsanādibhirabhyarcya havissamyak nivedayet || 10 || utsavaṃ cautsave bimbe snāpane snāpanaṃ tathā| yathāśakti prakurvīta dadyādacāryadakṣiṇām || 11 || laukikasthāpanāyāntu nityāgnirna praṇīyate| āvāhanaṃ tathā kumbhe kuryādādityamaṇḍalāt || 12 || kumbhāttu laukike bimbe samāvāhya samarcayet| ekaberavidhānañcet sthāpanaṃ na vidhīyate || 13 || kārayitvautsavaṃ bimbe rātripūjāvasānake| ekaberaṃ samabhyarcya kumbhe śaktiṃ niveśya ca || 14 || pūrvavatsthāpanādīni kārayitvā yathāvidhi| ekabere samāvāhya tasmādāvāhya cārcayet || 15 || baliberasya pṛthak pratiṣṭhā baliberapratiṣṭhā cettasminnāvāhya kautuke || 16 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva balyutsavamathācaret| devyoḥ ścātpratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣo vakṣyate'dhunā || 17 || devyoḥ paścāt pratiṣṭhā jaṅgamānāntu bimbānāṃ punardevyau ca kalpayet || 18 || dhruve devīviyukte'pi devīyuktañca kautukam| kuryātsarvaprayatnena viśeṣādautsavaṃ tathā || 19 || akṣyunmeṣādhivāsau ca kṛtvā tanmantramuccaran| pārśvayoryajñaśālāyāṃ kuryādaupāsanadvayam || 20 || tayornityāgnimādhāya yathoktaṃ homamācaret| dhruvasya devībimbābhyāṃ śaktimāvāhya kumbhayoḥ || 21 || snapanaṃ śayanaṃ kumbhaṃ homañca pṛthageva vā| sarvañca pūrvavatkṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā yathāvidhi || 22 || dhruvadevyossamāvāhya tābhyāmāvāhayettayoḥ| tacchaktipūrvaṃ saṃskārādvivāhaṃ na prakalpayet || 23 || devenāpyathavā sākaṃ pratiṣṭhāmācarettayoḥ| niveśya kautukācchaktiṃ dhruvabere yathāvidhi || 24 || dhruvaberāttathā kumbhe śaktimāvāhya pūrvavat| snānaśvabhre pratiṣṭhāpya devīṃ kumbhañca dakṣiṇe || 25 || pārśvayoḥ śvabhrayordevyau pratiṣṭhāpya pṛthakpṛthak| snāpayitvaikavedyāntu śāyayitvaiva mantrataḥ || 26 || hautrādi sakalaṃ karma kṛtvā pūrvoktamārgataḥ| kumbhāddhruve samāvāhya tasmādāvāhayejjale || 27 || vivāhavidhimatrāpi nācarediti śāsanam| dhruve devīviyukte'pi maṃthitenaiva vahrinā || 28 || āghāraṃ vidhivattatra kṛtvaupāsanakuṇḍake| devyau tu pūrvavaddhyatvā hṛdayādvā'rkamaṇḍalāt || 29 || āvāhya kumbhayordevyau homakarmāvasānake| kumbhāttadvimbayorbhaktyā samāvāhya samarcayet || 30 || devībhyāmautsave sādhaṃ sthāpyamāne tapodhanāḥ| dhruve devīviyukte'pi kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūvarvat || 31 || devībhyāmautsave sārdhaṃ sthāpyamāne tapodhanāḥ| dhruve devīviyukte'pi kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat || 31 || kumbhe bimbātsamāvāhya devaṃ devyau tataḥ param| āvāhya hṛdayāddhyāyaṃstathaivādityamaṇḍalāt || 32 || pūrvavat snapanādīni kṛtvā sarvāṇi tatra vai| devadevaṃ samāvāhya dhruvabere tu pūrvavat || 33 || tasmāddevaṃ samāvāhya kumbhāddevyau samāvahet| kautukavyatirikta pratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ kautukavyatiriktānāṃ sthāpanāyāṃ tapodhanāḥ || 34 || pariṣaddevatāhvānaṃ sarvadevārcanaṃ tathā| pariṣaddevatāhomaṃ varjayediti śāsanam || 35 || athavā devadevasya devyoścaiva pṛthakpṛthak| śayanaṃ kumbhapūjāñca kuryādityeva kecana || 36 || ekaberapratiṣṭhāyāṃ devyau na sthāpayetpunaḥ| śrībhūmisahitaṃ kuryāṃdādāve dhruvārcanam || 37 || sarvakāmābhivṛddhyarthī śriyā kevalameva vā| sthāpayedekaberasya paścādvai kevalaṃ śriyam || 38 || devībhyāṃ rahitaṃ kuryānnārasihaṃ dhruvārcanam| icchanti yogamārgeṇa santassarve dhruvārcanam || 39 || paṭakuḍyādibimba pratiṣṭhā paṭakuḍyasudhā''lekhyabimbānāṃ sthāpanāvidhim| pravakṣyāmi samāsena bimbaṃ kṛtvā salakṣaṇam || 40 || aupāsanāgnimādhāya vāstuhomavidhānataḥ| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā samīpataḥ || 41 || pūrvoktena krameṇaiva kṛtvā tasyākṣimocanam| kumbhaṃ pūrvavadādāya śuddhyartha prokṣaṇaṃ caret || 42 || pradoṣe samanuprāpte kuṇḍe caupāsane tathā| āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā kumṛbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat || 43 || abhyukṣya saptakalaśairbadhdvā pratisaraṃ tathā| hautraṃ praśaṃsya vidhinā devamāvāhya pūrvavat || 44 || āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet| ādimūrtipratiṣṭhā cedvaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktakam || 45 || sūktañca pauruṣaṃ hutvā punaścāpi ca vaiṣṇavam| pañcavāruṇasaṃyuktaṃ jayādīśca tathaiva ca || 46 || yaddevādīṃstato hutvā sahasrāhutisaṃyutam| avatārapratiṣṭhā cetattanmatraṃ śataṃ yajet || 47 || prātarmantrākṣaranyāsaṃ kṛtvā''vāhya smaran harim| adhastāttasya bimbasya pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā trivedikam || 48 || vitastyāyāmavistāraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulasamucchrayam| tassinkūrcañca vinyasya dvādaśāṅgulamātrakam || 49 || tasmindevaṃ samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet| arcanānte tathā bimbe visarjanamathā'caret || 50 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvañca pūrvavat| ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre paścāt snāpanautsaverdavīpratiṣṭhā vidhirnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
<13> oṃ trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ mahāsnapanam animittāni ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi snāpanaṃ vai samāsataḥ| pratiṣṭhotsavayorapi viṣuvāyanayorapi || 1 || devasya snapanaṃ kuryādrahaṇe sūryacandrayoḥ| vibhave sati kurvīta viṣṇupañcadineṣu ca || 2 || māsarkṣeṣvanyasaṅkāntyāṃ janmarkṣe kartṛbhūpayoḥ| grahakope'vagrahe ca dussvapne durnimittake || 3 || vyādhyādyaiḥ janapīḍāyāṃ tattacchāntyai prakalpayet| abdānte ca yugānte ca vyatīpātādiṣu kramāt || 4 || sambhārāḥ aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhva dravyāṇyapi samāharet| nādeyādimṛdo'ṣṭau ca himavatpramukhācalān || 5 || śālyādīnyapi dhānyāni tattaddhānyāṅkurāṇi ca| śrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakumbhañca bherīmādarśanaṃ tathā || 6 || matsyayugmāṅkuśe śaṅkhamāvartañcāmaṅgalam| bṛhadbhānupuradvandvamāvartamabhidhīyate || 7 || yukyānyāni prakurvīta prāgdravyāṇyatha pañca vai| pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtamadhudadhikṣīrāṇi pañca vai || 8 || guhṇīyādāḍhakāhīnaṃ yathālābhamathāpivā| śeṣaṃ jalena sampūrya tattatthāne samamarcayet || 9 || candanīśīrakoṣṭhailālavaṅgādyadhivāsitam| gandhodakamiti proktamāḍhakāhīnameva ca || 10 || yavasarṣapavrīhimāṣataṇḍalusaṃyutam| jalāṣṭāṃśākṣatairyuktamakṣatodakamucyate || 11 || kadalīcūtapanasanārikelaphalairyutam| nāraṅgamātuluṅgābhyāṃ triphalairmauñjakena ca || 12 || bhavyahavyakurundaiśca kāmareṇāpi saṃyutam| phalodakamiti proktaṃ jalāṣṭāṃśaphalairyutam || 13 || kuśāgrairmiśritaṃ toyaṃ kuśodakamiti smṛtam| navabhiḥ pañcabhirvāpi ratnaiḥ ratnodakaṃ smṛtam || 14 || 'āpo hi' ṣṭheti mantrāṃstrīnāvartyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam| 'ato devā' dibhiṣṣaḍbhirvaiṣṇavaissakṛdeva vā || 15 || japtvā'bhimantritaṃ toyaṃ japyodakamiti smṛtam| oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāstābhissarvābhiranvitam || 16 || toyāṣṭāṃśapramāṇābhiḥ sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ smṛtam| bilvapatrāśvadūrvābjanandyāvartaśamīpriyāḥ || 17 || puṇyapuṣpāṇi coktāni yathālābhaṃ samāharet| bilvapatrasamaṃ rātrau kapitthadalamucyate || 18 || cūrṇaṃ jātiphalādīnāṃ kaṣāyaṃ tīrthavāri ca| vanauṣadhiniśācūrṇaṃ sarvagandhamataḥ param || 19 || plotañca mūlagandhañca dhātūnapi samahāret| vastrottarīyopavītabhūṣaṇāni tathā''haret || 20 || kalaśānāḍhakāpūrṇān śarāvānprasthapūraṇān| droṇārdhapūrṇānkarakān droṇapūrṇānghaṭānapi || 21 || khaṇḍasphuṭitakālādirahitāneva cā'haret| sāgrairagarbhadarbhaiśca pañcabhirdaśabhiryutān || 22 || ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅṛgulāyāmān paristraṇakūrcakān| kalaśārthānprakurvīta dvādaśāṅgulasammitān || 23 || navabhissaptabhirvā'tha pañcabhistribhireva vā| kuśāḥ kāśāstathośīrā dūrvā vai vrīhayastathā || 24 || viśvāmitrā yavāścāpi sapta darbhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| snapanāṅgādhivāsaḥ pūrvarātrau tu deveśaṃ samabhyarcya nivedayet || 25 || ālayāddakṣiṇe vediṃ śayanārtha prakalpya ca| śayanāni pañca cāstīrya tathā dhānyopari kramāt || 26 || tatra devaṃ samāropya baddhvā pratisaraṃ tathā| śayane śāyayeddevaṃ pūrvavatsusamāhitaḥ || 27 || sandhidvayamatikramṛya snapanaṃ sambhavedyadi| sadyaḥ pratisaraṃ badhdvā śayanaṃ samprakalpayet || 28 || kautuke snāpanābhāve snapanaṃ yadi kārayet| dhruvārcāsnapane vā'pi sadyaḥ kautukabandhanam || 29 || kṛtvā śvabhre pratiṣṭhāpya snāpayediti śāsanam| rātrau yadodayātpūrva nimittaṃ snapanasya tu || 30 || rātripūjāvasāne tu tathā nodvāsayeddharim| snapanānte tathodvāsya prātarāvāhayettathā || 31 || nāvāhanavisargau dvau kautukavyatiriktayoḥ| snapanamaṇḍapam ālayābhimukhe kuryāduttaraiśānyayostathā || 32 || maṇḍapaṃ vā prapāṃ vā'tha kūṭaṃ vā snapanālayam| ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvārasamanvitam || 33 || śrīvatsaṃ padmakaṃ vā'pi svastikaṃ vā yathāvidhi| taṇḍulairvrīhibhirvā'tha paṅktiṃ kuryāttadantare || 34 || dvitālāhīnavistāraṃ yugāgnyakṣyaṅgulocchrayam| caturdikṣu tathā hastavistāraṃ dvārasaṃyutam || 35 || likhetpatralatākāraṃ 'sumitrān' iti sthalam| indrādīnāṃ digīśānāṃ paṅktīśasyāmitasya ca || 36 || tattatthāneṣu pīṭhāni paṅktāveva prakalpayet| paṅktibāhyetare vāpi kuryāccedābhiṃcārikam || 37 || tanmadhye snapaśvabhramaupāsanavidhānataḥ| kalpayitvā paristīrya jayādīnapi pūjayet || 38 || pūrvoktena prakāreṇa tatpaṅktyāṃ vihite pade| dravyanyāsaḥ nyase nmṛdādidravyāṇi deveśābhimukhāni vai || 39 || teṣu kūrcañca vinyasya pūjayedadhidevatāḥ| tattaddravyadharān dhyātvā tattaddravsamīpataḥ || 40 || uddhṛtya śayanāddevaṃ śvabhramadhye niveśca ca| pādyādibhissamabhyarcya tailenābhyajya pūrvavat || 41 || tathaiva punarabhyarcya snāpayecca mṛdādibhiḥ| snapanaprakāraḥ praṇavena samabhyukṣya gṛhītvā śiṣyahastataḥ || 42 || lalāṭāntaṃ samuddhṛtya trissakṛdvā pradakṣiṇam| nītvā saṃsnāpayeddevaṃ mūrtibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ kramāt || 43 || dravyaṃ pātraṃ punaḥ prokṣya pūrvasthāne niveśayet| prāgdravyaiśca pradhānaistadupasnānasamanvitaiḥ || 44 || anudravyaiśca pūrvoktairmantraissaṃsnāpayettathā| saṃsthāpya devamāsthāne samabhyarcya nivedayet || 45 || kautukaṃ snapanānte ca jīvasthāne nivedaśya ca| samarbhyarcya vinedyaiva dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ punaḥ || 46 || ghravārcāsnapane viśeṣaḥ dhravārcāsnapane kuryādālayābhimukhe prapām| pūrvavatparitaḥ paṅkatyāṃ snanadravyāṇi vinyaset || 47 || dhānyarāśau tu tanmadhye gandhatoyābhipūritam| kumbhaṃ sannyasya varuṇaṃ tatra sampūjyadaivatam || 48 || ādāyābhyantaraṃ gatvā snāpayecca mṛdādibhiḥ| alaṅkatṛya samabhyarcya havīṃṣyapi nivedayet || 49 || rātrau sūryodayātpūrva snapanaṃ yadi sambhavet| nodvāsya śaktiṃ tadvimbājchvabhre saṃsthāpya pūrvavat || 50 || snapanānte samabhyarcya nivedyodvāsayettathā| udaye śaktimudvāya ghruvavedyāṃ niveśya ca || 51 || ghruvāttatra samāvāhya snāpayediti śāsanam| yadi nakṣatrayugmaṃ syādekamāse viśeṣataḥ || 52 || parrāsmanneva divase snāpayetpuruṣottamam| tithidvayaṃ yadi bhavet dvayorapi samācaret || 53 || vāradvayānuṣaktañcennimittarkṣaṃ tithistu vā| parasminnave divasaṃ snapanādīni kārayet || 54 || ekasminneva divase nimittarkṣatithidvayam| nakṣatrasnapanaṃ pūrvaṃ tithikarma tataścaret || 55 || pūrvakarmāvasāne tu kṛtvā sadyo'ṅkurārpaṇam| sadyaḥ pratisaraṃ badhdvā dvitīyaṃ snapanaṃ caret || 56 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ khiloktavat| ityorṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ krayādhikāre mahāsnapanavidhirnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<14> oṃ caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ mahotsavaḥ avabhṛthakālaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi krameṇaivotsavaṃ hareḥ| viṣuvāyanabhūparkṣapratiṣṭhākartṛbheṣu ca || 1 || yajamānasya janmarkṣe nṛpateḥ ṛkṣa eva vā| grahaṇe māsanakṣatre viṣṇupañcadineṣu vā || 2 || utsavasyāntyadivase teṣu tīrtha prakalpayet| eteṣveka parigrāhya jayamānecchayā dinam || 3 || viṣuve cāyane caiva grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ| tattatkāle prakurvīta tīrthasnānantu nānyathā || 4 || anyarkṣeṣvadha madhyāhre pūrvāhṇe vā guṇādhike| ekasminneva māse tu yadi tīrthadinadvayam || 5 || tayorantyadinaṃ tīrthamiti pūrvajaśāsanam| tadeva yadi sūryasya viddhañcetsaṅkamādibhiḥ || 6 || vajranīyaṃ tathā pūrvaṃ praśastamabhidhīyate| vāradvayānuṣaktañceddinamekamathāparam || 7 || arkavārarkṣasayogassarvadā sampraśasyate| śravaṇadvādaśīyogassarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 8 || yogāśca supraśastāḥ syussiddhāmṛtavarāhvayāḥ| utsavatraividhyap kālaśraddhānimittārthā utsavāstrividhāḥ smṛtā || 9 || māse tu yasmin kasmiścit pratisaṃvatsaraṃ hareḥ| kriyate samayenaiva sa vai kālotsavo bhavet || 10 || śraddhayā kriyate yastu sa śraddhotsava ucyate| utpāteṣu nimitteṣu anāvṛṣṭyādikeṣu vai || 11 || kriyate tatra śāntyartha sa nimittotsavaḥ smṛtaḥ| utsavadinamānam kālaḥ uttamantu trisaptāhaṃ madhyamantu caturdaśa || 12 || navāhaṃ vā'tha saptāhamadhamaṃ paricakṣate| triguṇānyutsavāhāni kṛtvā''dau ghoṣaṇañcaret || 13 || madhye tu dviguṇādau syādutsavādidine'dhame| athavā'vabhṛthātpūrva ekaviṃśatike dine || 14 || dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvamutsavamācaret| dhvajadaṇḍalakṣaṇam viprādīnāṃ kramādveṇu5jāticampakapūgajāḥ || 15 || dhvajadaṇḍāḥ samākhyātāḥ sarveśāṃ kramūkantu vā| athavā śubhavṛkṣāṇaṃ sāraṃ kaiścidapīṣyate || 16 || tadvimānasamāyāmaṃ pādonaṃ vā'rdhameva vā| dhvajapaṭalakṣaṇam dhvajavastraṃ samādāya khiloktavidhinā caret || 17 || tanmadhye vilikhedvīśamāsīnaṃ sāñjaliṃ vibhum| pañcavarṇasamāyukṛtaṃ navatālapramāṇataḥ || 18 || ākāśārohiṇaṃ vāpi vīrāsanamathāpi vā| aiṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā khile || 19 || parivāroktamārgeṇa nayanonmīlanādikam| kṛtvā vīśaṃ samāvāhya samabhyarcca nivedayet || 20 || bherītāḍanam āgneyyāṃ dhānyapīṭhe tu vinyasyaiva tu bherikām| tatra nandīśamāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedya ca || 21 || 'upaśvāsaya pṛthivī' miti dundubhisūktakam| pajvā vyāhvatibhiḥ paścāddhoṣaṇaṃ svayamācaret || 22 || balinā balibimbena cakravīśāmitaissaha| grāmasandhau baliṃ datvā tattanmantraiśca ghoṣayet || 23 || kramādālayamāviśya dhvajaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat| dhvajadaṇḍaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pūrvāhaṇe ca śubhodaye || 24 || ghoṣaṇānte punaḥ kuryādyatrārohaṇameva vā| puṇyāhānte samabhyacrya mudgānnaṃ vā nivedayet || 25 || dhvajāvarohaṇaṃ yāvattāvannityaṃ samāhitaḥ| trikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ vā'pyekakālamathāpi vā || 26 || pūrvektena krameṇaiva samadhyarcya nivedayet| pūrvedyureva pūrvāhṇe kṛtvā nayanamokṣaṇam || 27 || rātrau homādikaṃ kṛtvā prātarāvāhya pūrvavat| dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhre tu viśeṣataḥ || 28 || devānāṃ ghoṣaṇaṃ kuryādrātrāviti ca kecana| dhvajasyārohaṇādūrdhvamutsavādidinādadhaḥ || 29 || rātripūjāvasāne tu grāmasandhau tu pūrvavat| āhūtānāñcadevānāṃ baliṃ dadyādyathāvidhi || 30 || utsavadravyasambhārāṃstataḥ prabhṛti cā'haret| prathame'hani pūrvāhre vīthīḥ sarvatra śodhayet || 31 || 'avadhūta' miti procya mārjanyā mārjanaṃ caret| adbhirabhyukṣaṇaṃ kuryā 'dāśāsvi' ti ca mantrataḥ || 32 || sanapanoktakrameṇaiva madhyāhre snāpayeddharim| cakravīśāmitāṃścaiva snāpayedvandhavāriṇā || 33 || viśeṣatassamabhyarcya haviścaiva nivedayet| tato'parāhe samprāpte cakravīśāmitaissaha || 34 || tīrthāṅkurārtha gṛhṇīyānmṛdaṃ pūrvoktamārgataḥ| grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praviśyā'layamatvaraḥ || 35 || atha tīrthadinātpūrvaṃ navame vā'tha saptame| pañcame'hani vā kuryādvidhinā cāṅkurārpaṇam || 36 || pradoṣe samanuprāpte dakṣiṇe'bhimukhe'thavā| yāgaśālāṃ prakalpyaiva ṣīḍaśastambhasaṃyutām || 37 || madhye vediṃ prakalpyaiva pañcāgnīnuttame'thavā| tretāgnīnmadhyame kuryātsabhyamevādhame tathā || 38 || agnirāhavanīyaḥ syātpradhāno madhyame bhavet| anyayossabhya eva syāt nityahome'thavā bhavet || 39 || homasthāne tvanirdiṣṭe nirdiṣṭesthānasaṅkaṭe| aśaktastvarito vā'tha nirdiṣṭe sthānakalpane || 40 || karmaṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ kalpayetpacanālaye| anādeśaviṣayaḥ agnikuṇḍe tvanirdiṣṭe kuṇḍamaupāsana caret || 41 || homadravye tvanirdiṣṭe gavyaṃ ghṛtamudāhṛtam| kāle'nukte tu madhyāhraḥ pātre'nukte struvaṃ bhavet || 42 || praṇāmeṣvaviśeṣokte svasttibandhanamācaret| navakumbhāropaṇam navakumbhāntsamāhṛtya tantunā pariveṣṭya ca || 43 || nādeyādbhissamāpūrya vastrayugmena veṣṭayet| aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktān pañcāyudhasamanvitān || 44 || navaratnasamāyuktān kūrcākṣatasamanvitān| kumbhāṃstāṃstu pṛthak kṛtvā pidhānaistu pidhāya ca || 45 || punarantaḥ praviśyaiva devadevaṃ samāhitaḥ| dviguṇañca samabhyarcya dviguṇañca nivedayet || 46 || badhdvā pratisaraṃ paścāddevaṃ devīsamanvitam| yāgaśālāṃ samāsādya 'jātavedasa' ityatha || 47 || praṇīya teṣu nityāgniṃ kuṇḍeṣvāghāramācaret| vedyāṃ dhānyaṃ samāstīrya kumbhānāropya tatra vai || 48 || dhruvādāvāhayetteṣu dīpaddīpamiva kramāt| madhye kumbhe tathā viṣṇuṃ prāgādi puruṣādikān || 49 || āgneyādi tathā''vāhya kapilādīn yathāvidhi| saptaviṃśatibhedaiśca samabhyarcya praṇamya ca || 50 || vīśānapāyipaṅktīśaśāntān dikṣvarcayetkramāt| sāyaṃ prātarvinā kumbhairdevaṃ vīśāmitaissaha || 51 || vedyāmeva pratiṣṭhāpya pūtajediti kecana| nityahomaḥ hotā paścātpradhānāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret || 52 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva tadālayagatān surān| āvāhya tatkrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet || 53 || utsavadaivatyāni tatrāhastithivārarthavāhanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ| adhidevāśca tanmantrāḥ kramaścaiva pravakṣyate || 54 || prathame brahmadaivatyaṃ dvitīye cārṣameva ca| tṛtīye rudradaivatyaṃ caturthai vāsavaṃ tathā || 55 || pañcame somadaivatyaṃ ṣaṣṭhe vaiṣṇavamācaret| saptame sarvadaivatyamaṣṭame yāmyameva ca || 56 || navame vāruṇaṃ proktaṃ daśame vāyudaivatam| ekādaśe tu kaumāraṃ dvādaśe naiṛtaṃ yajet || 57 || trayodaśyāntu vārāhaṃ caturdaśyāntu rauhiṇam| gārūtmantuṃ pañecadaśyāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ daurgakaṃ yajet || 58 || saptadaśyāntu kaumāraṃ juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ| aṣṭādaśe tu hotavyaṃ narasūktantu vittamaiḥ || 59 || ekonaviṃśatidine narasūktaṃ yadedvudhaḥ| viṃśatime dine caiva bhūsūktaṃ juhuyādvudhaḥ || 60 || ekaviṃśadine caiva juhuyātpāramātmikam| evamutsavadaityaṃ krameṇa juhuyādvudhaḥ || 61 || prathame tvagnidaivatyaṃ prājāpatṛyaṃ dvitīyake| tṛtīye ca tu kauberaṃ caturthe vaighnameva ca || 62 || śrīdaivatyañca pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kaumārameva ca| saptamyāṃ sūryadaityamaṣṭamyāṃ raudrameva ca || 63 || navamyāṃ daurgadaivatyaṃ daśamyāṃ yāmyameva ca| ekādaśyāṃ tathaindrañca dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet || 64 || trayodaśyāṃ tathā vā'pi mātṛdaivatyameva ca| caturdaśyāntu hetavyamīśadaivatyameva || 65 || pañcadaśyāṃ tathā vā'pi saumyañca juhuyātkramāt| sūryavārādivāreṣu tattaddaivatyamācaret || 66 || 'agnaye kṛttikābhyassvā' heti nakṣatradaivatam| tattadvāhanadaivatyaṃ tattannāmnā ca hūyatām || 67 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktaṃ yajedvudhaḥ| śrībhūsūktaṃ tato hutvā mahīsūktaṃ yajetkramāt || 68 || mūrttihomañca juhuyāt nityamevaṃ kramaṃ viduḥ| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktasamanvitam || 69 || dinasandhyādidaivatyaṃ tithivārarkṣadaivatam| tadālayagatānāñca mūrtibhiścajuhoti vai || 70 || 'samidbhirjuhuyātsabhye sājyena caruṇā budhaḥ| juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktamaindramāhavanīyake || 71 || anvāhārye viṣṇusūktaṃ śrīsūktena samanvitam| vaiṣṇavaṃ gārhapatyāgnāvāvasathye tataḥ param || 72 || ekākṣarādisūktañca mahīsūktaṃ tathā yajet| pratheme'hani pālāśaṃ dvitīye belvameva ca || 73 || tṛtīye tu śamī caiva nyagrodhañca caturthake| audumbaraṃ pañcame ca ṣaṣṭhe cāśvatthameva ca || 74 || saptame khādiraṃ proktamaṣṭame ṣlākṣamucyate| āpāmārgant navame daśame cāmrameva ca || 65 || ekādaśyāṃ kuśañcaiva dvādaśyāṃ daurgameva ca| trayodaśe cāmalakaṃ pāṭalañca caturdaśe || 76 || panasaṃ pañcadaśake kovidārantu ṣoḍaśe| saptadaśe tu punnāgaṃ samidbhiriti hūyate || 77 || aṣṭāśe tu mandāraṃ vakulamekonaviṃśato| campakaṃ viṃśatitame juhuyācca cathākramam || 78 || ekaviṃśatike caiva kāpitthaṃ juhuyātkramāt| ityetaiśca samidbhiśca krameṇa juhuyādvudhaḥ || 79 || ājyena sājyacaruṇā samidbhiścottame hunet| ājyena sājyacaruṇā madhyame homamācaret || 80 || ājyenaivādhame homaṃ sājyena caruṇā'thavā| ājyena vā'tha caruṇā sāyaṃprātaryajedvudhaḥ || 81 || prathamotsavamārabhya tīrthāntaṃ juhuyātkramāt| vinā kumbhaiśca devaiśca nityāgnau homamācaret || 82 || cakravīśamitaissādhaṃ balinā ca samanvitam| pradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva grāmasandhau baliṃ kṣipet || 83 || grāmotsavaprakāraḥ paścādantaḥ praviśyaiva devadevaṃ praṇamya ca| alaṅkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 84 || sugandhipuṣpamālābhirgandhairapi manoramaiḥ| rathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā vīśayantre'thavā haran || 85 || gajayantrāndolikāsu ḍolāyantre'thavā punaḥ| 'ahamaive' ti mantreṇa devamāropya niścalam || 86 || aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya lājāpūpādikāni ca| saṃskṛtānguḍasammiśrān nivedya mukhavāsakam || 87 || datvā vādyaissamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam| mukhavāsaṃ nivedyaiva vīthīścāpi nayedvudhaḥ || 88 || bhramaṇam, vāhanakramāḥ utsave devadevasya vāhanakrama ucyate| prathame cotsave prātaḥ śukavāhanamācaret || 89 || tadrātrau devadevasya hasavāhanamācaret| dvitīye divase caiva mṛgendraṃ śarabhaṃ caret || 90 || kapīndrañca prabhāñcaiva tṛtīye cotsavaṃ caret| caturthe divase caiva kalpakaṃ pañcagaṃ caret || 91 || pañcame cotsave caiva pakṣīśañcārdhacandrakam| ṣaṣṭhe'hri cotsave prāpte gajaṃ pāśiṃ tathaiva ca || 92 || saptame cotsave caiva puṣpakaṃ kamalaṃ caret| aṣṭame cotsave prāpte ḍolāmaśva samācaret || 93 || navame divase caiva vimānaṃ yānamācaret| daśame cotsave prāpte śibikārohaṇaṃ caret || 94 || tadrātrau ca mahotsedhaṃ gajalakṣmīṃ prakalpayet| ekadaśadine prātaḥ kacchapaṃ vāhanaṃ caret || 95 || tadratrau tu mahotsedhaṃ punnāgaṃ vāhanaṃ caret| dvādaśe tuṃ dine prātaḥ kṛṣṇasāraṃ samācaret || 96 || tadrātrau tu mahārūpaṃ matsyavāhanamācaret| trayodaśadine prāta kūrmayantraṃ prakalpayet || 97 || tadrātrau tu viśeṣeṇa śrībhūmisahitaṃ tathā| talpe caiva samāropya utsavaṃ tu samācaret || 98 || kautukarathaḥ caturdaśadine prātaḥ kautukaṃ rathamācaret| tadrātrau tu mahārūpaṃ śārdūlaṃ vāhanaṃ caret || 99 || saptāṣṭadivase prātaḥ caretkuṇḍalivāhanam| tadrātrau tu śubhākāraṃ gaṇḍabheruṇḍamācaret || 100 || ṣoḍaśe divase prātaḥ prabhāpīṭhaṃ prakalpayet| tadrātrau tu mahārupamaindrañca parikalpayayet || 101 || navāṣṭadivase prātaḥ girivāhanamācaret| tadrātrau tu śubhākāraṃ panasaṃ vāhanaṃ caret || 102 || aṣṭādaśadine prātaḥ kāliyaṃ vāhanaṃ caret| tadrātrau tu viśeṣeṇa cakravāhanamācaret || 1103 || ekonaviṃśadivase'pyātapaṃ vāhanaṃ caret| tadrātrau tu mahotsedhaṃ pārijātaṃ prakalpayet || 104 || dine viṃśatike prātaḥ dhvajavāhanamācaret| tadrātrau tu mahārupaṃ śaṅkhavāhanamācaret || 105 || ekaviṃśadine prātaḥ rathayātrāṃ samācaret| ityevaṃ vāhanaṃ proktaṃ krameṇaivotsavaṃ caret || 106 || āhikavikalpaḥ ekaviṃśe'pyaśaktau tu caturdaśadinaṃ caret| caturdaśe'pyaśaktau tu nabāhaṃ cotsavaṃ caret || 107 || ekaviṃśadine caiva caturdaśadine tathā| navasaptāhapakṣe vā rathayātrāṃ samācaret || 108 || rathayātrāvasāne tu deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca| aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya mudrānnañca nivedayet || 109 || mukhavāsaṃ nivedyaiva puṣpāñjalimathā'caret| tatkṣaṇādeva deveśaṃ tadrathādavaropayet || 110 || yāne caiva samāropya tīrthasthānaṃ praveśya ca| tīrthasyābhimukhe kṛtvā tīrthetsavamathācaret || 111 || rathe tvāropi te deve rathyāsu parivartite| rathaprāryāścattaviśeṣāḥ rathacakre tadā'dhāre bhagne bhinne tathaiva ca || 112 || evaṃ vighne samutpanne dvidinaṃ tridinantu vā| āsāyadinaparyantaṃ rathe tiṣṭhati keśave || 113 || navāhe'pi ca sāyāhre tīrthāntotsavamācaret| rathe devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya ālayaṃ praviśedvudhaḥ || 114 || snāpanañca tathā nītvā cakrañcaiva tathaiva ca| śibikāyāṃ samāropya tīrthasthānaṃ praveśayet || 115 || tīrthotsavañca kṛtyaiva ālayaṃ praviśetsudhīḥ yāgaśālāṃ praviśyaiva antahomaṃ samācaret || 116 || kumbhaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya garbhagehaṃ praveśayet| kumbhācchraktiṃ samādāya dhruvabere'varopayet || 117 || tadrātrau tu prakartavyān balīn sarvāśca kārayet| baliberaṃ tathā nītvā dhvajasthāne niveśya ca || 118 || tasminnevāhri rātrau tu dhvajadevaṃ visarjayet| dhvajaṃ tamabaropyaiva maunena balimācaret || 119 || sarvāndevān visṛjyaiva śiṣṭaṃ karma samācaret| rathasthānaṃ tato gatvā devadevaṃ pramaṇam ca || 120 || rathacakraṃ tadādhāraṃ sudṛḍhīkṛtya pūrvavat| rathe, tu yojayecchīghraṃ rathaṃ nītvā krameṇa tu || 121 || yathāsthānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya devaṃ tamavaropayet| jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya laghusamprokṣaṇaṃ caret| snapanoktaprakāreṇa snapanañcaiva kārayet || 122 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā deveśāya nivedayet| rakṣābandhavisargaḥ ācāryasyartvijāñcaiva rakṣābandhaṃ visarjayet || 123 || bandhanaṃ devadevasya visṛjya praṇamedbhuvi| utsave devadevasya pakṣadvayagate sati || 124 || tīrthakālavighāraḥ māsadvayagate vāpi varṣadvayagate tathā| tithiṛkṣapradhānādau dvitvadoṣo na vidyate || 125 || parivāraparivṛtiḥ dvikālamekakālaṃ vā utsavaḥ kriyate yadi| yānārūḍhe devadeve rathyāsvānāyite'pi ca || 126 || dāsībhirvādakaiścaiva nṛttageyasamanvitaiḥ| sarvavādyāsamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam || 127 || brāhmaṇairviṣṇubhaktaiśca bhāṣāstutiparāyaṇaiḥ| purāṇastutipāṭheśca vastuśāstraparāyaṇaiḥ || 128 || etaissarvessamāyuktamagre cotsavamācaret| dhvajādiparivāraḥ dhvajaiśchatrairātapatraistoraṇaiśca tathaiva ca || 129 || yāni śrṛṅgāracihrāni prabhucihrāni yāni ca| gṛhītvā tāni cihrāni brāhmaṇāśśucayastathā || 130 || devasyāgre tu gaccheyuḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ| teṣāmaparabhāge tu yānādhiṣṭhitakeśavam || 131 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| raktaiḥ pītaissitaiścaiva nibaddhaiḥ kanakāmbarai || 132 || hemadaṇḍasamāyuktaiścāmarairvyajanaistathā| dāsībhirviṣṇubhaktairvā pārśvayorvījayetkramāt || 133 || yānavahanam ṣoḍaśairaṣṭabhiścaiva caturbhirvā yathocitam| viprādyairvāhanīyassyāt devadevo hariḥ prabhuḥ || 134 || śuddhāssnātāḥ samāgatya savarṇā brāhmaṇādayaḥ| yānaṃ skandhe niveśyaiva pracareyuśśanaiśśanaiḥ || 135 || gajavāhanaviśeṣaḥ ārohaṇe gajendrasya devadevaṃ viśeṣataḥ| vastrābharaṇapuṣpādyairalaṅkṛtya yathārhakam || 136 || deveśaṃ pūrvamāropya pṛṣṭhapārśve gajasya tu| ādāyāṅkuśamācāryo gajapṛṣṭhe niṣīdati || 137 || arcakaśchatramādāya muktālaṅkārabhūṣitam| devasyāparabhāge tu bhṛguvatsa niṣīdati || 138 || garuḍādiṣu yāneṣu śibikāsu tathaiva ca| āsīnaḥ pūrvabhāge tu dakṣiṇe deśikottamaḥ || 39 || deveśaṃ manasā dhyāyan vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccaran| āsītaivānyathā kuryāttatsarva niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 140 || vedādhyayanamanyacca maṅgalastutipāṭhanam| devasyāparabhāge tu viśeṣeṇa samācaret || 141 || brāhmaṇā viṣṇubhaktāśca hotradhvaryupurassarāḥ| deveśamanugaccheyurvedādhyayanatatparāḥ || 142 || eṣāmaparabhāge tu devasya tu viśeṣataḥ| gajapṛṣṭhe samāropya dundubhiṃ jhallarīṃ tathā || 143 || ghoṣayitvā'nugacdeyurvādakāḥ dṛḍhavādanāḥ| evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prathamāvaraṇādiṣu || 144 || bahirāvaraṇe vā'tha grāmaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam| sandhiṣu viśeṣārādhanam sandhau sandhau tu deveśaṃ pādyādyairaṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 145 || nivedayetsamabhṛyarcya mukhavāsaṃ samantrakam| upahārasamarpaṇam tadā vastūnyapakvāni brāhmṇairāhṛtānyapi || 146 || dadyādbhakṣyāṇyapakvāni pakvaṃ viprāhṛtaṃ tathā| śuddhena vāriṇā prokṣya amañca nivedayet || 147 || utsave dūramadhvānaṃ deveśaṃ prāpite sati| dūragamane viśeṣaḥ dvikrośe vāpi trikrośe grāmāntaragate'thavā || 148 || aparedyuḥ prakartavyā homabalyarcanākriyāḥ| pūrvedyureva kṛtvā tāḥ gacchediti ca kecana || 149 || vādakān nartakādīṃśca gandharvān bhāvayetsadā| jayādyapsarasaścaiva bhāvayet devayoṣitaḥ || 150 || striyau cāmaradhāriṇyau māyāṃ saṃhrādinīṃ smaret| kiṣkindhasundarau vā'tha puraṣau yadi tau smaret || 151 || smaredgaruḍavatsarvān rathayantrādivāhakān| pratyāgamane pūjā viśeṣaḥ evaṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā punarantaḥ praviśca ca || 152 || āsthāne devamāsthāpya viṣṭare sottaracchade| pādyamācamanaṃ datvā nīrājanamataścaret || 153 || nīrājanaprakāraḥ jalena sahitaṃ pātraṃ śālyannaṃ puṣpasaṃyutam| ācāryaścāgrataḥ sthitvā devadevasya mūrdhataḥ || 154 || pādāntaṃ bhrāmayetpātraṃ śānakaiḥ triḥ pradakṣiṇam| haridrāsahitaṃ toyaṃ śālyannaṃ puṣpasaṃyutam || 155 || kāṃsyapātre samāpūrya dāsībhirbhrāmayettathā| ācūḍātpādaparyantaṃ bhrāmayediti cāṅgirāḥ || 156 || dvārabāhye visṛjyaiva rakṣāṃ kṛtvā lalāṭake| āsthāne devamāsthāpya viṣṭare sottaracchade || 157 || pāmācamanaṃ datvā nārikelaphalāmbu ca| apūpasaktulājādibhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca || 158 || nivedyāṣṭākṣareṇaiva mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet| stutipāṭhaḥ nīrājanakriyānte tu devasya jayaśaṃsibhiḥ || 159 || nānābhāṣāprabandhaiśca stutiṃ stutiṃ stotraiḥ prakalpayet| darśayeddevadāsībhirmārganṛttaṃ tataḥ kramāt || 160 || śuddhasnānoktamārgeṇa snāpayitvā tataḥ param| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva jīvasthāne niveśayet || 161 || atra kecitpraśaṃsanti 'śramasveti name' diti| devasya dakṣiṇe vā'pi pramukhe vā mahāsane || 162 || mandiraṃ sundaraṃ kṛtvā ṭṭaḍhavaddhakavāṭakam| antargṛhasya paritaḥ darpaṇādi niveśya ca || 163 || tanmadhye devadevaśaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet| atrānuktāni sarvāṇi khiloktavidhinā caret || 164 || evamevotsavaḥ proktaḥ dinayoḥ prathamāntyayoḥ| dvikālamekakālaṃ vā dineṣvanyeṣu cotsavam || 165 || viṣūparāgādiṣu tīrtha prāpte vipūparāgāyaneṣu tīrtha rātrau bhavedyadi| tathā sāyotsavañcāpi kuryāttīrthadine punaḥ || 166 || dvitīyāhaprabhṛtyeva dvikālotsavamācaret| prātassandhyāṃ samārabhya madhyāhrāttu samāpye || 167 || utsavasya kālāvadhi prātarutsava eṣaḥ syāt sāyaṃkālārcanātparam| sāyamutsava ārabdhaḥ yāmādarvāksamāpyate || 168 || āsāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ prātarāprātassāyameva vā| utsavassarvakāleṣu devīsahitamuttamaḥ || 169 || madhyamaḥ prātareva syādadhamaḥ pañcame'hani| ekakālotsavaścettu madhyāhre balihomakau || 170 || sāyāhre cotsavaṃ kuryāditi saṅgirate'ṅgirāḥ| tīrthāhātpūrvadivase samāpte prātarutsave || 171 || mṛgayotsavaḥ mṛgayārthamalaṅkṛtya devadevaṃ
