viśeṣataḥ| ajavānaraśārdūlagajāśvānugataṃ nayet || 172 || nānāpraharaṇopetairanvitaṃ paricārakaiḥ| kaṣṭhīravasamārūḍhe devyāvapyānayedvudhaḥ || 173 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bahiścāpi manorame| utsavaṃ kārayecchīghraṃ cakravīśāmitairvinā || 174 || nānāvidhopakāryāsu vinodañcāpi kārayet| avatāreṣu vā cailallaukikeṣviti kecana || 175 || vāpītīropakāryāsu cārāmaracitāsu ca| pūjākarmānurodhena kuryādanyadineṣvapi || 176 || śayanādhivāsaḥ atha tīrthadinātpūrvaṃ rātrau devaṃ viśeṣataḥ| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva badhdvā pratisarāmapi || 177 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva sārdhaṃ cakreṇa śāyayet| havīṃṣi ca vinā prātararcayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 178 || homaṃ hutvā baliṃ datvā prātarutsavamācaret| cūrṇotsavaḥ āsthānamaṇḍape devaṃ saṃsthāpya prāṅmukha kramāt || 179 || devāgre sthāpayeccakraṃ dhānyapīṭhe bahirmukham| tasyaivottarataḥ pārśve viṣvaksenaṃ samāhitaḥ || 180 || cakrāgre dhānyapīṭhe tu haridrāñcāpi vinyaset| saṃskṛtyaiva tathā cūrṇamabhiṣicca pūrvavat || 181 || cakraśāntau ca sasnāpya abhiṣicca ca pūrvavat| grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tīrthasthānaṃ praviśya ca || 182 || tīrthasnānaprakāraḥ tasya tīre pratiṣṭhāpya devaṃ cakrañca pūrvavat| kalaśān pañca saṃsthāpya devasyāgre yathāvidhi || 183 || mṛtkuśairgandhapuṣpādbhirakṣataiśca prapūritān| kramānmadhyādi saumyāntaṃ nidhāyābhyarcya devatāḥ || 184 || bhūmiṃ cartūśca dhātāraṃ kāśyapañca prajāpatim| snāpanoktaiśca mantraiśca prokṣya deveśamatvaraḥ || 185 || śiṣṭābhiḥ kalaśādbhistu cakrañcaivābhiṣicya ca| tato devañca tīrthasyāntarnimajjayet || 186 || punastīre pratiṣṭhāpya viṣṭare sottaracchade| kuryādavabhṛthasnānaṃ śuddhasnānoktamārgataḥ || 187 || yajamāno guruścaiva ṛtvijaḥ paricārakāḥ| snātvā'tra saha devena śvetavastrottarīyakāḥ || 188 || grāmotsavaḥ devadevamalaṅkatya yānamāropya pūrvavat| śuklamālyānulepādyaiḥ svarṇasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ || 189 || alaṅkatena guruṇā ṛtvigbhiśca tathāvidhaiḥ| śākunaṃ sūktamuccārya svastisūktasamanvitam || 190 || toyadhārāsamāyuktaṃ neyāt grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇam| tatkāle yajamāno'pi pratyutthānaṃ samācaret || 191 || alaṅkṛtyā'layadvāraṃ pūrṇakumbhāṅkurādibhiḥ| dīpaiśca buhabhistatra devadeve samāgate || 192 || tauyadhārāsamāyuktaṃ dīpaiśca bahubhiryutam| strīyadhārāsamāyuktaṃ dīpaiśca bahubhiryutam| strībhissumaṅgralībhiśca kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam || 193 || pañca citrānnapiṇḍāni nītvā devasya mūrdhani| pradakṣiṇaṃ digīśānaṃ nāmabhiḥ praṇavādibhiḥ || 194 || namo'ntaiśca caturthyantairmadhye ca visṛjetkramāt| tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā praviśyā'bhyantaraṃ punaḥ || 195 || atsavāntasnapanam havirdānam snapanokrameṇaiva snapanaṃ samyagācaret| havirdānam mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā samabhyarcya nivedayet || 196 || jīvasthāne praveśaḥ kumbhāvāhanam jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya praṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi| yāgaśālāṃ samāgatya hutvā'gniṣu savaiṣṇavam || 197 || tattatkumbhagatāṃ śaktiṃ dhruve samyaṅniveśca ca| nityakuṇḍe praṇīyāgnimupatiṣṭheta bhāskaram || 198 || nityakuṇḍe'pyaśakto'pi pūrvoktakramamācaret| navame cotsave caiva caturdaśadine tathā || 199 || ekaviṃśotsave caiva rātripūjāvasānake| devodvāsanaprakāraḥ rātrau grāmabaliṃ datvā cakravīśāmitairbinā || 200 || udvāsya devatārsvā dhvajamāgatya vai punaḥ| dhvajadevaṃ samabhyarcya mudgānnaṃ vinivedya ca || 201 || dhvajadevaṃ visṛjyaiva dhvajaṃ tamavaropayet| daśame divase caiva dine pañcadaśe tathā || 202 || puṣpayāgaḥ uttamakalpaḥ dvāviṃśadivase caiva puṣpayāgaṃ samācaret| autsavapratimābhāve kautuke kriyate yadi || 203 || tatraiva tīrthadivase prātassandhyāvasānake| samyakpratisaraṃ badhdvā prātarutsavamācaret || 204 || dvitīyadivase tīrthāt puṣpayāgaṃ samācaret| puṣpayāgotsavaḥ trividhaḥ śāntikaḥ pauṣṭikaiḥ kāmyaḥ iti sa trividho bhavet || 205 || tallakṣaṇam uttamakalpaḥ prātarmadhyāparāhṇeṣu kramādenaṃ prakalpayet| prātararcāvasāne tu alaṅkatya yathārhakam || 206 || āsthānamaṇḍape devaṃ samānīyodayātparam| śuddhasnānoktamārgeṇa snāpayitvā jārdanam || 207 || navavastrottarīyādyairalaṅkṛtya vibhūṣaṇaiḥ| mahāviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā samabhyarcya nivedayet || 108 || āsthānamaṇḍape vā'pi snapanālaya eva vā| caturdiśaṃ caturhasataṃ gomayenopalipya ca || 209 || upapīṭhapadaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṭsūtraiḥ prāgudaggataiḥ| madhye navapadaṃ padmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 210 || ratnyāsoktadhānyairvā taṇāḍulairvīhibhistu vā| bahiḥṣṭheṣu padeṣvagre vīśamekatra pūjayet || 211 || dakṣiṇe cakramabhyarcya paṅktīśaṃ paścime tathā| udīcyāṃ śāntamabhyarcya śeṣeṣvarkapadeśu ca || 212 || āsanādyarcanadravyasañca susannyaset| daleṣvaṣṭasu padmasya lokapālāntsamarcayet || 213 || karṇikāyāṃ ravīndvagnimaṇḍalāni kramādyajet| viṣṭaraṃ tatra saṃsthāpya pādāntargatapaṅkaje || 214 || tatra devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yāvaddivasamutsavaḥ| tāvatkṛtvassamabhyarcya saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 215 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca caturvedastavairapi| tattatpūjāvasāne tu pṛthak puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet || 216 || paṅkujaṃ tulasīṃ bilvaṃ karavīramathotpalam| nandyāvartañca kumudamapāmārga tathaiva ca || 217 || viṣṇukrāntaṃ ca dūrvāgraṃ etānyeva kramātatpunaḥ| puṣpāñjalipradānārtha puṣpāṇyuktāni pūjane || 218 || puṣpāñjalipradānāni sarvāṇyanyārcane dadet| sabhya ekāgnireva syādanyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 229 || puṣpayāgaḥ tṛtīyakalpaḥ ityevaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ pravakṣyāmyadhamaṃ panuḥ| vinā vīśādibhirdevairhomaistatpṛthagarcanaiḥ || 230 || maṇḍale devamāropya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi| irvīṣi pañca coktāni nivedya ca tataḥ param || 231 || dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ mantraiḥ samastadivasocitaiḥ| utsavai'jñātadoṣāṇāṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam || 232 || utsavaphalaśrutiḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt| iha loke sukhaṃ bhuṃktvā viṣṇossāyujyamāpnuyāt || 233 || ālayārcāvidhisso'yaṃ saṅkṣepādudito mayā| atrānuktaṃ ca yatsarva khiloktavidhinā caret || 234 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre utsavavidhirnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<15> oṃ pañcadaśodhyāyaḥ gṛhārcāpratiṣṭhā viṣṇupratiṣṭhā athārcanaṃ gṛhe viṣṇoḥ pravakṣyāmi tapokṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ || 1 || ṣaṅṅgulādahīnantu tadrūpaṃ hāṭakādibhiḥ| kārayitvā yathāmargaṃ pratiṣṭhāmārabhetpunaḥ || 2 || pūrvoktaguṇasampanne kāle cāpi śubhojjavale| aupāsanāgnimādhāya vāstuhomāvasānake || 3 || akṣyunmeṣoktahomānte kṛtvā caivākṣimocanam| darśayitvā gavādīni jalādiṣvadhivāsya ca || 4 || dhruvaberoditāṃ śuddhiṃ citrābhāse ca kārayet| pūrvedyureva tasmāttu sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca || 5 || aupāsanāgnimādhāya hutvā tatra ca vaiṣṇavam| saṃsādhya pūrvavatkumbhaṃ devamāvāhya tatra vai || 6 || adhivāsagataṃ devamuddhṛtya praṇavena tu| snānaśvabhre pratiṣṭhāpya svastisūktaṃ samuccan || 7 || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge dhānyapīṭhe susannyaset| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ sopasnanaiśca pūrvavat || 8 || citrābhāsaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prokṣayetkalaśāmbhasā| tato'gneruttarasyāntu dhānyapīṭhe niveśya ca || 9 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu badhdvā pratisaraṃ tathā| tathaiva śāyayeddevaṃ pañcavastrasamāstṛte || 10 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya tatkāle dakṣiṇapraṇidhau jale| oṃ bhṛḥ puruṣa mityuktvā oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣaṃ tathā || 11 || oṃ suvaḥ purapaṃ ceti bhūrbhūvassuvarittyapi| nārāyaṇaṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ satyamacyutam || 12 || aniruddhaṃ samāvāhya śriyañceti mahīmiti| nirupyājyāhutīrhutvā sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe || 13 || ato devādimantrāṃśca caturāvartya vai yajet| śrībhūmisahite tattat sūktamantrāṃstathā yajet || 14 || mūrtimantraiśca hutṛvā'nte viṣṇugāyatriyā punaḥ| aṣṭottaraśataṃ padmaṃ devaṃ dhyāyan juhoti vai || 15 || prādurbhāvavikalpānāṃ tattanmantraiśca mūrtibhiḥ| pūrvoktamūrtibhissārdhaṃ homakarma samācaret || 16 || homakarma samāpye va prātassnātvā yathāvidhi| japtvā japyāni sūktāni muhūrte tu śubhotajjavale || 17 || gṛhe vāyavyabhāge tu pīṭhe ratnādisaṃyute| pratiṣṭhāpya samāvāhya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 18 || sūryakalpaḥ yadīcchedbhāskārasyāpi gṛhe nityaṃ samarcayet| bhāskarañca mahādevaṃ kadambakusumaprabham || 19 || navārdhatālamānena dvibhujaṃ padmadhāriṇam| devībhyāñca samāyuktaṃ rāśibhiḥ parivāritam || 20 || svasvapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya svasvadevīsamāyutam| evaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ akṣyunmeṣādanantaram| adhivāsādikaṃ karma hareriva samācaret || 21 || 'udutyaṃ citra' mityevaṃ mūlamantraṃ pracakṣate| aupāsanāgnimādhāya kuṇḍe vā sthaṇiḍale'thavā|| 22 || saṃsādhya pūrvavatkumbhaṃ raktavastradvayānvitam| ācāryassuprasānnātmā trayīmayamanāmayam || 23 || viśvabodhātmakaṃ bhānuṃ dhyāyannāvāhayejjale| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ bimbaṃ kumbhasamanvitam || 24 || agreruttarapārśve tu dhānyarāśiṃ prakalpya ca| sannyasya bilvaphalakaṃ vastraṇyāstīrya pañca ca || 25 || tadveraṃ tatra vinyasya baddhvā pratisaraṃ tataḥ| vidhinā śayane dhīmān śāyayedraktavāsasā || 26 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya nirupyājyāhutīryajet| hutṛvā tu sūryagāyatryā bhāvayanmanasā racivam || 27 || 'bhāskarāya' ca 'sūryāya mārtāṇḍāya vivasvate'| 'trilokamaṇḍanā'yeti tathā caiva 'trimūrtaye' || 28 || 'sarvātmane nama' śceti juhuyā 'ccaṇḍarociṣe'| 'triguṇeśvarāya' paścādvai 'sarvajyotiṣmate' tathā || 29 || sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā'tha daśakṛtvo'thavā yajet| maitramantradvayaṃ hutvā 'udvayaṃ tamasa' stathā || 30 || 'udutyaṃ jātave' deti 'citraṃ de' veti hūyatām| 'yacciddhī' ti tato hutvā 'yatkiñce' ti tataḥ param || 'kitavā' seti hutvā tu 'imamme varu' ṇetyapi| arkāpāmārgapālāśasamidbhiścaiva hūyatām || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ lokapālakadaivatam| mindāhutī tato hutvā homakarma samācaret || 31 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ nāmnā devyostatra juhoti vai| prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena ratnādīntsannyasetkramāt || 32 || paścimābhimukhaṃ devaṃ sthāpayetprāṅmukhaṃ tu vā| na sthāpyo bhāskaraḥ kvāpi dakṣiṇottaradiṅmukhaḥ || 33 || kumbhasthāṃ śaktimādāya bimbe cā'vāhayedguruḥ| anuktamatra yatsarvaṃ hareriva samācaret || 34 || 'udutyaṃ citra' mityuktvā praṇamya jyotiṣāṃ patim| samantrābhyukṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā nirmālyaṃ saṃvyapohya ca || 35 || svāgatañcānumānañca 'tvamagne rudra' ityapi| 'udvayaṃ tamasa' śceti pādyaṃ dadyāttataḥ param || 36 || dadyādācamanaṃ haste 'hiraṇyavarṇā' iti bruvan| 'pavitraṃ ta' iti procya mūrdhni puṣpaṃ vinikṣipet || 37 || 'ime gandhā' dinā gandhaṃ dhūpamantreṇa dhūpayet| 'pravaśśukre' ti dīpaṃ tu arghya dadyātsamantrakam || 38 || dadyādanyopacārāṃstu 'udutyaṃ citra' mityapi| gurupadeśasaṃsiddhaiḥ kalpamantrairathāpi vā || 39 || āsanādyupacaustu pūjayediti kecana| sāvitryā vā'rcayennityamiti pūrvajaśāsanam || 40 || eṣa evaviśeṣassyādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| suvarcalāmuṣāṃ cati śyāmalāṃ suprabhāmiti || 41 || arcayeddakṣiṇe devīṃ reṇukāṃ raktavarṇinīm| prratyūṣāṃ śvetavastrāṃ tāmiti vāme samarcayet || 42 || guhārcanam nityapūjāṃ guhasyaicchan bimbaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi| skandadaivatyamantraiśca nayanīnmīlanādikam || 43 || kṛtvā tu kautukaṃ baddhvā śatamaṣṭauttaraṃ yajet| tanmantreṇa samāvāhya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 44 || atrānuktāni sarvāṇi khiloktavidhinā caret| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tasya putrāstu nīrujaḥ || 45 || āyuṣmantaḥ śriyā yuktāḥ vardhante nātra saṃśayaḥ| iha bhuktvā mahābhogān so'nte svargamavāpnuyāt || 46 || vināyakārcanam vakratuṇḍasya vakṣyāmi nityaṃ vai samyagarcanam| dharmaughamā' di mantrābhyāṃ nayanonmīlanādikam || 47 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ tābhyāṃ hutvā''vāhya yathāvidhi| tābhyāmeva tu maṃntrābhyāṃ nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 48 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā nirvighnaṃ tasya karma vai| sarva samapadyate śīghraṃ lakṣmī ca vipulā bhavet || 49 || śrīdevyarcanam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi gṛhe nityārcanaṃ śriyaḥ| padmakiñjalkasadṛśāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 50 || padmāsane samāsīnāṃ sapadmordhvabhujadvayām| savyena pūrvahastena bhaktānāmabhayapradām || 41 || vāmena pūrvahastena dadhatīṃ vipulaṃ dhanam| evaṃ kṛtvā śriyaṃ devīṃ 'śriye jāta' iti buvan || 52 || 'śaṃ sā niyaccha' tītyuktvā 'bhūyāma' iti ca kramāt| nayanonmīlanaṃ kṛtvā jalādiṣvadhivāsya ca || 53 || kumbhaṃ saṃsasādhya saṃsnāpya baddhvā pratisaraṃ tathā| śāyayitvā samāvāhya hautrakarmāvasānake || 54 || pauṇḍarīke tu hotavyaṃ 'śriye jā' teti mantrataḥ| 'śaṃ sā niyaccha' tītyuktvā 'bhūyāma' iti ca kramāt || 55 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā śrīsūktena sakṛdyajet| śriyaśśatāṣṭakairmantrairdaśakṛtvastataḥ param || 56 || madhusarpissamāyuktaṃ pṛṣadājyasamanvitam| puṣkalāmāhutiṃ hutvā bilvapatrairghṛtāplutaiḥ || 57 || 'śriye jā'te ti mantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| prātassnātvā pratiṣṭhāpya samāvāhṛya samarcayet || 58 || tatsūktenaiva tanmantraiḥ pūjayetsarvavigrahaiḥ| atrānuktāni sarvāṇi khiloktavidhinā caret || 59 || acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti janmajanmāntare'pi ca| tadvaṃśajāśca śrīmanto bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 60 || durgārcanam atha vakṣyāmi durgāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāmarcanaṃ gṛhe| sākṣātsā vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ tasmāttāṃ nityamarcayet || 61 || navārdhatālamānena kṛtvā devīṃ caturbhujām| śaṅkhacakradharāñcaiva kirīṭamukuṭojjavalām || 62 || pītavastradharāṃ devīṃ kakṣyābaddhaghjñanastanīm| sasyaśyāmanibhāṃ saumyāṃ hārakaustubhabhūṣitām || 63 || aṅgahomañca hutvā tu durgāsūktaṃ śatāṣṭakam| pāñcabhautikamantreṇa hutvā vaiṣṇavasaṃyutam || 64 || kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ paścajjalādiṃṣbadhivāsya ca| kumbhe dhyātvā samāvāhya saṃsnāpya kalaśairapi || 65 || baddhvā pratisaraṃ paścāt śāyayecchayanopari| hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya nirupyājyāhutīryajet || 66 || durgāsūktaṃ tatassabhye śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| vaiṣṇava brāhma raudrañca bhautikaṃ pañcavāruṇam || 67 || jayādibhiśca kūśmāṇḍaissāvitryā ca sahasrakam| sahasrāhutiparyanta pūrvavajjuhuyādvudhaḥ || 68 || pālāśībhissamidbhiśca viṣṇusūktena hūyatām| sviṣṭākārañca hutvā tu rātriroṣaṃ vyapohya ca || 69 || prātassnātvā pratiṣṭhāpya samāvāhya samarcayet| 'jātavedasa' ityādi tatsūktenaiva pūjayet || 70 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā durgāyāḥ sthāpanārcane || 71 || jitvā śatruṃściraṃ bhuktvā bhūmau tu vipulaṃ sukham| viṣṇusāyujyamāpnoti daśapūrvairdaśāparaiḥ || 72 || sarasvatyarcanam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vāgdevyā arcanaṃ gṛhe| jaṭāmaṇḍalasaṃyuktāṃ svarṇavarṇā caturbhujām || 73 || urdhva dakṣiṇahastantu akṣamālāsamanvtim| mudrāhastamadhastādvai varadaṃ vā'pi kalpayet || 74 || kamaṇḍalamusamāyuktaṃ vāmahastaṃ tathordhvagam| jñānamudrāsamāyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 75 || padmāsane samāsīnāṃ padmakāñcanaśobhinīm| 'pāvakā' iti smṛtvā 'maho arṇa' iti smaran || 76 || pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa akṣyunmeṣādhivāsanam| baddhvā pratisarañcāpi snapanaṃ śayanādikam || 77 || hautrañca sampraśaṃsyaiva tanmūrtyāvāhanaṃ caret| nirupyājyāhutīrhutvā śamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 78 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktaṃ yajetkramāt| brāhmamaindraṃ tathā''gneyaṃ sviṣṭākāraṃ juhoti ca || 79 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarva hareriva| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā sarvavidyāmavāpnuyāt || 80 || itaraṃ pustakadharaṃ yojayecca tata param| brahyāsanantu kartavyaṃ padmapīṭhasya copari || pādaṃ prasāritaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇaṃ tu samācaret| sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ śvetavastravibhūṣitām || śuklapuṣpāṅgarāgāṃ tāṃ kakṣyābaddhadhanastanīm| sārasvatena sūktena kṛtvā'kṣyunmeṣaṇādikam || śayanaṃ tu tathā kṛtvā hautraśaṃsanamācaret| śvetapadmasahasrañca ghṛtāktaṃ vai samāhitaḥ || tatmūktamantrairjuhuyātāṃ devīṃ manasā smaran| etairājyāhutīrvā'pi yathāśakti samācaret || pāramātmikamantraiśca viṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ| prātassnātvā pratiṣṭhāpya samāvāhya samarcayet || tatsūktenārcayennityamanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| medhāvitvaṃ kavijvañca vāditvaṃ vāgmitāṃ tathā || yaśāsvitvamihāmutra sukhamatyantadurlabham| ānpoti tasmāddevī sā dhyeyā pūjyā manīṣibhiḥ || darśanīyā ca kīrtyā ca jagadvyāpārakāriṇī| bhadrakālīñca śāstāraṃ kṣetrapālaṃ vinetarān || yadīcchedarcituṃ dhānmi pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi| aupāsanāgnau tanmantraṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || pratiṣṭāmarcanādīni tanmantreṇaiva kārayet| gṛhe traivarṇikāssarve devān nārāyaṇādikān || anena vidhinā sthāpya pūjayeyuryathāvidhi| athavā'nena saṃsthāpya kalpamantreṇa pūjayet || tāntrikeṇānulomastu pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet| nārcayetpratilomastu tāntitrakeṇāpi jātvapi || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ kriyākidhakāre gṛhe viṣṇavādityaskandavināyakalakṣmīdurgāsarasvatībhadakālī bimṛbaprartiṣṭhārcanākalpo nāma pañcalaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<16> oṃ ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ kṣī davyāḥ pṛthagarcanam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śrīdevyāḥ pṛthagarcanam| sthite deve sthitāṃ devīmāsīnāmāsane hareḥ || 1 || āsīnāṃ vā sthitāṃ vā'pi śayane parikalpayet| śriyaṃ devīṃ prakalpyaiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 2 || padmakiñcalkasadṛśāṃ pītavastradharāṃ śubhām| padmāsane samāsīnāṃ padmordhvabhujadvayām || 3 || savyena pūrvahastena bhakṛtānāmabhayapradām| vāmena pūrvahastena dadhatīṃ vipulaṃ dhanam || 4 || evaṃ kṛtvā śriyaṃ devīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet| ālayābhimukhe kṛtvā yāgaśālāṃ yathāvidhi || 5 || aupāsanāgnikuṇḍe dve kṛtvā śayanavedikām| 'śriye jā' teti mantreṇa sarvaṃ kṛtvā yathākramam || 6 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya saṃsnāpya badhdvā pratisaraṃ tathā| śāyayitvā samāvāhya dakṣiṇapraṇidhau tathā || 7 || 'śriyaṃ dhṛtiṃ pavitrī' ca 'pramodāyinī' miti| uttarapraṇidhau vā'pi bhūmiñcaiva sarasvatīm || 8 || ratiṃ prītiṃ tathaivātra kīrti kṣāntiṃ tathaiva ca| puṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiṃ samāvāhya āṣṭau tāḥ paricārikāḥ || 9 || indrādilokapālāṃśca dvitīyā'varaṇe'pi ca| balākinīṃ vanamālāṃ vibhīṣāmapi śāṅkarīm || 10 || guggulaṃ cāgaruñcaiva damakaṃ śaṅkhilaṃ tathā| tṛtīyā'varaṇe proktā ete cāṣṭau viśeṣataḥ || 11 || prathamadvārasavye tu nirmālyahariṇī tathā| vāme caiva tathā proktā naivedyahariṇīti ca || 12 || dvitīyadvārasavye tu bhūmiñcāpi samācaret| vāṃme sarasvatīñcaiva dvitīyadvārapālike || 23 || tṛtīyadvārasavye tu ratiñcaiva prakalpayet| vāme bhāge tathā proktā prītiratra samarcane || 14 || eṣa eva viśeṣassyādanyatsarva hareriva| devya etāssamāvāhya uttarapraṇidhai jale || 15 || 'śaṃ sā niyaccha' tītyuktvā 'bhūyāma' iti ca kramāt| 'śriye jā' teti mantreṇa śataṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 16 || śrīsūktenaiva padmāgnau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| nirmālyahāriṇyantāṃśca parivārān prakalpayet || 17 || homāvāhanapūjādi tattannāmabhirācaret| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva sarvāṇyanyāni kārayet || 18 || evameva pratiṣṭhāpya trisandhyaṃ nityamarcayet| utseva devadevasya saha devīṃ nayedanu || 19 || iyamaṅgapratiṣṭhā syātsvatantrasthāpanocyate| etaṃ kalpaṃ samāsena vistareṇa vadāmyaham || 20 || śayyāvediñca paritaḥ agnikuṇḍāni kalpayet| pañcāgniṃ pauṇḍarīkañca snānaśvabhrañca pūrvavat || 21 || bhūmiyajñañca kṛtvā tu kuṇḍeṣvāghāramācaret| tataśca pauṇḍarīkāgnau hautraśaṃsamācaret || 22 || ājyasthālīṃ sruvañcaiva suvarṇenaiva kārayet| tena sruveṇa hotavyamāhutīnāṃ sahasrakam || 23 || viṣṇossahasrakaṃ hutvā aṣṭāsaśītiṃ yajetkramāt| śriyaśśaṃtāṣṭakairmantrairdaśavārañca hūyatām || 24 || puṣkalāmāhutiṃ hutvā diśāhomaṃ juhoti ca| yajedāhavanīyāgnau śrīsūktaṃ bhāvayañchriyam || 25 || 'śriye jā' teti mantreṇa dakṣiṇāgnau juhoti vai| 'śaṃ sā niyaccha' tītyuktā 'bhūyāma' iti ca kramāt || 26 || kuṇḍayoranyayorhutvā vyāhṛtyantaṃ pṛthakpṛthak| sabhye samastairmantreśca vyāhṛtyantaṃ kramādyajet || 27 || muhūrte samanuprāpte devīṃ saṃsthāpayettathā| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādapyatsarvaṃ haroriva || 28 || evaṃ devīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya trisandhyaṃ nityamarcayet| haṃsadhvajo viśeṣaḥ syācchrīdevyāścotsave'pi ca || 29 || utsavoktakrameṇaiva sarvāṇyanyāni kārayet| utsave devadevasya saha devīṃ nayedanatu || 30 || evameva prakāreṇa viṣṇusadmāśritaśriyaḥ| utsavaṃ kurute bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāmarcanādikam || 31 || acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti janmajanmāntare'pi ca| tadvaṃśajāśca śrīmanto bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 32 || svatantralakṣmīpratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svatantrasthāpanaṃ śriyaḥ| grāme vā nagare vā'pi pattane kharvaṭe'pi vā || 33 || madhye saṃsthāpayeddevīṃ brahmasūtrāttu dakṣiṇe| athavā paścime bhāge tathā tatsūtradakṣiṇe || 34 || viṣṇavālayavihīne tu brahmasūtrottare'thavā| grāmādīnāntu vāyavye prācyāṃ vā sūtradakṣiṇe || 35 || manorame'nyadeśe vā nadyāstīre tathā vane| parvatāgre'bdhitīre vā pratiṣṭhāmācaredvudhaḥ || 36 || vimānaṃ svastikaṃ grāme śrīpratiṣṭhitameva vā| viṣṇucchandavimānaṃ vā catuḥphuṭamathāpi vā || 37 || karṣaṇādikriyāssarvāstatsūktenaiva kārayet| bālālayārcanaṃ kurvan vimānaṃ parikalpayet || 38 || śūlasthāpanamārgeṇa śūlaṃ saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ| śrīdevyā bilvavṛkṣastu śūlavṛkṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 39 || athavā'śvatthavṛkṣo vā śilāśūlamathāpi vā| śilāsthāpanamārgeṇa sthāpayettu śilāmayam || 40 || dhruvārcāṃ vā prakurvīta samyaglakṣaṇasaṃyutām| ādyeṣṭakānāṃ vinyāse garbhaprakṣepaṇe'thavā || 41 || mūrdheṣṭakānāṃ vinyāse śūlasya sthāpane'pi ca| pauṇḍarīkāgnirekaḥ syāt mantraṃ śrīsūktameva ca || 42 || śrīdaivatyaṃ 'śriye jāta' iti japyedṛcaṃ śriyaḥ| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva || 43 || tathā ca kārayeddevīṃ dvibhujāṃ vā caturbhajām| rajjubandhādikaṃ sarva hareriva samācaret || 44 || kuryādvilvavanāmbhojamadhye padmaṃ manoharam| tanmadhye mandiraṃ kuryāttaptahāṭakasannibham || 45 || dīpacāmaramuktāsakpūrṇakumbhadvayāṅkuraiḥ| puṣpairgandhaiśca dhūpaiśca vitānaiḥ stambhaveṣṭanaiḥ || 46 || mandiraṃ sundaraṃ kṛtvā catarāvaraṇānvitam| tatra siṃhāsanāmbhojakarṇikāmadhyaviṣṭare || 47 || kuryāccaturbhujāṃ devīṃ sapadmordhvakaradvayām| pūrvadakṣiṇahastena bhaktānāmabhayapradām || 48 || vāmena pūrvahastena dadhatīṃ vipulaṃ dhanam| indīvarodaradṛśīṃ śaradindumukhīṃ śubhām || 49 || śuklagandhānuliptāṅgīṃ śuklamālyāmbarojjavalām| nānāratnojjavalānardhadivyabhūṣaṇa bhūṣitām || 50 || suvarṇavarṇā varadāṃ hemararupasagujjavalām| evaṃ kṛtvā bhagavatīṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīm || 51 || śaṅkhapadmanidhī kuryātpādayoragrataḥ śriyaḥ| prāgādiṣu caturdikṣu puruṣādīn prakalpayet || 52 || athavā vāsudevādīn śaṅkhacakradharān parān| kirīṭahārakeyūramakuṭādivirājitān || 53 || śrīvatsakaustubhoraskān vanamālāvibhūṣitān| caturbhujān sukhāsīnān śyāmābhān padmalocanān || 54 || vīkṣamāṇān śriyaṃ devīṃ vismayotphullalocanām| gugguluṃ cāgaruñcaiva damakaṃ śiṅkhilaṃ tathā || 55 || caturviṣāṇān śuklāṅgān koṇeṣu parikalpayet| bhūmiṃ sarasvatīñcaiva ratiṃ prītiṃ tathaiva ca || 56 || kīrti kṣāntiṃ puṣṭituṣṭī śaktīraṣṭau prakalpayet| indrādilokapālāṃśca tattatsthāne prakalpayet || 57 || balākinīñca prāgdvāre dakṣiṇe vanamālikām| vibhīṣikāṃ pratīcyāntu udvagdvāre ca śāṅkarīm || 58 || kalpayedvāmanāstvetāścatasro dvārapālikāḥ| dve dve kṛtṛvā'thavā caitāḥ khiloktā dvārapālikāḥ || 59 || śuklāmbarāḥ padmahastāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ| balākinyādayastvetāḥ padmakiñjalkasannibhāḥ || 60 || kalpasantānamandārapārijātāṃścaturdiśam| vilvavṛkṣāṃśca paritaḥ pūrṇakumbhān likhetkramāt || 61 || kalpayitvākhiloktāṃśca parivārān yathākramam| kṛtvā tu bhūtapīṭhāntān sthāpanārambhamācaret || 62 || phālgunottarulgunyāṃ sthāpanā prītaye śriyaḥ| bilvavṛkṣādadharassamyagāsīno vāhmamāsanam || 64 || japedaṣṭoktaraśataṃ śrīsūktaṃ bhāvayecchriyam| sthāpanādivasātpūrvaṃ pañcame'hryaṅkṛrārpaṇam || 64 || aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayet| śayyāvediñca paritastvagnikuṇḍāni kalpayet || 65 || pañcāgnīn pauṇḍarīkāgniṃ snānaśvabhrañca pūrvavat| akṣyunmeṣādhivāsau ca dhruvaśuddhiṃ tathaiva ca || 66 || kṛtvā tu pūrvavatpaścāt pūrvarātrau viśeṣataḥ| bhūmiyajñañca kṛtvā tu kuṇḍeṣvāghāramācaret || 67 || kumṛbhaṃ sampūjya kalaśaiḥ snāpayetsaptabhiḥ punaḥ| pūrvavatkautukaṃ badhdvā śayane śāyayecchriyam || 68 || tataśca pauṇḍarīkāgnau hautraśaṃsanamācaret| ājṛyapātraṃ sruvañcaiva suvarṇenaiva kārayet || 69 || tena sruveṇa hotavyamāhutīnāṃ sahasrakam| viṣṇossahasrakaṃ hutvā aṣṭāśītyāhutīryajet || 70 || śriyaśśatāṣṭakairmantrairdaśavārañca hūyatām| puṣkalāmāhutiṃ hutvā diśāhomaṃ juhoti vai || 71 || yajedāhavanīyāgnau śrīsūktaṃ bhāvayañchriyam| 'śriye jā' teti mantreṇa dakṣjñiṇāgnau juhoti ca || 72 || 'śaṃ sā niyaccha' tītyuktvā 'bhūyāma' iti ca kramāt| kuṇḍayoranyayorhutvā vyāhṛtyantaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 73 || sabhye samastairmantraiśca vyāhṛtyantaṃ kramādyajet| muhūrte samanuprāpte lakṣmīṃ saṃsthāpayettathā || 74 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ khiloktavat| pṛthakkartumaśaktaścedālayāśrayameva vā || 75 || ālaye devadevasya dakṣiṇe samprakalpayet| caturbhujāṃ prakurvīta pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ || 76 || athavā dvibhujāṃ devīṃ kalpayitvā khiloktavat| vidhinā sthāpayetsamyak svatantraṃ vā''layāśrayam || 77 || arcanādi śriyo devyāḥ sthāpanaṃ śrīśatāṣṭakam| khile vistarataḥ proktaṃ tattat jñātvā samarcayet || 78 || dhruvakautusaṃyuktaṃ sthāpanaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet| ekaberārcanaṃ madhyamābhāsamadhamaṃ bhavet || 79 || śriyo yaḥ kurute bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāmarcanādikam| acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti janmajanmāntare'pi ca || 80 || tadvaṃśajāśca śrīmanto bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ| saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 81 || ante vimānamāruhya sālokyaṃ padamāpnuyāt| śrīdevyāḥ vimānakramaḥ ataḥ paraṃ śriyo devyāḥ vimānakrama ucyate || 82 || vimānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā parivārānprakalpayet| tale ca prathame caiva devānāṃ krama ucyate || 83 || prāgādiṣu caturdikṣu puruṣādīn prakalpayet| dvitīye'pi tale proktaṃ vāsudevādivyūhakam || 84 || tṛtīye'pi tale proktaḥ parivārakramo yathā| gugguluñca kuraṇṭañca damakaṃ salilaṃ tathā || 85 || caturviṣāṇān śuklāṅgān gajānprāgādi kalpayet| pañcame'pi tale proktaḥ parivārakramo budhāḥ || 86 || bhūmiṃ sarasvatīñcaiva ratiṃ prītiṃ tathaiva ca| etāścatasro devyaśca prāgādi parikalpayet || 87 || ṣaṣṭhe'pi ca tale proktāḥ kīrtiḥ kṣāntistathaiva ca| puṣṭistuṣṭistathaitāśca prāgādi parikalpayet || 88 || saptame'pitale vā'pi digdevāṃśca prakalpayet| aṣṭame'pi tale kuryādaṣṭhadikpālakānapi || 89 || prāgādiṣu caturdikṣu etāndevān prakalpayet| navame'pi tale vā'pi devānāṃ krama ucyate || 90 || vāsukiñca tathā'nantaṃ śaṅkhañca gulikaṃ tathā| prāgādiṣu caturdikṣu kramādevaṃ prakalpayet || 91 || daśame'pi tale vā'pi parivārakramo budhāḥ| pūrve sarasvatīñcaiva gāyīṃ dakṣiṇe tathā || 92 || paścime'pi ca sāvitrīṃ vaiṣṇavīmapi cottare| ekādaśatale vā'pi pālikānāṃ kramaṃ śṛṇu || 93 || pūrve tatra śriyaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇe hariṇīṃ tathā| paścime ca ilāñcaiva uttare sundarīṃ tathā || 94 || dvādaśe'pi tale proktadevatākrama ucyate| balākinīñca pūrve tu dakṣiṇe vanamālikām || 95 || vibhīṣikāṃ paścime tu uttare śaṅkarīṃ tathā| vimānadvārabhāge tu catasro dvārapālikāḥ || 96 || vimānaṃ paritaścāpi etāndevānprakalpayet| śuklāmbarāḥ padmahastāḥ sarvabharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 97 || balākinyādayastvetāḥ padmakiñjalkasannibhāḥ| gajendraṃ vā mṛgendraṃ vā koṇe koṇe prakalpayet || 98 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| pratiṣṭhādivasātpūrvaṃ pañcame'hryaṅkurārpaṇām || 99 || vimānaṃ paritaścāpi yāgaśālāṃ prakalpya ca| vimānasya caturdikṣu cāgnikuṇḍāni kalpayet || 100 || vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā pañcagavyena cokṣayet| śriyo devyāḥ pratiṣṭhoktaṃ sarvamatraiva kārayet || 101 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ śriyo yathā| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyāṃ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 102 || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre bhagavadālayāśritaśrīpratiṣṭhāvidhirnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<17> oṃ saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ trimūrtisthāpanam trimūrtisthāpanaṃ vakṣye jagatāmabhivṛddhaye| madhye viṣṇuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ || 1 || vāme rudraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pūjanaṃ yattaduttamam| sthāpanaṃ vyatyayenaiva madhyamaṃ brahmarudrayoḥ || 2 || madhye rudraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dakṣiṇe viṣṇumuttare| brahmāṇaṃ vyatyayenātha sthāpayedadhamaṃ smṛtam || 3 || kṛtvā vā pārśvayoranyau madhye brahmāṇameva vā| saumyenānena vidhinā sthāpayedviṣṇupadmajau || 4 || śaivena tāntrikeṇaiva sthāpanaṃ vai śivasya tu| niṣkalaṃ sakalaṃ vā'pi sthāpayeccandraśekharamam || 5 || trayāṇāṃ parivārāṇāṃ tattaduktāni kalpayet| anapāyigadvāravimāneśāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 6 || prākāraparivārāṇāṃ sarve sādhāraṇā matāḥ| prathamāvaraṇādīnāṃ dvārapālāstathaiva ca || 7 || daśatālottamenaiva devedavaṃ prakalpayet| śaṅkaraṃ madhyamenaiva viriñcamadhamena ca || 8 || ālayābhimukhe teṣāṃ yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayet| ṣaṅagnīn devadevasya pañcāgnīm brahmaṇastathā || 9 || tacchāstroktena mārgeṇa rudrasyāpi prakalpayet| akṣyunmeṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatkārayetpṛthak || 10 || hautraśaṃsanavelāyāmindrādipariṣadgaṇān| madhyālayāgnikuṇḍe tu samāvāhya samarcayet || 11 || devasya rpvavaddhomaṃ ṣaḍagniṣu juhoti vai| brahmaṇamsabhyakuṇḍe tu kṛtvā hautrapraśaṃsanam || 12 || prājāpatyaṃ jayādīṃśca kūśmāṇḍaṃ gaṇahomakam| āhutīnāṃ sahastrañca pūrvavajjuhuyādbudhaḥ || 13 || brāhmantradvayenāpi śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| sāvitryā'bjaṃ ghṛtābhyaktaṃ śatavāraṃ tato yajet || 14 || aindramāgneyasaṃyuktaṃ yajedāhavanīyake| yāmyaṃ naiṛtasaṃyuktamanvāhārye juhoti vai || 15 || vāruṇaṃ vāyudaivatyaṃ gārhapatye juhoti ca| saumyaṃ kauberamaiśānyāmāvasatthye yajetkramāt || 16 || caturvedādimantraiśca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ samaṃ bhavet || 17 || sthāpanaṃ ca trimūrtīnāṃ pariṣadvaṇapūjanam| vyaktaṃ marīciḥ provāca uktaśeṣaṃ samācaret || 18 || dvimūrtisthāpanam dvimūrtisthāpanaṃ vakṣye dakṣiṇe viṣṇumavyayam| vāme rudraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 19 || athavā kartumiccheccet brahmaṇaḥ sthāpanaṃ pṛthak| grāmādiṣu ca tanmadhye vivikte'nyatra vā vane || 20 || bhūparīkṣādikaṃ sarva tanmantreṇaiva kārayet| kṛtvā vimānaberādinayanonmīlanādikam || 21 || sthāpanoktakriyāssarvāḥ kārayetpūrvavadbudhaḥ| brāhmamantradvayenāpi nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 22 || havīṃṣi pāyasādīni catvāryevaṃ nivedayet| utsave tu dhvajaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇaṃ tasya kalpayet || 23 || vinā puruṣasūktena viṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ| brāhmamantradvayenaiva tattaddhomastadutsave || 24 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarva samaṃ bhavet| parivārasthāpanam raviṃ guhañca vidhneśaṃ durgā jyeṣṭhāṃ sarasvatīm || 25 || sthāpayitvā'rcanaṃ kartu yadīcchedbhaktitaḥ pṛthak| khile vistarataḥ proktaṃ yanmayā tatsamācaret || 26 || āśrayālayamiccheccetparito viṣṇumandire| bhāskarādīn prakalpyaiva pūjayeccenmahāphalam || 27 || prathamā'varaṇe prācyāṃ bhāskaraṃ bhāratīmapi| guhaṃ yāmye tu vidhneśaṃ naiṛte parikalpayet || 28 || jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyabhāge tu durgāṃ yāmye prakalpayet| pratyaṅmukhau ca kartavyau bhāratī ca divākaraḥ || 29 || kārayetprāṅmukhānanyāniti pūrvajaśāsanam| saumyenaiva vidhānena pūjayetsarvasampade || 30 || saumyālayāśritānetān tāntrikeṇa na cārcayet| aupāsanāgnireva syādeteṣāmāśrayālaye || 31 || kuryāddhruvārcāmārgeṇa sarvamanyatkhiloktavat| ālayaṃ pratimotsedhaṃ parivāroktavadbhavet || 32 || āśrayālayakalpaḥ āśrayālayakalpañca pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ| svatantramālayaṃ kartumaśakṛtonya'tra vā''laye || 33 || sthāpayitvā'rcayetso'pi samagraṃ phalamāpnuyāt| mūlālaye sthite deve sthitaṃ evā'śraye bhavet || 34 || āsīne cā'sanaṃ vā'pi sthānakañca prakalpayet| sthānakāsanaśayyāsu śayane'nyatamaṃ matam || 35 || mūlālaye dhruvārcāyāmāśrayañca dhruvārcanam| dhruvakautukasaṃyukte tadvadevaikameva vā || 36 || avatārāśrayañcettu gauṇamārge yathāvidhi| āsīnāveva sarvatra varāhanarasiṃhakau || 37 || avatārāśrayaṃ kurvan prathamāvaraṇādiṣu| matsyakūrmau prakurvīta pūrvadvārasya dakṣiṇe || 38 || varāhatrayamāgneyādyāmyāntaṃ parikalpayet| pārasiṃhaṃ prakurvīta girijaṃ yāmyapaścime || 39 || sthūṇajaṃ naiṛte deśe nīlavāruṇamadhyame| saudarśanaṃ nṛsiṃhantu vāruṇe ca tataḥ param || 40 || kuryāllakṣamīnṛsiṃhañca varuṇodānamadhyame| pātālanarasiṃhañca vāmanaṃ vāyudiśyapi || 41 || dhanadedānayormadhye kārayettu trivikramam| jāmadagnyaṃ tu kaubere kubereśānamadhyame || 42 || kuryāddāśarathiṃ rāmamaiśānye tu halāyudham| īśānendrāntare kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravāme tu kalkinam || 43 || varāhaṃ nārasiṃhañcarāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathaiva ca| dikṣu sarvāsu saṃsthāpya pūjayetsarvasiddhaye || 44 || yoge mūlālaye kuryādyogamevāśrayālayam| bhoge bhogañca yogaṃ vā na jātu virahādikam || 45 || mūlaberantu śūlañcecchūlamevāśrayālaye| śaile śailañca śūlaṃ vā lohe lauhaṃ śilāmapi || 46 || ekaberantu sarvatra śailameva prakalpayet| sudarśanapratiṣṭhā cedyāmye vā nairṛte tathā || 47 || kalpayedīśvaraṃ prācyāṃ prāgādi parikalpanam| pādahīnamathārdha vā mūlādāraśrayamandiram || 48 || tatra mūlālayotkṛṣṭamalaṅkāraṃ na kalpayet| saṅkhacādhikatalaṃ naiva kalpayedāśrayālayam || 49 || sālāśrayaṃ trivargāḍhyaṃ tadantarmaṇḍale'pi vā| agramaṇḍapasaṃyuktaṃ prathamā'varaṇe smṛtam || 50 || vimānadvāradevāśca garbhālayagatā api| parivārā iti proktā mukhāvāsāntamarcanam || 51 || dvitīyāvaraṇe cettu śāntāntapariṣadyutam| tṛtīyāvaraṇe cettu homakarmāṇi kārayet || 52 || mukhamaṇḍapasaṃyuktaṃ cakraśaṅkhayutaṃ tathā| caturthāvaraṇe cettu navaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 53 || anapāyigaṇāntsarvānkalpayetsnapanālayam| dvātriṃśadvigrahairūrdhvaṃ pṛthagevotsavādikam || 54 || brahmapadmāvaṭāntāśca bhūparīkṣādikāḥ kriyāḥ| naivāśrayālaye kuryāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || 55 || ārabhyādyeṣṭakānyāsaṃ vimānaṃ parikalpayet| naivādyantyeṣṭakānyāsau taccedāvṛtamaṇḍape || 56 || mūlaṃ paurāṇikaṃ cettu yathākāmamathāśrayam| gauṇaṃ samaṃ vā mukhyaṃ vā kalpayeccenna doṣakṛt || 57 || anyedavālaye viṣṇoḥ kuryāccedālayāśrayam| sarvaṃ mūlālayotkṛṣṭaṃ kalpayediti śāsanam || 58 || viṣṇavālaye'nyadevānāṃ kuryāccedāśrayālayam| na samaṃ naiva cotkṛṣṭaṃ hīnameva prakalyet || 59 || sthite'pi deve jyeṣṭhā ca vidhneśaśca sarasvatī| āsīnā eva kartavyāstadā'nye saṃsthitā matāḥ || 60 || iti saṅkṣepataḥ proktamāśrayālayakalpanam || irtyoṣa śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre trimūrtidvimūrtisthāpanavidhyāśrayālayakalpanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
<18> oṃ aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ puṇyanakṣatrapūjanam athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi puṇyanakṣatrapūjanam| śravaṇaṃ dvādaśī ervaṃ viṣṇupañcadināni vai || praśastaṃ śravaṇaṃ teṣu dvādaśī cottamā matā| viṣuvāyanāmāsarkṣagrahaṇeṣvanyasaṅkrame || kartṛbhūparkṣayoścaiva grāmanakṣatra eva vā| kṛtvā'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ tadvadvaddhvā pratisaraṃ tathā || śāyayeṃtpūrvarātrau tu prātassnātvā yathāvidhi| prātassandhyārcanānte tu mantrāṃstīrthadinoditān || nityāgnikuṇḍe hutvā tu cakravīśāmitaissaha| utsavoktakrameṇaiva grāmasandhau baliṃ dadet || utsavaṃ vidhināṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ pūrvavadācaret| snapanoktaprakāreṇa snāpayitvā tataḥ param || samabhyarcyaṃ nivedyaiva jīvasthāne niveśayet| śāntikotsavamuddiṣṭametaṃ pūrvāḍṇā ācaret || vinaiva balihomābhyāṃ madhyāhre pauṣṭikotsavam| tīrthaṃ vinā'parāhṇe tu kuryātkāmyotsavaṃ budhaḥ || arcāyāṃ śāntikaṃ karma kāmyamautsava eva vā| autsavaṃ snāpayitvā'hri rātrāvāsthānamaṇḍape || sarvopacārairabhyarcya pāyasādiharvīṣi ca| sarvaprayatnairnaivedyaṃ kuryādevamatandritaḥ || evaṃ kartumaśakṛtaśceddineṣveṣu yathāvidhi| saṃsnāpya gandhatoyena śuddhasnānoktamārgataḥ || dvātriśadvigrahairdevamarcayetvarayā mudā| tatrāpi balivelāyāṃ yānamāropya pūrvavat || devamevaṃ nayetsamṛyagālaye tu pradakṣiṇam| jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya śeṣaṃ tatra samācaret || viṣṇupañcadinasnāne kālo madhyāhra ucyate| viṣūparāgāyaneṣu tatkālātpūrvamācaret || haviṣpākoktavidhinā pākeṣvāgrayaṇaṃ caret| āhṛtāni ca dhānyāni vividhāni phalāni ca| sarvānathopadaṃśāṃśca navāni vasanani ca| sarvāṇyāhṛtya yatnena sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam || japecchakunasūktantu kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam| alaṅkatyāgrataścakaṃ nayediti ca kecana || havaḥ pākavidhi ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi haviṣpākavidhiṃ param| haviruddiśya dhānyāni copadaśāṃstathā''haret || 1 || śālivrīhipriyaṅgūni nīcavāraṃ ṣāṣṭikaṃ tathā| yavañca veṣṇukañcaiva praśastāni vidurbudhāḥ || 2 || vrīhīṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇadhānyaṃ visarjayet| sarveṣāṃ vrīhidhānyānāṃ śālirdaśaguṇo bhavet || 3 || śataguṇaḥ priyaṅguḥ syānnīvārantu sahasrakam| ayutaṃ garbhaṣaṣṭiḥ syāt anantaṃ yavaveṇuka || 4 || caturvarṇāhṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ praśastamabhidhīyate| antyajaiḥ pratilomaiśca nīlaṃ dhānyaṃ vivarjayet || 5 || athavā paṇyalabdhañca dhānyaṃ śuddhaṃ samāhet| trivarṣātītadhānyāni na praśaṃsanti daivike || 6 || taṇḍulānāñca sarveṣāṃ māsātītāni varjayet| 'āpo hi' ṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣya dhānyāni cā'haret || 7 || ālaye vā gṛhe vā'pi śuddhe deśe samāhitaḥ| vitāne vā kaṭe vā'pi samāstīrya vidhānataḥ || 8 || ātapena tathā śoṣya viśvāmitrān parāvapet| tato dhānyaṃ sumaṅgṛhya palāleṣu ca nikṣipet || 9 || palālona samābadhdya gajaskande nidhāya ca| sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅgārasaṃyutam || 10 || vedaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ pūrṇakumbhāṅkurairyutam| alaṅkatyā'layaṃ sarvaṃ pūrṇakumbhāṅkurairapi || 11 || dīpaiśca bahubhiśśastaiḥ kadalīkramukairapi| devālayaṃ śanairnītvā devāgre tāni vinyaset || 12 || teṣu vāyuṃ samabhyarcya tathaikādaśavigrahaiḥ| śrīsūktena śriyaṃ devīṃ saṃstūya praṇipatya ca || 13 || 'śriye jā' teti mantreṇa gṛḍṇīyāddhānyamatvaraḥ| avaghātaṃ punaḥ kuryāddhaviṣpākoktamārgataḥ || 14 || taṇḍulāṃścāpi śuddhāṃstu tataḥ pātre samāharet| havīṃṣi copadaṃśāśca pācayitvā yathāvidhi || 15 || taṇḍulānkṣālitānadbhiḥ śarkarāguḍamiśritān| marīcijīrakaiścaiva nārikelaphalairapi || 16 || saghṛtaṃ devadevāya mantravattānnivedayet| taireva taṇḍulairhutvā parivārabaliṃ dadet || 17 || punarācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet| punarabhyarcya deveśamupadaṃśādibhiryutam || 18 || nivedayeddhaviḥ paścānmūrtihomaṃ tathauva ca| parivārabaliṃ datvā pānīyācamanaṃ dadet || 19 || mukhavāsaṃ nivedyaiva 'kṣama' sveti praṇamya ca| paścātpuṣpāñcaliṃ dadyāddevadevasya pādayoḥ || 20 || kṛttikādīpaḥ kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāntu dīpadānaṃ samācaret| ālayaṃ samalaṅkatya mṛṣṭasiktopalepanaiḥ || 21 || alaṅkārairalaṅkuryādanyairapi ca śobhanaiḥ| devadevamalaṅkatya vastramālyānulepanaiḥ || 22 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti nivadayet| pūgaṃ vā nārikelaṃ vā tālaṃ vā jātimeva vā || 23 || dīpadaṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā tu devāgre sthāpayetpunaḥ| dīpadaṇḍasya paritaścolkādīpatrayāṇi ca || 24 || ratnimātrāyatānvevamayugmāni ca kārayet| kārayeddīpadānārtha kūṭākāraṃ caturmukham || 25 || maṇḍapeṣu ca sarveṣu sarveṣvāvaraṇeṣu ca| dīpādhārān prakurvīta yathāvibhavavistaram || 26 || pradoṣe kārayedevamālayantu pradakṣiṇam| 'uddīpya' sveti mantreṇa dīpamāropayetpunaḥ || 27 || dhānyapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya deveśābhimukhaṃ punaḥ| śriyaṃ tatra samabhyarcya 'śriye jāta' iti bruvan || 28 || sannyaseddīpadaṇḍāgre dīpaṃ deveśāsannidhau| prākārādiṣu sarvatra dīpānāropayedvahūn || 29 || nityaṃ tatkārtike māsi dīpadānaṃ viśiṣyate| saṃsthāpya devamāsthāne pūjayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 30 || apūpalājapṛthukān yathāśakti nivedayet| marīcijīrakagulairnārikelaissusaṃskṛtān || 31 || khile vistarataḥ proktā kṛttikādīpasaṃskṛtiḥ| keśikadvādaśī adhyayanotsavaḥ sārgaśīrṣākhyamāse tu pūrvapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 32 || ekādaśyāmathā'rabhya vedapārāyaṇaṃ caret| prātassandhyāvasāne tu devamāsthānamaṇḍape || 33 || saṃsthāpaya caturo vedān krameṇādhyāpayetsadā| pūjayeddevadevaṃ taṃ saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ || 34 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam| svastisūktaṃ samuccārya jīvasthāne niveśayet || 35 || pakṣaṃ trayodaśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāhaṃ samācaret| purāṇānītihāsāṃśca devasya vijayotkaṭāḥ || 36 || kathāṃ vā śrāvayennityaṃ devadevasya sannidhau| tatraiva māsi dvādaśyāṃ prātassnātvā yathāvidhi || 37 || mṛṇmayāni ca bhāṇḍāni purāṇāni parityajet| yathārha śodhayedanyā 'nāmā vā' jeti mantrataḥ || 38 || mṛṣṭasiktopalepādyaiśśodhayitvā tathā''layam| autsavādīni berāṇi sarvāṇyeva yathāvidhi || 39 || saṃsnāpya gandhatoyena śuddhasnanoktamārgataḥ| snāpayetsnāpanaṃ beraṃ kalaśaiśca yathāvidhi || 40 || caturdiśaṃ caturhastaṃ gomayenopalipya ca| vrīhibhiḥ kārayetpadmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 41 || tatpadmasaṃsthitāndevān pūrvavatsamyagarcayet| tasmin devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya viṣṭare sottarachade || 42 || āsanādibhirabhyarcya pāyamānnaṃ nivedayet| pādyamācamanaṃ 'datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet || 43 || puṣpayāgoktamantraistu dadyātpuṣpāñjalīn bahūn| dhāmapradakṣiṇānte tu jīvasthāne niveśayet || 44 || saṃvatsarārcane nyūnaṃ nitye naimittike'pi yat| tatsarva paripūrṇa syāt dvādaśyāṃ pūjayā'nayā || 45 || āpnuyādyajamāno'pi tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam| saṃvatsarārcanādoṣaprāyaścittārthameva tat || 46 || śravaṇadvādaśīviśeṣaḥ śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā| pavitrāropaṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ kārayediti kecana || 47 || tasmātṛsarvaprayatnena pavitrāropaṇaṃ caret| gavyena payasā taiṣye nityaṃ saṃsnāpayeddharim || 48 || rāghavasyārcanam dvādaśī pūrvapakṣe tu māghamāse punarvasū| jayā tasyāmupoṣyaiva rāmaṃ vā viṣṇumeva vā || 49 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā snāpayitvā nivedayet| titapadmavidhiḥ tajayāsminmāse site pakṣe pañcamī viyājahvayā || 50 || tilapadmavidhiṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ kuryāttu tatra vai| pūrvarātrau tu deveśamarcayitvā yathākramam || 51 || harvīṣyapi nivedyaiva badhdvā pratisaraṃ punaḥ| pūrvavacchāyayeddevaṃ rātriśeṣaṃ nayedbudhaḥ || 52 || prabhāte devamutthāpya kalaśaiḥ snāpayetpunaḥ| saṃsthāpya maṇḍape devaṃ praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 53 || vikīrya pramukhe dhānyaṃ dvihastāyatavistṛte| navabastre samākīrya kṛṣṇājinasamanvite || 54 || tilabhāraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadūdhvera maṇḍalākṛti| vikīryātra likhetpadmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 55 || suvarṇapadmaṃ kṛtvā tu tilapadmopari nyaset| āḍhakaiśśālidhānyaiśca pūrṇapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa || 56 || aindrādi ca tathaiśānta saśāli parito nyaset| āḍhakaṃ tailamāhatya tadardha vā ghṛta tathā || 57 || tatsamaṃ dadhi saṅgṛhya pātreṣu ca pṛthakpṛthak| dakṣiṇe sannyasettailamuttare tu ghṛtaṃ nyaset || 58 || paścime dadhi sannyasya devadevaṃ praṇamya ca| ātmasūktaṃ japitvā tu pūjayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 59 || praṇamya devamāvāhya padmamadhye tu pūrvavat| prāgādi puruṣārdīśca tathaikādaśavigrahaiḥ || 60 || aindrādyaiśāntamāvāhya digdevānarcayettataḥ| 'ato devā' disaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ japetvunaḥ || 61 || bimbe devaṃ samāropya cānyānudvāsayetkramāt| yajamāno'tha tatkāle dadyādacāryadakṣiṇām || 62 || viṣṇubhaktiyutaṃ dāntaṃ dayādyātmaguṇairyutam| nityasvādhyāyasaṃyuktaṃ sarvāvayavasaṃyutam || 63 || vipramāhūya tatkāle dhyātvā taṃ devamāvyayam| tilapadmaṃ dadettasmai devadevasya sannidhau || 64 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti nivedayet| parītya mandiraṃ paśyāt jīvasthāne niveśayet || 65 || yajñādhikāre samproktaṃ tadvidhānaṃ suvistṛtam| dhūpadānaviśeṣaḥ dhūpadānaṃ tu tanmāsi devadevasya śasyate || 66 || phālgunamāsārcanam phālgunottarulgunyoḥ śriyā sārdha janārdanam| snāpayitvotsavaṃ kṛtvā samabhyarcya nivedayet || 67 || athavā śuddhatoyaiśca snāpayitvā nivedayet| taddine śriyamabhyarcya śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt || 68 || devasya phālgune māse gandhadānaṃ viśiṣyate| caitre damanotsavaḥ paurṇamāsyā tathā caitryāṃ kuryāddamanakotsavam || 69 || pūrvāsminneva divase alaṅkṛtyālayaṃ śubham| mālā damanakasyaiva vividhāḥ kārayecchubhāḥ || 70 || rātripūjāvasāne tu devamāsthānamaṇḍape| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva baddhvā pratisarāmapi || 71 || trilokamaṇḍalaṃ hṛdyaṃ devāgre parikalpayet| mātā damanakasyaiva merumūrdhani vinyaset || 72 || aṣṭau kulācalāgreṣu gandhodakaghaṭān nyaset| tadvahiṣṣoḍaśapade dikṣu dvāraṃ visṛjya ca || 73 || pañcagavyādidravyāṇi nyaseccheṣapadeṣu ca| tasyāgre pauṇḍarīkāgnikuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 74 || āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā deveśaṃ śāyayetpunaḥ| dravyādhidevānabhyarcya vasantaṃ kāmamarcayet || 75 || vaiṣṇava viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| śrībhūmisūktamantrāṃśca yaddevādīstathaiva ca || 76 || jayādīn pariṣaddevamūrtimantrānathāpi vā evaṃ hutvā niśāṃ nītvā prātassnātvā yathāvidhi || 77 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ gandhodakaghaṭairapi| vastrādyairapyalaṅkatya muhūrte tu śubhodaye || 78 || adhivāsitamālāstāssamādāya samāhitaḥ| devasya viṣṇusūktena dadyāṃdbhaktisamanvitaḥ || 79 || sarveṣāmapi berāṇāṃ tathā pariṣadāmapi| mālā damanakasyaiva dadyāttanmantramūrtibhiḥ || 80 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamaṃ| nītvā''layaṃ tato devaṃ saṃsthāpyāsthānamaṇḍape || 81 || saṃsnāpya gandhatoyena samabhyarcya nivedayet| antahomāvasāne'gnirnityakuṇḍe praṇīyatām || 82 || vasantotsavaḥ puṣpadānaṃ praśastaṃ syādasminmāse tu śārṅgiṇaḥ| taddinañca samārabhya jyeṣṭhe mūlāvasānakam || 83 || tattatkālodbhavairdravyairvasantotsavamācaret| devaṃ madhyāhrapūjānte saṃsthāpyā'sthānamaṇḍape || 84 || saṃsnāpya gandhatoyena vastraṃ parimitaṃ laghu| samācchādya samabhyarcya puṣpaistatkālasambhavaiḥ || 85 || nivedya pāyasādīni kṛtvā dhāmapradakṣiṇam| pakvāpi kadalīcūtapanasānāṃ phalāni ca || 86 || apūpādīni bhakṣyāṇi nārikelaphalāmbu ca| nivedyā'cmanaṃ datvā mukhavāsāṃ nivedayet || 87 || arcāpīṭhe tu deveśaṃ mantravatthāpayedbudhaḥ| jyeṣṭhe mūlādi varpāntaṃ nityamevaṃ samācaret || 88 || vaiśākhotsavaḥ vaiśākhe paurṇamāsyāntu snapanādīni pūrvavat| kṛtvā tu pūrvavaddevaṃ saṃsthāpyā'sthānamaṇḍape || 89 || āsanādibhirabhyarcya saptaviṃśativigrahaiḥ| pāyasādinivedyañca prabhūtañca nivedayet || 90 || marīcijīrakaguṅairnārikelarasena ca| saṃskṛtaṃ bhūri sarpiśca dadyāccūtulaṃ bahu || 91 || pānīyācamanānte tu mukhavāsa nivedayet| ālayaṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā devadevasya cotsavam || 92 || jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya nityapūjāṃ samācaret| asmin pānīyadānantu praśastamabhidhīyate || 93 || jyeṣṭhotsavaḥ jyoṣṭhamāse tu mūlāyāṃ vastradānaṃ hareḥ smṛtam| tanmāse paurṇamāsyāntu gandhodairabhiṣicya ca || 94 || navavastrairalaṅkṛtya samabhyaccarya nivedayet| āṣāḍhotsavaḥ āṣāḍhe paurṇamāsyāntu kuryādekāhikotsavam || 95 || snāpayitvā samabhyarcya hṛrvīṣyapi nivedayet| ardhyadānaṃ praśastaṃ syāddevasyāṣāḍhamāsi vai || 96 || śrāvaṇotasavaḥ śrāvaṇe śravaṇarkṣe tu devadevasya yatnataḥ| utsavasnapanādīni pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ || 97 || śrāvaṇe māsi tasmiṃśca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ| aṣṭamī rohiṇīyuktā jayantī rahitā'thavā || 98 || tatra candrodaye viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇavigrahamarcayet| viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ vā'tha tathā snāpya vāribhiḥ || 99 || nivedya pracuraṃ kṣīraṃ havissamyaṅnivedya ca| badhdvā pratisaraṃ tadvacḍāyayetpuruṣottamam || 100 || ahorātramupoṣyaiva prātassnātvā yathāvidhi| utsavoktaprakāreṇa devasyotsavamācaret || 101 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairviṣṇumāsthāne sthāpayedbudhaḥ| samabhyarcya havirdadyātpāyasaṃ gaulyameva vā || 102 || arpayenmukhavāsānte jīvasthāne niveśayet| pāraṇantu tataḥ kuryāt sa vai sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 103 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā viṣṇupūjāñca taddine || 104 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati| atassarvaprayatnena jayantyāmutsavaṃ caret || 105 || dhūpadānaṃ praśastaṃ syāchrāvaṇe māsi śārṅgiṇaḥ| yo nityaṃ parayā bhaktyā dhūpadānaṃ samācaret || 106 || so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ dhūphalameti na saṃśayaḥ| bhādrapadotsavaḥ śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā || 107 || saṃvatsarārcanādoṣaśāntyarthaṃ keśavasya ca| rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhyarthaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam || 108 || sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ proktaṃ yadbruhmaṇā purā| pavitrāropaṇaṃ kuryātsarvadoṣopaśāntaye || 109 || utsavoktaprakāreṇa kuryāttacchravaṇe budhaḥ| asminmāse havirdānaṃ praśastaṃ keśavasya tu || 110 || māse'sminnārabhetaiva śrāvaṇaṃ vratamuttamam| mārgaśīrṣaṃ samārabhya kuryādekādaśīvratam || 111 || ekabhuktastu pūrve'hri prātassnātvā yathāvidhi| yugmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāddevadevaṃ praṇamya ca || 112 || keśavādīni nāmāni japedekāgramānasaḥ| mārgaśīrṣaṃ samārabhya kramānmāseṣu vai punaḥ || 113 || athavā pauruṣaṃ sūktamupoṣya vratamācaret| prātassaṃsnāpya deveśaṃ samabhyarcya nivedya ca || 114 || dānaṃ kṛtvā dvijendrebhyaḥ pāraṇaṃ punarācaret| tatassarveṣu māseṣu kṣutapraskhalanādiṣu || 115 || japettanmāsanāmnaiva deveśaṃ manasā smaran| viṣṇavādipañcamūrtyantaiḥ snapanañcārcanādikam || 116 || kuryāttanmāsanāmnaiva brāhmaṇebhyastathaiva ca| evaṃ varṣe tu sampūrṇe māsi bhādrapade tathā || 117 || śravaṇe snāpayeddevaca śatāṣṭakalaśairapi| mahāhaviḥ prabhutaṃ vā saṃyuktaṃ pāyasādibhiḥ || 118 || nivedya mukhavāsānte dadyātpuṣpāñjalīn bahūn| kṛtvā'nnadānaṃ viprebhyaḥ pāraṇaṃ pūrvavaccaret || 119 || ekādaśīvrataṃ kurvan sampūrṇe vatsare tathā| dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu snapanādīni kārayet || 120 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā mahāpāpairvimucyate ante vimānamāruhya viṣṇoḥ padamavāpnuyāt || 121 || mārgaśīrṣaśca māso'yaṃ māsānāṃ śreṣṭha īritaḥ| dvādaśī śravaṇaṃ tasminnamāvāsyā tathaiva ca || 122 || upavāsavrataṃ kuryāttasminnānyatsamācaret| aśvayujārcanam śravaṇañcāśvayuṅmāsi sarvapāpaharaṃ varam || 123 || matsyakūrmavarāhāṇāmāvirbhāvadinaṃ smṛtam| utsavasnapanādīni kuryāttatrāpi śārṅgiṇaḥ || 124 || mukhavāsaṃ harerdadyāt māse'sminnityameva ca| sarveṣvapi ca māseṣu māsarkṣeṣvadhikārcanam || 125 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sahitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre puṇyarkṣapūjana āgrayaṇa viṣpākavidhāna sarvamāsārcanavidhirnāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<19> oṃ ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ viśeṣārcanam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣārādhanaṃ hareḥ| śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ kāmyamiti bhinnaṃ tridhā'rcanam || 1 || vyādhidurbhikṣadussvapnadurnimittapraśāntaye| śatrupīḍopaśāntyarthaṃ tathā'vagrahaśāntaye || 2 || anyadoṣopaśāntyartha śāntikaṃ samudāhṛtam| dhanadhānyādivṛddhyarthaṃ kṛtaṃ pauṣṭikamucyate || 3 || yatkiñcidabhikāṃkṣyārtha kṛtaṃ kāmyamudāhṛtam| pūrvāheṇa śāntikaṃ kuryānmadhyāhre pauṣṭikaṃ tathā|| 4 || kāmyaṃ syādaparohṇe tu na kuryānniśi kiñcana| pūrvoktena prakāreṇa kārayitvā'ṅkurārpaṇam || 5 || aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhva dravyāṇyapi samāharet| maṇḍapaṃ vā prapāṃ vā'pi kūṭaṃ vā'pi yathocitama || 6 || kārayettatra deśe tu snapanālayacodite| pūrvarātre tu deveśaṃ samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 7 || badhdvā pratisaraṃ tadvacchāyayitvā tataḥ param| śvabhrasya paritaḥ paḍaktiṃ kalpayetsnapanoktavat || 8 || dravyāṇi ca mṛdādyāni tatra sannyasya pūrvavat| devāgre dakṣiṇe vā'pi pauṇḍarīkaṃ prakalpayet || 9 || devaṃ śvabhre pratiṣṭhāpya snāpayitvā'tha pūrvavat mathitaṃ laukikaṃ vā'gniṃ kuṇḍe cā'dhāya pūrvavat || 10 || āghārānte suhotavyaṃ mūlamantradvayena vai| ājyāśvatthasamiddūrvācarubhiśca pṛthakpṛthak || 11 || pratyekamayutaṃ proktamuttamaṃ munisattamāḥ| aṣṭottarasahasrantu madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam || 12 || aṣṭhottaraśataṃ nyūnamevaṃ trividhamīritam| jājvalyamānamakuṭaṃ dīpyamānavibhūṣaṇam || 13 || śyāmāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ taptahāṭakasannibham| raktāsyapāṇipādākṣaṃ praṇavātmakamavyayam || 94 || śaṅkṣacakradharaṃ devaṃ parātparataraṃ vibhum| ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā homakarma samācaret || 95 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| brāhmaṃ raudraṃ jayārdīśca juhuyātsarpiṣā sakṛt || 16 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā śrīsūkṛtenāpi pauṣṭike| dvātriṃśatprasthasampūrṇa navaṃ kumbhaṃ pragṛhya ca || 17 || tantunā pariveṣṭyādbhiḥ pūrayitvā yavāntaram| sauvarṇaṃ viṣṇurupañca śrībhumyośca pṛthakpṛthak || 18 || sannyasedviṣṇugāyatryā pratyekañcāṣṭaniṣkataḥ| tāni vdyaṅgulamātrāṇi maṅgalānyāyudhāni ca || 19 || nikṣipetpūrvacaddhīmān ratnāni nva viśeṣataḥ| kṣaumābhyāmatha paṭṭābhyāṃ sūkṣmavastradvayena vā || 20 || kumbhasya kaṇṭhamāveṣṭya puṣpamālāpariṣkṛtam| aśvatthapallavaṃ kūrcaṃ nyaseddūrvāṅkurāṇyapi || 21 || praṇavena samāveṣṭya mūlamantraṃ dvayaṃ japet| aṣṭottarasahasrantu deveśaṃ manasā smaran || 22 || 'namo vāce' samuccārya 'śanno vāta' itīrya ca| daśakṛtvo'bhimintryaiva nityamevaṃ samācaret || 23 || āsthānamaṇḍape devaṃ sthāpayetpadmaṇḍale| samabhyarcya harvīṣyatra pāyasāni nivedayet || 24 || pānīyācamanaṃ datvā paścāttāmbūlameva ca| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 25 || nārāyaṇānuvākañca sūktamekākṣarādikam| sañjapanviṣṇugāyatrīṃ 'namo brahmaṇa' ityāpi || 26 || dvādaśāṣṭākṣarābhyāñca datvā puṣpāñjaliṃ bahu| daṇḍāṅgena namaskṛtya 'kṣamasve' tyanumānya ca || 27 || arcāpīie pratiṣṭhāpya nityapūjāṃ samācaret| evaṃ māsaṃ trisaptāhaṃ pakṣaṃ vā'tha trayodaśa || 28 || ekādaśadinaṃ vā'pi navāhaṃ vā tathaiva ca| saptāhaṃ vā'tha pañcāhaṃ tridinaṃ vā yathāvidhi || 29 || snapanañcārcanaṃ homaṃ tathā kumṛbhābhimarśanam| uttamaṃ kumṛbhahomābhyāṃ tathā kumbhena madhyamam || 30 || nityamevaṃ prakurvīta samāptadivasotsavam| yajamānaṃ tathā''cāryo devadevasya sannidhau || 31 || snāpayetkumbhatoyena prokṣayedvā sahasraśaḥ| māsi māsi svajanmarkṣe kuryādevaṃ yathāvidhi || 32 || āyurārogyamaiśvaryamacalāṃ śriyamāpnuyāt| evaṃ yaḥ kārayedbhaktyā devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 33 || vyādhayastasya naśyanti grahapīḍādyupadravāḥ| durnimittāni duḥsvapnacoraśatrubhayādayaḥ || 34 || upadravāstathā cānye praṇasyanti na saṃśayaḥ| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca siddhyantyevaṃ kṛte sati || 35 || pauṣṭike caiva kāmye ca naiva kumbhābhimarśanam| evaṃ kartumaśaktaścedayugmadinaṅkhyayā || 36 || śuddhatoyābhiṣekañca pūjanañca nidedanam| nityāgnikuṇḍe homañca kuryāditi ca kecana || 37 || nityāgnihome vicchinne pauṇḍarīke tu śāntike| kāmye ca pauṣṭike caiva laukikāgnau samācaret || 38 || ityorṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ sarhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre viśeṣārādhanavidhirnāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
<20> oṃ viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ bhūparīkṣādiprāyaśrittam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūparīkṣādiniṣkṛtim| prāyo doṣasamutpattiḥ cittistasya nirāsanam || 1 || tasya doṣasya sandhānaṃ prāyaścittamitīritam| tadeva dinamārabhya navame vā'tha saptame || 2 || pañcame'hani vā kuryātpūrvamevāṅkurārpaṇām| aṅkurārpaṇahīne aṅkurārpaṇahīne tu bhūparīkṣādikarmaṇām || 3 || brahṛmādīnāntu ṣaṇṇāṃ vai mantrerhutvā tu vaiṣṇāvaiḥ| pālikādhipatīnāñca jayādīnāñca mūrtibhiḥ || 4 || kṛtvā'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ paścāttattatkarma samācaret| pālikānāmabhāve tu śarāvānvā samāharet || 5 || darbhairdagdhvopayuktānvā gṛhṇīyāditi kecana| viśeṣārcanahīne tu dviguṇañca samarcayet || 6 || aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya havimsamyaṅnivedayet| viśeṣārcanamityukte sarvatra dvijasattamāḥ || 7 || viśeṣeṇārcanaṃ kuryātkautuke cāṅkurārpaṇe| anyālayāṅgabimbānāmutsavādyaṅkurārpaṇe || 8 || viśeṣato'rcanaṃ yattatbera eva samācaret| pramāṇahīnāyāṃ paṅktau yajetpaṅkīśamūrtibhiḥ || 9 || saptahastapramāṇañcet sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayetpadam| pañcahastapramāṇañcedupapīdupapīṭhapadaṃ nayet || 10 || paṅktiṃstrihastamānā cetkuryānnavapadaṃ tathā| saptasaptapade madhye caikaṃ brāhmamudāhṛtam || 11 || parito'ṣṭau jayādīnāṃ tadvahiṣṣoḍaśe pade| kalpayitvā tu tadvāhye caturviṃśatike pade || 12 || dikṣu dvārāṇi catvāri śeṣādīnāṃ padāṣṭakam| dvārāṇāṃ pārśvayośśeṣāḥ pālikāsthāpanāya vai || 13 || śeṣañca vakratuṇḍañca prāgdvārobhayapārśvayoḥ| vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ pūjyau cakravīśau tu dakṣiṇe || 14 || paṅttīśaśaṅkhau vāruṇyāṃ somaśāntāvudagdiśi| evameva prakurvīta saptasaptapade tathā || 15 || pañcapañcapade madhye brahmaṇaścaikamucyate| parito'ṣṭau jayādīnāṃ tadvahiṣṣouśāṃśake || 16 || dikṣu dvārāṇi catvāri śeṣādiṃsteṣu pūjayet| śeṣavidhneśapaṅktīśasomāṃstadchavarapārśvagān || 17 || īśānasomayormadhye viṣvaksenaṃ samarcayet| śiṣṭāni pālikādīnāṃ sthāpanāya prakalpayet || 18 || madhye navapade caikaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitam| śeṣādīnāṃ jayādīnāṃ pālikānāṃ tathaiva ca || 19 || tadvahiśca padeṣvṣṭhasvaṣṭāvevātra pālikāḥ| aṅkurārpaṇamārabhya tṛtīye pañcame'thavā || 20 || saptame navame vā'hri tattatkarma samācaret| ataścordhvamayugmeṣu dineṣveva yathāvidhi || 21 || mahāśāntiñca hutvā tu kṛtvā sadyo'ṅkurārpaṇam| brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu tattatkarma samācaret || 22 || karmaṇāṃ sādhivāsānāṃ sadyaśceṅkurārpaṇam| kārayetpūrvarātrau tu pūrvamevādhivāsanam || 23 || kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ paścāt jalādiṣvadhivāsya ca| vāstuhomādikaṃ karma pūrvavatsarvamācaret || 24 || dinadvaye'pyalabdhe tu sadyaḥ kartṛ tvarānvitaḥ| kṛtvā'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ sadyo nayanonmīlanādikam || 25 || kṛtvā sadyastadahryeva sthāpayediti kecana| bhūparīkṣāyām bhūparīkṣāmakṛtvā tu kṛtaṃ tatkarṣaṇaṃ yadi || 26 || bhūsūktaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ hutvā bhūmiṃ parīkṣya ca| punaśca karṣaṇaṃ kuryāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || 27 || akāle bhūparīkṣāyāṃ tathaiva juhuyādbudhaḥ| parīkṣeta śubhe kāle bhūmiṃ pūrvektamārgataḥ || 28 || bhūparīkṣaṇakāle tu durnimittasamudbhave| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 29 || hutvā tu viṣṇugayatryā sāvitryā'ṣṭaśataṃ yajet| śākunaṃ svastisūktañca daśakṛtvo japettathā || 30 || kanyāyā bhojane hīne daurga hutvā tu bhojayet| kanyāyā dīpavicchede patane paṅkajasya ca || 31 || hutvā śrīsūktadaivatye paścātkarma samācaret| gṛhṇīyātpaṅkajābhāve kumudaṃ dhavalaṃ navam || 32 || ārabheta kriyāssarvāssamabhyarcya vināyakam| vināyakārcane hīne tanmantreṇa śataṃ yajet || 33 || karṣaṇe karṣaṇe ca kṛte kāle kriyāhīne tathaiva ca| viparyāse ca sarvatra bhūsaktaṃ bhūmidaivatam || 34 || hutvā tattatprakurvīta tattanmantraṃ samuccaran| uktavṛkṣasya cālābhe halādīnāṃ yathākramam || 35 || tadvṛkṣādhipamabhyarcya śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadet| vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ yajettatra vidhānataḥ || 36 || uktapramāṇahīneṣu halādiṣu tathaiva ca| prājāpatyañca yāmyañca raudraṃ bhautikasaṃyutam || 37 || ādāvante ca juhuyādvyāhṛtyantaṃ savaiṣṇavam| bhede chede tathā teṣāṃ rajjucchede tathaiva ca || 38 || vṛṣabhāṅgavihīne ca padmāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| brāhmañca vīśadaivatyaṃ prājāpatyañca bhautikam || 39 || ārṣānapi ca mantrāśca taddaivatyasamanvitam| kāpilena ghṛtenaiva mahāvyāhṛtibhiryajet || 40 || deveśamarcayayitvā tu rupyaṃ dadyādyathodayam| vraṇayukte tu tatkāle sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe || 41 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ hutvā'cāryāya dīyatām| niṣkādhikasuvarṇantu dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau || 42 || supte mūḍhe tathā bhrānte durgame patite vṛṣe| rudite viṣṇugāyatryā padmāgnau tu sahasrakam || 43 || hutvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt keśadantanakhādiṣu| kāpālabhasmapāṣāṇatuṣaśalyeṣu satsu ca || 44 || visṛjya tāni sarvāṇi prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣayettathā| pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya vāstuhomaṃ yajetpunaḥ || 45 || karṣaṇe tu vihīne tu hīne bījanivāpane| sadyaḥ kartumaśakto vā kālakṣepabhayāttathā || 46 || padmāgnau rātrisūktañca viṣṇusūktañca vaiṣṇavam| godānasūktaṃ vicchinnaṃ hutvā bījaṃ pradāya ca || 47 || karṣayitvā bhuvaṃ paścāt palālāni tṛṇāni ca| vikīrya bhuvi sarvatra gogaṇebhyo nivedayet || 48 || upteṣu teṣu naṣṭeṣu vandhyatvādaprarohiṣu| pūrvoktaniṣkṛtiṃ hutvā tṛṇānyāstīrya tatra vai || 49 || gogaṇebhyo nivedyaiva paścātkarma samācaret| ekaṃdeśakriyāhīne karṣaṇe bījavāpane || 50 || tatkarmaṇāñca sarveṣāṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam| gṛhītāmanyadevārtha na gṛhaṇīyātkadācana || 51 || ajñānādyadi gṛhaṇāti vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ| pratilomasamīpeṣu na kuryādviṣṇumandiram || 52 || caṇḍālapakkaṇātkrośādarvāṅranaiva prakalpayet| tathaiva pulkasāvāsāttathā takṣakakārukāt || 53 || anulomanivāse'pi na kuryādi kecana| anulomanivāseṣu kuryāccettāntrikeṇa tu || 54 || hīne śāntārcane hutvā taddaivatyaṃ sahasrakam| vīśacakrārcane hīne taddaivatyaṃ tathā yajet || 55 || tilasarṣapamiśreṇa caruṇā juhuyāttathā| taruṇālayahīne taruṇālayahīne tu niṣphalaṃ sarvamucyate || 56 || pauṇḍarīke ghṛtābhyaktaiḥ juhu yācchvetapaṅkajaiḥ| krameṇa rātrisūktañca pāramātmikameva ca || 57 || īṅkārādīntsmaran devaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhaktito dadet| bālālaye'rcanaṃ kurvan paścātkarma samācaret || 58 || taruṇālayaberavicāraḥ alābhe lohabimbānā labdhaṃ bimbaṃ samāharet| alābhe nānurūpaṃ vā yācitaṃ vā samāharet || 59 || yāceta śrotriyāgārāllokikaṃ vā'nyamandirāt| ālayāṅgaṃ na yāceta kautukāditrayaṃ budhaḥ || 60 || yācitaṃ śrotriyāgārādanurupa dhruvasya cet| tamevaṃ kautukaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet || 61 || anyālayādyarcitaṃ cettatkriyānte punaḥ kramāt| pūrvā'layaṃ samānīya śāntiṃ hutvā samarcayet || 62 || sthāpitaṃ nānurupañcedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccaran| sahasakrakṛtvo hutvā tu kautukaṃ sthāpayecchubham || 63 || vāstusavanapuṇyāhīne vāstuhomavihīne tu pāñcabhaitikavaiṣṇavai| mahāvyāhṛtisaṃyuktaṃ hutvā tatpunarācaret || 64 || puṇyāhavācane hīne viprān śaktyaiva bhojayet| brahmapadmāvaṭe brahmapadmāvaṭe tasminkapālāsthyādidarśane || 65 || vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ brāhmamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam| hutvā'nyatraiva tatkuryādbrahmapadmāvaṭaṃ punaḥ || 66 || vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ yajetpunaḥ| bhinne tatra ghaṭe srāve janānāṃ bhayasambhave || 67 || kalahe rudhirasrāve vaiśvaksenaṃ yajetkramāt| gāruḍaṃ vaiṣṇāvaṃ brāhmamaindrañcaiva samāhitaḥ || 68 || rātrisūktañca hutvā tu prājāpatyasamanvitam| vāmāvarte vāruṇañca vāyavyaṃ bhūmidaivatam || 69 || saṅkulañcettadā vāri brāhmaṃ hutvā savāruṇam| spandane calane caiva pāṃsucchanne tathaiva ca || 70 || vāruṇaṃ vaiṣvaksenañca juhuyāttasya śāntaye| padme'dharottare tasmin pārśvasthe patite'pi ca || 71 || spandane patrakauṭilye parimlāne ca bhedane| brāhmaṃ taddevahomañca vāruṇaṃ bhārgavaṃ yajet || 72 || vidiggate tathā padme brāhmamāruṣameva ca| śaṅkusthāpane śaṅkusthāpanahīne ca pariṣaddhomamācaret || 73 || śuddhaprācyā'thavā kuryāddikparicchedamatvaraḥ| ārabhya mukhyamārgantu tadgauṇaṃ kārayedyadi datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ devaṃ saktyābhyarcya nivedya ca || 75 || ārabdhanatu yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva punarācaret| ādyeṣṭakāyām ādyeṣṭakāmakṛtvā tu vimānaṃ kriyate yadi || 76 || grāmasya yajamānasya rāṣṭrasya mahatī vipat| tasmāttadapahārāya mahāśāntiṃ tathā yajet || 77 || ādyeṣṭakāñca sannyasya vimānaṃ kārayetpunaḥ| ādyeṣṭakākriyāyāntu nyūnāyāṃ mantraparyaye || 78 || iṣṭakāgre śilāgre ca viparyāse tathaiva ca| ratnanyāsavihīne ca sarvadaivatyapūrvakam || 79 || vaṃṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pairuṣaṃ sūktameva ca| mindāhutī mahīsūktaṃ vicchinnaṃ juhuyātkramāt || 80 || pūrvoktena vidhānena kārayediti śāsanam| vimāne prastare tasminnalaṅkāre ca sarvaśaḥ || 81 || hīne cāṅke vimāne ca pratikhaṇḍaviparyaye| śāntikādivimāne tu tale tvanyonyasaṅkare || 82 || dvārasyābhyantarasyāpi bhitteḥ hīne'dhike tathā| nyakṣādīnāṃ caturṇāñca śatakṛtvo yajetkramāt || 83 || madhye tu pauṇḍarīkāgnau padmahomaṃ juhoti ca| juhuyādrātrisūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 84 || sahasrāhutiparyantaṃ yathoktaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| anyonyaṃ gaṇyasāṅkaryaṃ nācarecchāntikādiṣu || 85 || adṛbhute śānitakaṃ gaṇyaṃ yojayetsārvadeśikam| prākārādyeṣṭakāhīne parivārādhidaivatam || 86 || vaiṣṇavena samāyuktaṃ daśakṛtvo juhoti ca| gopurādyaiṣṭakāhīne dvārapālādhidaivatam || 87 || dhātrādīnāntu ṣaṇmantrān daśavāraṃ savaiṣṇavam| ādyeṣṭakānāṃ vinyāse hīne cainmaṇḍapādiṣu || 88 || tanmaṇḍapādhidaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇāvena śataṃ yajet| mahānasasya hīne ceddhavirakṣakadaivatam || 89 || śrīdaivatyañca tatsūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| bhūtapīṭhe adyeṣṭakā ādyeṣṭakākramaṃ vakṣye bhūtapīṭhaprakalpane || 90 || iṣṭakāṃ vā śilāṃ vā'tha gṛhītvā pūrvasaṅkhyayā| adhivāsādikarmāṇi kṛtvā pūrvoktamārgataḥ || 91 || mantrau tadṛbhūtadaivatyau vaiṣṇavena samanvitau| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā bhūtebhyaśca tataḥ param || 92 || yakṣebhyaśca piśācebhjñyo nāgebhyaśca juhoti ca| caturvedādimantraistu sthāpayeccaturiṣṭakāḥ || 93 || tatrāpyādyeṣṭakāhīne kṛte sati tapodhanāḥ| juhuyādbhūtamantrābhyāṃ vaiṣṇavena yutaṃ śatam || 94 || adhivāsocitairmantraiḥ pīṭhaṃ saṃsnāpya vāriṇā| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairhomaṃ hutvā ca pūrvavat || 95 || caturvedādimantrāstāṃścaturdikṣu tathā japet| sādhāraṇaniṣkṛtiḥ karmaṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ pracyutāvuktaniṣkṛtiḥ || 96 || hutvā taduktahomānte tattanmantrān japetkramāt| parivārālayānāñca hareruktapramāṇataḥ || 97 || ādyeṣṭakādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryāttanmantrapūrvakam| garbhanyāsahīnegarbhanyāsakriyāhīne kālātīte viparyaye || 98 || vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ śrīdaivatyaṃ tathaiva ca| viṣṇusūktañca juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 99 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ mahīsūktaṃ kramādyajet| pūrvavatsannyasedgarbha tattatpariṣadāṃ smṛtam || 100 || mūrdheṣṭakānyāse mūrdheṣṭakāyāṃ hīnāyāṃ kāle'tīte viparyaye| ādyeṣṭakāyāṃ samproktaṃ prāyaścitaṃ juhoti ca || 101 || aṅgahomaṃ tato hutvā pūrvoktavidhinā caret| sthūpiśūlādihīne sthūpiśūlādihīne tu dhruvasūktaṃ samuccaran || 102 || sannyasediṣṭakāmekāṃ tatra ratnāni sannyaset| dikṣviṣṭakāścatasrastu sthāpayitvā tu pūrvavat || 103 || madhye sthūpiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sudhayā kārayeddṛḍham| parivārālayānāñca gopurāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 104 || rvalepādihīne mūrdheṣṭakāyāṃ hīnāyāṃ varṇalepaviparyaye| sahasrāhutimabajagnau vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyāttathā || 105 || sudhākarma punaḥ kuryādvarṇalepaṃ tathaiva ca| agnayulkāśanidhūmādyairdoṣayukte ca mandire || 106 || śāntaye tasya duhuyādīṅkārīdīṃstathaiva ca| mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ pāramātmikameva ca || 107 || brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| berasyāgnisparśe bere'gnisparśane'bjāgnau mahāśāntiṃ dinatrayam || 108 || hutvā śatāṣṭakalaśaiḥ snāpayitvā tataḥ param| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācet || 109 || prakāraiṣvagnidagdheṣu prākareṣvagnidagdheṣu tatrasthapariṣadgaṇān| saṃsnāpyaiva samabhyarcya teṣāṃ mantraṃ savairūṣṇavam || 110 || caturvedādimantrāṃśca hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet| devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya havissamyaṅnivedayet || 111 || dāramasaṅgahakāle tu viparītaṃ bhavedyati| yājamāno gurūḥ snātvā tatrābjāgniṃ prakalpya ca || 112 || juhuyādrātrisūktantu śrīsūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca gṛhṇīyātpūrvavatpavunaḥ || 113 || śūlasthāpanahīne śūlasaṃsthāpane hīne samāpte sati mandire| bhavetpiśācāvāsaḥ sa vāstuhomaṃ yajetpunaḥ || 114 || pauṇḍarīke tu tanmadhye mahāśāntiṃ juhoti ca| hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādīn datvā karmaṃ samārabhet || 115 || ekamāse bhavedevaṃ dvimāse dviguṇaṃ bhavet| evaṃ saṃvardhayetprājño yāvatsaṃvatsarāvadhi || 116 || saṃvatsare'pyatīte tu mahāśāntiṃ juhoti ca| hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādīn datvā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 117 || evamādyeṣṭakādīnāṃ hutvā tattanmanuṃ smaran| tattanmantrajapaṃ kṛtvā śūlaṃ saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ || 118 || māsamekaṃ mahāśāntiṃ dvādaśābdātpaṃra yajet| karṣaṇādīni karmāṇi kuryātsarvāṇi pūrvavat || 119 || dhruvaberakriyāhīne śūle saṃsthāpite yadi| juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgnau viṣṇusūktamanusmaran || 120 || vicchinnañcaiva hutvā tu mindāhutyā ca hūyatām| hutvā tu saptasamidho deveśamanumānya ca || 121 || bhūmiñca gurave datvā tattatkarma samācaret| evaṃ māse tu samproktaṃ dvitīye dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 122 || vardhayedevamevaitat yāvatsaṃvatsarādhi| saṃvatsare'pyatīte tu pauṇḍarīkañca kārayet || 123 || kuryādāhavanīyādīn caturdikṣu yathākramam| āghārānte tu hotavye sahasrāhutivaiṣṇave || 124 || viṣṇusūktañca juhuyāttattaddhome śatāṣṭakam| digdaivatyañca hutvā tu dakṣiṇāñca dadettathā || 125 || viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāñca svaśaktitaḥ| dvitīye dviguṇañcaiva vardhayedvādaśāvadhi || 126 || dvādaśādve vyatīte tu karṣaṇādīni kārayet| pauṇḍarīke tu kūṣmāṇḍaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam || 127 || pāramātmikamīṅkārānaṅgahomaṃ tataḥ param| pauruṣaṃ viṣṇusūktañca hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 128 || pañcaniṣkasuvarṇañca dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 129 || kavāṭabodhikāsthūṇāsūttare deṣasaṃyute| vṛddhau pramāṇahīne ca jīrṇe dagdhe ca taṃ tyajet || 130 || anyatpramāṇasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhītvā yojayetpunaḥ| 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' dibhiḥ prokṣya juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ śatam || 131 || bhuvaṅge ca pataṅge ca kavāṭe stamṛbhayordvayoḥ| dhātrādīn ṣaṭ samāvāhya vidhinaiva samarcayet || 132 || anyālayopayuktāśca anyārtha svīkṛtāśya yāḥ| hutāśanaparītāśca tyājyā dāruśileṣṭakāḥ || 133 || vimānaṃ navadhā mārge yanmārgeṇa prakalpitam| kārayedhdruvaberantu tanmārgeṇādhikena vā || 134 || tato hīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ kautukāditrayaṃ tathā| ālayasya viparyāse tathā beraviparyaye || 235 || śūladāruviparyāse kalpanādiviparyaye| brāhmañca viṣṇusūktañca gāruḍaṃ saumyameva ca || 136 || prājāpatyañca raudrañca sahasraṃ juhuyātkramāt| pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa kārayettadvidhānataḥ || 137 || vimānādīnāṃ śraiṣṭyam ālayaṃ gopurañcaiva pratimā pīṭhameva ca| śarīrameva devasya smṛtametacctuṣṭayam || 138 || jīrṇodvāravicāraḥ ālaye maṇḍape vā'pi parivārālaye tathā| prākāre gopure pīṭhe pacanālaya eva vā || 139 || iṣṭakānāṃ tu prakṣepe tathā varṇānulepane| ekadvimāse kuyāccet navakarmādikaṃ tathā || 140 || taddoṣantu vyapohyaiva sarveṣāntu salakṣaṇam| yathāsaundaryamārgeṇa navakarma samācaret || 141 || samāpte'hri ca pūvahiṇe'pyālayasyottare tathā| vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā || 142 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya puṇyāhamapi vācayet| snapanoktakrameṇaiva vidhinā snāpayedbudhaḥ || 143 || ālayāddakṣiṇe caiva aupāsanavidhānataḥ| kuṇḍaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā prajvālyāgniṃ samantrakam || 144 || taddaivatyañca hutvā tu pariṣanmantrasaṃyutam| aṅgahomaṃ tato hutvā pāramātmikasaṃyutam || 145 || īṅkārādīṃstato hutvā aṣṭāśītyāhutiṃ yajet| vaiṣṇavaṃ tatrajuhuyānmahāvyāhṛtisaṃyutam || 146 || sahasrāhutiñca juhuyātsarveṣāmeva kārayet| tāṃstān devān pratiṣṭhāpya pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇa vai || 147 || antahomaṃ tato hutvā deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca| mahāviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā deveśāya nivedayet || 148 || śilādārvomuṃkhaṃ pārśveṃ pṛṣṭhamūrdhvamadhastathā| jñātvā kuryādviparyāsāddevarūpaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi || 149 || sthāpitaṃ cettadābhicārikamucyate| rājāṣṭravināśaḥ syāt prajāpīḍā bhayaṃ mṛtiḥ || 140 || taddoṣaśamanārthāya kṣipraṃ śāntiñca kārayet| ālayasyottare kuryātpauṇḍarīkaṃ salakṣaṇam || 151 || juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūkta 'mato devā'di vaiṣṇavam| īṅkārādyaṅgahomañca pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam || 152 || jayābhyātānasaṃyuktaṃ pariṣanmantrasaṃyutam| pūrvavadvidhinā kṛtvā sthāpayettadvicakṣaṇaḥ || 153 || aṅgavaikalye bāhuprakoṣṭhahastorujaṅghāpādataleṣu ca| pārśvādhaḥkaṭidaṇḍeṣu na hīnaṃ nādhikaṃ tathā || 154 || aṅgopāṅgeṣu sarvatra hīne caivāṅgule tu tat| hemnā vā rajitenātha tāmreṇaivātha pūrvavat || 155 || sthāpayedvyatyayenaiva śūlaṃ yadi vinaśyati| ālayasyotare pārśve pūrvoktaṃ homamācaret || 156 || hutvā puruṣasūktañca dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| gṛhītvā vidhivacchūlaṃ pūrvavatsthāpayetkramāt || 157 || dūṣitā mūttikā cettu śvakākapaśuvānaraiḥ| mūṣikābhiḥ kukkuṭairvā tyaktvānyāṃ vidhinā haret || 158 || juhuyādbhūmidaivatyaṃ pāramātmikasaṃyutam| īṅkārādīṃścakūṣmāṇḍān saṃskuryācca punarmṛdam || 159 || mṛdaḥsnehasya cūrṇasya kaṣāyasyauṣadhasya ca| nyūne saṃskārahīne ca prayogasya viparyaye || 160 || rajjubandhe'ṣṭabandhe ca śarkarālepane tathā| nyūne saṃskārahīne ca prayogasya viparyaye || 161 || vaiṣṇavaṃ cāruṣañcaiva pāñcabhautikameva ca| brāhmamaindraṃ trayastriṃśaddevatābhyaśca hūyate || 162 || pūrvoktena vidhānena tattatkarma samācaret| varṇavyatikrame hutvā prājāpatyaṃ sapauruṣam || 163 || mṛṇmayaṃ nārdhacitram ardhacitraṃ na kurvīta mṛṇmayaṃ lohajaṃ tathā| sthāpitañca visṛjyānyat beraṃ saṅgṛhya yatnataḥ || 164 || padmāgnau brahmasūktañca vaiṣṇa 'vā śrāvi' tādikam| hutvā mindāhutī viprān bhojayitvā tataḥ param || 165 || pūrvoktena vidhānena sthāpayediti śāsanam| śilāmaṇibimbe śilājaṃ maṇijaṃ bimbamardhacitraṃ na doṣakṛt || 166 || śailajaṃ dhruvaberantu varṇayuktantu kārayet| dhruvaberārcanaṃ cettu varṇayuktaṃ na kārayet || 167 || brahmasthānārcanārhaṃ yat sthāpanaṃ taddhruvārcanam| daiviṃke mānuṣe caiva sthāpayecca viśeṣataḥ || 168 || ekaberārcanañcaitat varṇayuktaṃ na doṣakṛt| nyūnādhikyaviṣayaḥ kimidaṃ parimāṇena kāraṇaṃ yacca vai viduḥ || 169 || yavaṃ yavatrayaṃ cāpi ardhāṅgulamathāpi vā| ekena vā'tha pādābhyāṃ nyūnādhikye na doṣakṛt || 170 || bimbasya vastramābharaṇaṃ padmaṃ kirīṭaṃ śaṅkhacakrakau| upavītaṃ pralambañca śrīvatsaṃ kuṇḍanaladvayam || 171 || evamādyaissamāyuktaṃ bimbaṃ karyādviśeṣataḥ| etairhīṃnaṃ yadi bhavetpunaretaissamāyutam || 172 || kārayitvaiva juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmasaṃyutam| aindrañca viṣṇusūktañca sauraṃ saumyañca pauruṣam || 173 || brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu vidhinā sthāpayedbudhaḥ| beraṃ kṛtrimavarṇena yojayeccetpramādataḥ || 174 || kṣālayitvāṃ pramārjyaiva viśoṣya ca yathāvidhi| pauṇḍarīkāgnikuṇḍe tu sūktaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ yajet || 175 || brāhmañca viṣṇusūktañca vaiṣṇavañca jayādibhiḥ| tasyānurūpaṃ varṇañca yojayettadvidhānataḥ || 176 || akṣimocanahīne ca kālātīte pramādataḥ| ṣaṇmaṇḍalādhidaivatyaṃ 'yaddevādi' tataḥ param || 177 || 'īṅkārādī' stato hutvā pāramātmikameva ca| aṣṭāśītiṃ tato hutvā kārayedakṣimocanam || 178 || krūragrahāṇāmudaye tvajñānātkriyate yadi| kṣālayitvā tato hutvā prāyaścittañca pūrvavat || 179 || pūrvavadvidhinā samyagakṣimocanamācaret| karṣaṇādīnāṃ sāmānya prāyaścittam karṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāntaṃ nyūne hīne viparyaye || 180 || juhuyātpauṇḍarīkāgnau sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe| 'yaddevādīṃ' stato hutvā pāramātmikameva ca || 181 || 'īṅkārādī' śca juhuyādaṣṭāśītimataḥ param| prājāpatyañca saumyañca aindramāgneyameva ca || 182 || sauraṃ saumyañca juhuyādaṅgahomañca vaiṣṇavam| mahāvyāhṛtibhirhutvā brāhmaṇānbhojayetpunaḥ || 183 || vācayitvā tu puṇyāhaṃ svastighoṣañca kārayet| devakāryeṣu praṇyāhaviśeṣaḥ daivikeṣu tu sarveṣu bhūparīkṣādikarmasu || 184 || puṇyāhe vihite samyak, yatpuṇya' miti ca bruvan| 'puṇyāhaṃ svastimṛddhi' ñca vācayitvā tridhātridhā || 185 || 'svasti na-ṛddhyāssme' ti vācayitvāntarāntarā| 'āpo hiraṇya pavamānaiḥ' prokṣayitvā tataḥ param || 186 || dakṣiṇādānādāne ca sūtroktavidhinā caret| gavādidakṣiṇāṃ datvā paścātkarma samācaret || 187 || hīnakriyāsu sarvāsu prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam| anuktadavyakalpite bere iṣṭakābhissudhābhirvākaṇṭakādyairnapuṃsakaiḥ || 188 || anyaiśca kāṣṭhaivṛrkṣairvā'pyanyairdūṣitadārubhiḥ| kālāyasaiśca pāṣāṇaiḥ cūrṇairvā'pi samāyutaiḥ || 189 || saṃyukte tu kṛte bere kṛte pakve tu mṛṇmaye| paiśācaiścāsurairdravyairatiriktamṛdā'thavā || 190 || dravyairasaṃskṛtairvāpi dhruvabere prakalpite| aśūle rajjumṛdvastraśarkarādāvamānake || 191 || kuśe sthūle'tijīrṇe ca vṛddhau vā'nuktavarṇake| sudhayaiva kṛte bere tathaiveṣṭakayā kṛte || 192 || kalpite'nuktadravyeṇa kṛtrimābharaṇānvite| ityādidoṣasaṃyukte bere sarva vinaśyati || 193 || sthāpayeccetadajñānāt yajamāno vinaśyati| tacchāntiḥ tacchāntiḥ pauṇḍarīkāgnāvālayasyottare kṛte || 194 || pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṣṭāśītyaṅgahomakam| brahmasūktasamāyuktaṃ śrīsūktena samanvitam || 195 || durgāsūktañca juhuyādviṣṇusūktamataḥ param| juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viśvajitsūktameva ca || 196 || prājāpatyañca raudrañca brāhmamāgneyameva ca| sauraṃ saumyasamāyuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyāyātpunaḥ || 197 || brāhṛmaṇān bhojayitvā tu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya sadoṣamapahāya ca || 198 || salakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sthāpayetvūrvatkramāt| punarjaurṇavimānādikathanam tadvimānagalasthāne pādavargasya madhyame || 199 || kārayedvihitāṃ mūrtiṃ sudhayeṣṭakayā'thavā| mṛcchūlaśarkarārajjavustre hīne'pramāṇake || 200 || kṛte kṛtrimavarṇena doṣaiḥ kārśyādibhiryute| na doṣadā iti proktā yadi te śilayā kṛtāḥ || 201 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannān varṇahīnān prakalpayet| śilāsaṅgahavarja bimbe kṛte akṛtvā kalpite bere śilāsaṅgahaṇakriyām || 201 || pauṇḍarīke mahāśāntiṃ ekāhaṃ juhuyātpunaḥ| śilāgrahaṇahomañca hutvā mantraṃ spṛśan japet || 203 || ajñānātsthāpitañcaitat evaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 204 || śīghraṃ saṃsthāpayedveraṃ nirdoṣaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam| na sthāpayati cenmohādādhivyādhyādyupadravaiḥ || 205 || kṣutpipāsādibhiścaiva sa deśaḥ pīḍyate bhṛśam| tasmāddhutvā mahāśāntiṃ bhojayitvā dvijottamān || 206 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| anuktakāle bimbe sthāpite ārdrādyanuktanakṣatre vāre rāśau ca nindite || 207 || ulkāgnyaśanipāte ca digdāhe pāṃsulohite| varṣadhārātipāte ca candrasūryoparāgayoḥ || 208 || caityavṛkṣanipāte ca bhūmikampadine tathā| doṣuyakte ca nakṣatre śarvaryāṃ vā tathaiva ca || 209 || sthāpitaṃ cettadajñānāt pūrvavadhomamācaret| sahasrāhutimiṣṭvaiva sahasrañcaiva vaiṣṇav || 210 || pariṣaddevatānāñca tattanmantraiśca hūyate| yathoktaṃ sthāpayitvaiva śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 211 || akṛtvā bhūparīkṣādikriyāssarvāḥ pramādataḥ| anuktamāsanakṣatrathivāsararāśiṣu || 212 || rātrāvavidhikaṃ mohādajñānātsthāpite yadi| māsaṃ pakṣantu saptāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ triyahantu vā || 213 || trikālaṃ pauṇḍarīkāgnau mahāśāntiṃ juhoti vai| tattanmantrajapaṃ kṛtvā bhūparīkṣādikarmaṇām || 214 || pūrvoktena prakāreṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ panarācaret| ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛṃguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre bhūparīkṣādiprāyaścittavidhirnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<21> oṃ ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ calitasthāpanam atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa calitasthāpanakramam| pīṭhātpracalitaṃ bimbaṃ sāpāyasthalamāśrim || 1 || anyasthale nadītīre grāmā dvahiravāstukam| mahāpathasthaṃ yadveramarcāhīnaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 || jīrṇālayagataṃ bimbaṃ cirakālamanarcitam| asthānasthāpitaṃ beraṃ calitañca pramādataḥ || 3 || anyālayagataṃ bimbamantyajātibhirāvṛtam| pratilomanivāsathāṃ śūnyamūlālayasthitam || 4 || cālayitvā vidhānena yāne vā śakaṭe'pi vā| āropya susthalaṃ nītvā kārayedālayaṃ mahat || 5 || prāsādaṃ gopuraṃ vā'pi vimānaṃ parikalpayet| aśakṛtaścedyathālābhaṃ garbhālayamathāpi vā || 6 || tasmin tadveramāsthāpya pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| yaḥ karoti mahāviṣṇoranyatra sthāpanaṃ mahat || 7 || vyādhayastasaya naśyanti grahapīḍādyupadravāḥ| durnimittāni draḥsvapnacoraśatrubhayādayaḥ || 8 || upadravāstathā'nye ca praṇaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || kautukādiniṣkṛtiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kautukādiṣu niṣkṛtim| kṛtvā saṅkīrṇalohena lohenāvihitena vā || 10 || kātukaṃ sthāpayeccettu kṣipraṃ tadapahāya ca padmāgnau pariṣanmantrān sūkte pauruṣavaiṣṇave || 11 || śrībrahmarudrasūktāni vyāhṛtyantaṃ hunet pṛthak| dakṣiṇāntu tato dadyādbuhmaṇānapi bhojayet || 12 || dhruvakautukayauḥ sārūpyam yadākāraṃ dhruvaṃ kuryāttadākārantu kautukam || 13 || āsīnaṃ vā sthitaṃ vā'pi śayānaṃ naiva kautukam| sthānake sthānakaṃ proktamāsapane sthānakāsane || 14 || āsīnaṃ sthānakaṃ vā'pi śayāne parikalpayet| sthāpitaṃ viparītaṃ cet trayastriṃśadgaṇān yajet || 15 || vaidhnaṃ sauraṃ gāruḍañca śāntiṃ vai pāñcabhautikam| durgāsūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ sūktaṃ tatpauruṣaṃ yajet || 16 || brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu puṇyāhamapi vācayet| yathoktaṃ kautukaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāmācaretpunaḥ || 17 || avatāraviṣaye paurāṇikapradeśeṣu ca viśeṣaḥ yatheṣṭaṃ kārayedbupamiti provāca pūrvajaḥ || 18 || paurāṇikeṣu sthāneṣu yathāpūrvaṃ tathā caret| anyathā tuna kartavyaṃ yadi kuryādvinaśyati || 19 || tacchāntyai pauṇḍarīkāgnau sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe| hutvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā yathāpūrva tathā caret || 20 || pūrvamāgneyabimbañca saumyena sthāpitaṃ yadi| tadverajīrṇoddhāre'pi kuryātpūrvavadeva hi || 21 || suvarṇādanyalohena miśralohena kautukam| sthāpitañcenmahādoṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || ālayāddakṣiṇe'bjāgnau brāhmaṃ saurañca saumyakam| āgneyaṃ gāruḍaṃ hutvā sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe || 23 || īṅkārā' rdīstato hutvā tadvimbamapahāya ca| uktalohena kṛtvā tu vidhinā sthāpayetpunaḥ || 24 || pratiṣṭhāpyārccamānantu lohajaṃ kautukaṃ śubham| tyaktvā'nyatthāpayecchettadābhicārikamucyate || 25 || digdaivatṛyaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥ param| śrīsūktañcaiva juhūyāddurgāsūktaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 26 || aṅgahomaṃ tato hutvā viśvajitsūktameva ca| pūrvaṃ yadvimṛbamādāya sthāpayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ || 27 || tatraivānyannavaṃ beraṃ sthāpayitvā ca laukikam| yathālābhopacāraistu pūjayediti śāsanam || 28 || vivarṇe sphuṭite rūkṣe suṣire jarjharānvite| varjite lakṣaṇaiścāpi sthāpite sati kautuke || 29 || anyadvimbaṃ samādāya sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe| vaiṣṇavañcaiva kūṣmāṇḍaṃ brāhmamaindrañca vāyavam || 30 || gāruḍañca sakṛddhutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam| mahāvyāhṛtibhirhutvā pūrvavatsthāpayetpunaḥ || 31 || pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtaṃ beraṃ tyaktvānyatsthāpayedyadi| ālayasyottare'bjāgnau viṣṇusūktaṃ juhoti ca || 32 || daurgañca pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ brahmasūktaṃ yajetpunaḥ| rudrasūktaṃ tato hutvā punarāhavanīyake || 33 || vaiṣṇava vyāhṛtīścāpi mahāvyāhṛtisaṃyutam| hutvā sāṣṭaśataṃ beraṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ || 34 || tato'nyatra navaṃ beraṃ sthāpayitvā samarcayet| anyālayārtha vā dadyādyācitaṃ cenmahatphalam || 35 || arcārahitaberadoṣaḥ nirduṣṭaberasya tyāganiṣedhaḥ beramarcāvihīnañcetsarvanāśakaraṃ bhavet| nirdoṣaṃ lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ na tyājyamiti śāsanam || 36 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ kevalamuktidam| śaṅkhacakradharaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 37 || śaṅkhacakragadādharaṃ pūrvavadarcitam| punaśca beranirmāṇe tattathaiva prakalpayet || 38 || kuryāttasyāpi saumyena pratiṣṭhāmarcanādikam| madhūcchiṣṭakriyāhīne madhūcchiṣṭakriyāhīne lohabere kṛte sati || 39 || brāhmañca sauraṃ saumyañca sārasvatasamanvitam| prājāpatyaṃ tathā''gneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīrapi || 40 || hutvā viprāṃśca sampūjya dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadet| śilāviparyāse puṃrūpaṃ puṃśilābhiśca strīrūpaṃ śilaṃyā striyā || 41 || striyā napuṃsakenātha puṃrūpantu kṛtaṃ yadi| ābhicārikamityuktaṃ tena sarva vinaśyati || 42 || sthāpitañcet parityajya beramanyatsamāharet| napuṃsakena puṃsā vā devīberaṃ kṛtaṃ tyajet || 43 || yathoktaśilayā beramāhṛtyānyadvidhānataḥ| ṣaḍagnīn sādhayitvā tu pariṣicya ca pāvakam || 44 || pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṣṭāśītiṃ jayādibhiḥ| rātrisūktañca juhuyādviśvajitsūktameva ca || 45 || brahṛmendraviṣṇusūktāṃśca narasūktaṃ saraudrakam| dūrgāsūktañca sarveṣu śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 46 || padmahomañca juhuyātpāñcabhautikasaṃyutam| puṇyāhaṃ vācayedviprān bhojayitvā tataḥ param || 47 || hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādīn datvā tatra mudānvitaḥ| vastrottarīyābharaṇairācārya pūjayetpunaḥ || 48 || evaṃ hutvā mahāśāntiṃ tathā sthāpanamācaret| śilābhede ca doṣeṣu sarveṣveṣu vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 49 || devaṃ devyau ca kuryācce ddivaberañcaikavastunā| anyathā yadi tatrāpi prāyaścittañca pūrvavat || 50|| pratiṣṭhite dhruve anyatra sthāpite anyatra sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ dhruvaberaṃ tataḥ param || 51 || ādāyānyatra na sthāpyaṃ sthāpitaṃ cetpramādataḥ| mahāśāntiṃ tato hutvā bimbamādāya vai tataḥ || 52 || pūrvasminnālaye samyak sthāpayitvā samarcayet| avidhinā sthāpite bimbe avidhi kama lakṣaṇyamayuktañcāprayojakam || 53 || virūpaṃ vā vivarṇa vā'pyanyadoṣeṇa saṃyutam| tyaktvānyadvidhinā kṛtvā lakṣaṇena samanvitam || 54 || ladālaye pratiṣṭhāpya mahāśāntiśca hūyate| ālayāddakṣiṇe'bajāgnau aṅgahomassuhūyatām || 55 || tattaddaivatyasaṃyuktaṃ pariṣanmantrasaṃyutam| vyāhṛtirviṣṇusūktañca sūktaṃ brāhmañca pauruṣam || 56 || vaiṣṇavaṃ padmahomaśca hotavyaṃ pāramātmikam| hutvaiva dakṣiṇāṃ datvā sthāpanaṃ punarācaret || 57 || yatra kartṛsmṛtistatra vidhireṣa pravartate| divyādisthale viśeṣaḥ daivike cārṣike kṣetre yathāpūrva tathā caret || 58 || avidhikamalakṣaṇyamapramāṇaṃ na doṣakṛt| tasmātsarvaprayatnena yathāpūrva tathā caret || 59 || anyathā cenmahādoṣa iti pūrvajaśāsanam| kautukaberasyānyatra sthāpane ekasminnalaye bimbaṃ kautukaṃ sthāpitaṃ tu yat || 60 || anyatra sthāpitaṃ cettu padmāgnāvālayottare| savaiṣṇavaṃ taddaivatyaṃ cariṣamanntrasaṃyutam || 61 || brahmasūktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ pāramātmikameva ca| 'īṅkārādī' stathāṣṭāśītyaṅgahomaṃ tataḥ param || 62 || rātrisūktañca juhuyādviśvajitsūktameva ca| ādāya pūrvavatsthāne sthāpayetsarvayatnataḥ || 63 || paracakrabhayādiṣa kartavyakramaḥ paracakrabhayodrekādathayā corapīḍayā| grāmālayavināśo tu janasañcāravarjite || 64 || bālālayaprakāreṇa homaṃ hutvā yathāvidhi| dhruvaberagatāṃ śaktiṃ jaṅgameṣu niveśya ca || 65 || nirbhayānyālayaṃ nītvā pūjayeccenmahāphalam| brāhmaṇaireva sarvāṇi tāni berāṇi vāhayet || 66 || nityāgnikuṇḍamāsādya pariṣicya ca pāvakam| ājyena sājyacaruṇā śāntihomaṃ juhoti ca || 67 || samidhyātmani vā''ropya nityāgniñca yathāvidhi| praveśya nirbhayaṃ deśaṃ tatra saumyā'laye punaḥ || 68 || āgneyamandire vā'pi yatīnāmāśrameṣu ca| saumyamārgānyadevānāmālayeṣu maṭheṣu vā || 69 || gṛheṣu vā gṛhasthānāmupakāryāsu vā punaḥ| eteṣvekaṃ praveśyaiva pūrvālābhe tathottare || 70 || saumyālayānyadeśeṣu vāstuhomāvasānake| tatassarvāṇi bimbāni śuddhaudairabhiṣecayet || 71 || vinā pradhānasthānañca parivārālayaṃ tathā| ramaṇīyapradeśeṣu vistīrṇeṣu niveśayet || 72 || yathāpūrvamukhaṃ vā'tha vistīrṇābhimukhantu vā| pratiṣṭhāpya yathālābhaṃ nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 73 || tasyaiva paritassarvaparivārān samarcayet| tāṃ homakāle samidhaṃ laukikāgnau nidhāya ca || 74 || hutvā homāvasāne'nyasamidhyāropayetpunaḥ| athavā pūrvavatkuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā'thā'trāpi pūrvavat || 75 ||
