rakṣannagnimavicchinnaṃ nityahomaṃ samācaret| nityayātrotsavenāpi vinā varṣotsavena ca || 76 || nityainaimittikeranyairyathālābhaṃ samarcayet| mūlālayārcanaṃ yāvadyuktaṃ tāvattu tatra vai || 77 || nityamevaṃ yathālābhamarcayediti śāsanam| bhaye tatra vimukte tamagnimāropya pūrvavat || 78 || pūrvālaye tu bimbāni samānīya ca pūrvavat| vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā || 79 || pañcagavyokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā mahāśāntiṃ juhoti ca| tāṃ lokikāgnau samidhaṃ nidhāyādhāramācaret || 80 || devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya rātripūjāvasānake| autsavārcāgatāṃ śaktiṃ kautuke tu niveśayet || 81 || pūrvavatsādhite kumbhe samāvāhya tu kautukāt| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 82 || sabhyañca pauṇḍarīkañca dvāvagnī iti kecana| kuryānnityāgniviccheda pañcāgnīneva pūrvavat || 83 || hautrakarmāvasāne tu cā'vāhya pariṣadṇān| tāneva parite'bhyarcya tattanmantrāṃ juhoti ca || 84 || mūlālayarcane avicchinne viśeṣaḥ mūlālaye dhruve nityamavicchinnārcane sati || 85 || tattadvimbagatāṃ śaktiṃ dhruve samyaṅniveśya ca| tasmādāvāhayedvimbe sarvamanyatsamaṃ bhavet || 86 || evaṃ kartumaśaktaśceddhbuvapūjāṃ samācaret| bhayarakṣārthaniṣkṛtiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhayarakṣārthaniṣkṛtim || 87 || coraśatrubhaye vā'tha paracakrabhaye'thavā| rakṣārthaṃ kautukādīnāṃ snāpanautsavaberayoḥ || 88 || anyalaukikabimbānāṃ prādurbhāvagaṇasya ca| jaṅgamāḥ pratimāścaiva bhūmiguptikriyocitāḥ || 89 || gupte caiva śucau deśe'pyavaṭaṃ khānayedbudhaḥ| sikatāstatra nikṣipya mahīdevīṃ samarcayet || 90 || 'āpo hi' ṣṭheti mantreṇa samprokṣya ca yathāvidhi| ācāryo'pyarcako vā'pi yajamānayutastathā || 91 || devāgāraṃ praviśyaiva bhaktaissārdhaṃ praṇamya ca| 'yāvatkālaṃ bhayaṃ mābhūttāvatṛkālaṃ mahāprabho || 92 || atre deśe śriyā bhūmyā vasa tvaṃ vai janārdana'| iti mantreṇa deveśamanumānya yathāvidhi || 93 || kautukādiṣu bimbeṣu tathā pāriṣadeṣu ca| āhitāṃ śaktimādāya dhruve cāropayedbudhaḥ || 94 || 'paraṃ raṃhe' ti mantreṇa devamādāya yatnataḥ| 'pratadviṣṇu stava' teti devaṃ sannamya cādarāt || 95 || 'yadvaiṣṇava' miti procya prākrchiraśśāyayettathā| avaṭaṃ sikatābhiśca mṛttikābhiśca pūrayet || 96 || sudṛḍhaṃ kārayetpaścādālayāntaḥ praviśya ca| devadevaṃ praṇamyaiva jīvasthāne ca sannyaset || 97 || kūrcaṃ tatra samabhyarcya nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caret| dhruvaberāttathā śaktiṃ kūrce cā'vāhya pūjayet || 98 || tatrāpi bhayasandehe vidhnite cāpi pūjane| arcakastvarito gatvā devaṃ dhyātvā samāhitaḥ || 99 || 'āyātu bhagavāni' ti ca 'yāte agna' iti bruvan| berasthāṃ śaktimagniñca svātmanyāropya śīghrataḥ || 100 || japan śakunasūktantu guptaṃ deśaṃ samāśrayet| yathāsukhaṃ tathā gacdetpramādarahitaṃ sthalam || 101 || yadi syātsvarṇajaṃ bimbaṃ gṛhītvā saha gacchati| tatrā'vāhyārcayennityamutsavādīni kārayet || 102 || balyutsavābhyāṃ rahitaṃ nityaṃ nemittikaṃ tathā| abhyukṣaṇañca snapanaṃ yathā śaktiṃ ca kārayet || 103 || suvarṇabimbarahite kūrce sarvañca kārayet| vartamāne'rcanepyevamarcake vyādhipīḍite || 104 || śakyāvāhanataḥ pūrvamarcakaṃ mṛtisaṃśaye| tatkāle tvaritasso'pi svaputreṣu ca bhrātṛṣu || 105 || devaśaktiṃ tadagniñca samyagāropayebdbudhaḥ| putre bhātari bhaṣṭe'pi kurce cā'vāhya cādarāt || 106 || ārādhayedevameva bhayanirharaṇe punaḥ| kāle svasthe tathā deśe bimbānyutthāpya cādarāt || 107 || saṃśodhya cā'layaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyāhamapi vācayet| aspṛśyasparśane caiva vāstuhoñca kārayet || 108 || caṇḍālādyantyajātaiśca bimbe spṛṣṭe'thavā punaḥ| kṛtvā jalādhivāsādīn pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 109 || kālāpekṣāṃ na kurvīta kṛtvā vā'pyaṅkurārpaṇam| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagācaret || 110 || arcako hṛdgatāṃ śaktiṃ kumbhe cā'vāhayetkramāt| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 111 || nityārcanavidhānena nitṛyapūjāṃ samācaret| nityahomañca hutvā tu baliṃ tatra pradāpayet || 112 || autsavādiṣvlabdheṣu sarvaṃ kuryācca kautuke| snapane tatra samprāpte dhruve baddhvaiva kautukam || 113 || tasmātkūrce samāvāhya taddravyaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ caret| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva tathaivodvāsayetpunaḥ || 114 || kālotsavasya samprāptau dhvajamāropya pūrvavat| homañca balidānañca nityaṃ vidhivadācaret || 115 || cakravīśāmitān pātreṣvāvāhyā'bhyarcā caret| vidhināṃ balimārādhya pradakṣiṇamathā'caret || 116 || utsavānte baleśśaktiṃ dhruvabere niveśya ca| tasmātkūrce samāvāhya prabhūtañca nivedayet || 117 || dhruvabere samāropya dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ punaḥ| tatastīrthadine prātarutsave ca kṛte sati || 118 || niśācūrṇābhiṣekañca snapanaṃ kalaśairapi| kṛtvā tu kūrce devāgre snapanaṃ punarācaret || 119 || ārambhadivase kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya dhruvaberataḥ| dīpāddīpamivāvāhye tena kṛtvotsavaṃ punaḥ || 120 || tīrthānte snapanānte tu punarudvāsayeddhruve| kālotsave tu vicchinne prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 121 || sukāle bimbamuddhṛtya pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| sabhyābjakuṇḍe dve kṛtvā nityamagni praṇīya ca || 122 || punaḥpratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa surva kuryādyathāvidhi| kautukādiṣu gupteṣu vicchinne vā dhruvārcane || 123 || kṛtvā tu dhruvaberasya arcanāhīnaniṣkṛtim| tasmāttu kautukādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāmācaretpunaḥ || 124 || caṇḍālādyantyajasparśe prāyaścittaṃ tadīritam| hutvā śuddhiṃ panuḥ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 125 || aṅgahīnaṃ yadi bhavet dhruvaberaṃ tadeva hi| ayuktaṃ yadi coddhartu kautukasnāpanautsavāḥ || 126 || kṛtvā ca dāravaṃ bimbaṃ yācitaṃ bimbameva vā| bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya navakaraṇamācaret || 127 || mahāparitiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhīṃ punarācaret| bhinne ghaṭe yathākāśaṃ mahākāśe pralīyate || 128 || beranāśe tathā śaktirviśvasminneneva līyate | prākpratyagdakṣiṇādikṣu vidikṣu ca tathā''nate || 129 || kukṣicchidre tathā dīrghe pārśvahīne kaṭikṣaye| ūrūjaṅghākṣye caiva mukhaśoṣe tathaiva ca || 130 || makuṭe doṣasaṃyukte sarvopāṅgakṣaye tathā| pramāṇaparihīne ca pādagulphakṣye tathā || 131 || karṇanāsākṣaye cāpi kṣipraṃ śāntiñca kārayet| ālayāddakṣiṇe cāgnau juhuyātpāramātmikam || 132 || 'īṅkārādīṃ śca juhuyādaṣṭāśītyāhutiṃ tathā| taddaivatyañca juhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam || 133 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvaiva dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| tattallakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ || 134 || tattadukṛtapadādanyapadeṣu sthāpayedyadi| ūrdhvadṛṣṭyādidoṣeṣu ūrdhvaṣṭṛṣṭyāmadhodṛṣṭyāṃ tiryagdṛṣṭyāṃ tathaiva ca || 135 || asaumyakrūradṛṣṭyāñca prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| vaiṣṇavaṃ paścime'bjāgnau taddaivatyaṃ śatāṣṭakam || 136 || 'īṅkārādī' stu juhuyādaṣṭāśītimataḥ param| bhojayitvā tathā viprānācāryādīṃśca pūjayet || 137 || saṃsthāpyoktapade samyagvidhinā cārcayetpunaḥ| dhruvakautukapīṭhe dhruvakautukayoḥ pīṭhe mānahīne'dhike'pi ca || 138 || taddaivatyañca juhuyādaṣṭādhikasahasrakam| mantraiśca parivārāṇāṃ hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet || 139 || salakṣaṇaṃ tathā pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ| ratnanyāsavahīne tu pīṭhasaṅkhātakarmaṇi || 140 || cālayitvā tataḥ pīṭhācchāntihomāvasānake| satnanyāsaṃ tathā kṛtvā punassaṅghātamācaret || 141 || ratnanyāse kṛte padmasaṅghāte mantravarjite| śāntiṃ hutvā vidhānena tattanmantraṃ spṛśan japet || 142 || yadyāgneyavidhānena kevalaṃ śilpinā'thavā| kṛte tu padmasaṅdhāte saṃsrāpya kalaśaistathā || 143 || hutvā paścānmahāśāntiṃ tattanmantraṃ japettathā| tathaiva mūlabere tu sthāpite kevalasthale || 144 || devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya 'kṣama' sveti praṇamya ca| kumbhe devaṃ samāvāhya pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā salakṣaṇam || 145 || pīṭhe devaṃ samāropya śāntiṃ hutvā yathāvidhi| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ puṇyāhena ca śodhayet || 146 || pañcagavyādhivāsādīn kṛtvā saṃsnāpya pūrvavat| pratiṣṭoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 147 || navāhaṃ vā'tha saptāhaṃ triyahantu vā| devaṃ viśeṣato'bhyarcya 'kṣama' sveti praṇamya ca || 148 || brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| ityārṣo śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre kautuṃkaberaprāyaścittavidhirnāmaikaviṃśodhyāyaḥ ||
<22> yathoktaguṇahīnena guruṇā sthāpakādibhiḥ uktadoṣayutairvāpī sthāpite puruṣottame ॥
<23> oṃ trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ navīkaraṇam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi navīkaraṇamuttamam| prāsādāgopurādīnāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ tapodhanāḥ || 1 || varṇanāśe sudhāsphoṭe bhittibhede tathaiva ca| śileṣṭakādipatane śīghra karmedamācaret || 2 || ālayābhimukhe kṛtvā kuṇḍamaupāsanasya ca| nyakṣādīnāṃ caturṇāntu mantrān hutvā tu mūrtibhiḥ || 3 || devatānāṃ galasthāne sthāpitānāṃ viśeṣata| pādavargagatānāñca hutvā mantrānanukramāt || 4 || tadvimbāntargatāṃ śaktiṃ dhruvabere niveśya ca| prākārāśrayapīṭheṣu tattaddikṣu yathākramam || 5 || nyakṣādīṃśca samāvāhya daśakṛtvastu vaiṣṇavam| caturvedādimantrāṃśca hutvā cāgniṃ visṛjya ca || 6 || śileṣṭakāprakṣepādyairdṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi| sudhāvarṇānulepādīn pūrvavatpārikalpya ca || 7 || pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya vāstuhomassuhūyatām| abjāgnau vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe || 8 || vyāhṛtīraṅgahomañca pāramātmikasaṃyutam| 'īṅkārādī' śca juhuyādaṣṭāśītyāhutiṃ tathā || 9 || sahasrāhutiparyantaṃ yajettaddoṣaśāntaye| vimānasthāpanaproktaprakāreṇa yathāvidhi || 10 || saṃsthāpya tattadvimbādīn nyakṣādīṃścaturastathā| sarvāṇi cānyakarmāṇi kārayediti śāsanam || 11 || sarveṣāmeva devānāmālayeṣu tathaiva ca| nyakṣādayo vimāneśāḥ parivārālayeṣu ca || 12 || vimānapatanādau bālālayaḥ vimāne patine jīrṇe śīghraṃ bālālaye tataḥ| devadevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vimānaṃ kārayetpunaḥ || 13 || yatpramāṇaṃ yadākāraṃ yaddravyañca yadālayam| taddravyañca tadākāraṃ tatpramāṇañca kārayet || 14 || pauruṣañcettadutkṛṣṭapramāṇākṛtivastubhiḥ| athavā kārayetprājñaḥ pūrvanāśe yathocitam || 15 || prākārīdināśe prākāreṣu viśīrṇeṣu tatprākārādhidaivataiḥ| mantrairhutvā navīkṛtya vāstuhomaṃ yajetpunaḥ || 16 || parivārālaye jīrṇe nyakṣādīṃścaṃturastathā| tanmūlabere cāropya navīkṛtya yathāpurā || 17 || tatpratiṣṭhāprakāreṇa vimāne sthāpayetpunaḥ| gopureṣu viśīrṇeṣu taddavārādhipatīṃstathā || 18 || pīṭheṣu tattatpārśveṣu samāvāhyātutīrataḥ| tattanmantraiśca hutvā tu navīkṛtya yathāpurā || 19 || tadvārapālakāṃstatra sthāpayitvā samarcayet| maṇḍapādiṣu sarveṣu tattatproktādhidevatāḥ || 20 || dhruvabere niveśyaiva nīvakṛtya yathāpurā| samāvāhyādhidevāstān pūrvavatsthāpayeddharim || 21 || navakarmaṇi śuddhiḥ prāsādādiṣu sarveṣu navakarmāvasānake| sāmānyo vāstuhomaśca śuddhiḥ puṇyāha eva ca || 22 || navīkaraṇe kecana niyamāḥ ekaberavimānānāṃ pauruṣāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ| tathaivoddhṛtabimbānāṃ jīrṇānāntu punaḥ kṛtau || 23 || pūrvapramāṇādadhikaṃ yadi kuryānna doṣakṛt| padānuguṇamevaitat parito vardhayettathā || 24 || pūrva mṛdālayaścettadiṣṭakādyaiḥ prakalpayet| parito vardhayitvaiva kalpayedālayaṃ tathā || 25 || prākārāṇāntu jīrṇānāṃ punassandhānakarmaṇi| athavā mṛṇmayānāñca tathā vṛddhiṃ yadīcchati || 26 || parito vardhayedeva prācyudīcyorathāpi vā| yadyagre grāmavīthī syāttriṣu vā'nyeṣu vardhayet || 27 || śālānāṃ maṇḍapānāñca pārśvayoragratastathā| vṛddhiṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa prācyudīcyorathāpi vā || 28 || udīcyāmagrataścaiva vardhayetpacanālayam| ekatassaṅkaṭañcettu nadīsāgarāparvataiḥ || 29 || vardhayedanyapārśveṣu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā| dakṣiṇāparavṛddhiñca kṣayañcāpi na jātucit || 30 || prākāramaṇḍapādīnāṃ śālānāñca samācaret| parāṇamandireṣu niyamāḥ paurāṇikavimānānāṃ vṛddhiṃ vā'pi na kārayet || 31 || grāmāgrahāranagarapattanādyanukarmasu| agarbhadaivataṃ vāstu parito vardhayetsamam || 32 || naiva vinyāsabhedena yadi bhedo vinaśyati| vimānaṃ yena hastena pramitaṃ tena kārayet || 33 || prākāramaṇḍapādīni nādhikena kadācana| sthāpayeduttamaṃ beramālaye madhyame'dhame || 34 || anyathā yadi kurvīta rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati| tasmātsarvaprayatnena yathāvidhi samācaret || 35 || dhruvaberajīrṇoddhāraḥ vakṣyāmi dhruvaberasya jīrṇeddhāramataḥ param| jīrṇe chinne tathā bhinne spuṭite varṇasaṅkṣaye || 36 || bālālayamathā'gneyyāṃ yāmyanairaṛtayostathā| vāruṇyāṃ vā prakurvīta yathāvibhavavistaram || 37 || bālālayapratiṣṭhoktaprakāreṇa tataḥ param| bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya navīkaraṇamācaret || 38 || dṛśyate yatra doṣastu tatra saṃskāramācaret| varṇe vā'dhyanuvarṇe vā sphuṭitaṃ dṛśyate yadi || 39 || nipuṇaiśśilpibhiśśuddhaistadvarṇa tatra yojayet| paṭādūrdhvantu doṣaścettattatkuryāttu pūrvavat || 40 || doṣayukte paṭe vā'pi paṭaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohya ca| paṭamācchādya vidhinā kārayedupari kriyām || 41 || śūlordhve doṣayuktaścedāśūlaṃ śodhayettathā| mṛṇmaye dārave śaile śarkarālepanādikāḥ || 42 || kārayitvā kriyāssarvāḥ beraṃ samyakprakalpayet| śūle ca mṛṇmaye jīrṇe sarvamabdhau visṛjya ca || 43 || dārusaṅgahaṇaṃ kṛtvā śūlaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat| samudre dāravaṃ jīrṇaṃ tyaktvānyasthapayettathā || 44 || aṅgahīnaṃ tathā śailaṃ beraṃ prakṣipya toyadhau| śilāṃ gṛhītvā vidhinā kṛtvā berañca pūrvavat || 45 || saṃsthāpya vidhinā paścādberaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi| tāmrajasyāṅgahīnasya kautukoktavadācaret || 46 || punarbimbanirmāṇe niyamāḥ pūrvaṃ yenoddhṛtaṃ bimbaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ yadākṛti| taddravyeṇa tadākāraṃ tatpramāṇañca kārayet || 47 || pūrvantu pauruṣañcettu mukhyaṃ vā sthāpayetpunaḥ| mukhyapramāṇākārābhyāṃ kārayedvā'tha pauruṣe || 48 || bimbeṣu dravyabhedena taratamabhāvaḥ mṛddārūpalatāmreṣu pūrvātpūrvātparo varaḥ| sthānakādāsanaṃ tasmācchayanañca kramādvaram || 49 || pūrvantu śailajaṃ yatra tatra śailajameva vā| aśaktaḥ pūrvavatkartu sthānanāśabhayādiṣu || 50 || kālakṣepe'pyayuktena tu hetunā yena kenacit| gauṇamānākṛtidravyaiḥ kārayediti kecana || 51 || mūlanāśāt yathālābhaṃ gauṇaṃ vā'pi praśasyate| dhruvakautukamārgeṇa pade saṃsthāpya daivike || 52 || kṛtvā varṇānulepādīn pratiṣṭhāpyārcayetpunaḥ| kautukādiṣu sarveṣu naṣṭe sthāne tathaiva ca || 53 || śailañca dhruvaberañca dṛśyate yatra kutracit| aśaktaḥ pūrvavatkartuṃ sthānanāśabhayādiṣu || 54 || kṛtvā nayanamokṣaṃ tatsthāpayedvā dhruvārcanam| asatyāṃ nāśaśaṅkhāyāmaśakte'pi yathāpurā || 55 || kārayeta vidhānena gauṇenaiva prakalpayet| śithile dhruvapīṭhe tu kṛtvā bālālaya kṣaṇāt || 56 || śilpibhissudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ sthāpanamācaret| sthalanāśe ca ratnani susunnyasya tu pūrvavat || 57 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| bahuberapratiṣṭhā cedyadveraṃ doṣasaṃyutam || 58 || vastreṇāveṣṭya nirdoṣaṃ doṣaduṣṭasya tasya tu| saṃskāraṃ pūrvavatkuryāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || 59 || parivāreṣu duṣṭeṣu tattatpārśve tathaiva ca| kṛtvā bālālayaṃ hutvā tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam || 60 || pratiṣṭhāpya navīkṛtya punaḥ sthāpanamācaret| bahubhūmivimāneṣu doṣayuktaṃ talaṃ prati || 61 || bālāgāraṃ prakalpyaiva dvitīyāvaraṇe'thavā| prathamāvaraṇe vā'tha uktadeśe yathāvidhi || 62 || sadoṣatalabimbāni nirdoṣeṣu taleṣu vai| naiva saṃsthāpayenmohādyadi kuryādvinaśyati || 63 || śīghraṃ hutvā mahāśāntiṃ sthāpayettaruṇālaye| ūrdhvaṃ talaṃ samuddiśya paścime taruṇālaye || 64 || adhastalasya tatpūrve sthānaṃ samyakprakalpayet| pañcamūrtividhāne tu bālāgāraṃ yathāvidhi || 65 || tattanmūrti samuddiśya tattaddiśi ca kārayet| berāṇāṃ keṣāñcidekadravyaniyamaḥ berāṇi pañcamūrtīnāmekadravyeṇa kārayet || 66 || tathaiva pañcavīrāṇāṃ brahmaṇo garuṅasya ca| viparītaṃ yadi bhavettadgrāmayajamānayoḥ || 67 || bhavedāśu vināśāya viśeṣādrājarāṣṭrayoḥ| vālālayamakṛtvā na navīkaraṇam bālālayamakṛtvā tu navakarmācaredyati || 68 || ābhicārikamityuktaṃ tasya doṣasya śāntaye| navāhaṃ vā'tha saptāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ triyahantu vā || 69 || hutvā'bjāgnau mahāśāntiṃ sthāpayitvā samarcayet| ādityamaṇḍalātkumbhe samāvāhya samarcayet || 70 || anyeṣāmapi devānāmeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ| kautukādiṣu gupteṣu navīkaraṇaprakāraḥ kautukādiṣu gupteṣu jīrṇe tasmin dhruve sati || 71 || kumbhe śaktiṃ samāvāhya navīkaraṇamācaret| kumbhātkumbhe samāvāhya yajetparvaṇi parvaṇi || 72 || navakarmāvasāne tu dhruvaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat| tasmātkūrce samāvāhya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 73 || kautukābhāve suvarṇaśakale'rcanam sarvatra kautukābhāve suvarṇaśakalantu vā| kumbhe tu māsamekaṃ syāt ṣaṇmāsaṃ darpaṇe tathā || vatsarāntaṃ paṭe proktaṃ dārau dvādaśavatsaram| ata ūrdhvaṃ haristatra na rameta punastathā || arcāpīṭhe'thavā kūrca sannyasyāvāhya pūjayet || 74 || jīrṇaberārcanaṃ yattaddoṣāyaiva bhaviṣyati| tasmācchīghrantu vidhinā jīrṇādau kautukādike| kautuke tāmraje bimbe śailaje dāruve'thavā || 75 || jīrṇe chinne ca bhinne ca khaṇḍe vṛddhau tathaiva ca| hīnapramāṇe suṣire bimbaṃ tyājyantu tat tyajet || 76 || jīrṇe chinne ca bhinne ca khaṇḍe vṛddhau tathaiva ca| hīnapramāṇe suṣire bimbaṃ jyājyantu tat tyajet || 77 || vastreṇa bimbaṃ saṃveṣṭya tatprakṣipya jalāśaye| madhūcchiṣṭaprayogeṇa bimbaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 78 || pūrvavadvimbamāsādya vidhinā sthāpayetpunaḥ| kālāpekṣā na kartavyā śīghraṃ karmedamācaret || 79 || aṅgādisaṃjñā kaṇṭhodaraśirovakṣobāhukoṣṭhorupāṇayaḥ| kaṭijaṅghe mahāṅgāni netranāsauṣṭhatālavaḥ || 80 || karṇaścāṅgulayo'ṅgāni keśaromanakhādayaḥ| upāṅgānīti coktāni makuṭaṃ bhūṣaṇāmbare || 81 || śaṅkhacakre śiraścakraṃ pādapadmāyudhānyapi| pīṭhaṃ prabhā ca chatraṃ ca pratyaṅgāni vidurbudhāḥ || 82 || krīḍāyaṣṭiśca vaṃśaśca pratyaṅgaṃ kṛṣṇavigrahe| āṣāḍho vāmane cāpi pratyaṅgamabhidhīyate || 83 || hutvā śāntiṃ tyajedvimbamaṅgahīnantu kautukam| upāṅgahīne bimbasya tāmrajasyaiva bhaktitaḥ || 84 || kautukasaṃskāraprakāraḥ dhruve śaktiṃ samāropya sandhānaṃ tulyavastunā| hutvā puraṣasūktena viṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 85 || 'īṅkārādyai' śca juhuyādaṣṭāśītyā samāhitaḥ| rātrisūktena hutvaiva jayādyairjuhuyātpunaḥ || 86 || bimbaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettathā| sandhānayogyatākathanam pratyaṅge tu tathā hīne na tyajediti śāsanam || 87 || kirīṭe bhūṣaṇe vastre nakhe vā romakeśayoḥ| cakre śaṅkhe śiraścakra hīne sandhānamācaret || 88 || śailasyāyudhavicchede kuryātlohena vā''yudham| tāmrajasyāṅgasandhānaṃ kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 89 || bimbatyāge pratiprasavaḥ sauvarṇaṃ rājitaṃ bimbamaṅgahīnaṃ bhavedyadi| na tyajettulyalohena sandhāya sthāpayetkramāt || 90 || sandhāne nimittāntarāṇi pratyaṅge tu tathā hīne sandhānaṃ kārayetkramāt| tathā bimbe tu calite tathā pīṭhādviyojite || 91 || rekhāsuṣirayukte ca sandhānaṃ kārayeddṛḍham| vastrādiṣu ca cakreṣu chede bhede tathaiva ca || 92 || pūrvavatkārayettadvat tulyalohena yuktitaḥ| pūrvavacchāntihomānte punaḥ sthāpayati kramāt || 93 || bimbasya tāmrajasyāpi karṇanāsāṅgulīṣu ca| hīneṣvaṅgeṣu sandhānaṃ kuryādeva na saṃśayaḥ || 94 || upāṅge tasya hīne'pi śaijalaṃ dāravaṃ tyajet| ekadviyavamātre tu sphuṭite tatra tatra vai || 95 || tattadaṅgasamuttiṃ rekhāmātreṇa kalpayet| vṛddhaṃ pramāṇahīnañca jīrṇaṃ raukmañca rājitam || 96 || lohavattatsamāhṛtya śāntihomāvasānake| madhūṣchiṣṭavidhānena navīkaraṇamācare || 97 || akṣyunmeṣādikaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpayati kramāt| ratnajapratimā yā syādrūpamātraṃ samāharet || 98 || nirduṣṭabimbasya na cālanam arcyamāne tu nirdoṣe bimbe tatra viśeṣataḥ| lohagauravamuddiśya punarbimbaṃ na kārayet || 99 || yadi kuryāttadajñānādrājā rāṣṭrañca naśyati| jīrṇaṃ hīnādhikāṅgañca bimbaṃ tyaktvā yathāvidhi || 100 || śakto'dhikena dravyeṇa kārayeccettaduttamam| aṅgahānyādiyukte tu kautuke pūrvamarcite || 101 || dhruvabere samāropya tacchaktiṃ śīghrameva tu| yāvadvimbaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā sthāpayedvidhikovidaḥ || 102 || tāvatṛkautukapīṭhe tu snāpanaṃ bimbameva ca| autsavaṃ baliberaṃ vā sthāpayitvā'tha vai dhruvāt || 103 || āvāhya ca vidhānena nityamarcanamācaret| pūrvavatkautukaṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 104 || snāpanautsavabalyarcāḥ svasthāne sanniveśayet| kaitukabimbapratinidhitvena svarṇakūrcārādhanam snāpane cautsave hīne kūrcaṃ raukmantu tatra vai || 105 || nyasya devaṃ samāvāhya dhyāyan pūrvavadarcayet corāpahṛtabimbavicāraḥ corairvā śatrubhirvā'pi bimbaṃ tvapahṛtaṃ yadi || 106 || yāvadvimbaṃ punaḥ kuryāttāvatkālanatu tatra vai| bhaktyā suvarṇaśakale samāvāhya samarcayet || 107 || bimbaṃ tatpūrvavatkṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| tatra vikalpāḥ vinaiva devadevena devyāvapahṛte yadi || 108 || devyau te vidhinā kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāpurā| pūrvoktena vidhānena vivāhaṃ vidhinā caret || 109 || juhuyādyadi nityāgnau dhruvādāvahanaṃ yadi| na vivāhavidhiṃ kuryāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || 110 || devībhyāntu vinā tatra deveśe'pahṛte yadi| devyoranuguṇaṃ devaberaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 111 || dhruvādāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā nityamagniṃ praṇīya ca| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva kṛtvā nityamagniṃ praṇīya ca| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 112 || ta eva devyau devasya nānye devyau prakalpayet| tacchaktaiḥ pūrvasaṃskāraṃ na vivāhavidhiṃ caret || 113 || sthāpite'pi nave bere dṛṣṭe tvapahṛte punaḥ| samantraṃ laukikaṃ beraṃ sthāpayitvā samarcayet || 114 || anyathā yadi kurvīta rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati| dhruve sthite tu deveśe taddevyoraṅgahīnayoḥ || 115 || taddevyoḥ sthitayordeve hīnāṅge'pi tapodhanāḥ| tattadvimbagatāṃ śaktiṃ kumbhe samyaṅniveśya ca || 116 || bālālaye pratiṣṭhāpya kurvanvai nityapūjanam| deveśānuguṇaṃ devau devaṃ vā'nuguṇaṃ tayoḥ || 117 || pūrvamānākṛtidravyaiḥ kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetkramāt| pūrvapramāṇādadhikaṃ mukhyākārañca nācaret || 118 || kārayettulyalohena devyau naivādhikena ca| yadyadvimbantu nirduṣṭaṃ tattanna tyājyamucyate || 119 || yāgaśālāgnikuṇḍeṣu nityamagniṃ praṇīya ca| śaktimudvāsya tāmeva kumbhe samyaṅniveśya ca || 120 || pratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavatkuryādvivāhaṃ tatra nācaret| śaktau saṃskṛtapūrvāyāṃ na saṃskārāntaraṃ punaḥ || 121 || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ sthitāyāṃ puruṣākṛtau| strīberanāśe puruṣaberanāśo'thavā striyām || 122 || sāmānyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ punassandhānakarmaṇi| sandhānakartuḥ phalapraśaṃsā punassandhānakartuḥ syāttanmūlāddviguṇaṃ phalam || 123 || sarvān kāmānavāpnoti kīrtimān dhanavān bhavet| sarvapāpavinirmukto bhogān bhuṅkte mahītale || 124 || jaṅgameṣu ca gupteṣu paracakrabhayeṣu ca| yāvatkālaṃ taduddhāraḥ tāvatkālañca tatra vai || 125 || kūrce bhaktyā samāvāhya dhyātvā devaṃ samarcayet| uddhṛtya tāni bimbāni śuddhidravyeṇa śodhayet || 126 || kalaśaiḥ snāpayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram| mahāśānticca hutvā tu puṇyāhamapi vācayet || 127 || brāhṛmaṇān bhojayitvā tu śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadet| arcayeñca yathānyāyaṃ havissamyaṅnivedayet || 128 || jaṅgameṣu ca gupteṣu hīne ca sthāvarārcane| mahāśāntiñca hutvā tu tatkālānuguṇaṇaṃ punaḥ || 129 || punaḥ pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| arcyamānaṃ gṛhe beraṃ sundaraṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 130 || dhruvaberānurūpañced grāmasyānuguṇaṃ tathā| labdhaṃ cedautsavārthantu snāpanārthamathāpi vā || 131 || nityotsavārthaṃ vā tatra sthāpayitvā samarcayet| tadvimbasaṃsthitāṃ śaktiṃ niveśyādityamaṇḍale || 132 || dhruvāttasmintsamāvāhya pūrvavatsthāpayetsudhīḥ| tāmeva śaktimathavā kumbhe samyaṅniveśya ca || 133 || laukikaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya kumbhādāvāhya pūjayet| laukikasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ laukikāgnau juhoti vai || 134 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ samaṃ bhavet| rūpamicchanti ye devā ye na necchanti mandire || 135 || pīṭhakuṅyakavāṭādāvarcyante supratiṣṭhitāḥ| arcanāṅgeṣu pātreṣu yānādiṣvāsanādiṣu || 136 || vāpīkūpataṭakādiṣvāvāhya ciramarcitāḥ| navakarmaṇi te'rhanti bālāgārocitāḥ kriyāḥ || 137 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mantrato yaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ| taṃ sarvaṃ navakarmādau jīrṇoddhārakrameṇa vai || 138 || saṃskṛtya navakarmānte saṃskuryātpunareva vai| ādāya navavastūni pratiṣṭhāṃ vā samācaret || 139 || ityorṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre navīkaraṇaprāyaścittavidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<24> oṃ caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ arcanāyāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kavāṭoddhāṭane ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi arcanāhīnaniṣkṛtim| ādityasyodayātpūrva prātardevālayasya ca || 1 || sāyamastamayātpūrvaṃ madhyāhrādahri madhyame| kavāṭoddhāṭane hīne śīghramuddhāṭayettataḥ || 2 || nityāgnikuṇḍe chullyāṃ vā pariṣicya ca pāvakam| ājyena varuṇā saurairjuhuyāddavāradaivataiḥ || 3 || vaiṣṇavairapi ṣaṇmantraiḥ punaḥ karma samācaret| dravyasaṅgrahe nītañcedarcanādravyaṃ jalapuṣpādyamantrakam || 4 || ālaye vā'tha saṃskuryāttamanmantraṃ dviguṇaṃ japet| anyasūtribhirānītaṃ saṃskuryāttriguṇaṃ caret || 5 || gṛhṇīyāt brāhmaṇālābhe neyañcetkṣatriyādibhiḥ| śaṅkhacakrāṅkitabhujaiḥ pūrvālābhe tathottaraiḥ || 6 || caturvedādi ṣaṭkṛtvo japaṃ kuryātpunaḥ punaḥ| vāpayennakhakeśādīste ca parvaṇi parvaṇi || 7 || śuddhāmbaradharāḥ snātāḥ śuddhadantanakhāḥ tathā| dīpahīne sandhyādīpavihīne tu śrīdaivatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 8 || āgneyañca sakṛddhutvā dīpāṃśca dviguṇaṃ dadet| ajasradīpavicchede śatamaṣṭottara yajet || 9 || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ dīpaḥ priyatamo bhavet| śvetapaṅkajanālotthaissūtraiḥ kṛtvā tu vartikām || 10 || uttamaṃ dīpadānantu kāpilena ghṛtena vai| aṣṭāṅgulocchrayajvālo dīpa uttama ucyate || 11 || uktapaṅkajanālotthaiḥ sūtraiḥ kṛtvā tu vartikām| ṣaṅgulocchrayajvālo madhyamo gavyasarpiṣā || 12 || tailena kalpito dīpaḥ picatuvartiyuto'dhamaḥ| triyaṅgulocchrayajvālo yathālābhocchrayo'pi vā || 13 || karpūravartikāklṛpto dīpassyāduttamottamaḥ| mārjanādihīne mārjane ca tathā hīne hīne caivopalepane || 14 || 'āpo-hiraṇya-pavamānaiḥ' prokṣayitvopalepayet| nirmālyaśodhane hīne hīne cābhyukṣaṇe tathā || 15 || vaiṣṇavaṃ vaiṣvaksenañca vāruṇañca yajetpunaḥ| bimbābhiṣeke'śaktaśceddeveśamabhivādya ca || 16 || kuśodakaissamabhyukṣya pūrvavastraṃ visṛjya ca| anyena dhautavastreṇa deveśaṃ paridhāpayet || 17 || bimbābhiṣekahīne tu vaiṣṇavaṃ vāruṇaṃ yajet| puṣpanyāsahīne puṣpanyāsavihīne tu kālātīte punastadā || 18 || kṛtvaiva puṣmanyāsañca viṣṇugāyatriyā punaḥ| juhuyāddaśakṛtvastu nāmabhirjuhuyācchatam || 19 || anyadevārcanāhīne garbhālayagatān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān| samabhyarccāyeddevaṃ hīne teṣāmathārcane || 20 || dviguṇaṃ tān samabhyarcya tattanmatraṃ sakṛdyajet| arcane dhyānahīne tu viṣṇusūktaṃ yajettataḥ || 21 || devaṃ samyaktāthā dhyātvā punararcayati kramāt| navabhedeṣvathaikasmin kalpite'pyarcane tathā || 22 || āsanādiṣu yaddhīnaṃ tattatprati viśeṣataḥ| vaiṣṇāvaṃ viṣṇugāyatrīṃ juhuyātṛtadanusmaran || 23 || devadevaṃ smaran buddhyā sarvavyāpinamavyayam| havirnivedanahīne havirnivedane hīne brāhmaṃ hutṛvā tataḥ param || 24 || prājāpatyaṃ tato hutvā vaiṣṇavena samanvitam| viṣṇusūktaṃ havistadvaddviguṇañca nivedayet || 25 || upadaṃśeṣu hīneṣu yajetsaumyaṃ savaiṣṇavam| sāmādiñca ghṛte hīne juhuyādvaiṣṇavānvitam || 26 || juhuyāddadhihīne tu yajurādyaṃ savaiṣṇavam| mukhavāsahīne mukhavāsavihīne tu śrīmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet || 27 || nityahomahīne nityahomaṃ kapālāgrāvajñānājjuhuyādyadi| vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīścāpi hutvā ca juhuyāttathā || 28 || nityāgniṃ tamavicchinnmaśakto rakṣituṃ yadi| samidhyātmani vā''ropya nidhāyāharaharyajet || 29 || śrīvaikhānasasūtrokto mantra āropaṇe smṛtaḥ| tathā'varopaṇe cāgnau nāmantraṃ kiñcidācaret || 30 || sakāle'rcanehīne prātassandhyārcane hīne madhyāhre dviguṇaṃ bhavet| vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ yajettataḥ || 31 || prātarmadhyāhrayorhīne sāyāhre dviguṇaṃ bhavet| ekāhe tvarcanāhīne hutvā taddviguṇaṃ punaḥ || 32 || havīṃṣyapi nivedyaiva dakṣiṇāgnau tataḥ param| pañcaviṃśatikṛtvastu ṣaṇmātrān vaiṣṇavān yajet || 33 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ hutvā viprāṃśca bhojayet| ekāhe tvidamuddiṣṭaṃ dvitīye dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 34 || dvādaśāhāntamityevaṃ vardhayettu dine dine| atīte dvādaśāhe tu dakṣiṇāgnau tataḥ param || 35 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ śataṃ yajet| catvāriṃśadbhiraṣṭābhiḥ kalaśaiḥ snāpayetpunaḥ || 36 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā samabhyarcya nivedayet| ācāryāya paśūn dadyādbrāhmaṇān bhojayetpunaḥ || 37 || māsahīnaṃ yadi bhavedālayaṃ paritastathā| agnīnāhavanāyādīn prāgādi parikalpayate || 38 || deveśaṃ manasā dhyātvā pratyekañcaikaviṃśatim| devībhyāñca munibhyāñca vaighnaṃ gārūḍameva ca || 39 || tattaddhome suhotavyaṃ mahāvyāhṛtisaṃyutam| śatāṣṭakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ || 40 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet| yāvaddinārcanaṃ hīnaṃ gaṇayitvā tataḥ param || 41 || tāvaddinārcanādravyaṃ deveśāya nivedayet| evaṃ māse prakurvīta dvimāse dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 42 || varṣāntaṃ vardhayedevaṃ varṣe'tīte tataḥ param| aṣṭādhikasahasrairvā śatairvā kalaśaistadā || 43 || snāpayitvā tu deveśaṃ praṇamyaivānumānya ca| suvarṇapaśubhūmyādīn datvā''cāryāya dakṣiṇām || 44 || tato'bjāgnau mahāśāntiṃ hutvā devamanusmaran| sahastrapadmaṃ saṅgṛhya gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ vadan || 45 || āplutyā'plutya juhuyātkāpilena ghṛtena vai| pūrvoktena vidhānena pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 46 || evamevārcane hīne prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate| anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ sāmānyamidamucyate || 47 || balihīne prātassandhyābalau hīne madhyāhre dviguṇaṃ bhavet| vaiṣṇavaṃ saurasaumye ca prājāpatyaṃ yajettataḥ || 48 || prātarmadhyāhrayorhone sāyāhre dviguṇaṃ bhavet| ekāhaṃ balihīnañcedagnāvaupāsanīyake || 49 || juhuyādviṇusūktañca ,pūrvamantraiśca saṃyutam| utthāpayedvaliṃ hīnaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ || 50 || ekāhe tvidamuddiṣṭaṃ dvidine dviguṇaṃ bhavet| vardhayet dvādaśāhāntamatīte dvādaśe'hani || 51 || agjāgnau pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ tataḥ param| pāramātmikasaṃyuktaṃ 'mīṅkārādīn' juhoti ca || 52 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairbimbaṃ kautukameva ca| mahāhavirnivedyaiva balīnutthāpayetkramāt || 53 || evamevavidhānena yāvanmāsāntamācaret| māsahīnaṃ yadi bhavetprācyāmahāvanīyake || 54 || yajedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe| madhye tu sarvadaivatyaṃ sabhyakuṇḍe juhoti ca || 55 || śatāṣṭakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā tataḥ param| pañcaviṃśatigā datvā devamuddiśya yatnataḥ || 56 || mahāhavirnivedyaiva balīnutthāpayetkramāt| evameva vidhānena kuryātsaṃvatsarāvadhi || 57 || patite taddhalau spṛṣṭe aspṛśyaiḥ śrutidūṣakaiḥ| pūrvavadvalimāpādya banidevaṃ yajetpunaḥ || 58 || balimutthāpya vighnaścetsauraṃ saumyasamanvitam| hutvā tu pūrvavatkarma prārabheta yathāvidhi || 59 || balau pramāṇahīne tu vaiṣṇavañcaikaviṃśatim| bhinne jīrṇe śataṃ pātre tatpramāṇavivarjite || 60 || veṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viśṇusūktamataḥ param| pāramātmika 'mīṅkārān' raudraṃ tathaiva ca || 61 || sauramāgneyasaṃyuktaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam| jayādyaiścaiva kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ juhuyāttasya śāntaye || 62 || ativātātivṛṣṭyośca harimārādhya pūrvavat| dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ garbhagehe pradakṣiṇam || 63 || kṛtvā saupānamadhye tu śrībhūtāgre baliṃ dadet| parivārabaliñcāpi deveśaṃ paritastathā || 64 || tattatsthāne samāsādya dadyādityeva kecana| kalpitānnabalau kāle tvalabdhe'nnabalau sati || 65 || kuryādardhyabaliṃ vā'pi pūrvavatpuṣpameva vā| nityāgnau daśakṛtvastu yajetsaurañca vaiṣṇavam || 66 || ālayāvaraṇādvāhye mukhe vāme prakalpite| kalpite balipīṭhe ca tacca kuryātpudakṣiṇam || 67 || balibhramaṇakāle tu vādyahīne tu pauruṣam| nṛttageyavihīne ca viṣṇusūktañca vaiṣṇavam || 68 || hutvā ghaṇṭādhvaniyutaṃ balibhramaṇamācaret| japanvai śākunaṃ sūktaṃ svastisūktasamanvitam || 69 || śavapāte pañcāśaccāpasīmānte caikavīthyāṃ śave sati| arcanañca havirdānaṃ devadevasya varjayet || 70 || yadi kuryāttadajñānācduddhodairabhiṣicya ca| yaddevādyaiśca hutvā tu samabhyarcya nivedayet || 71 || ṣaṣṭisaptatyaśītyarvāk kṣatriyādiśave sati| anulomaśave kuryācchāntiṃ śūdrasya coktavat || 72 || anyavāstugate pūjā na doṣāya bhavecchave| aspṛśyasparśe arcakānyadvijaiḥ spṛṣṭe śuddhodairabhiṣecayet || 73 || sptabhiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ spṛṣṭe kalaśaiḥ snāpayeddharim| snāpayedvaiśyasaṃsparśe caturviśatibhastathā || 74 || śāntihomañca juhuyācchaktito bhojayeddivajān| aṣṭottaraśataiśśūdraiḥ saṃsparśe snāpayettathā || 75 || mahāśāntiṃ tato hutvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet| spṛṣṭe'nulomaiśśūdroktaprāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 76 || ucchiṣṭāśucibhirvipraiḥ kuryācchūdroktaniṣkṛtim| spṛṣṭe tvāśaucavadvapraiḥ kuryācchūdroktaniṣkṛtim || 77 || pratilomaistu saṃspṛṣrūṭe jalādiṣvadhivāsya ca| mahāśāntiñca saptāhamabjāgnau juhayāttataḥ || 78 || pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| kārayettāntrikasparśe pratilomoktaniṣkṛtim || 79 || avedamūlāssamāyāstāntrikā vedadūṣakāḥ| brāhmaṇaiḥ pācakādanyaiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ naiva havirdadet || 80 || yadi dadyāttu mohena vaiṣṇavantu sakṛdyajet| ucchiṣṭāśucibhirvipraiḥ kṣatriyairviḍ bhireva vā || 81 || anne nivedite spṛṣṭe śuddhodairabhiṣecayet| vaiṣṇavaṃ daśakṛtvaśca hutvā'nyacca nivadeyet || 82 || spṛṣṭamāśaucavadvipraiḥ śūdrairvā'thānulomajaiḥ| nivedayeccedajñajñanātkalaśairadhamādhamaiḥ || 83 || snāpayitvā tataśśantiṃ hutvā'bhyarcya nivedayet| pratilomaistu saṃppṛṣṭaṃ haviryadi nivedayet || 84 || kalaśaiḥ snāpayeddevaṃ cajvāriśadbhiraṣṭabhiḥ| mahāśāntiñca hutvā tu prabhūtañca nivedayet || 85 || deveśaṃ snānakāle vā pūjākāle nivedane| pratilomāśca pāṣaṇḍāḥ patitā vedadūṣakāḥ || 86 || nāskikā bhinnamaryādā yadi paśyanti mohataḥ| havirvā yadi tairddṛṣṭaṃ deveśāya nivedayet || 87 || deveśaṃ snāpayitvā tu śuddhodaistasya śānye| abhyarcya śāntihomānte prabhūtañca nivedayet || 88 || pūjanārtha jale puṣpe mantravatsaṃskṛte punaḥ| spṛṣṭañcedbrāhmaṇādanyaiḥ tattyaktvā'nyatsamāharet || 89 || athavā prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣya pātrāntaraniveśitam| pūrvavanmantrasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tenaiva pūjayet || 90 || ucchiṣṭāśucibhirvipraiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ yadi tathaiva ca| spṛṣṭamāśaucavadvipraiḥ tyaktvā'nyaddravyamāharet || 91 || pratilomaistu saṃspṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭañcaiva visarjayet| śūdrairathāpya śucibhiḥ pratilomairudakyayā || 92 || spṛṣṭamājyaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ madhu vā toyameva vā| devārthaṃ naiva gṛhṇīyāddaṣṭaṃ sūtikayā tathā || 93 || ajñānāddevadevāya yadi tāni nivedayet| śuddhodaiḥ snāpayitvā tu hutvā śāntiṃ samarcayet || 94 || tyājyaṃ puṣpañca saṃspṛṣṭamevamanyat phalādikam| na tyajedyadi lobhena śāntiṃ hutvā'bhiṣecayet || 95 || amantrakā'rcanaṃ viṣṇorakāle ca tathā'rcanam| grāmanāśañca durbhikṣaṃ vyādhiñcaiva prayacchati || 96 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāle kāle viśeṣataḥ| mantravatpūjayedviṣṇumiti pūrvajaśāsanam || 97 || avijñāteṣu sarveṣu mantrāṇāntu pṛthak pṛthak| ṛṣicchandodhideveṣu chando'nuṣṭubiti smaret || 98 || antaryāmī ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ paramātmā ca devatā| iti sāmānyataḥ smṛtvā pūjayetpuruṣettamam || 99 || aṣṭhavidhā bhaktiḥ bhaktimaṣṭavidhāṃ vakṣye devadeve tu śārṅgiṇi| tadbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ tatpūjāsvanumodanam || 100 || tatkathāśravaṇe bhaktiḥ svaranetrāṅgavikriyā| tadanusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ tadarthe dambhavarjanam || 101 || nityaṃ tadekaśeṣitvaṃ yacca tannopajīvati| bhaktiraṣṭavidhā hyeṣā yatra sādhāraṇena vai || 102 || tameva pūjakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ varayennānyamarcakam || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre nityārcanāprāyaścittavidhirnāma caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<25> oṃ pañcaviṃśoṃ'dhyāyaḥ snapanaprāyaścitam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi snapane doṣaniṣkṛtim| nā'rpayitvā'ṅkuraṃ viṣṇoḥ snapanaṃ kriyate yadi || 1 || aṅkurārpaṇahīne brahmādīnāntu ṣaṇṇāṃ vai mantrānaupāsane yajet| mūrtibhiśca jayādīnāṃ hīne vā'pyadhike'pi vā| mantraṃ taddevatānāñca pratyekaṃ viṃśatiṃ yajet || 2 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vyāhṛtīśca savaiṣṇavam| puṣpaiḥ prapūrvaṃ pātrāṇi śvetairvā taṇḍulairapi || 3 || aṅkurāniti saṅkalpya punaśca snāpayeddharim| pramāṇe pālikādīnāṃ hīne vā'cyadhike'pi vā || 4 || mantraṃ taddevatānāñca vaiṣṇavaṃ viṃśātiṃ yajet| pālikānāmalābhe tu śarāveṣvathavā'rpayet || 5 || snapanālayam hīnādhikena mānena kuryāccetsnapanālayam| vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūmidaityaṃ pratyekaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam || 6 || ālayasyottaraṃ kuryācdāntikaṃ snapanālāyam| puṣṭikāmastu pūrvasmin muktikāmastu dakṣiṇe || 7 || jalakāmastu vāruṇyāṃ sarvakāmasatu śāṅkare| āgneye naiṛte caiva vāyavye na samācaret || 8 || tatraiva yadi kuryāccetṛpunaḥ snapanamācaret| taddikpālakamantrañca vaiṣṇavaṃ viṃśatiṃ yajet || 9 || kalaśeṣu pramāṇe kalaśānāñca nyūne vā'pyadhike'pi vā| vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyādbrāhyaṃ mahāvyāhṛtisaṃyutam || 10 || vyāhṛtyantaṃ pṛthagghutvā gṛhṇīyāllakṣaṇānvitam| vastre vastrahīne mahān doṣo bhavedvastrādihīnatā || 11 || ācārya pūjayedvastraiḥ śrīmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| toraṇādau toraṇe deṣayukte tu mantrau dauvārikau yajet || 12 || tattaddavārādhipaṃ hutvā vaiṣṇavena samanvitam| kūrcādau pramāṇahīne kūrcādau vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmasaṃyutam || 13 || sauraṃ ṣoḍaśakṛtvastu hutvā kuryātsalakṣaṇam| paṅktau paṅktau pramāṇahīnāyāṃ paṅktīśañca samarcayet || 14 || paṅktīśamantraṃ juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ pāñcabhautikam| vimānapālako mitraḥ paṅktīśa iti kīrtyate || 15 || śvabhre,mṛtsu śvabhre pramāṇahīne ca medinyādīn suhūyatām| yathoktasthānamūddhīne yathālābhaṃ pragṛhya ca || 16 || juhuyādbhūmidaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmasaṃyutam| athavā paścime śvabhraṃ kṛtvā tu snapanālaye || 17 || paṅktiṃ tasyāgrataḥ kṛtvā dravyanyāsārthameva vā| mṛdādīni yathāsthānaṃ paṅktau dravyāṇi sannyaset || 18 || madhye śuddhodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kumbhaṃ vastrādiveṣṭitam| sannyasya dhānyapīṭhordhve mṛdādisnapanātparam || 19 || japtvā puruṣasūktañca snāpayediti kecana| kārayetsnapanaścavabhraṃ śilayeṣṭakayā'thavā || 20 || hastamātrocdrayaṃ pīṭhamadhiṣṭhānoktavaccaret| adhiṣṭhānatalordhve cenmañcāntaṃ vedikādikam || 21 || talopuri talaṃ naiva kuryādityāha pūrvajaḥ| tadūrdhve kārayecchvabhramaupāsanavidhānataḥ || 22 || hastamātrocchrayaṃ pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā yajñoktadārubhiḥ| paṅktimadhye pratiṣṭhāpya jaladhārāṃ taduttare || 23 || saṃsnāpya devaṃ tacchvabhre snāpayediti kecana| atha nityābhiṣekārya maṇḍapasya tathottare || 24 || sthāpayitvā tathā devaṃ devībhyāṃ snāpayetsaha| tāvadāyamavistārayutaṃ śvabhraṃ prakalpayet || 25 || prāgādikantu paṃritaḥ pīṭhānāntu pṛthakpṛthak| dvivedisahitaṃ kuryādaupāsanavidhānataḥ || 26 || hastocchaye ṣaḍaṃśe vā mukhamekāṃśakaṃ bhavet| tribhāgaṃ kaṇṭhatuṅgaṃ syāddivabhāgaṃ cordhvapaṭṭikā || 27 || kuṇḍasyaupāsanasyeva nimyaṃ tasaya vidhīyate| śvabhraṃ nityābhiṣekārtha keciṃdevaṃ vadanti vai || 28 || parvatādau hīnādhikena mānena parvatān kārayedyadi| āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hutṛvā vyāhatyantaṃ pratiprati || 29 || dhānyānām alābhe sarvadhānyānāṃ kevalaṃ yavameva vā vrīherūrdhva yathālābhaṃ dhānyaṃ prakṣipya cārcayet || 30 || vāyavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ jahuyāttasya śāntaye| aṅkurāṇām aṅkurāṇāmalābhe tu pūrvāṅkuramathāpi vā || 31 || taddaivatyañcajuhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ saumyameva ca| maṅgalānām hīnādhikapramāṇena maṅgalān kurute yadi || 32 || aindraṃ yajedvaiṣṇavañca mahāvyāhṛtibhissaha| pañchagavye yathoktayogahīne tu pañcagavyasya buddhimān || 33 || raudrañca vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ pratyekaṃ viṃśātiṃ yajet| kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ raktāyā dadhi cā'haret || 34 || śvetāyāstu tathā kṣīraṃ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ bhavet| kapotagalavarṇāyā gomūtramapi cā'haret || 35 || alābhe coktavarṇānāṃ yathālābhamathāpi vā| pūrvoktaireva mantraistu tatsaṃyogamathā'caret || 36 || saṃyoge pañcadavyasya mantrahīnaṃ kṛte sati| saṃyogavihitaṃ mantraṃ dvirjapetpāṇinā spṛśan || 37 || pradhānadravyeṣu grāhyaṃ kṣīrañca dadhyājyamājamāhiṣavarjitam| ājaṃ vā māhiṣaṃ vā'pi gṛhītvā snāpayedyadi || 38 || pauruṣaṃ juhuyātsūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥ param| pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṅgahomaṃ sakṛtsakṛt || 39 || sadyastaptaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ samapakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ haret| kṛmikīṭapataṅgādi yadi dṛśeta tadaṃghṛte || 40 || utpūya vastreṇoddīpya prokṣāyitvā''haretpunaḥ| saṃspṛśya vaiṣṇavairmantrai 'rāpohiṣṭhā' mayādibhiḥ || 41 || sāmavedādimantraiśca juhuyādvaiṣṇavena ca| snāpayeddevadevantaṃ mantravadbhaktisaṃyutam || 42 || madhuhīne tu toyaṃ vā samāhṛtṛya madhu smaran| hutvā ṛgādimantreṇa vaiṣṇavena tataḥ param || 43 || snāpayeddevadevntaṃ mantraṃ pūrvoktamuccaran| daghi śuddhaṃ ghanaṃ grāhyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ priyadarśanam || 44 || sadoṣe dadhni juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ yajurādikam| vyāhṛtīścaiva juhuyā 'dato devādi' vaiṣṇavam || 45 || 'śānno devī' riti kṣīre pratyekaṃ viṃśātiṃ yajet| gandhahīne ca gandhe vai taddaivatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 46 || akṣatode'kṣatālābhe yathālābhaṃ pragṛhya ca| ārṣañca vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ hutvā'bhiṣiñcati || 47 || phalālābho yathālābhaṃ gṛhītvā saumyavaiṣṇavaiḥ| vyāhṛtyantaṃ kuśālābhe darbhāgraṃ tatra nikṣipet || 48 || ārṣakaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamaindaṃ hutvā samācaret| ratnodakasya ratnānāmalābhe rukmameva vā || 49 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca brāhmaṃ raudraṃ yajettataḥ| japyode japahīne tu vaiṣṇavañca brāhmaṃ yajet || 50 || hutvā tu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥ param| kṣipedvā taṇḍulān śālīnoṣadhīnāmalābhake || 51 || puṇya puṣṇaṇām ādityaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ yajetpunaḥ| alābhe puṇyapuṣpāṇāṃ dhātṛmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam || 52 || prāyaścittaṃ sakṛddhutvā yathālābhaṃ samāharet| gandhacūrṇānām alābhe gandhacūrṇānāṃ cakramantraṃ sarvaṣṇavam || 53 || hutvośīreṇa maudgena cūrṇenodvartayettathā| kaṣāyacūrṇeṣu sarvālābhe kaṣāyārthamāśvatthī tvacamāharet || 54 || vāruṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā tenaivodvartayetpunaḥ| tīrthatoyasya alobhe tīrthatoyānāṃ nādeyaṃ vā samāharet || 55 || gāṅgeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ sakṛdyaret| oṣadhīnām oṣadhīnāmalābhe tu vaiṣṇavaṃ raudrasaṃyutam || 56 || hutvā''dāya yathālābhaṃ mārjayetpūrvamantrataḥ| alābhe sarvagandhānāṃ candanaṃ vā samāharet || 57 || aindrañca vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā vyāhṛtīśca tataḥ param| slote plotālābhe'nyavastreṇa dhautena parimārjayet || 58 || tvāṣṭuṃ savaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ hutvā samācaret| 'tvaṣṭā rūpāṇāmadhipati' riti tvāṣṭramudāhṛtam || 59 || mūlagandhasya alābhe mūlagandhasya dūrvāgraṃ vā samāharet| brāhmañca vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā prājāpatyasamanvitam || 60 || dhātūnām alābho sarvadhātūnāṃ jātihiṅgulikanatu vā| daurgañca viṣṇusūktañca hutvā tena samācaret || 61 || pāṇipādatalauṣṭheṣu jātihiṅṛgulikaṃ dadet| bhūṣaṇāmbarayordadyāddharitālaṃ manaśśilām || 62 || sarvāṅgeṣvañjanaṃ proktamathavā pakṣmaṇordvayoḥ| gosecanaṃ nayanayormukhe sarvatra cavā'thavā || 63 || yathāsthānamalaṅkuryādetairdhātubhireva vai| alaṅkāre alaṅkāraviparyāse yajeddaurgañca vaiṣṇavam || 64 || juhuyādbhūṣaṇālābhe skandadaivatyavaiṣṇavaiḥ| dravyoddhāre viparyāsoddhṛte dravye mohādvā'tha pramādataḥ || 65 ||
taddaivatyañca hutvā tu vaiṣṇavañcaikaviṃśatim| kalaśabhedādau sādhite kalaśe bhinne spṛṣṭe śūdrādibhistathā || 66 || anyaṃ kalaśamādāya pūrvavatsamprapūrayet| taṃ spṛṣṭvā vauṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ taddaivatyaṃ śataṃ japet || 67 || catuviṃśatikṛtvaśca taddaivatyaṃ juhoti ca| juhuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmamaṣṭottaraśataṃ punaḥ || 68 || kṛmikīṭadipatane kṛmikīṭapataṅgadau dravyeṣu patite yadi| taddravyaṃ varjayennityaṃ dravyamanyatsamāharet || 69 || taddaivatyaṃ śataṃ hutvā deveśaṃ snāpayetpunaḥ| athavā sarvadoṣāṇāṃ śāntyarthaṃ snapane tathā || 70 || juhuyātpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇusūktamataḥ param| pāramātmikamīṅkārādyaṣṭāśītyāhutīrapi || 71 || śrīsūktaṃ rātrisūktañca durgāsūktaṃ tataḥ param| pañcavāruṇasaṃyuktaṃ jayādīn vaiṣṇavānapi || 72 || yajeddravyādhidevānāṃ jayādīnāñca mūrtibhiḥ| saṅkalpite snapane vidhnite kalpite snapane hīne grahaṇa grahaṇe viṣuve'yane || 73 || ekāhantu mahāśāntimabjāgnau juhuyādbudhaḥ| kalaśairdviguṇairdevaṃ snāpayīta yathāvidhi || 74 || evameva ca saṃvardhya snapanaṃprati kārayet| tailābhyakte tu deveśe snapanaṃ tatra nācaret || 75 || tailābhyekte na snapanam tailamokṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punaḥ snapanamācaret| tailamokṣamakṛtvā tu mohena snāpayedyati || 76 || āsuraṃ snapanaṃ tatsyāttasya doṣasya śāntaye| śāntihomaṃ sakṛddhutvā punaśca snāpayettathā || 77 || snāpayedyadi devībhyāṃ saha taccāsura bhavet| tatrāpi śāntihomānta deveśaṃ snāpayetpṛthak || 78 || beraviśeṣāṇāṃ devīsāhityarāhitye snāpanaṃ baliberañca devīrahitameva vai| autsavaṃ snāpayeccettu devīrahitameva vai| autsavaṃ snāpayeccettu devībhyāṃ snāpayedvinā || 79 || tatrāpi snapanānte tu devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ caret| devīyukte snāpane tu pūrvavatṛkārayedbudhaḥ || 80 || balibere ca da
<26> oṃ ṣaḍviṃśādhyāyaḥ utsavaprāyaścittam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittamathotsave| vastre pramāṇahīne ca dhvajadaṇḍe tathaiva ca || 1 || dhvajapaṭādīnāṃ lakṣaṇahanau vīśe lakṣaṇahīne ca citrakarmaviparyaye| gāruḍaṃ dhvajadaivatyaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 2 || kṛte saṅgīrṇavarṇena prāyaścittamathācaret| aspṛśyasparśādau kṛte pratiṣṭhāsaṃskāre dhvaje tatra viśeṣataḥ || 3 || saṃspṛṣṭe kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣya cā'haret| ucchiṣṭāśucibhirvipraiḥ śūdraiḥ spṛṣṭe tathaiva ca || 4 || saptabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ prokṣya juhuyādhdvājagāruḍau| saptaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ syāducchiṣṭāśucibhirnṛpaiḥ || 5 || caturviśatibhiḥ prokṣya kalaśairdviguṇaṃ yajet| dviguṇaṃ tadvaṇiksparśe snapanaṃ homamācaret || 6 || ucchiṣṭāśucibhiśśūdraiḥ pratilaumairūdakyayā| spṛṣṭe sūtikayā vā'tha kalaśaismāṣṭakeśśataiḥ || 7 || snāpayitvā tu pūrvoktaṃ homaṃ dviguṇamācaret| pūrvavadhdvajadevasya pratiṣṭhāmācaretpunaḥ || 8 || savarṇākhyānulomena saṃspṛṣṭe kṣatriyoktavat| ābhaṣiktākhyasasparśe kuryādveśyoktaniṣkṛtim || 9 || anyānulomasaṃsparśe kuryācchūdroktaniṣkṛtim| varṇajātivivekena yatra noktā tu niṣkṛtiḥ || 10 || tatkrameṇaiva vihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śuddhiṃ sarvatra kārayet || 82 || dhvaje adharottare dhvajārohaṇakāle tu dhvaje tatrādharottare| mahāśāntiñca hutvā tu dhvājamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 12 || gāruṅañca tathā hutvā kalaśaiḥ prokṣya saptabhiḥ| samabhyarcya nivaidyaiva punarāropayedhdvajam || 13 || kṛtvaivaṃ daṇḍabhaṅge ca dhvajabhaṅge tathaiva ca| bhaṅge ca yaṣṭyādhārāṇāṃ tadvadanyatsamāharet || 14 || dhvajapatanādau dhvaje tu patite dhvājaṃ gāruḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣya tatpaścādhdvajaṃ tatra suyojayet || 15 || dhvajasya nāśe bhede ca āgneyaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā| dhvājañca vaiṣṇavaṃ hutvā kārayitvaiva tadhdvajam || 16 || āvāhya garuḍaṃ tatra punarāropayeddhvajam| grāmapradakṣiṇañcaiva balidānañca nācaret || 17 || śiṣṭāheṣu prapūrṇeṣu dhvajaṃ tamavaropayet| dhvajārohaṇahīne dhvajārohaṇahīne tu lokapālakadaivatam || 98 || prājāpatyañca raudrañca viṣṇusūkta yajetkramāt| na dhvajārohaṇaṃ kuryādekāhe ca dinadvaye || 19 || dinatrāyotsave cāpi na kuryāditi kecana| anukteṣu ca doṣeṣu prāyaścittaṃ dhvajasya ca || 20 || dhvājañca gāruḍañcaiva daśakṛtvo yajetpunaḥ| kālotsave vidhnitepratyabdakriyamāṇe tu hīne kālotsave khile || 21 || pauṇḍarīke mahāśāntiṃ yāvaddivasamutsavaḥ| dineṣu tāvatsaṅkhyeṣu juhuyādbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 22 || savatṛsāstāvatīrgāśca deveśāya dadenmudā| utsavasya ca yanmūlyaṃ dravyaṃ tadvā'tha sandadet || 23 || kalaśaissnāpayitvā tu śatenāṣṭādhikena ca| sarvopacārairabhyarcya nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ || 24 || kṛtvā ca mahatīṃ pūjāṃ puṇyāhamapi vācayet| saṃstūya viṣṇusūktena deveśaṃ pauruṣeṇa ca || 25 || brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu punaścotsavamācaret| utsavaṃ dviguṇaṃ samyakkārayediti kecana || 26 || samūrtārcanayajñasya prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam| dhvajārohaṇāle tu ācāryo garbhavān yadi || 27 || mahotsave pavitrasyādvarṣe varṣe kṛto yadi| nityakārma tadākhyātaṃ garbhadīkṣā na vidyate || 28 || prokṣaṇādyāni karmāṇi nityānyanyāni cā'caret| garbhiṇīpatirācāryastrimāsātprabhṛti dvijāḥ || 29 || śrāddhānnaṃ tilahomañcaiva na kuryāditi vai vidhiḥ| sindhusnānaṃ gayāśraddhaṃ vapanaṃ pretavāhanam || 30 || parvatārohaṇañcaiva na kuryāditi vai vidhiḥ| pratisaṃvatṛsarañcaiva vardhayitvā tu kārayet || 31 || hīne dine tathaikasmin tasya kālotsavasya tu| hutvā puruṣasūktena vaiṣṇavai ṣaḍbhireva ca || 32 || kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ brāhmamantrābhyāmaindrairapi ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ| mūrtibhiḥ parivārāṇāṃ tadālayanivāsinām || 33 || kalaśaiḥ snāpayitvā tu samabhyarcya nivedayet| pūrvoktena krameṇai va cotsavaṃ punarācaret || 34 || vardhayitvā caredevaṃ dinaṃprati dinaṃprati dinaṃprati| atītāhotsavaṃ kṛtvā punaśśeṣaṃ samācarat || 35 || utsavaṃ dviguṇaṃ keciptrātarhīne dine dine| ekakālotsave hīne ekakālotsave hīne pūrvoktaṃ homamācare || 36 || utsavañca tathā kuryāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret| vīthībhramaṇavelāyāṃ deve yānagatesati || 37 || rathayātrāyāṃ sambhāvyamānadoṣeṣu kalahe rudhirasrāve mahotpāte mṛte jane| rathacakragrahe caiva narāṇāṃ mṛtisambhave || 38 || śeṣavīthīṃ paribhragāmya prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tu| ālayañca praviśyaicava deveśamavaropya ca || 39 || saptabhiḥ kalaśairdeva saṃsnāpya ca vidhānataḥ| puṇyāhaṃ vācayedvidvāna prokṣaṇañcaiva kāratey || 40 || viśeṣeṇatu da devāya mudgānnaṃ vinivedayet| kṣamāmantraṃ samuccārya praṇāmamapi kārayet || 41 || kṣamāmantraprakāra kṣamāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ| ājñānādarthalobhādvā rāgāddaveṣātpramādataḥ || 42 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama| mayā vāmajjanairvā'tha mama bandhubhireva vā || 43 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puraṣottama| ācāryeṇārcakenā'pi bhaktairvā paricākaiḥ || 44 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puraṣottama| rājñā vā rājabhṛtyairvā tadamātyairathāpi vā || 45 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama| grāmaṇībhirgrāmibhirvā grāmapālairathāpi vā || 46 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama| gāyakairnartakairvā'pi tathā vāditravādakaiḥ || 47 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puruṣettama| amantrakārcanāyāṃ yat jātamajñātajanmanaḥ || 48 || avadyaṃ mamayatkiñcit kṣamasva puruṣottama| praṇāmāṃdivisargāntaṃ kriyāsu vidhipūrvakam || 49 || aparādhaḥ kṛto yastaṃ kṣamasva puraṣottam| arpitantu yathāśakti patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam || 50 || niveditañca naivedyaṃ svīkuru tvaṃ janārdana| abāvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanem || 51 || karmaṇā manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama| antaścarasi bhūtānāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ || 52 || nātha yonisahasreṣu yeṣu yeṣu vrajāmyaham| teṣu teṣvacyutā bhaktiracyute'stu sadā tvayi || 53 || devo dātā ca bhoktā ca devassarvamidaṃ jagat| deve jayati sarvatra tvaṃ devaḥ svayameva hi || 54 || aśakyaṃ vidhivatkartu brahmādyairapi pūjanam| nyūnātirekavyāghātadoṣahīnaṃ jagatpate || 55 || kimutāsmābhiralpajñairmanuṣyairadṛḍhātmabhiḥ| tasmānnityārcanāyāntu yadudbhūtamaśobhānam || 56 || anayā pūjayā viṣṇo praśāntaṃ sarvamastu naḥ| upacārāpadeśena kṛtānaharaharmayā || 57 || apacārānimān sarvān kṣamasva puraṣottama| evaṃ nityārcanānte tu prārthayetsarvaniṣkṛtiḥ || 58 || pūjābhāgaṃ na nānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ puraṣottama| iti saṃstutya nṛtyante yāgaśālā praviśya ca || 59 || śāntihomaprakāraḥ pauṇḍarīkāgnimāsādya ghṛtena juhuyātyakramāt| vaiṣṇava viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 60 || juhuyādviṣṇugāyatrīṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tadā| īṅkārādīśca juhuyādvāstuhomañca kārayet || 61 || paryagnikaraṇam varṣabindupatanādau kuryādvīthyāñca paryagniṃ prokṣayecca vidhānataḥ| utsave devadevasya secane varṣabindubhiḥ || 62 || tathā bimbaṃ samānīya samācchādyānyadaśukam| paridhāpya mahāśānti hutvā snāpya śatāṣṭakaiḥ || 63 || bhārataṇḍulasaṃyuktaṃ datardhatilasaṃyutam| niṣkatrayasuvarṇañca tāmbūlasahitaṃ punaḥ || 64 || datvā kālotsave proktāṃ niṣkṛtiñca samācaret| dviguṇārcanādihīne devadevasya devyośca sāyaṃ prātastathotsave || 65 || haviṣi dviguṇe hīne hīne ca dviguṇe'rcane| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca hutvā tatra caturgaṃṇam || 66 || arcayitvā haviśvacā'pi samyagdadyāccaturguṇam| haviṣo dviguṇe hīne vīśaśāntānapāyinām || 67 || dviguṇaṃ tān samabhyarcya dviguṇañca nivedayet| utsavacakrahīne utsavaṃ cakrahīnantu nācarediti śāsanam || 68 || kārayedutsavārtha tamathavā cānapāyinām| cakrañca baliberañca yācayediti kecana || 69 || yācitaṃ tatkriyānte tu nītvā pūrvālayaṃ punaḥ| saṃsthāpya śāntiṃ hutvā tu pūrvasthāne niveśayet || 70 || āvāhya pātre puṣpeṣu vīśaśāntau susannyet| homahīne tu juhuyāddviguṇantu yathāvidhi || 71 || kumbhasthadevanāṃ pūjane hīne jīne kumbhasthadevānāṃ sāyaṃ prātastathārcane| ekamādaśopacāreṣu hīneṣu ca tadarcane || 72 || kārayedarcanāhīnaprāyaścittoktaniṣkṛtim| kumbhasthānāñca devānāṃ nāmabhiśca yajetpunaḥ || 73 || punardviguṇamabhyarcya dviguṇañca nivedayet| kumbhasyāspṛśyasparśādau kumbhe spṛṣṭe śvakākādyaiḥ aspṛśyaiśca tathaiva ca || 74 || prāyaścittaṃ pratiṣṭhoktaṃ kṛtvā'nyaṃ kumbhamāharet| anapāyināmarcane hīne vīśānapāyipaṅktīśāsāntānāṃ yāgamaṇḍape || 75 || hīne'rcane tu tanmantraistaddigagnau juhoti ca| tretāgniryadi śāntasya yajedāhavanīyake || 76 || sarveṣāṃ juhuyātsabhye mantrānekāgnikalpane| dviguṇañca samabhyarcya dviguṇañca nivedayet || 77 || atītadivasādyevaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| nityāgnāvānādṛte nityāgnivyatiriktāgniryadi kuṇḍe prāṇīyate || 78 || utsavo niṣphalastasmādagniṃ nityaṃ praṇīya ca| hutvā taddviguṇaṃ homaṃ punaścotsavamācaret || 79 || ātīrthadivasādagnimavicchinnañca rakṣayet| grāmabalau hīne hīne grāmabalau tattaddevānāṃ mūrtibhissaha || 80 || juhuyādvaiṣṇavañcāpi vyāhṛtyantaṃ pratiprati| paścādgrāma baliṃ datvā punaścotsavamācaret || 81 || āsthānācarvanam āsthānamaṇḍapaṃ kuryādvidiśāsu diśāsu vā| prāṅmukhaṃ kalpayedvidvānathavā dakṣiṇāmukham || 82 || pañcahastādibhedena kalpayeddeśikottamaḥ| tatra devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pādyādyaira rcayetkramāt || 83 || tanmukhe nṛttagītādivinodakaraṇāni ca| kārayettu vidhānena pāde puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet || 84 || anyatra kṛtyavaikalye rājā rāṣṭrañca naśyataḥ| tasmātsarvaprayatnena uktavatsarvamācaret) || 85 || balibhramaṇakāle sambhāvyamānadoṣeṣu balibhramaṇavelāyāṃ caṇḍālassūtikā'thavā| pramādātpraviśetsadyaścakrādīnālayaṃ nayet || 86 || cakraśāntau ca vīśañca baliberaṃ pūthakpṛthak| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ prokṣayitvā baliṃ tathā || 87 || cakravīśāmitānāñca mantrairapi ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ| balirakṣakamantrābhyāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 88 || paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā'tha vīthikām| datvā, śiṣṭabaliṃ paścātpunaḥ karma samāpayet || 89 || utsave vīthyā śavapatane paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ vīthīṃ saṃśodhya sarvataḥ || 90 || lokapālakamantraiśca baliṃ nirvāpya pūrvavat| hutvā balyutsavādīni pūrvavatparikalpayet || 91 || tadgrāmantarmṛtau satyāṃ śīghramuddhṛtya taṃ śavam| prāyaścittañca pūrvoktaṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ samācaret || 92 || śavañca kevalaṃ naiva nayetkeśavasannidhau| nītañcetsyādvināśāya tadgrāmayajamānayoḥ || 93 || tasmattaddoṣaśāntyarthaṃ vāstuhomañca kārayet| śāntiñcaiva mahāśāntiṃ hutṛvā tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ || 94 || alaṅkaraṇahīne brāhmaṇān bhojayitvaiva dakṣiṇāñca dadedguroḥ| bhūṣaṇairapi sauvarṇairnānāvarṇāmbarairapi || 95 || devālaṅkaraṇe hīne śrīsūktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| sugandhairbahubhiḥ puṣpairmālyairapi viśeṣataḥ || 96 || devālaṅkaraṇe hīne mahīsūktañca vaiṣṇavaṃm| śibikādihīne ratharaṅge ḍolikāyāṃ śibikāyāmathāpi vā || 97 || hīneṣu devadevasya cānyālaṅkakaraṇeṣuca| haviṣi hīne haviṣi dviguṇe hīne cotsavaṃ nācaredbudhaḥ || 98 || yānālaṅkaraṇe hīne vaiṣṇavaṃ gāruḍaṃ yajet| dhvajahīne tu juhuyādhdvajamantraṃ savaiṣṇavam || 99 || parikarāntarahīne nṛttageyavihīne tu brāhmaṃ raudrañca vaiṣṇavam| śvetacchatrādihīne tu saumyavaiṣṇavavāruṇān || 100 || hīne paricchadetyasmin śrīmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| gandhadhūpavihīne tu bārhaspatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 101 || juhuyādārṣakairmantraiḥ brāhmamantrasamanvitam| dīpahīne tu juhuyātsauramāgneyavaiṣṇavau || 102 || stotrahīne tu juhuyāddigdaivatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam| ācāryādiṣu hīneṣu bārhaspatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 103 || juhuyādārṣakairmantrairbrāhmantrasamanvitam| ācāryagarimā utsave ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ snapanādau tathaiva ca || 104 || gurudevācaretsarvamalābhe'nyapadārthinām| yathoktā'cāryahīne tu nārabhetotsavaṃ hareḥ || 105 || ācino'ti hi śāstrārthamācāre sthāpayatyapi| tasmādācārya ityuktassarvakāryopadeśakaḥ || 106 || hīne parijane hutvā viṣṇusūktaṃ savaiṣṇavam| viṣṇossūktena juhuyāddhīne dhāmapradakṣiṇe || 107 || snāpanahīne snānahīne tu devasya toyamantraṃ savaiṣṇavam| vāruṇaṃ juhuyāddevaṃ pūrvavatsnāpayetpunaḥ || 108 || utsave sparśadoṣābhāvaḥ viṣṇorutsavasevārthamāgatāstatra ye janāḥ| te tu vipaprasamāssarve pratilomādayo'pi ca || 109 || tasmādaspṛśyasaṃsparśo na doṣāya prakalpate| utsave devadevasya yassnāti sparśahetunā || 110 || svargasthāḥ pitarastasya patanti narake dhruvam| utsavāntopacārahīne utsavānte'rcanāhīne tathā hīne haviṣyapi || 111 || hutvā taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ dviguṇañca samarcayet| dviguṇañca havirdadyāt 'kṣamasve' ti praṇamyaca || 112 || prāyaścittāvasāne tu pūrvavaccheṣamācaret| utsave kālatikrame kālātīte tu juhuyācchata brāhmañca vaiṣṇavam || 113 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ yajettathā| abhimatakālaḥ prātarutsavamārabdhaṃ madhyāhre tu samāpyatām || 114 || sāyaṃ sāyārcanādūrdhva yāmādarvākṛ samāpyatām| āsāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ prātarāpratāssāyameva vā || 115 || gauṇe nyūne tu gauṇantu prāyaścittaṃ samācaret| mukhye nyūne tathā mukhyamiti pūrvajaśāsanam || 116 || annabalau patite patite'nnabalau vā'pi tathā'bhyarcya balau punaḥ| samyagabhyarcya deveśaṃ haviścaiva nivedya ca || 117 || balirakṣakamabhyarcya hemañca juhuyāddvayoḥ| vidhinā balimārādhya punaranyaṃ samuddharet || 118 || patita bimbe bhūmau nipatite bimbe śīghramudhdṛtya tatpunaḥ| saṃsnāpya śuddhatoyena namaskṛtyasamarcya ca || 119 || saṃstūya viṣṇusūktena sūktenaikākṣarādinā| caturviśatibhirdevaṃ kalaśairabhiṣicya ca || 120 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ juhuyācchatam| viṣṇornukādibhiḥ stutvā kramādutsavamācaret || 121 || bhūmau nipatite bimbe vīśaśāntānapāyinām| saṃsnāpya tattanmantraiśca tattanmūrtibhireva vā || 122 || vaiṣṇavairviṣṇusūktena kṛtvā taddoṣaśāntaye| arcayettañca deveśamutsavañca samācaret) || 123 || pīṭhe viyojite yānānnipatite bimbe pīṭhe bimbādviyojite| bhinnaṃ pīṭhaṃ prabhāṃ chatramāyudhābharaṇādikam || 124 || ālakṣya tadvimbagatāṃ śaktiṃ kumbhe niveśya ca| bhinnan cyutāṃśca saṃyojya bimbaśuddhiṃ samācaret || 125 || vāstuhomañca hutvā tu snapanañca samācaret| mahmaśāntiñca hutvā tu pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 126 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva punarutsavamācaret| patanādaṅgahīne patanādaṃṅgahīne cedhdruve śaktiṃ niveśya ca || 127 || jīrṇaberaparityāgavidhiṃ kṛtvā visṛjya ca| punarbimbañca kṛtvā tu pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 128 || utsavaṃ punarārabhya kārayediti śāsanam| athotsavasya śeṣantu kautukenārcayā'thavā || 129 || ācaredutsavaṃ bimbaṃ kārayediti kecana| cakravīśāmitādīnāmevameva samācaret || 130 || sahasrakṛtvo juhuyā duktamantraiśca mūrtibhiḥ| yānānāṃ patane yānānāṃ patane caiva gāruḍaṃ homamācaret || 131 || ratharaṅgādipatane brāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃyutam| hutvā tu kārayettāni pūrvavaddhidhikovidaḥ || 132 || gāyakādīnāṃ patanādau gāturnartuśrva patane śrīdevyā homamācaret| ṛtvigācāryasaṃṅkṣobhe bhartsane śapane tathā || 133 || kenaciddhanane teṣāṃ caturdaśabhirārṣakaiḥ| ṣaḍbhiśrva vaiṣṇavairhutvā punaḥ karma pravartayet || 134 || kenaciddhanane teṣāṃ caturdaśabhirārṣakaiḥ| ṣaḍbhiśrva vaiṣṇavairhutvā punaḥ karma pravartayet || 134 || dīpapātrādīnāṃ patanādau dīpānāṃ patane caiva āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajet| bārhaspatyaiśrvaturbhiśrva dhūpādipatane yajet || 135 || patane cāmarādīnāṃ dahane yena kenacit| taddhārakāṇāṃ patane vyajanānāṃ tathaiva ca || 136 || māyāsaṃhlādinī caiva kiṣkindhaṃ sundaraṃ tathā| abhyarcya vāyudaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ homamācaret || 137 || dhvajasyāgnisparśādau dhvajapāte'gnidāhe ca yajeddhvājañca vaiṣṇavam| kalahe brāhṛmaṇādīnāṃ bhaktanāṃ brāhmavaiṣṇavo || 138 || vāditravādakādīnāṃ patane nandīśamarcayet| brāhmañca vaiṣṇavaṃ sauraṃ hutvā karma samārabhet || 139 || kalahe padārthinām kalahe rudhirastrāve cānyotpātānmṛte jane| tatsarvañcaiva cānyotpātānmṛte jane| tatsarvañcaiva saṃśodhya vāstuhomāvāsanake || 140 || juhuyādviṣṇusūñca vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ kramāt| pariṣadgaṇamantraiśca devadevamanusmaran || 141 || ukavānāmutsavāṅgānāṃ mantrairapi ca hūyate| kātukabandhanahīne pūrvarātre ca tīrthārthe, badhnīyātkautukaṃ tathā || 142 || pramādāttu na badhīyātprātaḥ pratisaraṃ tathā| vāruṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ hutvā taddinadaivatam || 143 || kṛtvā pratisarābandhaṃ kārayettu punastathā| śayane hīne śayane tatra hīne tu devyorhomaṃ samācaret || 144 || utsavañcautsavābhāve kautuke kārayedyadi| prātassandhyārcanānte tu sadyaḥ kautukabandhanam || 145 || kṛtvotsavañca tīrthañca sadya eva samācaret| viṣuvādau viśeṣaḥ viṣuve cāyane cāpi grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ || 146 || karotsavabhṛthaṃ cettatsadyaḥ kautukabandhanam| kṛtvotsavañca tīrthañca latkāle samyagācaret || 147 || atīte tīrthakālaḥ syāt tu vāruṇaṃ skandardevatam| viṣṇusūktaṃ tato hutvā tīrthasnānaṃ samācaret || 148 || madhyāhre tīrthakālaḥ syāt pūrvāheṇa vā guṇānvite| tīrthāntasnapane hīne digdaivatyaṃ savaiṣṇavam || 149 || viṣṇusūktañca hutvā tu punaḥ snapanamācaret| mahāhaviṣi hīne ca viṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 150 || sūktena vaiṣṇavenā'pi prājāpatyena hūyate| punarabhyarcya deveśaṃ nivedyaiva mahāviḥ || 151 || saṃstūya viṣṇusūktena pauruṣeṇa ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ| "kṣamasve" ti ca tairmantrairdadyātpuṣṇāṇi pādayoḥ || 152 || utsavadīkṣāyā māśocābhāvaḥ utsavārthantu devasya pratiṣṭhārthamathāpi vā| kṛte'ṅkurārpaṇe pūrva tattatkarmāvasānataḥ || 153 || naivā'śaucaṃ gurorvidyātsūtakaṃ pretakantu vā| vṛtānamṛtivajāṃ tattatkarmārambhātparaṃ na hi || 164 || tattatkarmāvasānāntamiti pūrvajaśāsanam| jātyuktāśaucabhājaḥ syuḥ kṣatriyādyāśca sarvaśaḥ || 155 || mantravadvaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti dīkṣā ca nānyataḥ| śūdraṇāmapi bhaktānāṃ kṣatriyāṇaṃ viśāmapi || 156 || devakāryābhiyuktānāṃ nāstyevāśaucalāghavam| avatārāṇāmutsavaḥ yadīcchedavatārāṇāmarcanaṃ munisattamāḥ || 157 || pūrveṣāmeva pañcānāmutsavaṃ kalkinastathā| caturṇāmapi śeṣāṇāmutsavaṃ kārayedbhudhaḥ || 158 || teṣāmapi ca vīśāṅkadhvajamāropayediti| dīkṣāviśeṣaḥ utsavārthantu devasya pratiṣṭhā'rthamathāpi vā || 159 || rāṣṭrakṣobhamahotpāta durbhikṣabhayapīḍanaiḥ| evaṃ prakārairvighnaścedutsavasya dinasya vā || taddineśu vyatīteṣu rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati| tasmātsarvaprayatnena dineṣūkteṣu kārayet || taddineṣvardharātre tu yadīcchedutsavaṃ nṛpaḥ| ācāryasyartvijāñcāpi kṣaurakarma vidhīyate || ardharātre'pi kārya syāditi śātātapo'bravīt| devakārye na doṣassyāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || devotsavasya madhye tu tattīrthādūrdhvameva vā| devyutsave viśeṣaḥ devyutsavaṃ vidhānena samyageva samācaret || 160 || pūrvaṃ deveśāmabhayacarya paścāddevyau samarcayet| teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthakkuryādaṅkurārpaṇamutsave || 161 || pūrvarātrau tu deveśaṃ samabhyarcya viśeṣataḥ| suvarṇādimaye pātre taṇḍulopari kautukam || 162 || nyasyālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ grāmamālayameva vā| śirasaiva vahantsamyakkārayitvā pradakṣiṇam || 133 || sannyasya devābhimukhe puṇyāhānte'bhimṛśya ca| baddhvā pratisaraṃ paśyācchayane śāyayettathā || 164 || prātardevaṃ samarbhya saṃsthāpyā'sthānamaṇḍape| strnāpayitvā samabhyarcya prabhūtañca nivedya ca || 165 || alaṅkṛtya ca vastrādyaiḥ bhūṣaṇairvividhairapi| anyamutsavakāloktamutsavaṃ samyagācaret || 166 || punaśca snāpayitvā tu samabhyarcyaṃ nivedayet| anantaradine tasmādalaṅkāraprabhāmapi || 167 || yojayitvotsavaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu pūrvavat| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva jīvasthāne tu sannyaset || 168 || avatārakramātteṣāṃ caturṇāmutsavaṃ caret| yatrālaye'vatārāṇāṃ kriyate nityamarcanam || 169 || avatārākramāttatra kuryā dutsavamatvaraḥ| tadavasthā kramādevamacaryebdahuvigrahaiḥ || 170 || utsavaṃ laukikānāñca kartuṃ bhaktyā yadīcchati| evamevācaretsarvamaṅkurārpaṇakādikam || 171 || laukikeṣvavatāreṣu kriyamāṇe'pi cotsave| nityañcaivautsave bimbe sāyaṃ prātassamācaret || 172 || anyadevotsavaneṣedhaḥ utsave kriyamāṇe tu devadevānāṃ na kuryādutsavaṃ punaḥ || 173 || anyavāstugatānāñca na doṣaścotsave bhavet| aropite dhvaje viṣṇerusavārthantu tatra vai || 174 || arvāktadavasānāttu pratiṣṭhāṃ nācarebdudhaḥ| tadālayetsavāṅgāṃśca sthāpayediti kevaca || 175 || grāme utsavāntaraniṣedhaḥ grāme tatra manuṣyāṇāmutsavaṃ na samācaret || 176 || anyadevotsave viṣṇorutsavo naiva doṣadaḥ| tasyāgneyotsavenaiva dūṣitassaumya utsavaḥ || 177 || grāmavāsināmanyatragamananiṣedhaḥ āropite dhvaje viṣṇorutsavārtha viśeṣataḥ| utsavāvabhṛthātpūrvaṃ sarve tadgrāmavāsinaḥ || 178 || anyatra yadi gacchanti bhavanita vyādhayo dhruvam| bhavanti naiva tadgrāmavāstubāhye nivāsinām || 179 || svapradhānaṃ yadi bhavedutsavasya vidhikrame| viśeṣamatra vakṣyāmi śṛgudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ || 180 || yāgāśālāmalaṅkuryānmadhye vediñca kārayet| ekaṃ kumbhañca sannyasya tatpūrve garuḍaṃ tathā || 181 || dakṣiṇe vāhanañcapi paścime cakrameva ca| uttare viṣvaksenañca kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ || 182 || kumbhe tathaiva devyau ca samāvāhya samarcya ca| parivārapīṭhe taddevān samabhyarcedyathāvidhi || 183 || evameva vidhāne sāyaṃ prātadiṃne dine| kumbhavedyāntu tat prācyāṃ tattadagniṃ prakalpayet || 184 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ khiloktavat | ityorṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāthāṃ kriyādhikāre mahotsavaprāyaścittavidhirnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
<27> oṃ saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ aspṛśyapraveśaprāyaśritam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tapodhanāḥ| caṇḍālasūtikodakyāpatitapratilomajaiḥ || 1 || garbhālaye praviṣṭe taiḥ spṛṣṭe bimbe tathaiva ca| saptarātraṃ mahāśāntimabjāgnau juhuyāttataḥ || 2 || jalādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā jaṅgamānāṃ tathaiva ca| dhruvaśuddhiñca kṛtvā tu pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 3 || śūdrairvā'thānulomairvā spṛṣṭe bimbe tathaiva ca| śatāṣṭakalaśaissnāpya pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 4 || śvakukkuṭavarāhāṇāṃ sṛgālānāṃ praveśane| sparśane ca tathā teṣāṃ śāntihomaṃ juhoti ca || 5 || punaḥ pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret| caṇḍālādipraveśe tu prathamāvareṇe yadi || 6 || vāstuhomaṃ hutṛvā śāntihomaṃ juhoti ca| aṣṭottaraśatairdevaṃ kalaśaiḥ strnāpayettathā || 7 || dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva snapanaṃ syācchatāṣṭabhiḥ| śānitaṃ hutvā tṛtīye tu caturviśatibhistathā || 8 || strnāpayitvā tu kalaśaiḥ samabhyarcya nivedayet| caturthāvaraṇe cettu vaiṣṇavaṃ tvekaviṃśatim || 9 || hutvā tu saptakalaśaisstrnāpayitvā samarcayet| pañcamāvamaṇe cettu daśakṛtvastu vaiṣṇavam || 10 || hutvā tu pañcakalaśaisstrnāpayitvā samarcayet| tattatprakārapariṣaddaivatyaṃ viṃśatiṃ yajet || 11 || ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇa evāpi kalaśaireva saptabhiḥ| snāpayitvā tu vidhivatpuṇyāhamapi vācayet || 12 || saptamāvaraṇe cettu sarvasañcāra iṣyate| vīthyāmeṣāṃ praveśe tu na doṣo bhṛgurabravīt || 13 || parivārālayāntaścetteṣāṃ strnapanamācaret| bahiścecchatakṛtvastu tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam || 14 || hutvā tu saptakalaśaisstrnāpayediti śāsanam| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śuddhissarvatra kīrtitā || 15 || devālayasamīpe tu pratilomaniveśane| arcayeddevadevantaṃ mahādapi na jātucit || 16 || tatprākārānuṣaktañcenmahādoṣo bhavettataḥ| rāṣṭrasya yajamānasya grāmasya ca mahadbhayam || 17 || apanīya tu cacchīghraṃ saptarātraṃ yathāvidhi| mahāśāntiñca hutvā tu pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 18 || śatadaṇḍāntare caiva pratilomaniveśanam| caṇḍalapulkasānāñca krośādūrdhva prakalpayet || 19 || mṛtiprāyaścittam garbhālaye tu maraṇe prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyate| caṇḍālādipraveśe tu yaduktaṃ tatsamācaret || 20 || prathamāvaraṇe cettu tattathaiva samīritam| śālānuṣaktaśālāsu bahirmaraṇasambhave || 21 || tathaiva maraṇe caiva mahāśāntiṃ sakṛdyajet| saṃstrnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ samabhyarcya nivedayet || 22 || gṛhītvā''dhāvamajñānādantaḥ sthāśavakūpake| arcayedyadi tatpakvaṃ haviścāpi nivedayet || 23 || vaiṣṇavañca śataṃ hutvā 'yaddevādi' samanvitam| snāpayitvā tu kalaśaissamabhyarcya nivedayet || 24 || maṇḍapādīnāṃ agnidāhai anyathā cenmahādoṣa iti pūrvajadarśanam| maṇḍape gopure caiva prapāyāñca tathaiva ca || 25 || agnidāhe mahāśāntiṃ hutvā saṃsnāpayeddharim| vastrādīnāṃ dāhe garbhālaye'gnidāhe tu vastre mālye ca bhūṣaṇe || 26 || bimbe āgrispṛṣṭe devabimbe'gnisaṃsparśe tacchīghraṃ vyapanīya ca| saptarātraṃ mahāśāntiṃ gandhodaiḥ snapanaṃ caret || 27 || pratiṣṭhāñca punaḥ kṛtvā samabhyarcya nivedayet| aginā beranāśe beranāśe'gnidāhena tabdreramapanīya ca || 28 || māsamekaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hutvā garbhālaye punaḥ| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvopalipya ca || 29 || bimbamanyatsamādāya pratiṣṭhāmācaretpunaḥ| dārāvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ beraṃ dhūmākrāntaṃ pararyijet || 30 || jvālākrānta tathā śailaṃ santyajetpeśalaṃ yadi| bhinne ghaṭe ghaṭākāśaṃ yathā''kāśe pralīyate || 31 || beranāśe tathā śaktirviśvaṃ vyāpyaiva tiṣṭhati| grahasthānaṃ kalpayitvā pahmāgnau ca tathā''laye || 32 || mahāśāntiñca pahmāgnau hutvā tatrāṣṭadikṣu ca| tattadgrahāgnikuṇḍeṣu grahaśāntiṃ juhāti ca || 33 || tattaddaivatyamantraśya madhyāgnau pāñcabhautikam| hutvā bimbaṃ samāsādya 'namo brahmaṇa' īrya ca || 34 || 'namo vāce' samuccārya kumbhatoyaṃ spṛśan japet| prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣayedgrāmaṃ pradakṣiṇavaśena ca || 35 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ samabhyarcya nivedayet| tasmātpunaḥ pratiṣṭhāntaṃ sthaṇḍile nityamarcayet || 36 || vimbe sarpaspṛṣṭe sarpasaṃsparśane bimbe garbhagehapraveśane| vastramālyādi saṃśodhya śuddhodairabhiṣicya ca || 37 || kuryācchuddhiṃ pratiṣṭhoktāṃ dhruvaberasya pūrvavat| ucchiṣṭādisparśe ucchiṣvaśucisaṃspṛṣṭe bimbe pūrvoktavaccaret || 38 || anadhikāribhiḥ sparśe evaṃ viprairathānyaistu kramāddvitricaturguṇaiḥ| strnāpayedveśyasaṃsparśe śatāṣṭakalaśairvibhum || 39 || catvāriṃśādbhiraṣṭābhiḥ nṛpairabhiṣecitaiḥ| arcakānyadvijaisspṛṣṭe śuddhodairabhiṣecayet || 40 || abhiṣiktakṣatriyaistu sarvaṃ brāhmaṇavaccaret| mahāpātakisaṃsparśe prevaśe ca tapodhanāḥ || 41 || ācāretpratilomoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi| ekaberakalpe vimbanāśe ekabere tathā jīrṇe hīnāṅge ca tapodhanāḥ || 42 || yathālābhena mānena dāravaṃ beramāharet| tasmindevaṃ samāvāhya vālasthāne samarcayet || 43 || bālālaye tayorekaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet| navīkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāmācarediti || 46 || ekaberañca lohañceccoraśatrubhayādibhiḥ| tatrārcanamayuktaṃ tacchailaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra ca || 47 || lauhamautsavabairañca kalpayediti śāsanam| garbhālayasthalabhraṃśe garbhālayasthalabhraṃśe valmīkādisamudbhave || 48 || kumbhaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā saṃsthāpyā'vāhya tatra vai| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vaiṣṇavaṃ mūrtibhistathā || 49 || bālālayoktadeśeṣu sannyasya mukhamaṇḍape| tatra nityārcanaṃ kurvannavīkuryātsthalaṃ dṛḍham || 50 || pratiṣṭhāvidhinā bimbe kumbhādāvāhayetpunaḥ| garbhālayagatān devān kumbhasya parito'rcayet || 51 || pūrvoktadoṣasaṃyuka dhruvabere viśeṣataḥ| śīghraṃ bālālayaṃ kuryāduktadeśe yathāvidhi || 52 || anukalpaḥ alpadoṣayutañcetu bālāgāraṃ na kārayet| tadvimṛbasaṃsthitāṃ śaktiṃ kumbhe samyaṅniveśya ca || 53 || kumbhaṃ bimbaṃ samādāya madhyasūtrāttu dakṣiṇe| maṇḍape vā'ntarāle vā mālikāyāmathāpi vā || 54 || vidhinā tatra snnyasyadvādaśāhāntamarcayet| dvādaśāhātparañcetu bālagāraṃ prakalpayet) || 55 || bālālasyābhimukhe yāgaśālā prakalpayet| śayyāvediñca pañcāgnikuṇḍāni paristathā || 56 || śayyāvedyāstu pūrvasyāmekaṃ vai sabhyameva vā| kalpayitvā tu pūrvedyuḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca || 57 || bālālayasyottarato vāstuhomaṃ tadā yajet| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ bālāgārañca śodhayet || 58 || yāgaśālāñca sarvatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpunaḥ| rātripūjāvasāne tu devadevaṃ samarcya ca || 59 || havirnivedya vidhinā 'kṣamasve' ti praṇamya ca| bālālayasthāpanākramaḥ tataḥ praṇīya nityāgniṃ kuṇḍeṣvāghāramācaret || 60 || saṃsādhya pūrvavatkumbhaṃ devāgre tu yamāntare| dhānyapīṭhe susannyasya prārthayitvā tu pūrvavat || 61 || devaṃ kumbhe samavāhya dhruvaberādyathāvidhi| garbhālayagatān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān || 62 || sopānasaṃthitān devāṃstatkumbhāmbhasi saṃsmaret| vimānañcaiva jīrṇañcennyakṣādīścaturastathā || 63 || pīṭhe'rcyamānapariṣaddevāniti ca kecana| kumṛbhaṃ bimbaṃ samādāya strnānaśvebhre niveśya ca || 64 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairbaddhvā pratisaraṃ tathā| śāyayitvā tathā hautraṃ dakṣiṇāgnau praśaṃsati || 65 || tadālayagatān devān samāvahyaiva pūrvavat| āvāhanakrameṇaiva nirupyājyāhutīryajet || 66 || parito yāgaśālāntu paribārān samarcayet| pratiṣṭhoktakrameṇaiva homakarma samācaret || 67 || vyāhṛtyā pariṣanmantrān danniṇāṃgnau juhīti vai| vinaiva sarvadaivatṛyaṃ sabhyahomaṃ juhoti ca || 68 || nṛtairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayetkramāt| prātassnātvāvidhānena sūktāni ca tathā japet || 69 || arcāpīṭhaṃ prakurvīta brāhme bālālaye tathā| ratnanyāsaṃ vinā pīṭhe cararāśau viśeṣataḥ || 70 || sthāpayitvā'grataḥ kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe susannyaset| āvāhya kautuke kumbhāttasmādevautsavārcayoḥ || 71 || garbhālayagatān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān| tattatsthāne samāvāhya devān sopānagānapi || 72 || puṇyāhaṃ vācasitvā tu pūjayitvā yathāvidhi| harvīṣi pañcadhā datvā nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 73 || āvāhanavisargau dvau nācarettaruṇālaye| nityakuṇḍe praṇīyāgniṃ nityahomaṃ samācaret || 74 || bālālaye snānaśālādikalpanam strnanapānīyaśāle ca tathaiva snapanālayam| puṣpasañcayaśālāñca dravyasambhāramaṇḍapam || 75 || yāgaśālāṃ dhvajasthānaṃ bhūtapīṭhaṃ mahānasam| pūrvavatkārayedvidvān prathamāvaraṇe tathā || 76 || dvitīyāvaraṇe cettu bhūtapīṭhaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā| bālalayasyābhimukhe kuryādevaṃ yathāvidhi || 77 || kārayetparitassarva tṛtīyāvaraṇe yadi| eṣa eva viśeṣassyādanyatsarvaṃ khiloktavat || 78 || tantrasaṅkaraniṣkṛtiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tantrasaṅkaraniṣkṛtim| viṣṇostantraṃ dvidhā proktaṃ saumyāgneyameva ca || 79 || vaikhānasaṃ pāñcarātraṃ vaidikaṃ tāntrikaṃ kramāt| dvayorvaikhānasaṃ śreṣṭhamaihikāmuṣmikapradam || 80 || tāntrikaṃ pāñcarātrantu gauṇamāmuṣimakapradam| vidhistu vedamūnalaśca dīkṣāyuktaśca tāntrikaḥ || 81 || pāñcarātramapi proktaṃ śuddhaṃ miśramiti dvidhā| śuddhaṃ bhāgavataṃ proktaṃ pāñcarātramathetarat || 82 || pūjayecchuddhamārgeṇa sūto vā sāttvato'thavā| utsṛṣṭasūtrā viprādya dīkṣitā miśrapūjakāḥ || 83 || niṣekādyāḥ kiyāsteṣā tattattantreṣu coditāḥ| yā'bhavanmilitāvasthā vedānāṃ vyasanātpurā || 84 || tāntu vaikhānasīṃ śākhāṃ vadanti brahmapāragāḥ| tāntu vaikhānasarīṃ śākhāmādāvadhyāpayatprabhuḥ || 85 || nāmnā vikhanasaṃ pāhuryañca vaikhānasaṃ tathā| ṛṣīṇāṃ so'bravītsūtraṃ dharma samanubodhayan || 86 || ṛṣayo bahusūtrāṇi cakrustasyānusārataḥ| kecidvarṇāśramān dharmān vadanti smṛtirūpataḥ || 87 || athāgnau nityahomānte sāyaṃ prātaratandritaḥ| viṣṇornityārcanaṃ kuryātsavardadevārcanantu tat || 88 || iti vaikhānase sūtre proktaṃ yaṅkṣepato'rcanam| ṛṣibhistadupanyāso vistṛtaśca samantataḥ || 89 || bahuprayogo vyākhyāto lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā| kāśyapenātriṇā caiva mayā caiva marīcinā || 90 || so'yaṃ tatsūtramūlatvādvidhirvaikhānasassmatṛḥ| vaikṣānasena vidhinā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 91 || arcane kriyamāṇe tu pāñcarātreṇa saṅkare| grāmaśya yajamānaśca rājā rāṣṭrañca naśyati || 92 || pakṣamekaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hutvā taddoṣaśāntaye| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu tatra pañcaśatāvarān || 93 || vaikhānasena vidhinā pratiṣṭhāpyārcayetpunaḥ| januyukteṣu sarveṣu grāmādiṣu ca vāstuṣu || 94 || nārāyaṇaṃ devadevaṃ pāñcarātreṇa nārcayet| vaikhānasena vidhinā pūjayetsarvasampade || 95 || grāmabāhye vivikte vā nadītīre bane'cale| vaikhānasena didhinā pāñcarātreṇa vā'rcayet || 96 || pāñcarātreṇa vidhinā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi| kriyamāṇe'rcane māsamekaṃ hīnārcanaṃ yadi || 97 || pāñcarātre tathā''gneye saumyasyāsya praveśanam| yadīcchetkārayedbhaktyā saumyaṃ tacca bhaviṣyati || 18 || saptarātraṃ mahāśānitaṃ pauṇḍarīke juhoti ca| brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 99 || tattanmantrajapaṃ kuryādbhūparīkṣādi karmaṇām| nayanonmīlanādīnāmuktahomaṃ juhoti ca || 100 || jalādhivāsaṃ kurvīta jaṅgamānāntu pūrvavat| dhruvaberoditāṃ śuddhiṃ dhruvabere samācaret || 101 || vaikhānasena vidhinā pratiṣṭhāpya punaḥ kramāt| arcanādīni sarvāṇi vidhinā tena kārayet || 102 || yadīcchecchuddhapūjāyāṃ saumyasyāsya praveśānam| pakṣamekaṃ mahāśāntiṃ hutvā śeṣañca pūrvavat || 103 || sthāpayitvā'rcanādīni kārayediti śāsanam| avicchinnārcane cā'pi miśre grāmādivāstuṣu || 104 || vaikhānasena vidhinā pratiṣṭhāpyārcayediti| krūraiḥ śaivādividhibhirajñānātsaṅkare sati || 105 || māsemakaṃ mahāśanti hutvā viprasahasrakam| bhojayitvā tu saumyena pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet || 106 || sarveṣāmanyadevānāṃ tantrasaṅgaraniṣkṛtau| eṣa eva vidhiḥ prokta iti pūrvajaśāsanam || 107 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre aspṛśyasparśanatantrasaṅkaraprāyaścittavidhirnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<28> oṃ aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ pātrāṇāṃ saṃskāraḥ pātrāṇāmarcanāṅgānāṃ navānāṃ dvijasattamāḥ| vakṣyāmi śuddhisaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ samyagācaret || 1 || lauhānāmardhyapātrāṇāṃ haviḥ pātrasya caiva hi| tathā''camanapātrāṇāṃ pādyārthānāṃ tathaiva ca || 2 || snānāvāhanapātrāṇāṃ balipātrasya caiva hi| nīrājanārthapātrāṇāṃ dhūpadīpārthapātrayoḥ || 3 || sahasradhārāpātrasya śaṅkhapadmāṅkapātrayoḥ| lauhānāṃ kalaśādīnāṃ tripādānāṃ tathaiva ca || 4 || salakṣaṇāni kṛtvaitānyadbhirmṛdbhiśca śodhayet| vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā || 5 || pañcagavyokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dhānyapīṭhopari nyaset| tattaddevāṃtsamāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet || 6 || āvāhanādipātrāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ varuṇo'dhipaḥ| śaṅkhānāṃ pūrvamevoktā arcanāyāntu devatāḥ || 7 || ardhyapānīyapātrāṇāṃ soma evādhidaivatam| haviḥpātrādhipo bhānuḥ dhūpapātre bṛhaspatiḥ || 8 || dīpanīrājanārthānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ śrīrudāhṛtā| sahasradhārāpātre tu prakṛtiḥ karṇikāntare || 9 || dalāṣṭake'ṣṭaiśvaryāṇi caturvedāstu tatra ca| śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjyau śaṅkhapadmaṅkapātrayoḥ || 10 || ghaṇṭāyāṃ pūrvamevoktānadhidervātsamāhvayet| pātrāṇāṃ karakādīnāṃ tripādānāṃ tathaiva ca || 11 || mahābhūtāni pañcaiva skandaśca kalaśādhipaḥ | ityuktān sarvapātrāṇāmadhidevāṃtsamarcacet || 12 || śayanāsanayānānā saṃskāraḥ śayanāsanayānānā saskārañca vadāmyaham| śayyāṃ khaṭvāsane pīṭhaṃ ratharaṅgaṃ tathaiva ca || 13 || śibikāñcaiva yānāni tāni kṛtvā yathāvidhi| aupāsanāgnimādhāya vāstuhomaṃ yajettataḥ || 14 || paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ śodhayitvā tu pūrvavat| dharma jñānamathaiśvaryaṃ vairāgyamiti vai pṛthak || 15 || śayanāsanayānānāṃ pādānāmadhidevatāḥ| śayanādhipatiśśeṣo dharma evā'sanādhipaḥ || 16 || yānānāmapi sarveṣāṃ garuḍastvadhidevatā| kumbhe tu sādhite samyak dhyātvā vai tattadīśvarān || 17 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ dhānyopari niveśya ca| baddhvā pratisaraṃ pāde pūrvasminneva dakṣiṇe || 18 || tāṃstān devāṃtsaprāvāhya hautrakarmāvasānake| āvāhanakrameṇā'jyaṃ nirupyājyāhutīryajet || 19 || tattaddaivatyamantrāṃstu satamaṣṭottaraṃ yajetam| tattanmūrtibhirāvāhya tattatproktādhidevatāḥ || 20 || aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya devamāropayetpunaḥ| arcayedāsane yāne kuryāddhāmapradakṣiṇam || 21 || śayane śāyayedevaṃ pūjeyedvā yathāvidhi| anyāni sarvapātrāṇi śodhayecca yathocitam || 22 || pracchannapaṭasya sūtādipratilomāśca pāṣaṇḍāḥ patitāstathā| nāstikā bhinnamaryādāstathā vai vedadūṣakāḥ || 23 || pāparogayutāścaiva tathaiva gurunindakāḥ| arcanaṃ devadevasya havirdāñca vīkṣitum || 24 || nārhanti tasmātkurvīta dvāraṃ yavanikāvṛtam| mahāpātakināñcāpi sannidhiṃ parivarjayet || 25 || tasmāddavārasamāyāmaṃ kuryādyavanikāpaṭam| dvāraṃ yavanikācchannamakṛtvā pūjayedyadi || 26 || hutvā taddvāvāradaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīryajet| devedavañca saṃsnāpya samabhyarcyaṃ nivedayet || 27 || pūjādravyādhidevārcāmakṛtvā pūjayedyadi| hutvā taddvāradaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīryajet || 28 || dravyādhidevatāpūjāṃ kṛtvā taireva pūjayet| uktakāle tu sampūrṇe kuryādvai dvārabandhanam || 29 || na kuryādyadi mohena sandhyānte dvārabandhanam| uddhāṭane tadā'kāle tasya doṣasya śāntaye || 30 || vaiṣṇavaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇūsūktaṃ tathaiva ca| tattatsandhyādhidaivatyaṃ hutvā kuryācca bandhanam || 31 || prātassandhyendradaivatyā mādhyāhrī ravidaivatā| tathā varuṇadaivatyā sāyaṃsandhā prakīrtitā || 32 || pakvaṃ grahaṇavelāyāṃ grahaṇātpūrvameva vā| havirnivedayennaiva yadi mohānnivedayet || 33 || pīḍyate tu jagatsarvamādhivyādhyādyupadravaiḥ| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇuktañca mantrāṃśca grahadaivatān || 34 || navīkaraṇe viśeṣavidhayaḥ hutvā saṃsnāpya deveśaṃ samabhyarcya nivedayet| erkaveravimānānāṃ pauruṣāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 35 || tathaivodhdṛtabimbānāṃ jīrṇānāntu punaḥ kṛtau| pūrvapramāṇādadhikaṃ yadi kuryānna doṣakṛṃt || 36 || pādānuguṇamevaitatparito vardhayettathā| pūrvaṃ mṛdālayaṃ yattaddiṣṭakādiprakalpane || 37 || parito vardhayitvaiva kārayedālaye tathā| prākārāṇāntu jīrṇānāṃ punassandhānakarmaṇi || 38 || athavā mṛṇmayānāñca yadi vṛddhiṃ tathecchati| parito vārdhayedevaṃ prācyudīcyorathāpi vā || 39 || yadyagre grāmavīthī syāttisṛṣvāśāsu sardhayet| śālānāṃ maṇḍapānāñca pārśvayoragratastathā || 40 || vṛddhiṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa prācyudīcyorathāpi vā| udīcyāmagnrataścaiva vardhayetpacanālayam || 41 || ekatassaṅkaṭañcettu nadīsāgaraparvataiḥ| vardhayedanyapārśveṣu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 42 || dakṣiṇāparavṛddhiścetkṣemassyāttu na jātucit| prākāramaṇḍapādīnāṃ sālānāṃ na samāharet || 43 || maṇḍapādiṣu sarveṣu hīnadravyakṛteṣu ca| nyūnaṃ vā'pyadhikaṃ vā'pi kārayeddeśikottamaḥ || 44 || mukhyadravyakṛtaṃ yattu nyūnaṃ vā'pyadhikaṃ na ca| kārayeccettadajñānādyajamāno vinaśyati || 45 || tasmātsarvaprayaṃtnena yathāpūrvaṃ samācaret| mahānasottare vā'tha kuryādabhimukhe tathā || 46 || taṭākādikalpanam devālayasyābhimukhe taṭākaṃ parikalpayet| taṭākamānaṃ piścatya rajjunā''yādi śodhayet || 47 || tatāhatāyatenaiva kuryādāyādiśodhanam| nāhena tithivārau ca kalpayediti śāsanam || 48 || vṛttārdhaṃ tena cāhṛtya kūpasyāyādiśodhanam| sarvārāmopakāryāṇāmagre vāpīṃ prakalpayet || 49 || atha teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃskāraṃ munisattamāḥ| vāpīkūpataṭākānāṃ taṭamaśmeṣṭakādibhiḥ || 50 || dṛḍhamābadhdyakāṣṭhāsu sopānakramasaṃyutam| daśāhe tu tato'tīte vāstuhomaṃ tato yajet || 51 || paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyena śaṃśodhayet| tantunā kumbhamāveṣṭya nādeyajalapūritam || 52 || tīrthamṛttoyasauvarṇakūrmayādassamujjvalam| kuśakūrcākṣatopetaṃ puṇyuṣpopaśobhitam || 53 || dhānyapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya vastrayugmena veṣṭya ca| 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' di mantrāṇāmanuvākadvayaṃ japet || 54 || 'namo vāce' samuccārya 'śanno vāta' itīrya ca| 'āpo vā ida' mityuktvā mantrairvedādibhistathā || 55 || abhimantrya ca tatkumbhaṃ tasminvaruṇamarcayet| 'āpo vā ida' mityuktvā kumbhatoyantu tatpunaḥ || 56 || vāpīkūpataṭākeṣu prāṅmukhaḥ prakṣipeduguruḥ| evaṃ kṛtvā tatastoyamupayuñjīta karmasu || 57 || anyathā yadi kuryāttu prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate| mahāśāntiṃ sakṛddhutvā pratiṣṭhāṃ punarācaret || 58 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre pātrasaṃskāravidhirnāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<29> oṃ ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ mahāśāntividhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāśāntividhiṃ param| sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ sarvavyādhibhayāpaham || 1 || sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam| āyurārogyadaṃ kartuḥ śāntipuṣṭisukhapradam || 2 || mahādoṣeṣu sarvatra mahāśāntirvidhīyate| ālayābhimukhe kuryātpauṇḍarīkaṃ salakṣaṇam || 3 || dakṣiṇasyāmathāgneyyāṃ pacanālaya eva vā| alaṅkatya caturdikṣu pūrṇakumbhāṅkuradhvajaiḥ || 4 || kadalīkramukaiścaiva muktādāmāvalambanaiḥ| māsaṃ pakṣañca saptāhaṃ tridinantu vā || 5 || ekāhaṃ vā'tha saṅkalpya doṣāṇāṃ gurulāghavam| jñātvā tadanurūpāṇi dināni juhuyātkramāt || 6 || āghārānte suhotavye sūkte vaiṣṇavapauruṣe| rudrasūktaṃ tato hutvā dhātādīn juhuyātkramāt || 7 || 'namo vāce' samuccārya 'śanno vāta' itīrya ca| nārāyaṇāya vidme' ti tathā ṣaḍbhiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 8 || ājyena sājyacaruṇā samidhā ca ghṛtā'ktayā| saktulājitilāpūpaiḥ ghṛtamiśrairyathākramam || 9 || saṃsnāpya kalaśairdevaṃ samabhyarcya nivedayet| trikālamuttamo homo rātrihīnaśca madhyamaḥ || 10 || sāyaṃpratāśce hīnaścedadhamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| pūrvoktasarvadravyauścāpyuttame juhuyādbudhaḥ || 11 || ājyena sājyacaruṇā madhyame juhuyātkramāt| adhame kevalājyena pratarmadhyāhra eva vā || 12 || uttame snapanaṃ nityaṃ madhyame kevalārcanam| adhame kevalaṃ homa iti provāca pūrvajaḥ || 13 || rakṣedagnimavicchinnaṃ yāvatkarmāvasānakam| antahomaṃ samāptau ca kṛtvā viprāśca bhojayet || 14 || atiśāntiḥ dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau| yaddevādiyutatve tu atiśāntiriti smṛtā || 15 || adbhataśānitaḥ sāmānyaśāntiḥ navagrahādhidaivatyairyuktā cedabhutā'hvayā| sāmānyaśāntirityuktā yuktā sā cejjayādibhiḥ || 16 || utpātaśāntiḥ dvādaśāṣṭākṣarābhyāñca śatāhutirathāpi vā| utpataśāntirityuktā tathā viṣṇornukādibhiḥ || 17 || śāntiḥ mahāśāntiḥ
