athavā śāntirityuktā kevalaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śatam| mahāśāntariti proktā yaddevādisamanvitā || 18 || iti ṣaṭcchāntayaḥ proktāḥ sarvadoṣopaśośaṣaṇāḥ| alpadoṣe yajecchāntiṃ sarvatrāpi ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 19 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇāvīṃ punaḥ| 'śanno mitra' itītyuktvā tathā viṣṇornukādibhiḥ || 20 || aṣṭhāśītiḥ viṣṇave svastidāyeti tathā sarveśvarāya ca| viṣṇave sarvagoptre ca tathā sarvātmane'pi ca || sarvadevātmane ceti sarvavedātmane tathā| munīnāmātmane ceti yogasandhāraṇāya ca || tathā sarvapratiṣṭhāya viṣṇuśabdādayo daśa| viṣṇuśabdena tatra syātprayuktaṃ sarvamatra tu || nārāyaṇāya ca tathā tadādyenātmane punaḥ| sarvadevātmane tadvadindrarūpāya vai tathā || saṃyamanādhipataye sambhogapataye tathā| sarvatṛptipradāyeti anantātmane ca kramāt || brahmeśānātmane ceti prajāpaya ityapi| anantaśayanāyeti daśa nārāyaṇādayaḥ || puṇyanārāyaṇāyeti tridaśādhipataye tathā| vaṭapatraśāyine ceti tathā vaṭākṣavāsine || tathā pādārciṣe ceti bālarūpāya vai punaḥ| māyārūpiṇa ityuktvā prabodhina iti bruvan || sarvādhiṣṭhānakāyeti sarvapravaraṇāya ca| mūrdhasthānāyeti daśa puṇyanārāṇādayaḥ || bālāya bālarūpāya tathā vaṭapatraśāyine| satyāya satyaniṣṭhāya tathā satyātmane punaḥ || satyanityāya caṃtyukvā devadevamanusmaran| sarve satyaṃ hi satyasya satye satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || caturthyantamanenaiva sarvalokapravartine| tathā satyātmadevāya satyamodāya vai punaḥ || satyasopānakāyeti devadevamanusmaran| daśa tvaṃ satye satyātman satyaniṣṭhodbhavāya ca || puruṣāya tathā puruṣasaṃstutāyeti ca kramāt| puruṣasamadhītāyeti pusṣaniṣdāya vai punaḥ || puruṣātmane vai puruṣapuruṣāyeti coccaran| jaganmitrāya jagadādhārāya ca tataḥ param || jagatpravartine ceti jagaddhetave cetyapi| catvāraḥ puruṣāyeti viṣṇukrīḍātmane punaḥ || bhūmisaṅkīḍātmana iti jaganmodāya vai punaḥ| jagaddhitāya cetyuktvā tathā nikhuryapāya ca || kāya kasmai katamasmai sarvasmai viṣṇave tathā| viṣṇave ca tathā brūyāt mantrasandruhaṇāya ca || dhruvarūpiṇā ityuktvā saṃvṛtātmana ityapi| samprītikarāyeti sarvaśubhapradāya ca || aśubhanāśanāyeti śubhasambarhaṇāya ca| puṇyāyeti tato hutvā puṇyaśabdādayo'pare || balorjitāya hutvā tu devadevamanusmaran| tathā jayasamṛddhāya kāmāndajananāya ca || sarvānandāya cetyuktvā samṛddhāya tataḥ param| śrīvidhānāya cetyuktvā brahmasandruhaṇāya ca || varasthānāya cetyuktvā lokasamṛbhāvanāya ca| adbhutāya yajetpaścādanādinidhanāya ca || tathā'mitamahimneti tathā'tyantahitāya ca| caturthyantena tenaiva sarvapratiṣṭhāyeti ca || sarvalokapratiṣṭhāya sarvalokaśubhāvahāya ca| sarvātṛmana iti proktā aṣṭādaśa samīritāḥ || viṣṇurnārāyaṇaścaiva puṇyanārāyaṇastathā| puṇyaśceti caturthyantān vyastāneva prayojayet || athavā viṣṇugāyatryā āṣṭāśītyāhutīryajet| viṣṇugāyatriyā sākaṃ yatrāṣṭāśītirīritā || na tatra viṣṇugāyatryā tvaṣṭāśītyāhutīryajet| aṅgahomaḥ aṅgahomaṃ tato vakṣye nibodhata tapodhanāḥ || śirase ca tato'kṣibhyāṃ karṇābhyāmiti coccaran| nāsikābhyāmathauṣṭhābhyāṃ dantebhyau juhuyādbudhaḥ || jihvāyai kaṇṭhāyorase bāhubhyāmiti ca kramāt| koṣṭhābhyāñcaiva pāṇibhyāṃ nakhebhya udarāya ca || kaṭaye ca tathorubhyāṃ jaṅkhābhṛyāmipi hūyate| lomabhyāṃ makuṭāyeti śiraścakrāya cai punaḥ || śaṅkhāyaiva ca cakrāya gadāyai ca tataḥ param| śārṅgāyāsaya ityuktvā cāmbarāyeti hūyatām || bhūṣaṇebhyaḥ prabhāyai ca chatrāya ca juhoti vai| dadbhyaḥsvāhādibhirmantrairhutvā tattadanusmaran || maulimālādihomaḥ maulimālāyai divyāya cottarāya tataḥ tataparam| sarvottarāya sarvasmai viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave || tvaṃ yajñapuruṣāyeti praṇavāya ca viṣṇave| śirase juhuyātpaścāttathaiva prabhaviṣṇave || divyāya suvahāyeti kāya kasmai tataḥ param| tameva viṣṇave ceti nikhuryapāya caiva hi || dhruvasmāya cetyuktvā lalāṭāya ca viṣṇave| bhrūbhyāmantarikṣāyeti saprāṇātmabhūve tathā || śrotrābhyāṃ sañjuhotyante pakṣamabhyāmiti coccaran| sañjuhotyakṣyaṅgabhyaśca akṣibhyāmiti dūyate || tārakābhyāmapāṅgābhyāṃ kuvalayābhyāṃ tathaiva ca| yugābhyāñca kapolābhyāṃ tattadaṅgamanusmaran || juhoti nāsikāyai ca puṭābhyāmiti tṛṣṇave | aṇḍābhyāmiti dantebhyaḥ koṣṭhābhyāmapi hūyate || nimnebhyaścādhāroṣṭāya jihvāyai ca tataḥ param| suvaktrāyai ca juhuyāttālave viṣṇave punaḥ || hanubhyāṃ karṇapālibhyāṃ chatrābhyā kīkasāya ca || grīvāyai kanakāyeti supragrīvāya vai tathā| kaṇṭhanālāya kaṇṭhāya karṇanālāya hūyatām || dyauḥ śirase ca hutvā tu tathā dyaurakṣakāya ca| sarvādhiṣṭhānakāyeti tathā prāṇāśrayāya ca || keśebhyaśśirase ceti juhuyātpuṇyavāsine| āhubhyo dikprabandhebhyassarvakṣatrārṇakāya ca || sarvadeśaśarīrebhyaḥ sarvaprāṇalayāya ca| sarvaduḥkhaviyogebhyaḥ || calebhyassarvalokānāṃ duḥkhatrāṇebhya ityapi| kaṇchāya kaṇṭhanālībhyaḥ kandāya ca tataḥ param || pṛṣṭhāgrulakāyaiva bāhubhyo'ṣṭābhya ityapi| kīkasebhyaḥ korparebhya kaniṣṭhābhyastathaiva ca| sarvebhyaśca nakhebhyaśca vartinībhya iti bruvan| jatrubhyāṃ tāṭyadeśāya pārśvamūlebhya ityapi || pārśvābhyāmurase hutṛvā bhallakāya tataḥ param| urasyāya śirasyāya bāhumuktāya hūyām || hṛdayāya puṇḍarīkāya cittāya ca tataḥ param| cittebhya ākūtāyeti ākūtibhyaśca hūyatām || tarkāya tarkavāsibhyo mataye prabalāya ca| kīkase sākṣavāsābhyaḥ sūryāya viṣṇucakṣuṣe || vāmāya somanetrāya viṣṇave prabudhāya ca| atalāyādilāyeti mahābījāya mahātmane || ātmane ceti hutvā tu tathā sarvātmane budhaḥ| sarvodānāya lokānāṃ vyāptaye tṛptaye tathā || juhotyaprakṛtirūpāya samānāya yamāya ca| sarvasya sāmarupāya juhuyātprāṇibandhane || tattadaṅgamanusmṛtya śirastastu juhoti ca| juhoti romakūpebhyaḥ āntrāyeti tathaiva ca || āntrarūpāya juhuyādāntrasañcāraṇāya ca| divasāya kaṇṭhanityāya nityabandhāya vai punaḥ || bandhobdandhanaspāya stanābhyā mandakāya ca| marmabhyaśca pramarmabhyaḥ pārśvasthadhiṣaṇāya ca || sampattibhyaḥ kumārībhyaḥ puṇḍarīkāya vai punaḥ| nābhaye hṛllasāyeti nāsāyai ceti hūyatām || ārdrāya vartitāyeti juhuyāttamanusmaran| aniruddhāya dṛṣate vatsalāyeti hūyatām || tathā yakṛtplīhābhyāñca mukundāya tathaiva ca| nyastāyeti varāyeti corvarāya tataḥ param || tathaivodarabandhāya nāḍībhyāmiti coccaran| vāsibhyaścaiva vastubhyo vastimuṣkāya vai punaḥ || prajanāya janitṛbhyaḥ śroṇībhyāmiti vai punaḥ| tāṭikāyai ca vaṃśāya vaṃśadhāribhya eva ca || prajāpataya ityuktvā viṣṇave ceti hūyatām| śukrāya śukravāsibhyaḥ ūrubhyāmiti coccaran || sirābhyaścāsthibandhebhyo mukhebhyaśceti hūyate| tvagāsthibhyaśca hutvā tu juhuyācca tataḥ param || rūpa spebhya ityuktvā prasebhya urasāya ca| raktāya raktavāsibhyo medase ca tathā punaḥ || jīvāya tāstanañcava cāsthimajjāya vai punaḥ| juhuyānmajjāvāsibhya uttamāṅgāya vai punaḥ || dhātave caiva dhātubhyaḥ dhāturūpebhya ityapi| juhuyādupadhātubhyaḥ pārśvatvaca iti bruvan || sarvarūpayā grīvāyai dhanadāya dhanātmane| sarveśvarāya yajñāya puruṣāyeti hūyatām || yatrāṅgahomo vihitastvakṣayunmeṣādikarmasu| tatraivamevaṃ juhuyāditi pūrvajaśāsanam || sarvasya sāmyarūpāya svāhetyādi vivarjitaḥ| madhyame maulimālāyai svāhādirahi'to'dhamaḥ || aṣṭāśītyaṅgahomokte svāhāntaistu pṛthakpṛthak| maulimālādihomokte svāhāntaistu pṛthakpṛthak| maulimālādihomañca vadantyanye'nyathā budhāḥ || bhrūbhyāmiti samārabhya juhuyāddoṣaśāntaye| ityantaṃ sarvasāmānyaprāyaścittamitīritam || maulimālāyai divyāya ratnāyāthottarāya ca| sarvauttarāya sarvasmai viṣṇavai prabhaviṣṇave || makuṭāya ca keśebhya uṣṇīṣāya tathaiva ca| mūrdhne mukhalalāṭābhyāṃ śrotrābhyañca dhruvorapi || apāṅgābhyāmathākṣibhyāṃ pakṣmabhyaścāpyanantaram| patākābhyāṃ jyotiṣe ca jyotirūpāya ceti tu || gaṇḍābhyāñca hanubhyāñca nāsikābhyāṃ tathaiva| puṭābhyāmapi cauṣṭhābhyāṃ dantebhyo juhuyāttataḥ || jihvāyai ca suvaktrāya cubukayā'dharāya ca| galāya cātha kaṇṭhāya grīvāyai kīkāsaya ca || jatrubhyo jatrurūpebhyaḥ aṃsābhyāñca tathaiva ca| doṣabhyāñcaiva skandhābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ kūrparāya ca || prakoṣṭhebhyastalebhyaśca aṅgulībhyastathaiva ca| parvabhyaśca nakhebhyaśca hṛdayāya tathaiva ca || stasnābhyāñcaiva pārśvābhyāmudarāya ca nābhaye| kṛkāṭikāyai nālībhyaḥ vaṃśaśreṇyai tathaiva ca || kaṭirāya prajananāya prajātyai vastaye tathā| vastimuṣkāya sakthibhyāmūrujānubhya eva ca || jaṅghābhyāñcaiva gulphebhyaḥ pārṣṇipādebhya eva ca| pādāṅgulibhyaḥ parvabhyaḥ nakhebhyassandhibhyastathā || sandhānedhyastu romabhyo romakūpebhya eva ca| marmabhyo marmapālibhyaḥ hotrebhyaḥ sirābhyastathā || tvagraktamāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśuklebhya eva ca| śuklarūpebhya iti ca tejiṣkāya ca tejase || dhātubhyo dhāturūpebhyaḥ vāgbhyaścaivākṣarāya ca| nādebhyaścaiva manase buddhaye tadanantaram || ahaṅakāraya cittāya svāheti tadanantaram| hṛtprāṇaśabdapūrvanatu puṇḍarīkamudīrya ca || vāyurjīvaśca jīvātmā satyāya samudīrya ca| yatyarūpastathā jñāna jñānarūpastathaiva ca| jñeyavijñātranantāśca ānando vyakta eva ca| avyaktaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇātmā'pānavyānāvanantaram || udānaśca samānaśca mahate ca mahātmane| ātmā'nātmā ca viśvasmai viśvātmā para eva ca || paramātmā tathā yasmai tasmaikasmai tathaiva ca| sarvasmai ca śiraścakraṃ cakraśaṅkhau tathaiva ca || pādapīṭhaṃ mahāṅgebhyaḥ upāṅgebhyastathaiva ca| pratyaṅgebhyaśca sarvebhyaḥ puruṣāya ca vyāhṛtiḥ || sūktaparibhāṣā viṣṇornukādiṣaṇmantrairviṣṇusūktamudāhṛtam| 'jātavedasa' ityādi sūktaṃ draurgamudāhṛtam || 'hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇī' miti śrīsūktamīritam| 'bhūmirbhūmne' ti bhūsūktaṃ sarvalokaśubhāvaham || 'hiraṇyagarbha' ityādi brahmasūktamudāhṛtam| 'omāsaścarṣaṇī' tyādi sūktaṃ sārasvataṃ matam || 'pariṇo rudra' ityuktvā 'stuhi śruta' miti bruvan| 'mīḍhuṣṭama śivatamaḥ - arhan bibha' rṣīti ca || 'tvamagne rudra' ityuktvā 'ā vo rājāna' mityapi| etairapi ca ṣaṇmantraiḥ rudrasūktamudāhṛtam || balipīṭhapratiṣṭhā balipīṭhapratiṣṭhāñca pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ| tasyotsedhaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ garbhāgārasamaṃ tathā || 21 || āyataṃ vistṛtaṃ vā'pi garbhāgārasya madhyame | utsedye daśabhāge tu saptāṃśaṃ samudāhṛtam || 22 || saptaviṃśatibhāge tu vibhakte tu samucchraye| dvyaṃśakaṃ pādukaṃ jñeyaṃ jagatī caturaṃśakam || 23 || tryaṃśakaṃ kumudaṃ jñeyamekāṃśaṃ paṭṭikā bhavet| ṣaḍbhāgaṃkaṇṭhamityāhuḥ dvyaṃśakaṃ balakampayoḥ || 24 || caturaṃśaikapādañca aṃśaṃ caivāgravartikā| dvyaṃśārdhaṃ padmapuṣpantu ekārdhaṃ padmāpuṣpakam || 25 || evaṃ syagviditvā tu bhāge bhāge vinirdiśet| tryaṃśaṃ hastapramāṇena trihastādadhikañca vā || 26 || pañcahastādhikaṃ vā'pi gopurātprāgvidhīyate| madhye bhūtantu kartavyaṃ catustālapramāṇataḥ || 27 || sukhāsanamidaṃ śreṣiṃ parāvṛttantu kārayet| yadīcchetsvāminaṃ prekṣya grāmanāśo bhaviṣyati || 18 || athavā kārayedvidvān kāraṇāṃśe tu madhyame| yathānyāyaṃ caturdikṣu tattat dikṣu samīkṣya vai || 29 || ityevaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettu vai| prathamāvaraṇādīnāṃ mukhāyāmaṃ yatākramam || 30 || caturthāṃśaṃ vibhajyaiva tṛtīye prathamādiṣu| nākraśaṅkhadhvajān yūthanāthapākorjunānapi || 31 || caturthāvaraṇañcaittu taddvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ| yūthanākṣākṣahau caiva sthāpayediti kecana || 32 || guṇāvaraṇamātrañcettatīye prathamāṃśake| dhvajaṃ dvitīye yūtheśamakṣahañca prakalpayet || 33 || antardhārāvāsānañcettatīyāṃśe viśeṣataḥ| cakraśaṅkhadhvajāṃścaiva bhūteśañca prakalpayet || 34 || ekāvaramātrañcedagramaṇḍapapūrvataḥ| caturbhāgaṃ vibhajyaiva tṛtīye tu prakalpayet || 35 || athavā gopurādvāhye mukhāyāmaṃ prakalpya ca| kalpayettatra vā sarvān yūtheśaṃ vā'tha kevalam || 36 || vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā| pañcagavyaissamabhyukṣya kuryāccaivākṣimocanam || 37 || gavādīn darśayitvā tu pañcagavyādibhiḥ punaḥ| snāpayitvā'dhivāsyaiva tattanmantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 38 || aupāsanāgniṃ saṃṅkalpya tasyāgre dakṣiṇe'pi vā| āghārānte tu vidhinā kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat || 39 || saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ śuddhodairabhiṣecayet badhnīyātkautukañcāpi pradakṣiṇavaśādgale || 40 || hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya nirupyājyāhutīryajet| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā tanmantrantu savaiṣṇavam || 41 || prātaḥ pīṭhe samāvāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet| eṣa eva viśeṣassyādanyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 42 || garuḍapratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi suparṇasthāpanaṃ param| sthānake mūlabere tu kuryātsthānakameva vā || 43 || āsane śayane cāpi āsīnaṃ sthānakantu vā| viparītaṃ yadi bhavedrājā rāṣṭrañca naśyataḥ || 44 || triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyāṃ haste svātyāṃ punarvasau| yajamānasya janmarkṣe rājño nakṣatra eva vā || 45 || tasmāttu divasātpūrvamaṅkurānarpayettathā| aṅkarārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ dravyaṃ sambhṛtya pūrvavat || 46 || akṣimocanamuddiśya pūrvāhṇe homamācaret| aṅgahomañca hutvā tu mūrtihomaṃ tathā hunet || 47 || 'śatadhā' reti mantreṇa 'kadāpisṛja' teti ca| daśavāraṃ tato hutvā tābhyāṃ kṛtvā'kṣimocanam || 48 || antahomaṃ tato hutvā bhāskaraṃ sampraṇamya ca| pañcagavyādhivāsādīn kuryāttadaparāhṇake || 49 || gomūtre gomaye caiva kuśode cādhivāsayet| athavā kārayedvidvān pañcagavyasya kuṇḍake || 50 || pratiṣṭhādivāsātpūrvaṃ rātrau homaṃ samācaret| bhūmiyajñañca kṛtvā tu paryagniñcaiva kārayet || 51 || śayyāvediṃ prakalpyaiva pūrvoktavidhinā punaḥ| vedyā dakṣiṇpārśve tu dakṣiṇāgniṃ prakalalpayet || 52 || aupāsanāgnimathavā kārayediti kecana| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu bhūmiśuddhiṃ samācaret || 53 || snanavedyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ plotena parimṛjya ca || 54 || vastrādibhiralaṅkatya śayyāvedyāṃ niveśya ca| baddhvā pratisarañcaiva śayaneṣu ca śāyayet || 55 || tābhyāmeva tu mantrābhyāṃ sarvametatsamācaret| dakṣiṇāgniṃ paristīrya taddaivatyaṃ suhūyatām || 56 || hotā hautrakrameṇaiva tanmartyā''vāhya hūyatām| tato garuḍamantrābhyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ yajet || 57 || sāmavedādinamantrañca yajedvaiṣṇavasaṃyutam| nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayetpunaḥ || 58 || tataḥ prabhāte dharmātmā snātvā tu sthāpakaissaha| muhūrte samanuprāpte ratnanyāsaṃ samācaret || 59 || devaṃ kumbhaṃ samādāya praviśedālayaṃ punaḥ| śvetavarṇasya pūrṇe vā kṛṣṇapārśve'thavā punaḥ || 60 || prathamāvaraṇe vā'pi dvitīyāvaraṇe'pi vā| maṇḍapasya tato madhye sthāpayitvā samantrakam || 61 || ācārya pūjayitvā tu suvarṇapaśubhūmibhiḥ| sthāpakān pūjayettadvadvastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 62 || evaṃ saṃsthāpayedvīśaṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ| santatīnāṃ samṛddhiḥ syādvāhanānāṃ tathaiva ca || 63 || sarvān kāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati| viṣkaksenapratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śāntasya sthāpanaṃ param || 64 || bimbaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sthāpanaṃ samyaṃgācaret| pūrvoktamāsanakṣatre śuklapakṣe śubhe dine || 65 || bimbaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā śilpivisarjanam| vāstuhomāṅgahomau ca hutvā mantraiśca bhaurtikaiḥ || 66 || viṣvaksenasya mantrau dvau vaiṣṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīryajet| kuryātkramāttu mantrābhyāṃ dakṣiṇādyakṣimocanam || 67 || pañcagavyādhivāsādi kalpayettadanukramāt| tasyālayasyābhimukhe yāgaśālāṃ prakalpya ca || 68 || śayyavediñca tanmadhye bimbādhyardhapramāṇataḥ| kuryādaupāsanāgniñca tatprācyāmagra eva vā || 69 || dakṣiṇe snapanaśvabhraṃ kalpayitvā tu pūrvavat| vāstuhomaṃ yajetkuryātparyagnikaraṇaṃ tathā || 70 || pañcagavyokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sāyaṃ pūrvedyureva vā| adhivāsagataṃ devamuddhṛtya snāpayettadā || 71 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhina tatrā'vāhya samantrakam| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśairarcayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 72 || tataḥ kautukabandhānte śayane śāyayettadā| hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya nirupyā'jyāhutīryajet || 73 || sarvadevārcanaṃ hitvā vedādhyayanamācaret| viṣvaksenasya mantrābhyāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 74 || vaiṣṇavaṃ mūrtimantrañca hutvā gāyatriyā tathā| pradhānahomaṃ hutvā tu hutvā rātriṃ ninīya ca || 75 || prātassaṃsthāpya cā'vāhya samabhyarcya nivedayet| dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau || 76 || sarveṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ| ālayābhimukhe teṣāṃ yāgaśālāṃ prakalpya ca || 77 || śayyāvediñca tanmadhye tasyāgre'gniñca kalpayet| eṣa eva kramaḥ prokto mantra eva viśiṣyate || 78 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā tattanmantraṃ savaiṣṇavam| pratiṣṭhāpya samāvāhya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 79 || anantapratiṣṭhā anantaṃ sarvanāgānāmadhipaṃ cāniruddhavat| bimbaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā phaṇāsaptakasaṃyutam || 80 || prathamāvaraṇe vā'pi dvitīyāvaraṇe'pi vā| vāmalūrusamīpe vā gopurābdāhyato'pi vā || 81 || sthānaṃ saṅkalpya sambhārān sambhṛtyaiva tataḥ param| aṅkurārpaṇamārabhya pratiṣṭhāntoditāḥ kriyāḥ || 82 || śeṣadaivatyamantrābhyāṃ tatsūktenāthavā punaḥ| saṃsthāpya saumyamārgeṇa nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 83 || ananto garuḍaścaiva viṣvksenaḥ pitāmahaḥ| anādivaiṣṇavāḥ pañca muniśaḍvikhanā api || 84 || suparṇasya ca śāntasyāpyanantasya tathaiva ca| trayāṇāṃ sthāpanañcoktamadya saṅkṣepato mayā || 85 || vikhanasaḥ pratiṣṭhā brahmaṇaśca tridhā proktaṃ sthāpanantu pṛthaṅmayā| garbhālaye ca devasya pūjakalṛvena sammataḥ || 86 || trimūrtisthāpane caiva dvimūrtisthāpane tathā| mūrtimantreṇa samprokto maṇḍalāntargato vidhiḥ || 87 || prādhānyena tu suproktaḥ pūthageva pratiṣṭhitum| adhunā sampravakṣyāmi sthāpanaṃ vikhanomuneḥ || 88 || devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge śriyo devyāssaṃmīpataḥ| śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ caturbhujadharaṃ tathā || 89 || tridaṇḍadhāriṇaṃ viṣṇorarcanāsaktamānasam| kūrmapīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya nityaṃ vidhivadarcayet || 90 || devadevapratiṣṭhāvatsarvaṃ samyaksamācaret| sthānake mūlabere tu cāsane śayane'pi vā || 91 || āsīnameva sarvatra tapoyuktaṃ prakalpayet| viparītaṃ yadi bhavedrājarāṣṭravināśānam || 92 || triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyā haste svātyā punarvasau| yajamānasya nakṣatre rājño nakṣatra eva vā || 93 || tasmāttu divasātpūrvamaṅkurānarpayettathā| aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ dravyaṃ sambhṛtya pūrvavat || 94 || akṣimocanamuddiśya pūrvāhṛ homamācaret| aṅgahomañca hutvā tu mūrtihomassuhūyatām || 95 || 'ato devā-idaṃ viṣṇu' riti hutvā sahasraśaḥ| kṛtvā tābhyāmakṣimokṣamante homaṃ yajebdudhaḥ || 96 || adhivāsatrayaṃ vā'pi adhivāsacatuṣṭayam| pūrvoktavidhinā kṛtvā baliṃ nirvāpya pūrvavat || 97 || pratiṣṭhādivasātpūrvaṃ rātrau homañca kārayet| bhūmiyajñañca kṛtvā tu paryagnimapi kārayet || 98 || śayyāvediṃ prakalpyaiva pūrvoktavidhinā punaḥ| śayyāvedyāḥ pūrvabhāge śrāmaṇāgniṃ prakalpayet || 99 || aupāsanāgnimathavā kecidāhavanīyakam| puṇyāhamantraissamprokṣya bhūmiśuddhimathācaret || 100 || snānavedyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat| saṃsnāpya saptakalaśaiḥ plotena parimṛjya ca || 101 || vastrādibhiralaṅkṛtya śayyāvedyāṃ niveśya ca| baddhvā pratisarañcaiva śayaneṣu ca śāyayet || 102 || pūrvābhyāmevamantrābhyāṃ sarvametat samācaret| śrāmaṇāgniṃ paristīrya vaiṣṇavañca suhūyatām || 103 || hotā hautrakrameṇauva tanmūrtyā''vāhya homayet| pūjakaśreṣṭharūpatve vakṣyante mūrtayo'dhunā || 104 || tridaṇḍinaṃ taponiṣṭhaṃ puṇḍarīkavilocanam| haripriyaṃ samāvāhya caturbhirmūrtibhirhunet || 105 || dvārapālakarapave vakṣyanta mūrtayo'nyathā| pṛthaksthāpanakāle tu devīsahitamācaret || 106 || pralambasūtraṃ śrīvatsaṃ vinā'nyairviṣṇuvaccaret| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeva bimbaṃ tatsamudāhṛtam || 107 || tasya patnī ca vikhyātā divyākhyā paramarṣibhiḥ| viṣṇupriyasutañceti viṣvaksenasakhaṃ tathā || 108 || kalpasūtrakṛtañceti śrāmaṇāgnipriyaṃ tathā| paratattvapravaktāraṃ mūrtibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ kramāt || 109 || pṛthakatvena pradhānatve tasya patnyāśca mūrtayaḥ| ādivaiṣṇavamantrābhyāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 110 || 'yo vedādiḥ parama' iti yajedvaiṣṇavasaṃyutam| aṣṭhottarasahasraṃ vā aṣṭottaraśatantu vā || 111 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedguruḥ| arcakottamarūpatve devadevasya sannidhau || 112 || dvārapālakarūpatve dvitīyadvāradakṣiṇe| pṛthakpradhānarūpatve yamāgnyorantare tathā || 113 || śaṅkhacakradharo vā'pi api tābhyāṃ vivarjitaḥ| dvārapālakarūpatve sa vibhuḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 114 || śaṅkhakradharassākṣāditaratra prakīrtitaḥ| garbhālaye vā bāhye vā sthāpane cottarāmukhaḥ || 115 || dvārasya dakṣiṇe bhāge sthāpayeddevarāṇamukham| dhruvasūktena saṃsthāpya viṣṇusūktena saṃspṛśet || 116 || gobhūsuvarṇadānādyaiḥ guruṃ sampūjya bhaktiḥ| pūjayetsthāpakādīṃśca vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 117 || gurūttamasya yaḥ kuryātsthāpanaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ| vedānāñca samṛddhissyātsamṛddhiḥ puṇyakarmaṇām || 118 || sarvānkāmānavāpyaiva puṇyalokaṃ sa gacchati| 'ato devā-idaṃ viṣṇu' riti mantradvayena ca || 119 || pūjakatve pradhānatve ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ| sampūjya vidhivadviṣaṣṇuṃ tanniveditavastubhiḥ || 120 || mālyairgandhaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiśca havirādibhiḥ| arcayitvā tu dehānte sāyujyaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 121 || vaikhānasasya naivaidyaṃ viṣṇunaivedyavaccaret| dvārapālapratiṣṭhāyāṃ taddaivatyaṃ juhoti ca || 122 || dvārasya dakṣiṇe bhāge sthānakassupratiṣṭhitaḥ| 'vaikhānasāya' mantraśya taddaivatyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 123 || tiṣṭhatyayaṃ trirūpeṇa viṣṇorājñāviśeṣataḥ| tatkathā ca niruktādhikāre proktā suvistadā || 124 || samidhādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam samidhāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāmapi karmaṇām| kaṇṭakaṃ suṣiraṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛmiyuktaṃ pipīlikam || 125 || hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ kṛśacaiva sthūlañcaiva dviparvakam| hīnacarma tathā dagdhaṃ purāṇañca vivarjayet || 126 || vṛkṣe pakṣigaṇāvāse caityavṛkṣe tathaiva ca| tathā devālaye caiva śmaśāne coṣare tathā || 127 || jīrṇālaye tathā mūle sūtakyāśaucisaṅgate| maithune caiva nidrāyāmāture ca vivarjayet || 128 || kaṇṭakaṃ suṣirañcaiva proktaṃ sarvavināśanam| śuṣke bhrātṛvināśassyātkṛmidaṣṭe matibhramaḥ || 129 || pipīlikādau tvagdoṣaḥ hrasvaḥ kukṣijvarapradaḥ| dīrdhe ca maraṇaṃ vindyātkṛśe kleśabhayāvaham || 130 || sthūlaṃ dāridryadaṃ proktaṃ dviparvaṃ pāparogadam| tvacaśchede tu daurbhāgyaṃ dagdhañcetsannipātakam || 131 || purāṇe putranāśaḥ syāt jñānañcāpi vinaśyati| pakṣidevālayetthañcenmātāpitrorvināśanam || 132 || śmaśānajaṃ kulaṃ hanti ūṣare rājyanāśanam| jīrṇālayasamīpasthaṃ śirorogaṃ prayacchati || 133 || sūtakyāśaucisaṃspṛṣṭe bhāryāputravināśanam| maithunai spṛṣyate cettu vṛkṣe vai vyādhipīḍanam || 134 || nidrāto nidhanaṃ yāti cā'ture taskarādbhayam| etairdoṣairvimuktantu sarvalakṣaṇasayutam || 135 || pālāśaṃ bailvamatha ca śamījaṃ khadirantathā| aśvatthavaṭavṛkṣotthaṃ plākṣamaudumbaraṃ tathā || 136 || dvādaśāṅguladīrghantu tataśśānitakaraṃ viduḥ| trayodaśāṅgulañcaindraṃ dvisapatāṅgulamārṣakam || 137 || pañcadaśāṅgulāyāmamābhicārikamucyate| vidveṣe'nāmikānāha pramāṇamiti niṃśyataḥ' || 138 || tathāvidhāḥ paridhaya uktāyāmasamanvitāḥ| nadītaṭākatīrotthāssamidho doṣavarjitāḥ || 139 || sāgrā agarbhāḥ darbhāḥ syurasthūlakṛśavāmanāḥ| ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāḥ kūrcāḥ paristaraṇakarmaṇi || 140 || dvādaśāṅgulamāyāmaṃ pavitraṃ samudāhṛtam| hastamātramitaḥ proktaḥ kūrcaḥ prokṣaṇakarmaṇi || 141 || ṛtvijorapyabhāve tu kalpane brahmasomayoḥ| aratnimātramāyāmaṃ kūrcaṃ nyasyetu pārśvayoḥ || 142 || sarveṣāmapi kūrcānāmagrantu caturaṅgulam| granthistu dvyaṅgulā proktā śeṣaṃ lambaṃ prakalpayet || 143 || vatsajānusamākāro vedaḥ prodeśasammitaḥ| nirmitaśśatadarbhaiśca śodhanārthamathādhvare || 144 || dvābhyāmagarbhadarbhābhyāṃ paritraṃ parikalpayet| caturaṅgulaṃ bhavedagraṃ granthirekāṅgulā bhavet || 145 || dvyaṅgulaṃ mūlamityuktamevaṃ kuryādyāthāvidhi| sannyasyānāmikāṅgulyoḥ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet || 146 || apavitrakaraḥ kiñcannācarediti śāsanam || 146 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre mahāśāntividhānabalipīṭhapratiṣṭhādividhirnāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<30> oṃ triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ daśānāmavatārāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ vakṣyate tataḥ| avatārāṇāṃ ekatra kalpanam pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ pṛthagālayakalpanam || 1 || ekagarbhagṛhe syuścetṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ vibhajya ca| kalpayedaniruddhasya caturaṃśāṃstu madhyame || 2 || athavā kevalaṃ viṣṇumāsīnaṃ sthitameva vā| aṃśau dvau puratastyaktvā dvārārthaṃ munisattamāḥ || 3 || śeṣeṣu daśabhāgeṣu matsyādyaṃśān prakalpayet| yasya yasya yo deśaḥ kalpitaḥ padakalpane || 4 || avasthābhedabhinnāni tattadrūpāṇi tatpadam| samabhāgaṃ prakalpyā'tra sthāpayitvā samarcayet || 5 || pradhānābhisamukhān kuryādavatārān yathākramam| khile vistaraśaḥ proktameteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ purā || 6 || dhruvakautukasaṃyuktaṃ kuryātpratyekamuttamam| saṃsthāpya kautukaṃ vā'tha kevalaṃ vihite pade || 7 || ādimūrtesmāvāhya pūjayediti kecana| apādanaṃ daśāṃśānāmaniruddho yataḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || etanmadhyamamuddiṣṭamadhamaṃ kevalaṃ dhruvam| sthāpayitvā'grataḥ pīṭhe samāvāhya samarcayet || 9 || ādimūrtisamaṃ vā'tha karṇasīmāntameva vā| athavā bāhusīmāntaṃ tabderāṇi prakalpayet || 10 || pañcamūrtipratiṣṭhāyāṃ puruṣādiprakalpane| etadeva pramāṇaṃ syādadhikaṃ na samācaret || 11 || pramāṇaṃ pañcavīrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇo garuḍasya ca| vāsudevasamaṃ vā'tha bāhvantaṃ vā'dhikaṃ na ca || 12 || bimbaṃ daśāvātārāṇāṃ kevalaṃ kautukaṃ yadi| ādimūrtidhruvotsedhaṃ tridhā kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 13 || ekabhāgaṃ vyapohyaiva dvibhāgaṃ cottamodayam| ttribhāgadvibhāgoccaṃ madhyamaṃ pratimodayam || 14 || ekāṃśamadhamaṃ tattadantare navadhā kṛte| saptaviṃśatituṅgāni pūrvavatparikalpayet || 15 || kevalaṃ kautukaṃ syāccedarcāsthāne prakalpayet| nirmālyahāriṇaṃ teṣāmarcayetparito'mitam || 16 || parito vainateyasya madhyame navabhiḥ padaiḥ| kalpayedaniruddhasya vāhanāni prakalpayet || 17 || itthaṃ berāṇi kṛtvaivaṃ pratiṣṭhāmārabhetpunaḥ| kalpayedyāgaśālāyā upapīṭhapadaṃ kramāt || 18 || paritastabdahiḥ paṅktau prācyāṃ diśi padatrayam| yāmyādiṣu tathaikaikaṃ dvārārthaṃ parikalpayet || 19 || āgneyādīśaparyantaṃ matsyādīnāṃ yathākramam| tatṛtaddikṣu daśāṃśānāṃ pradhānāgnaun prakalpayet || 20 || śvabhraṃ śayanavediṃñca kalpayitvā yathocitam| aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvamakṣyunmeṣādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 21 || vinaiva sarvadaivatyaṃ pāramātmikameva ca| pratiṣṭhāmutsavādīṃśca pūrvavatparikalpayet || 22 || eṣāṃ pradhānamantrāśca murtibhedāstathaiva ca| pūrvameva mayā proktāḥ sarvamanyaddhareriva || 23 || āvāhanaṃ daśāṃśānāṃ ādimūrterdhruvādyādi| niṣkalatvād dhruvasyāsya kuryātkautukanāmabhiḥ || 24 || viparītaṃ yadi bhaveddhruvanāmnā samarcayet| vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhañca rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 25 || dakṣiṇottarayossamyak sthāpayenmukhamaṇḍape| sthāpayedantarāle vā nṛttamaṇḍapa eva vā || 26 || teṣāñca sthāpane śālāṃ varāhārthaṃ prakalpya ca| dakṣiṃṇābhimukhīṃ śālāṃ vāmanasya prakalpayet || 27 || taddakṣiṇe vā pūrvasmin rāghavārthaṃ prakalpyet| kṛtvā vāme nṛsiṃhārthaṃ tadvāme pūrvameva vā || 28 || kṛṣṇārthaṃ kalpayedyāgaśālāṃ prākpaścimāyatām| paścime śayanaṃ tatra kārayitvā tadagrataḥ || 29 || saṅkalpayetpradhānāgniṃ snānaśvabhraṃ tadagrataḥ| vāstuhomāvasāne tu kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya pūrvavat || 30 || snapanaṃ śayanārohaṃ hmaitraśaṃsanameva ca| sarvañca pūrvavatkṛtvā pradhānāgnau tathā'khilam || 31 || tattatṛpradhānamantraiśca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yaṃjet| prātassnātvā vidhānena praviśya mukhamaṇḍapam || 32 || varāhaṃ dakṣiṇe rāmaṃ matsyaṃ saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇe| nārasiṃhaṃ tathā vāme kṛṣṇaṃ tasya ca vāmataḥ || 33 || vārāhanārasiṃhau tu sthāpayitvā'gramaṇḍape| antarāle'thavā kṛṣṇarāmau saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 34 || dakṣiṇe nārasiṃhaṃ vā vāraharahitaṃ yadi| ekaberavimānasya garbhagehe'gramaṇḍape || 35 || autsavaṃ sthāpanaṃ kartuṃ yadi syātsthānasaṅkaṭaḥ| agramaṇḍapabāhye tu pratimāṃ maṇḍape kṛte || 36 || autsavasyoktadeśe tu tatra saṃsthāpya pūjayet| parapradhānabimbānāṃ pūjā ṣoḍaśavigrahaiḥ || 37 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| athavā matsyakūrmau tu garbhagehasya madhyame || 38 || pratiṣṭhāpya varāhādīn dikṣvaṣṭāsu prakalpayet| dhruvañca kautukañcaiva kuryādagre pṛthakpṛthak || 39 || pañcavīrāṇāṃ sthāpanam sthāpanaṃ pañcavīrāṇāmarcanañca tapodhanāḥ| pravakṣyāmi samāsena śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ || 40 || vāsudevādidevānāṃ pañcānāṃ viṣṇunā saha| pañcanavīrārcanaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṇā ca sahārcanam || 41 || annaprajāpatiyutaṃ rahitaṃ vā tapodhanāḥ| puṣṭida sarvalokānā sarvādhvarulāvaham || 42 || pañcavīrārcanaṃ hyetadvedavaidikavardhanam| sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ muktidaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 43 || nadīviśālamaṣṭāṅgaṃ somacchandaṃ catuḥsphuṭam| sarvatobhadrakaṃ vā'pi gopurākṛtikantu vā || 44 || ekatalaṃ dvitalaṃ vā kalpayitvā yathāvidhi| ādibhūmiṃ ghanaṃ kuryāddvitīye sthāpayettale || 45 || garbhavyāsāṣṭabhāgaikahīnocce vasudevaje| trayastriṃśatidaṇḍaikādhikaḥ saṅkarṣaṇodayaḥ || 46 || vāsudevādhikotsedho balabhadro nu daivikai| pradyumno vāsudevasya karṇasīmāntakodayaḥ || 47 || nasyastanāvāsānoccau rukmiṇī sāmba eva ca| vāsudevasya hikkāntastvaniruddha udāhṛtaḥ || 48 || vāsudevasamotsedhaṃ kalpayetkamalāsanam| samaṣṭirūpameteṣāṃ madhye viṣṇuṃ prakalpayet || 49 || sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamañcāpi tathā sthāvarajaṅgamam| śrībhūmisahitaṃ kuryādrahitaṃ vā yathāvidhi || 50 || sthāpayedvāsudavādīn pañca vai mānuṣe pade| sthāpayedvāsudevantaṃ brahmasūtrāttathottare || 51 || śyāmalaṃ dvibhujaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakrasamanvitam| padmātrāyatadṛśaṃ prasannendunibhānanam || 52 || pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| dakṣiṇe rukmiṇīṃ devīṃ śyāmāṃ raktāmbarojjavalām || 53 || mīnakuṇḍalatāṭaṅkāṃ yajñasūvirājitām| tāṭaṅkaṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe vāme makarakuṇḍalam || 54 || kuñcitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādañca susthitam| karaṃ prasāritaṃ vāmaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ varadaṃ tathā || 55 || athavā dakṣiṇenaiva divyapaṅkajadhāriṇīm| tasyāśca dakṣiṇe bhāge baladevaṃ prakalpayet || 56 || śvetābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuryāddakṣiṇenābhābhayapradam| uddeśavāmahastañca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 57 || dakṣiṇe bhittipārśve tu brahmaṇāṃ kanakaprabham| dvibhujaṃ kaṭikaṃ vāmaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradam || 58 || udaṅmukhaṃ sthitaṃ kuryātsarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| uttare vāsudevasya pradyumnaṃ dvibhujaṃ sthitam || 59 || sasyaśyāmanibhaṃ kuryātsarvābharaṇabhūṣitam| abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalambitam || 60 || uttarāṃ bhittimāśritya sāmbañca dvibhujaṃ sthitam| dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ śyāmaṃ sarvābhaṇabhūṣitam || 61 || varadaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalāmbitam| tatprācyāmaniruddhañca pravālābhaṃ prakalpayet || 62 || abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ vāmaṃ kaṭyavalambitam| dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ tasya hastau sāmbavadeva hi || 63 || daśālālottamenaiva madhye viṣṇuṃ prakalpayet| sthāvaraṃ daivike bhāge pade brāhme tu jaṅgamam || 65 || vāsudevasamotsedhaṃ sthāvaraṃ samudāhṛtam| sarvānukūlamānena kevalaṃ jaṅgamaṃ yadi || 66 || kautukaṃ pañcavīrāṇāṃ sthāpayettattadagrataḥ| yadākāraṃ dhruvākāraṃ tadākārañca kautukam || 67 || sarveṣāṃ kautukaṃ madhye viṣṇumekaṃ tathāpi vā| autsavaṃ snāpanañcaiva viṣṇumeva caturbhujam || 68 || annaprajāpatiṃ kuryātprācyāmevāniruddhataḥ| bhūtākāraṃ prakurvīta dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujam || 69 || paritastu trayastriṃśaddevān garbhagṛhe'rcayet| prāgbhitau dvādaśādityān rudrān dakṣiṇabhittikān || 70 || pratīcyāñca vasūnaṣṭau nāsatyāvuttare kramāt| dvārasya dakṣiṇe bhāge khaḍgaśaktiśarāriṇaḥ || 71 || gadāñca kalyayevdāme śaṅkhaṃ śārṅgañca kheṭakam| aṅkuśaṃ padmamityevamarcayecca daśāyudhān || 72 || parito lokapālāṃśca prahlādaṃ jñānamūrtikam| pūjayeddva śādityān rudrānekādaśa kramāt || 73 || vasūnaṣṭau ca nāsatyau caturjyotīṃṣi ca kramāt| prāgbhittau pāṇḍavān kuryāttale'dhabstādvahirmukhān || 74 || uttare dakṣiṇādyañca tattaccihrasamāyutān| prāgagbhittau daivikānpañcavīrān saṅkalpayebdudhaḥ || 75 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarvaṃ hareriva| sumāsapakṣanakṣatramuhūrtakaraṇādiṣu || 76 || aṅkurāṇyarpayitvaiva dravyāṇyapi samāharet| yāgaśālāñca pañcāgnīn pauṇḍarīkañca kalpayet || 77 || aupāsanavihīnañca dakṣiṇāgnestu dakṣiṇe| āvasathyottare kuryādannamūrtestathaiva ca || 78 || akṣyunmeṣādhivāsādīn sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret| adhivāsagatān devān samuddhṛtyābhiṣecayet || 79 || alaṅkatya yathānyāyaṃ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam| sthāpayedyāgaśālāyāṃ naiṛte viṣṭaropari || 80 || saṃsādhya pūrvavatkumbhaṃ sarvaṣāñca pṛthakpṛthak| alaṅkatya samabhyacrya baddhvā pratisarāmapi || 81 || śayane śāyayitvaiva vedānadhyāpayetkramāt| vāsudevasya viṣṇośca madhye hautraṃ praśaṃsya ca || 82 || rāmasyāhavanīyāgnau pradyumnasya ca dakṣiṇe| sāmṛbasya gārhapatyāgnāvāvasathye tathaiva ca || 83 || hautraṃ syādinaruddhasya brāhmaṇaśca prajāpateḥ| hotramaupāsanāgnau ca praśaṃsyā'vāhya pūrvavat || 84 || nirupyājyāhutīrhutvā sarvān devān samarcya ca| vāsudevasya sabhyāgniṃ paristīrya yathāvidhi || 85 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| śrīsūktañca mahīsūktaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam || 86 || mūlahomasāmayuktaṃ yaddaivādisamanvitam| āhutīnāṃ sahasrañca devaṃ dhyān juhoti ca || 87 || yajedevaṃ punaścāpi viṣṇumuddiśya tatra vai| hutvā tu sarvadaivatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ triḥ punaryajet || 88 || mindāhutī ca picchinnaṃ hutvā kṛtvā pravāhaṇam| rāmasyāhavanīyāgnau pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 89 || viṣṇusūktaṃ tato brāhmaṃ pradyumnasya ca dakṣiṇe| vaiṣṇavaṃ gārhapatyāgnau sāmbasya juhuyātpunaḥ || 90 || āvasathye'niruddhasya yajedekākṣarādikam| rudramantradvayenāpi bhaktyā devamanusmaran || 91 || ṛtvigaṣṭarkakṛtvastu juhuyāduttamādiṣu| yajedāhavanīyāgnau jayādīṃśca sakṛtsakṛt || 92 || tataśca pauṇḍarīkāgniṃ pariṣicya yathāvidhi| viṣṇugāyatriyā padmaṃ ghṛte gavye samāplutam || 93 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā juhuyātpāramātmikam| sabhyāgniṃ pauṇḍarīkāgniṃ vinā'nyāgnīn visṛjya ca || 94 || nṛttairgeyaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedruruḥ| prātaḥ snātvā'tha sāvitrīṃ japtvā sandhyāmupāsya ca || 95 || tnānyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādarcāpīṭhe tu pūrvavat| visṛjya śāntihomānte pauṇḍarīkaṃ vidhānataḥ || 96 || dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau| sabhyamagniṃ paristīrya viṣṇugāyatriyā yajet || 97 || hutvā''dadhīta sabhyāgniṃ nityahomāya dakṣiṇe| pradhānakumbhamācāryaḥ purataḥ śirasā vahan || 98 || gacchettadarcakāḥ kumbhān vahanto'nunayanti ca| śākurna sūktamuccārya kuryāddhāmapradakṣiṇam || 99 || paścādantaḥ praviśyaiva jīvasthāne niveśya ca| japtvā'tmasūktamācāryo manasā bhāvayan harim || 100 || mantranyāsākṣaranyāsau kṛtvā bimbe ca pūrvavat| rāmādīnāñca sarveṣāṃ tannamādyakṣarānvitam || 101 || pratyakpravṛttiṃ manasā dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ parātparam| vāsudevaṃ samārabhya rukmiṇyantamanukramāt || 102 || madhye viṣṇuṃ samāvāhya śrībhūmibhyāṃ samanvitam| tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇādīṃstān krameṇā'vāhayetsudhīḥ || 103 || garbhālayagatān devān dvāreśān dvārapālakān| vimānalokapālāṃśca parivārāṃstathottarān || 104 || āvāhya vāsudevasya kumbhādeva yathākramam| ekakumbhe tathā dhyāyetsarvāstān viṣṇunā vinā || 105 || vāsudevaṃ samāvāhya tasmādāvāhayetkramāt| sthāpakaiḥ saha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu pūrvavat || 106 || hapīṣi pāyasādīni rāmādīnāṃ nivedayet| maudgikaṃ brahmaṇe dadyāt śuddhānnantu prajāpateḥ || 107 || nityāgnikuṇḍe juhuyānmūrtihomaṃ yathāvidhi| kṛtvā balyutsavāntāni rātrau snapanamācaret || 108 || ārabhedutsavaṃ paścādutsavoktakrameṇa vai| hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādīn gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 109 || eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādanyatsarva hareriva| pañcavīrāṇāṃ sthāpane sthānanirdeśaḥ grāmānte nagarānte vā parvatānte vanāntare || 110 || nadīsamudratīreṣu vivikte'nyatra kutracit| pañcavīridayakakaheha pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet || 111 || pañcavīrārcanaprakāraḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcavīratamarcanam| arcakaḥ prātarutthāya snātvā sandhyāmupāsya ca || 112 || devādīṃstarpayitvā'dbhiḥ japtvā japyāni pūrvavat| devālayaṃ praviśyātha parītya ca yadhāvidhi || 113 || kavāṭoddhāṭanādīni kṛtvā sarvāṇi pūrvavat| samṛbhārānapi sambhṛtya nirmālyamapahāya ca || 114 || havīṃṣi copadaṃśāṃśca pācayitvā yathāvidhi| snāpayedvāsudevanta 'miṣe tvā'di japan punaḥ || 115 || viṣṇuṃ puraṣasūktena snāpayitvā yathāvidhi| snāpayebdalabhadranta 'māpo hi ṣṭhā' dibhiḥ tribhiḥ || 116 || pradyumnaṃ viṣṇusūktena sāmbaṃ saṃsnāpya vaiṣṇavaiḥ| snāpayedaniruddhantaṃ sūktenaikākṣarādinā || 117 || brāhmamantradvayenaiva brahmāṇañca prajāpatim| vāsudevasya viṣṇoścāvaraṇatrayanāmabhiḥ || 118 || anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ nyasetpuṣpāṇi mūrtibhiḥ| abhyarcya dvāradevādīn punarantaḥ praviśya ca || 119 || udaṅmukhasmamāsīno viṣṭare caikajānunā| mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā āvāhya ca tathā dhruvāt || 120 || kevale jaṅgame viṣṇornāvāhanavirsane| ekabere tathā viṣṇoviśeṣastatra vakṣyate || 121 || bimbābhiṣecanātpūrvamarcayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ| tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā kṛtvā saṃsnāpya ca yathā punaḥ || 122 || alaṅkṛtya pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ| viśeṣaṃ sampravakṣyāmi balabhadrādipūjane || 123 || rāmasyācamanaṃ dadyā 'dāpo' hi ṣṭhā'dibhiḥ tribhiḥ| 'hiṇyaga'rbha ityuktvā dadyādardhya havistathā || 124 || 'yoge yoga' ityācamanaṃ pradyumnasyābhidhīyate| 'idamāpaḥ śivā' ardhya 'miha puṣṭi' miti bruvan || 125 || havirnivedanaṃ kuryāttataḥ sāmbasamarcane| 'samāne vṛkṣa' ityuktvā dadyādācamanaṃ punaḥ || 126 || viṣṇugāyatriyā cārdhyaṃ 'samāvavartī' ti vai haviḥ| havirācamanārdhyāṇi aniruddhasya pūrvavat || 127 || pūjayenmukhavāsāntaṃ saṅkarṣaṇapurassarān| brāhmamantradvayenaiva brahmāṇañca prajāpatim || 128 || dvātriṃśadvigrahairviṣṇuṃ vāsudevañca pūjayet| mūrtayaḥ pūrvamevoktāḥ sarveṣāñca mayā khile || 129 || yeṣāṃ na mūrtayaḥ santi teṣāṃ nāmabhirarcanam| kautukaṃ pañcavīrāṇāmekameva yadā bhavet || 130 || tadā tu vāsudevañca saṅkarṣaṇamiti bruvan| pradyumnaṃ sāmbamityuktvā aniruddhamiti bruvan || 131 || tataḥ pañcabhirāvāhya samabhyarcya yathāvidhi| pañcasvāropayeddevān pūjanānte yathāvidhi || 132 || iti saṅkṣepataḥ proktaṃ pañcavīrasamarcanam| anuktānyatra sarvāṇi viṣṇoriva samācaret || 133 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre daśāvatāra pañcavīrapratiṣṭhādividhirnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<31> oṃ ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ sāmānya prāyaścittam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasāmānyaniṣkṛtim| aśakyaṃ vidhivatkartuṃ brahmādyairapi pūjanam || 1 || kiṃ vā tatra manuṣyāṇāmavyavasthitacetasām| viṣayāsaktacittānāmindriyāhṛtacetasām || 2 || ajñātānāñca doṣāṇāmarcanādiṣu karmasu| jñātvā cānādṛtānāñca doṣāṇāmarcanādiṣu karmasu| jñātvā cānādṛtānāñca mohāllobhātpramādataḥ || 3 || tattaddoṣopaśāntyarthaṃ kuryātsāmānyaniṣkṛtim| tattatsandhyāvasāne ca viṣṇusūktena vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 4 || sūktena pauruṣeṇāpi viṣṇugāyatriyā tathā| dvādaśāṣṭākṣarābhyāñca 'namo brahmaṇa' ityapi || 5 || puṣpāṇi pādayordatvā 'kṣama' sveti prasādayet| rātripūjāvasāne tu sūktenaikākṣarādinā || 6 || nārāyaṇānuvākena stutvā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet| māsāvasāne kuryācceddavādaśyāṃ śravaṇe tathā || 7 || tasmāttu divasātpūrvamaṅkurārpaṇamācaret| deveśaṃ pūrvarātrau tu samabhyarcya viśeṣataḥ || 8 || havirnivedayitvā tu baddhā pratisaraṃ tathā| śāyayitvā'tha deveśaṃ prātaḥ snātvā yathāvidhi || 9 || prātassandhyāvasāne tu kṛtvā grāmapradakṣiṇam| sthāpayitvā tu deveśaṃ tataḥ snapanamaṇḍape || 10 || snāpayitvā tu kalaśaiścatvāriṃśadbhiraṣṭabhiḥ| paṅkajaṃ śālibhiḥ kuryātsāṣṭaparṇaṃ sakarṇikam || 11 || tasmin devaṃ samāropya pūjayedāsanādibhiḥ| mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti nivedayet || 12 || pānīyācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet| tatkāle caiva mūrtyarcāṃ pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ || 13 || pariṣicya ca nityāgnimato devādivaiṣṇavaiḥ| piruṣeṇa ca sūktena tathā viṣṇornukādinā || 14 || jayādibhiśca kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pariṣanmūrtibhistathā| ājyena sājyacaruṇāṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ tato yajet || 15 || dvādaśāṣṭākṣarābhyāñca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet| pūrvoktairevamantraistu datvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā || 16 || jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya 'kṣama' sveti praṇamya ca| dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau || 17 || saṃvatsare tu yanyūṃnaṃ nitye naimittike'rcane| tatsarvadoṣaśāntyarthaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu māsi vai || 18 || dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu kuryātpūrvoktamarcanam| saṃvatsarāptadoṣāṇāṃ śāntaye cātha vaujase || 19 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā| pavitrāropaṇaṃ kecidicchanti munisattamāḥ || 20 || pavitrāropaṇanimittam athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ| nitye naimittike vā'pi tathā saṃvatsarārcane || 21 || jñanato'jñānato vā'pi ye do'ṣāssambhavanti vai| pavitrāropaṇenaiva te śāmyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || sarvadoṣopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidam| āyurārogyadaṃ kartuḥ sarvādhvarulāvaham || 23 || pavitrāropaṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ kārayetsarvaśāntaye| mārgaśīrṣākhyamāse tu śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 24 || kālaḥ dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe vā nakṣatre śravaṇe'thavā| dakṣiṇāyanamāseṣu viṣṇupañcadine tathā || 25 || kaverāśvayuje māsi cāśvayujyāṃ samācaret| kṛṣṇāṣṭamīcaturdayoḥ śambhormāseṣu ṣaṭsu ca || 26 || dvādaśyāṃ bhāskarasyoktaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandasya kīrtyate| kārtike māsi durgāyāḥ navamyāṃ kṛttikāsu ca || 27 || pūrvapakṣe'thavā kṛṣṇe śrīdevyāḥ pañcamītithau| athavottarulgunyauḥ pavitrāropaṇaṃ caret || 28 || tasmāttu divasātpūrvaṃ navame vā'tha saptame| pañcame'hani vā kuryāttṛtīye vā'ṅkurārpaṇam || 29 || aṅkurārpaṇakādūrdhvaṃ dravyāṇyapi samāharet| pavitramaṇḍapam pavitramaṇḍapanaṃ kuryāddevāgre vā'tha dakṣiṇe || 30 || snapanālaye'thavā tatra sthānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi| toraṇaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiśca kadalīkramukadhvajaiḥ || 31 || catudvariṣvalaṅkṛtya stambhayorubhayorapi| vitānaiśca patākābhistaraṅgaiḥ stambhapaveṣṭanaiḥ || 32 || muktādāmāvalambaiśca puṣpairvā darbhamālayā| kiṅkiṇījālakairhaimaiḥ kalpavṛkṣaissaratnakaiḥ || 33 || alaṅkatyāntaraṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ dīpānāropayedvahūn| gomayenopalipyaiva pañcavaralaṅkatam || 34 || caturdiśaṃ caturhastaṃ trihastaṃ vā'sya madhyame| gṛhītvā prāgudaksūtrairupapīṭhapade kṛte || 35 || mervādikalpanam tanmadhye merurekassyāddhastamātrasaṃmucchrayaḥ| tatturīyāṃśahīnāstatparito'ṣṭau kulācalāḥ || 36 || tattribhāgaikahīnāstu paritastasya ṣoḍaśa| indrādīnāṃ tathā'ṣṭānāṃ śivādīnāṃ padāni vai || 37 || caturbhirdaśābhiḥ sūtraiḥ bahiḥ paṅktiṃ caturdiśam| sāgarāḥ sapta caituṣu dvīpāḥ śākadāyaśca ṣaṭ || 38 || tatra meruḥ suvarṇābhaḥ sitapītāsitāruṇaḥ| himācalādayo dvandvāstathā'ṣṭau kulaparvatāḥ || 39 || śvetapītāsitaśyāmaraktanīlasitāruṇāḥ| tadvahiḥ ṣouśapade kalpanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 40 || jambūdvīpādikaṃ dhyātvā tadvahirlavaṇārṇavam| sasyaśyāmanibhaṃ kuryācchākadvīpaṃ bahistathā || 41 || śvetaṃ kṣīrārṇavaṃ bāhme kuśadvīpaṃ tato bahiḥ| kahirghṛtārṇavaṃ nīlaṃ krauñcadvīpaṃ tathaiva ca || 42 || dadhitoyanidhiśśuklaḥ śālmalīdvīpasaṃyutaḥ| madhvarṇavaḥ piśaṅgā'bho gomedadvīpasaṃyutaḥ || 43 || ikṣusārārṇavaḥ kecicchvetaḥ puṣkarasaṃyutaḥ| śuddhatoyārṇavo rakto lokālokācalastathā || 44 || evaṃ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā varṇairdhātuvikārajaiḥ| pauṣpaiḥ parāgairathavā patracūrṇairathāpi vā || 45 || tattadvarṇayutān kṛtvā sarvānetānasaṅkaram| japedupoṣya pūrvedyarvedān triṣavaṇāplutaḥ || 46 || pavitradravyam niṣkāhīnasuvarṇena dhruvādīnāṃ pṛthakpṛthak| devyostadardhamānena tathā pariṣadāmapi || 47 || channagulphatalañcaikaṃ sūtraṃ viṣṇoḥ prakalpayet| tadbuhya sūtramityuktaṃ tadasādhāraṇaṃ hareḥ || 48 || aśaktastāntavaṃ vā'tha sūtraṃ kṛtvā samāracaret| tāntavaṃ yadi kurvī triguṇīkṛtya tatpunaḥ || 59 || pavitranirmāṇaprakāraḥ prāṅmukhau dvau tu tiṣṭhantāvekastvabhimukhastayoḥ| japanvai viṣṇugāyatrīṃ dakṣiṇordhvantu vardhayet || 50 || tatpunastriguṇīkṛtya vāmordhva vardhayetpunaḥ| śucau deśe ca sannyasya tasyopari mṛdaṃ tathā || 51 || sannyasya hastau santāḍya triguṇīkṛtya kalpayet| yajñopavītamityuktaṃ granthisūtramathocyate || 52 || aṣṭottarasahasreṇa tadardhe na śatena ca| mūrtīnāṃ puruṣādīnāṃ tadardhenaiva kalpayet || 53 || devyośca parivārāṇāṃ tadardhenaiva kalpayet| gulphāntaṃ vā'tha jānvantūrvantañcottamādiṣu || 54 || ayugmāṃ kalayedgranthiṃ pañcavarṇoktatantubhiḥ| etatsarvaṃ divā kṛtvā sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca || 55 || dravyanyāsaḥ trilokīmaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā taddravyanyāsamācaret| pavitrāṇi ca sarvāṇi meruśrṛṅgopari nyaset || 56 || aṣṭopacāradravyāṇi nyasedaṣṭakulācale| maṅgalāni nyasedaṣṭalokapālapadāṣṭake || 57 || plotavastrottarīyādīn dhātūnābharaṇānyapi| …. .… … haviḥ pānīya || 58 || puruṣādipavitrāṇi prāgādiṣu kulādriṣu || 59 || koṇeṣu kapilādīnāmāgneyādiṣu vinyaset| tadbuhi ṣoḍaśāṃśeṣu sūtraṃ pariṣadāmapi || 60 || tattadukteṣu śaileṣu navavastropari nyaset| sāgareṣu ca sarveṣu tattaddravyasupūritān || 61 || pratyekamaṣṭau kalaśān sannyasetsūtraveṣṭitān| āḍhakāhīnadhānyeṣu pṛthagvastrottaracchadān || 62 || tadupasnānakalaśān bahirdvīpeṣu sannyaset| cakravālācalādvāhye prācyāṃ vīśaṃ samarcayet || 63 || dakṣiṇe vakrakhaṅgau ca śarañcaiva samarcayet| paṅktīśaṃ paścime'bhyarcya vāme caiva viśeṣataḥ || 64 || dakṣiṇe cakrakhaṅgau ca śarañcaiva samarcayet| paṅktīśaṃ paścime'bhyarcya vāme caiva viśeṣataḥ || 64 || śaṅkhakheṭakaśārṅgāṇi tathā kaumodakīmapi| chatrakhamarayugmañca darpaṇañca dhvajaṃ tathā || 65 || aiśānyādiṣu koṇeṣu sannyasettānasaṅkaram| utsavopakramaḥ rātripūjāvasāne tu snāpanañcautsavantu vā || 66 || 'paraṃ raṃ' heti mantreṇa pīṭhādādāya cātvaraḥ| svastisūktaṃ japitvā tu sarvalaṅkārasaṃyutam || 67 || maṇḍalātpaścime pīṭhe sthāpayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ| samabhyarcya nivedyaiva badhdvā pratisaraṃ tathā || 68 || pūrvavacchāyayeddevaṃ vedānadhyāpayetkramāt| dravyādhidevānabhyarcya vidhānaiśca vidhāyakaḥ || 69 || kalpayenmaṇḍalātprācyāṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ salakṣaṇam| homaprakāraḥ tatra nityāgnimādhāya pariṣicya ca pāvakam || 70 || juhuyādvaiṣṇavairmantrairājyena caruṇā tathā| hautraṃ praśaṃsya cā'vāhya devānabhyarcya pūrvavat || 71 || nirupyājyāhutīrhutvā paritastāntsamarcayet| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca || 72 || juhuyācchrīmahīsūktaṃ pañcavāruṇasaṃyutam| jayādyairapi hutvā tu yaddevādīṃstathaiva ca || 73 || sahasramāhutīnāñca sarvadaivatyameva ca| mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ padmahomaṃ tataḥ param || 74 || pārāmātmikasaṃyukṛtamīṅkārādīṃstathaiva ca| rātrisūktañca juhuyātsūktaṃ sārasvataṃ tathā || 75 || 'hiraṇyagarbha' ityādi brahmasūktaṃ tathaiva ca| rudramantradvayenāpi viśvajitsūktasaṃyutam || 76 || 'namo vāce' samuccāryaṃ 'śanno vāta' itīrya ca| devadevaṃ smaranneva rātrau homaṃ samāpya ca || 77 || prātaḥ snātvā'tha kṛtyāni yathāvidhi samācaret| devedavaṃ samuddhṛtya nirmālyamapi śodhayet || 78 || aiśānyāṃ maṇḍalācchrabhre devaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat| snapanam aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya snāpayellavaṇādibhiḥ || 79 || 'iṣe tvorje' tveti japan snāpayetsarvavastubhiḥ| puruṣasūktaṃ samuccārya śuddhodairabhiṣecayet || 80 || punaḥ plotena mṛjyātha sthāpayetpūrvaviṣṭare| antaḥ snānādikaṃ sarvamekabere samācaret || 81 || vastrottarīyābharaṇai dhātubhiśca yathocitam| pūrvamantrairalaṅkatya pūjayitvā'ṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 82 || nārāyaṇānuvākena kṛtvā sūtrābhimarśanam| pavitrāropaṇam karpūrādyaiśca gandhaiśca vāsitañca parīmalam || 83 || pūrvīktenaiva mantreṇa dadyāddevasya bhaktitaḥ| mūrtīnāṃ puruṣādīnāṃ pṛthak dadyāttaduttamam || 84 || pavitrasaṅkhyā viṣṇorekaṃ tathā teṣāmekamekantu madhyamam| sarveṣāmekasūtrañcedadhamaṃ paricakṣate || 85 || granthisūtraṃ nivītañca dadyāddevasya bhaktiḥ| dhruvādīnāñca sarveṣāmevaṃ sūtrañca sandadet || 86 || strīdevatānāṃ sarvāsāṃ dadyātsūtraṃ nivītakam| evaṃ deyantu sarveṣāu śaṅkhavādyapurassaram || 87 || aṣṭopacaurardeveśaṃ samabhyarcya yathāvidhi| havīṃṣi pāyasādīni prabhūtañca nivedayet || 88 || pānīyācamanaṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ ghanasaṃyutam| kuryātpuṣpāñjaliṃ stotrairnametpañcāṅgakaṃ guruḥ || 89 || sarvālaṅkārasaṃyaṃktaṃ grāmamālayameva vā| pradakṣiṇaṃ śanaiḥ kṛtvā jīvasthāne niveśayet || 90 || dadyādācāryapūrvebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ devasannidhau| madhyame tu prakurvīta trilokīmaṇḍalaṃ vinā || 91 || ghānyapīṭhe pavitrāṇi navavastropari nyaset| nityāgnikuṇḍe juhuyātpauṇḍarīkaṃ vinā'nilam || 92 || pavitrāropaṇa phalaśrutiḥ snapanaṃ śuddhatoyena kevalantvadhame bhavet| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ || 93 || sarvābhoṣṭamavāpnoti sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet| sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kīrtimān labhate śriyam || 94 || saṃvatsarārcanaphalaṃ labdhvā sāyujyamāpnuyāt| devadevopayuktaṃ tatsūtraṃ martyo bibharti yaḥ || 95 || aśvamedhāyutaphalaṃ samprāpnoti na śaṃsayaḥ| gṛhārcanā yadi bhavedviśeṣe homakarmaṇi || 96 || vinaiva sarvadaivatyaṃ pāramātmikameva ca| īṅkārādīnvinā sarvān yajedaupāsanānale || 97 || brahmādīnāntu devānāṃ tattanmantraṃ śatāṣṭakam| jayāṃdīścaiva kūṣmāṇḍān pañcavāruṇameva ca || 98 || mindāhutī ca vicchinnaṃ juhuyādvyāhṛtīrapi| etadeva vidhānaṃ syādanyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 99 || ityārṣe śrīvaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre pavitrārāpepaṇavidhirnāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<32> oṃ dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ śamīpūjāvidhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śamīpūjākramaṃ budhāḥ| māsi proṣṭhapade śuklapakṣe ca daśamītithau || 1 || devālayaṃ praviśyaiva dedeśaṃ sampraṇamya ca| snapanoktakrameṇaiva snapanañcaiva kārayet || 2 || deveśaṃ samamalaṅkatya nānāvastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ| turage ca samāropya sarvaśāstrāstrasaṃyutam || 3 || chatracāmarasaṃyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitam| samprāpte caiva sāyāhre deveśaṃ ninayedbudhaḥ || 4 || yatra deśe śamī tiṣṭheddevastatraiva gacchati| śamīvṛkṣasya paritaścālaṅkatya yathāvidhi || 5 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayedvidvān prokṣaṇañcaiva kārayet| devasyāgrasthale cā'pi gomayenopalipya ca || 6 || raṅgavallyādyalaṅkatya prokṣayetpūtavāriṇa| tatra deśe pratiṣṭhāpya śārṅgaṃ bāṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 7 || śārṅgasya cādhidaivatyaṃ vakṣyāmi munisattamāḥ| viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ samāvāhya brahmāṇāṃ varuṇaṃ tathā || 8 || śarāṇāmadhidaivatyaṃ cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathai ca| gadī khaḍgañca śārṅgañca adhidevāṃtsamarcayet || 9 || śamīvṛkṣasyādhidevaṃ vahriṃ tatra samarcayet| vṛkṣasya pūrve pakṣāṃśca dakṣiṇe rākṣasāṃstathā || 10 || piśācān paścime caiva uttare madhukaiṭabhau| etān devān samāvāhya krameṇaivārcayedbudhaḥ || 11 || aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya phalādīni nivedayet| arcakaḥ suprasannātmā dhanurādāya vīryavān || 12 || dhanvanā' geti mantreṇa jyāsvanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ| 'yāta iṣuḥ śi' veti mantreṇa sandadhyāddhanuṣi tviṣum || 13 || cakreṇa pūrve yakṣādīśchiṃndyādrakṣāṃsi dakṣiṇe| piśācān gadayā hanti paścimāśāsthitāṃstathā || 14 || asinā cottare hanti madhuṃ kaiṭabhameva ca| vṛkṣasya caturdikṣu caturbāṇān prayojayet || 15 || śārṅgākhyena ca bāṇena vṛkṣasyāgre prayojayet| punaśśarāngṛhītvaiva prokṣayetpūtavāriṇā || 16 || devasyāgre pratiṣṭhāpya praṇāmañcaiva kārayet| tato devaṃ samadāya grāmasyābhimukhaṃ nayet || 17 || sadmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā nīrājanamathācaret| uṣṇodakena saṃsnāpya āsthāne sanniveśya ca || 18 || mahāhavirnivedyaiva tāmbūlañca nivedayet| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 19 || sarvān kāmānavopnoti viṣṇusāyutajyamāpnuyāt| kṛttikādīpakramaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛttikādīpalakṣaṇam || 20 || kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāntu dīpairārādhanaṃ caret| devālayaṃ praviśyaiva deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca || 21 || devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ devaṃ snāpayitvā yathāvidhi| deveśaṃ samalaṅṛkatya nānāvastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 22 || mudrānnaṃ pāyasañcaiva apūpaṃ lājameva ca| viśeṣeṇa nivedyaiva mukhavāsaṃ samarpayet || 23 || yāne devaṃ samāropya devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ tathā| chatracāmarasaṃyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitam || 24 || sandhyāpūjāvasāne tu vīthīñcāpi nayedbudhaḥ| prathamāvaraṇe vā'pi tṛtīyāvaraṇe'pi vā || 25 || pañcamāvaraṇe vā'pi saptamāvaraṇe tathā| vīthīmadhye susaṃsthāpya tālavṛkṣaṃ tathaiva ca || 26 || nālikeraṃ tathā vā'pi kaitakaṃ kramukaṃ tathā| veṇuñcāpi tathā caiva āgastyamiti kecana || 27 || dāruṇyetāni saṃsthāpya dṛḍhīkṛtya prayatnataḥ| vimānasya sama vā'pi tripādādhikamathāpi vā || 28 || ardhādhikamatho vā'pi tripādādhikamevā vā| yādahīnaṃ tathā vā'pi ardhahīnaṃ tathaiva ca || 29 || tripādahīnamadhamaṃ dīpastambhapramāṇakam| dīpadaṇḍasya paritaḥ daśahastapramāṇataḥ || 30 || vṛttaiścāraṇaṃ kṛtvā gopurākṛtibhiścaret| ācchādayettālapattrairmūlādagrāntameva ca || 31 || taraṅgaiḥ darbhamālābhistoraṇaiścāpi veṣṭayet| puṣpairgandhairalaṅkatya navavastreṇa veṣṭayet || 32 || puṇyāhaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā prokṣaṇañcaiva kārayet| mahādīpādhidevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munipuṅgavāḥ || 33 || baḍabāmukhaṃ kālāgniṃ pralayānalameva ca| mahādīpañca nāmāni nāmabhistairathā'hvayet || 34 || aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya lājānapi nivedayet| sauvarṇaṃ rājitaṃ vā'pi tāmraṃ mṛṇyameva ca || 35 || pātraṃ samyaksamāpūrya gavyenaiva ghṛtādinā| madhyamādicaturdikṣu pañcavartīrvinikṣipet || 36 || kautukasyāpi dīpasya adhidevakramaṃ śṛṇu| bahabāmukhaṃ kālāgniṃ pralayānalameva ca || 37 || jātavedasaṃ mahādīpaṃ pañca cā'vāhya pañcasu| aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya lājānapi nivedayet || 38 || arcakaḥ suprasānnātmā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ| 'viṣṇustvā' miti mantreṇa kārābhyāṃ dīpamuddharet || 39 || sarvalokahitāñca mūrdhnaḥ pādāntameva ca| tadgrāmasya samṛddhyarthaṃ lalāṭādyantameva ca || 40 || netrādipādaparyantaṃ rājarāṣṭravivṛddhaye| sarveṣāṃ maṅgalārthañca bhrāmayitvā tridhā tridhā || 41 || tato dīpaṃ gṛhītvaiva mandaṃ mandañca gacchati| pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍāgre ca susannyaset || 42 || caturvartīrgṛhītvaiva caturdikṣu vinikṣipet| 'ayante yoni' riti ca mahādīpe vinikṣapet || 43 || mahādīpe prajvalite deveśaṃ praṇamenmuhuḥ| dīpadarśanaphalam sarvapāpāni naśyanti āyuḥ kītriśca vardhate || 44 || taddīpadarśanātsadyaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt| taddīpasyopaśamane deveśaṃ nāyayebdudhaḥ || 45 || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nīrājanamathā'caret| jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayetpusṣottamam || 46 || prabhūtañca nivedyaiva mukhavāsaṃ nivadeyet| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā kṛttikādīpamuttamam || 47 || rājyakāmo labhedrājyaṃ dhanakāmo labheddhanam| śrīkāma āpnuyātsampadāyuḥ kīrti samaśnute || 48 || sarvaiśvaryamavāpnoti viṣṇossāyujyamāpnuyāt| sugandhataila samarpaṇotsavaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi jyeṣṭhāyāmutsavakramam || 49 || jyeṣṭhe māsi susamprāpte dine jyeṣṭarkṣasaṃyute| viṣaṇave tu viśeṣeṇa gandhavattailamāharet || 50 || tatkramaṃ mpravakṣyāmi śrugudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ| yāgaśālāṃ prakalpyaiva sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutām || 51 || sabhyañca pauṇḍarīkañca kārayitvā salakṣaṇam| taddinasya tu pūrvedyuḥ tṛtīye pañcame'pi vā || 52 || saptame navame vā'pi aṅkarārpaṇamārabhet| āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā sarvaṃ kāryamataḥ param || 53 || vaidyā uttarapārśve tu bhūmyāmavaṣṭamācaret| catustālapramāṇena vistṛtaṃ nimnameva ca || 53 || nimne tu vinyasedbhāṇḍaṃ dvidroṇaparimāṇakam| 'bhūḥ pratiṣṭhityai' mantreṇā nimne bhāṇḍaṃ sunikṣipeta || 55 || malayāgurudāruṇi devadārutarudbhavam| yāni vāsitadāruṇi devayogyāni tāni vai || 56 || gugguluñca samāhṛtya mardayitvā pūthak pṛthak| viṣṇugāyatrimantreṇa bhāṇḍe dravyāṇi nikṣipet || 57 || śarāveṇāpidhāyātha mṛdā carilepayet| gokarīṣāṇi kāṣṭhāni tasyopari vinikṣipet || 58 || mandāgninā ca supacedyāvattailāgamo bhavet| paktvā yuktyā ca yatnena tailamāhṛtya tatkṣaṇāt || 59 || vāsitakvāthavastūni tāni tāni baniḥ kṣipet utpūya tailaṃ tadbhāṇḍa dhānyapīṭhe susannyaset || 60 || yathoktenaiva mantreṇa tantunā pariveṣṭayet| pitṝn somaṃ tathā'bhyarcya vanaspatimataḥ param || 61 || samāvāhya ca tailaṃ tānardhyāntamabhipūjayet| vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 62 || japtvā tu viṣṇugāyatrīmaṣṭottarasahasrakam| ācāryastvarito gatvā sabhyāgneśca samīpataḥ || 63 || dvitālavistṛta vṛttaṃ caturaṅgulamunnatam| kūrmākṛtivadākāraṃ bilvādyaiḥ parikalpitam || 64 || pratiṣṭhāyāmutsave ca japahomārcanādiṣu| sarvakāryeṣu vihitaṃ kūrmapīṭhaṃ samāsthitaḥ || 65 || samāhitaḥ prasannatmā sabhyāgnau juhuyāttataḥ| kūrmapīṭhavihīnantu karma tanniṣphala bhavet || 66 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktaṃ tathaiva ca| juhuyātsarvadaivatyaṃ pāramātmikameva ca || 67 || mahāvyāhṛtibhirhutvā antahomaṃ samācaret| pariṣicya tato'gabjāgniṃ mahāśāntiṃ hunetkramāt || 68 || pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā antahomaṃ samācaret| praṇidhyāṃ śaṅkhapātre vā agnimāropya buddhimān || 69 || tailasyālepanātpūrva dhruve'gnimavaropayet| sragvastrakuṇḍalādyaiśca pūjayetparicārakam || 70 || saṃveṣṭya navavastreṇa śiraśca munipuṅgavāḥ| tanmūrdhni tailabhāṇḍantaṃ vinikṣipya ca yatnataḥ || 71 || śanaiśśanaissamāgatṛya sarvavādyasamanvitam| sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitam || 72 || vīthīṃ pradakṣaṇīkṛtya devasyāgre vinikṣipet| ardhyāntamabhipūjyaiva deveśaṃ sampraṇamya ca || 73 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca narasūktaṃ japetkramāt| tailena lepayeddevamācāryastvaritastadā || 74 || ubhe devyau tathaivātra tattanmanmantreṇa lepayet| sarveṣāṃ parivārāṇāṃ tattanmantreṇa lepayet || 75 || ācāryastvarito gatvā autsavasya samīpataḥ| 'parilikhita' mityuktvā kavacaṃ pariśodhayet || 76 || jīrṇe bhinne ca kavace sandhānaṃ śilpinā caret| prakṣālya pañcagavyena jalena pariśodhayet || 77 || 'viṣṇornuke miti procya sandadhyātkavacaṃ punaḥ| dṛḍhīkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ yatnena pariśodhayet || 789 || sahasrakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā yathāvidhi| nitṛyapūjāvidhānena daivamārādhya pūrvavat || 79 || mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā pāyasañca nivedayet| 'kṣama' sveti ca mantreṇa praṇametpuruṣottamam || 80 || brahmaghoṣañca kṛtvā tu dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām| dine pakṣe ca māse ca tathā saṃvatsare caret || 81 || yadyadrūpaṃ tathā dhyāyettattadvimbeṣu yojayet| tasmātsarvaprayatnena bimbarakṣāntu kārayet || 82 || kārtikyāmutsave caiva jyeṣṭhāyāmutsave tathā| āṣāḍhyāmutsave caiva śrāvaṇyāmutsave tathā || 83 || caitryāmapyutsave caiva uparāgayute tathā| ayutañcotsavaṃ proktaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 84 || utsave devadevasya uparāgo na doṣakṛt| uparāge bhaye caiva pratiṣṭhānta nu kārayet || 85 || evaṃ yaḥ kurate bhaktyā kāryaṃ rogapraṇāśanam| sarvān kāmānacavāpyaiva viṣṇossāyujyamāpnuyāt || 86 || gahārcādoṣaniṣkṛtiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi gṛhārcādoṣaniṣkṛtim| prātaḥ kālārcane hīne sāyaṃ dviguṇaṇamarcanam || 87 || sāyaṃ hīne tathā prātarādvādaśādināvadhi| evameva kameṇaiva vardhayeddivaguṇaṃ sudhīḥ || 88 || samabhyarcya nivedyaiva brāhmaṇānapi bhojyet|
<33> oṃ trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ pañcāmṛtasnapanavidhiḥ atha pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ devadevasya tu priyam| viṣṇupañcadineṣvevamayane viṣuvadvaye || 1 || candrasūryoparāge ca vyatīpāte viśeṣataḥ| pratiṣṭhānte cotsavānte sarvaśāntyarthameva ca || 2 || pañcāmṛtābhiṣekastu devadevapriyaṅkaraḥ| devasya purataḥ samyak gomayenopalipya ca || 3 || yavairvā taṇḍulairvā'tra dvihastāyatavistṛtam| sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayitvā'ṣṭadalaṃ padmañca kalpayet || 4 || padmasyordhve tu puṣpāṇi prakṣipettulasīntu vā| padmākārasya madhye tu praṇavaṃ vilikhedbudhaḥ || 5 || pragādīśānaparyantaṃ daleṣṭhaṣṭākṣaraṃ likhet| kalaśāṃśca samāhṛtya tantunā veṣṭayedguruḥ || 6 || pañcāmṛtadravyam guḍaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu sarvaṃ samanvitam| pañcāmṛtantu vijñeyaṃ snānārtha śārṅgiṇaḥ priyam || 7 || pañcābhiṣekakalaśān pūrayedamṛtena vai| guḍasammiśritaṃ toyaṃ padmadhye suvinyaset || 8 || kṣīrasampūrṇakalaśaṃ prācyāṃ padmadale nyaset| dadhisampūrṇakalaśaṃ vinyaseddakṣiṇe dale || 9 || paścime dhṛtapātrantu uttare ca madhu vinyaset| āgneyādidaleṣvevamupasnānāni vinyaset || 10 || madhyādīśānaparyantamupasnāne tathaiva ca| ādityamaśvinau caiva rudrañcaiva tu vatsarān || 12 || prāgādi pañcavāyūṃśca madhyādiṣu sāmahvayet| devadevaṃ samādāya sthāpayedatha paścime || 13 || pādyādyairarcayedvidvān snapanoktavidhānataḥ| 'somaṃ rājā' mityuktvā 'śanno devī' riti kramāt || 14 || 'iṣe tvorje' tveti japan 'agna āyāhivī' ti ca| 'agnimīla' iti procya deveśaṃ snāpayedbudhaḥ || 15 || 'vārīścatasra' ityuktvā sarvopasnānamācaret| evaṃ pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ param || 16 || rājarāṣṭrarddhijananaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam| pañcagavyavidhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmiṃ pañcagavyavidhi hareḥ || 17 || taṇḍulopari devāgre sthaṇḍile caturaśrake| padmaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye praṇavaṃ nyaset || 18 || prāgādīśānapayrantaṃ daleṣvaṣṭākṣaraṃ nyaset| tatpadmaṃ kuśapuṣpādyairalaṅkatya tathopari || 19 || pañcagavyalakṣaṇam kapilāyā varaṃ varaṃ kṣīraṃ śvetāyā dadhi śasyate| raktāyāśca ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃyā gomayaṃ tathā || 20 || gomūtraṃ nīlavarṇāyāḥ pañcagavyaṃ śubhapradam| prasthapādaṃ ghṛtañcaiva dadhi taddivaguṇaṃsmṛtam || 21 || triguṇaṃ kṣīramityuktaṃ gomayantu caturguṇam| ṣaṅguṇañcaiva gomūtraṃ pañcagavyaṃ suyojayet || 22 || patitaṃ gomayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gomūtrañcāpyapātitam| dhāroṣṇaṃ kṣīramādeyaṃ sadyastaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || 23 || dadhi cāpyanatītāhatametadgavyasya lakṣaṇam| madhye pade tu gomutraṃ dadhi pūrvaṃ yame ghṛtam || 24 || kṣīrañca paścime saumye gomayaṃ sthāpayetkramāt| āgneyyāṃ gandhatoyañca nairṛtyāmāmlakaṃ tathā || 25 || vāyavyāmapi hāridramaiśānyāñca kuśodakam| evaṃ krame vinyasya adhidevāṃtsamarcayet || 26 || adhidevāḥ gomūtre jāhravī proktā yajurvedaśca dadhni vai| sāmavedo ghṛte proktaḥ kṣīre ṛgveda eva ca || 27 || atharvā gomaye caiva abhyarcyā aṣṭavigrahaiḥ| sayojanam gāyatryā caiva gomūtraṃ 'dadhikrā' vṇeti vai dadhi || 28 || ājyaṃ 'śukrama' sītyuktvā 'āpyāya' sveti vai payaḥ| gomayaṃ 'gandhadvā' reti 'devasya tvā' kuśodakam || 29 || evaṃ krameṇa saṃyejya caturvedādimantrakaiḥ| snapanaprakāraḥ snāpayetpañcagavyena āmlena ca suśodhayet || 30 || 'sinīvā' līti hāridraiḥ gandhaiḥ 'bhūrānile' ti ca| svāduśītalatoyena narasūktena vai harim || 31 || sasnāpya vasnnābharaṇairalaṅkṛtya nivedayet| abhiṣiktāvaśiṣṭaṃ tadamṛtaṃ gavyameva vā || 32 || prāśayitvā mahāpāpairupapāpaiḥ pramucyate| aihikān sakalān bhogān bhuktvā sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 33 || śudyartha pañcagavyasādhanam dehaberālayādīnāṃ śuddhyarthaṃ yatprayujyate || 34 || sūtasāttvatacaṇḍālasūtikādipraveśane| pañcagavyantu saṃyojyaṃ prokṣayettena mandiram || 35 || pañcagavyāni saṅgṛhya pañcapātreṣu pūrayet| svagṛhasyāṅgaṇe caiva gomayenopalipya ca| tanmadhye ṣoḍaśadalaṃ raṅgavallīñca kārayet || 37 || droṇārdhataṇḍulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ pragṛhya ca| tanmadhye vilikhetpadmaṃ dalapañcakasaṃyutam || 38 || pātrāṇi pañcagavyānāṃ vinyasettaddaleṣu ca| madhya ājya pratiṣṭhāpya pūrvasmin dadhi nikṣipet || 39 || kṣīrantu dakṣiṇe caiva gomaya paścime tathā| uttare caiva gomūtra krameṇa sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 40 || ghṛte tu sāmavedañca dadhni ṛgvedameva ca| kṣīre atharvavedañca gomaye skandameva ca || 41 || śarva devañca gomūtre adhidevān samarcayet| ājyaṃ 'śukrama' sītyuktvā ṣoḍaśāśāṃ pragṛhyaṃ ca || 42 || 'dadhikrāṇṇa' ityuktvā kṣiptvā taddivaguṇaṃ daghi| 'āpyāya' sveti mantreṇa triguṇaṃ kṣīramāharet || 43 || 'gandhadvā' reti mantreṇa gomayañca caturguṇam| ṣaḍguṇañcaiva gomūtraṃ gāyattrya tatra nikṣipet || 44 || 'vaṇoḥ pavitra' mityukvā ekīkuryāttu pañcakam| pañcagavyādhidevasya mūrtimantraṃ vadāmyaham || 45 || 'pañcagavyaṃ śivañceśamavyakta' miti pūjayet| japitvā viṣṇusūktañca 'rudramanyaṃ-tryambakam' || 46 || prokṣaṇam 'aṇoraṇīyā' nityuktvā 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' di bhistathā| prokṣaṇairanuvākaiśca prokṣayetsarvamandiram || 47 || prāśanam 'śanno devī' riti procya pañcagavyañca triḥ pibet| pañcagavya tathā pītvā pūto bhavati niścayaḥ || 48 || ācāryakaradattaṃ tatpañcagavyaṃ pibedbudhaḥ| pratiṣṭhārthañcotsavārthamanyakāryārthameva ca || 49 || vaikhānasakule jātaṃ niṣekādikriyānvitam| uktalakṣaṇasampannaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jñānasamanvitam || 50 || gṛhasthaṃ karmakuśalaṃ brahmacāriṇameva vā| vānaprasthamatho vā'pi varayedgurumuttamam || 51 || rakṣābandhanakāryādīn kārayediti śāsanam| ācāryamṛtijvajaḥ kuryādvanasthabrahmacāriṇau || 52 || tayorapi na doṣaḥ syāditi pūrvajaśāsanam| ācāryakaradattantu triḥ pibetpañcagavyakam || 53 || phalaśrutiḥ pañcagavyaṃ tathā pītvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate| aṅkurārpaṇakadūrdhvamārambhadivasādadhaḥ || 54 || dīkṣitānāmāśaicābhāvakathanama āśauyaṃ yadi samprāptaṃ karmamadhye viśeṣataḥ || 55 || snānenaiva viśuddhiḥ syātsnātvā karma samācaret| dīkṣitānāṃ vratasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || 56 || āśaucaṃ na bhavetteṣāmudake padmapatra vat| dīkṣito'pyekaputrastu mātāpitrorgurormṛtau || 57 || saṃskṛtya śālāmāgatya devakāryaṃ samācaret| devakāryasamāptau tu pretakārya samācaret || 58 || pretakāryasamāptau tu devakāryaṃ samācaret| pūrvantu devakārya syātpretakāryamanantaram || 59 || dine dine ca kartavyamiti śātātapobravīt| devakāryasya madhye cedācāryamaraṇaṃ yadi || 60 || prāṇotkramaṇakola tu rakṣābandhaṃ visṛjya ca| tatputrādiṣu cadvadhdvā śīghraṃ karma pravartayet || 61 || tatputrādiṣvalabdheṣu devahaste tu bandhayet| anyamārcāyamā hūya kāryaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 62 || bandhanantu na kartavyaṃ sarvakarma samāret| ajñānādanyahaste tu bundhayedyadi mūḍhadhīḥ || 63 || tatkarma niṣphalaṃ proktaṃ rājarāṣṭravināśanam| śuddhaspanavidhiḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śuddhasnānavidhiṃ hareḥ || 64 || maṇḍale tvabhiṣekārtha bahiḥ sopānamaṇḍape| saṃsthāpayadeddevadevaṃ snapanāya eva vā || 65 || āsthānamaṇḍape vā'tha kuryācduddhābhiṣecanam| gomayenopalipyaiva maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam || 66 || pañcavargairalaṅkatya vitānastambhaveṣṭanaiḥ| muktādāmāvalambaiśca puṣpadāmavālambanaiḥ || 67 || patākābhirdhvajaiścaiva alaṅkatya ca sarvataḥ| sarvatra dīnānaropya tanmadhye sottaracchadam || 68 || viṣṭaraṃ susthiraṃ nyasya pūjakassusamāhitaḥ| 'bhuḥ prapadya' iti deveśaṃ praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 69 || 'paraṃ raṃ' heti mantreṇa pīṭhādādāya cātvaraḥ| svastisūktaṃ samuccārya śākunaṃ sūktameva ca || 70 || śaṅkhaghoṣayutaṃ nītvā sthāpayedatra viṣṭare| 'pratadviṣṇuḥstavata' iti sthāpayitvā samāhitaḥ || 71 || snapāṅgopacāraḥ 'narāyaṇāya vi' dmeti pādapuṣpāṇi vinyaset| pādyamācamanaṃ datvā pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ || 72 || 'annādyāṃ yeti manteṇa dantadhāvanamācaret| tenaiva jihvāśuddhiñca mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || 73 || punarācamanaṃ datvā plotena parimṛjya ca| mukhavāsaṃ nivedyaiva praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 74 || devasyāparabhāgaṃ tadācchādyaiva galādadhaḥ| devasya paścime sthitvā gurustadbhāvabhāvitaḥ || 75 || 'ato devā' di mantrāṃśca 'somaṃ rājāna' muccaran| tailenābhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā keśānābaddhya vai punaḥ || 76 || sugandhimālayā''veṣṭya pāṇī prakṣālya vai tataḥ| lalāṭātpādaparyanataṃ tailenābhyajya mardayet || 77 || śālipiṣṭena devāṅgaṃ vimṛjeccandānena vā| tailasamarpaṇvarjyakālāḥ aṣṭamyāñca navamyāñca caturdaśyāñca parvaṇi || 78 || abhyañjanañca dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ carjayettathā| tato devaṃ samāsādya snānavedyāntu pūrvavat || 79 || prāṅmukhaṃ sthāpayetsamyak tamindumukhameva vā| pādyamācamanaṃ datvā praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 80 || 'parilikhita' miti mantreṇa āmlena pariśodhayet| tenaiva keśaśuddhiñca kuryādāmalakādibhiḥ || 71 || 'vārīścatasra' ityuktvā vāriṇā snāpayetpunaḥ| 'namo varuṇa' ityuktvā snāpayetpuṣpavāriṇā || 82 || 'sinīvā' līti devāṅgamālipya ca haridrayā| 'bhūrānilaya' ityuktvā snāpayedgandhavāriṇā || 83 || punarācamanaṃ datvā vastrañcaivottarīyakam| dadyādyajñopavītañca tattanmantramudīrayan || 84 || datvā cānāmikāṅgulyoḥ pavitre parahastayoḥ| aṣṭopacārairabhyarcya vedaiḥ saṃstūya ca kramāt || 85 || sahasradhārāsnāpanakramaḥ śaṅkhapadmāṅkapātrābhyāmāvarjitajalena ca| sahasradhārāpatreṇa pauruṣaṃ sūktamuccaran || 86 || nārāyaṇānuvākena snāpayitva tataḥ param| devyośca tattanmantrābhyāṃ tatta nmantrairathāpi vā || 87 || saṃsnāpyaca candanaṃ datvā plotena parimṛjya ca | vastrakhaṇḍena dhautena sūkṣmenācchādya mantravit || 88 || kalpayitvottarāsaṅgamalakānapi śodhayet| punarācamanaṃ datvā dadyātpuṣpāṇi pādayoḥ || 89 || tato daṃva samādāya sthāpayetpūparvaviṣṭare| alaṅkaraṇaprakāraḥ sūkṣmakauśeyavastreṇa citrakakṣyāyutena ca || 90 || alaṅkṛtya ca deveśaṃ yathā cakṣurmanaḥpriyam| visṛjyālakabandhañca dhūpaṃ datvā yathocitam || 91 || uttarīyopavītābhyāṃ bhūṣaṇairapi bhūṣayet| āsanādibhirabhyarcya dīpāntācamānāntakaiḥ || 92 || nityārcanoktavidhinā darpaṇādīn yathāvidhi| rājavadvigrahāścāpi tattanmantraiḥ prayojayet || 93 || mātrādānañca kṛtvā tu madhuparka nivedya ca| 'athāvanīda' mantreṇa maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakam || 94 || kṛtvā'trāstīrya dhautañca patraṃ prāguttarāgrakam | prāgagramuttarāgraṃ vā sannyasetkadalībhavam || 95 || 'ā mā vājasya' mantreṇa kṣālayetprokṣayettu vā| haviḥ pātrādhipaṃ sūryaṃ tasya pārśve samarcayet || 96 || 'devasya' tveti mantreṇa ghṛtenāpyabhighārya ca| 'amṛtopastaraṇama' sīti haviḥ prakṣipya tatra vai || 97 || phalaṃ guḍopadaṃśādīn dadhi kṣīramathāpi vā| tatra nikṣipya gāyatryā deveśāyeti saṃsmaran || 98 || tasyaiva parito dikṣu prāgādiṣu yathākramam| pāyasānnena catvāri śuddhānnena harvīṣi ca || 99 || pātraiḥ pañcabhirādāya tripādopari vinyaset| 'yatte susīma' ityuktvā ghṛtamāsrāvya tatra vai || 100 || abhimṛśyānnasūktena dadyādācamanaṃ punaḥ| 'tadasya' priyaṃ' mityuktvā 'subhūḥ svaya' mudīrya ca || 101 || havirnivedayedviṣṇoḥ prabhūtaṃ bhaktisaṃyutam| amantrakaṃ dvitīyañca tṛtīyañca nivedayet || 102 || arcakasya manastṛptiryāvatā sannivedayet| caturdikṣu tripādordhve nyastānyapi harvīṣi ca || 1103 || mūrtīnāṃ puruṣādīnāṃ tattanmantrairnivedayet| ājyena sājyacaruṇā homaṃ hutvā yathāvidhi || 104 || 'idaṃ viṣṇu' riti projya pānīyaṃ svādu śītalam| prasthapūrṇena pātreṇa pañcadhaiva nivedayet || 105 || punarācamanaṃdatvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet| apūpān pṛthukān lājān kadalyādiphalāni ca || 106 || nivedyāṣṭākṣareṇaiva nārikelaphalāni ca| punarācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet || 107 || parītya mandiraṃ paścātsarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam| sthāpayejjīvasthāne tu 'bhūrasi bha' riti bruvan || 108 || vinā rājopacāraiśca prabhūtahaviṣā tathā| sthāpayitvā samabhyarcya datvā pañcavidhaṃ haviḥ || 109 || arcāpīṭhe nyasaddevamidaṃ madhyamamīritam| nityābhiṣecanānte ca devān saṃsthāpya tatra ca || 110 || pādyamācamanaṃ datvā kṛtvā vai dantabhāvanam| darpaṇaṃ darśayitvā tu mukhavāsaṃ nivedya ca || 111 || tailenābhyajya cāmlādyaiḥ śodhayitvā'bhiṣicya ca| haridrayā'ṅgamālipya gandhaudairabhiṣicya ca || 112 || aṣṭopacaurabhyarcya snāpayitvā ca pūrvavat| jīvasthāne pratiṣṭhāpya vastreṇācchādya pūrvavat || 113 || āsanādibhirabhyarcya dīpāntācamanāntakaiḥ| śuddhānnameva devāya havirdadyātsamantrakam || 114 || pānīyācamanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet| eṣa eva viśeṣaḥ syādapyatsarvañca pūrvavat || 115 || ityārṣo śrīvaikṣānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kriyādhikāre ṣañcāmṛtasnāna pañcagavyavidhi śuddhasnānavidhi kathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|
<34> oṃ catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ godāpratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi godāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ param| viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 1 || purā bṛndāvane puṇye bhūmidevyaṃśasambhāvā| viṣṇubhaktisamāyuktā viṣṇubhogābhilāṣiṇī || 2 || dvibhujā mānuṣī bhūtvā hariṃ prāptavatī svayam| godeti nāmnā vikhyātā bhūmiloke viśeṣataḥ || 3 || sāyujyaṃ prāptavatyante viṣṇunā sahacāriṇī| tatpratiṣṭhākramaṃ vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ || 4 || māsarkṣatithivārādiḥ pūrvameva mayoditaḥ| yathoktadivasa kuryādaṅkurārpaṇapūrvakam || 5 || sambhārāharaṇādīni kṛtvā caicava prayatnataḥ| bhūdidevīpratiṣṭhoktaṃ vidhinā sarvamācaret || 6 || akṣyunmeṣaṃ dvitīye'hri vāstuhomādikaṃ tathā| adhivāsatrayañcāpi bimbaśuddhyarthamācaret || 7 || pauṇḍarīkaḥ pradhānāgniḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret| kumbhān vedyāṃ samāropya dhānyarāśau tu pūrvavat || 8 || pañcaniṣkapramāṇena pratimāsteṣu nikṣipet| navaratnāni nikṣipya vastrairāveṣṭya yatnataḥ || 9 || tato dhyānasamāyuktaḥ kumbheṣvāvāhanaṃ caret| jayādyapsaraso'ṣṭau ca saṃmabhyarcya nivedayet || 10 || kautukaṃ pūrvavadvadhdvā śayane śāyayecca tām| sarvadevārcanaṃ kṛtvā vedānadhyāpayettataḥ || 11 || pauṇḍarīkaṃ paristīrya hautraśaṃsanamācaret| hautraśaṃsanavelāyāṃ samāhvānañca mūrtibhiḥ || 12 || 'godāṃ vasumatīṃ lakṣmīsakhīṃ viṣṇusatīṃ' viduḥ| pūrvoktena vidhānena sarvakuṇḍeṣu homayet || 13 || bhūmimantradvayenaiva hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam| eṣa eva viśeṣassyātsarva pūrvoktavaccaret || 94 || nṛttagītādivādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayedguruḥ| tataḥ prabhāte dharmātmā devīmutthāpya mantrataḥ || 15 || kalaśaiḥ snāpya pūrvoktairalaṅkatyāmbarādibhiḥ| ratnanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhe saṃyojṛya mantravit || 16 || sudhayā vā dṛḍhīkṛtya yajamānuyajo guruḥ| śirasā kumbhamādāya grāmamālayameva vā || 17 || pradakṣiṇavaśānnītvā devāgāraṃ praveśayet| guraṃ sampūjya vidhinā vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 18 || yathoktadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddevīprītikaraṃ bhavet| muhūrte samanuprapte samyagāvāhanaṃ caret || 19 || bhūmimantradvayenaiva sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret| upacāraismabhyarcya prabhūtaṃ vā mahāhaviḥ || 20 || nivedayitvā vidhinā brahmaghoṣañca kārayet| sahasraviprabhuktiñca daśadānañca kārayet || 21 || evaṃ yaḥ kurate bhaktyā godāsthāpanamatvaraḥ| sarvān kāmānavāpyaiva viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt || 22 || pādukāpratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pādukāsthāpanaṃ param| hemarājitatāmrādidravyaiḥ kṛtvā salakṣaṇam || 23 || pādukāṃ devadevasya pādayogyāṃ saratnakām| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kārayitvā'tisundaram || 24 || yajamāno viśeṣeṇa pādukāsthāpanaṃ kramāt| kārayitvā yathāśāstraṃ devadevasya pādayoḥ || 25 || yojayetsarvakāmāṃśca labhetkartā na śaṃsayaḥ| anyathā devadevasya prīṇanaṃ na bhaveddhbuvam || 26 || tasmātkartā yathāśakti kārayitvā dadenmudā| kṛtvā'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ pūrvamācāyarcavaraṇādikam || 27 || ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhoktavadācaret| vāstuhomaṃ tato hutvā niṣkatrayasuvarṇakaiḥ || 28 || vāstupuruṣaṃ samāvāhya śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu tasya ca| adhivāsañca kṛtvā tu pūrvokṛtavidhinā tataḥ || 29 || kumbhaṃ saṃsādhya vidhinā niṣkahemnā pṛthakpṛthak| aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ pañcāyudhayutaṃ pṛthak || 30 || pādukāyāḥ svarūpañca kṛtvā niṣkatrayeṇa ca| vaiṣṇavena vinikṣipya kumbhamadhye vicakṣaṇaḥ || 31 || kalaśaissaptabhissnānaṃ samyakkṛtvā salakṣaṇam| āghāraṃ vidhivatkṛtvā hautraṃ tatra praśaṃsya ca || 32 || śeṣaṃ tadadhidevañca samāvāhyaiva mūrtibhiḥ| nirupyā'jyāhutīrhutvā śayanañca prakalpya ca || 33 || vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇusūktañca pauruṣaṃ sūktameva ca| śeṣamantradvayenaiva śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 34 || dikpālānāṃ manuṃścaivamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyyā| jayādīnapi hutvā tu yaddevādipurassaram || 35 || hutvā homaṃ samāpyaiva rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya ca| prātassnānādi kṛtyaiva muhūrte ca samāvahet || 36 || tato devasya padayoḥ paiṣṇavena dadenmudā| mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā deveśāya nivedayet || 37 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā pādukāsthāpanaṃ naraḥ| sarvaiśvaryamavāpyaiva sarvaṃ pāpa vyāpohya ca || 38 || sarvadānāphalaṃ labdhvā sāmīpyaphalamupāśnute| navīkaraṇamuddhiśya śaktyākarṣaṇapūrvakam || 39 || jīrṇaberavidhānena sarva karma samācaret| bhaktapratiṣṭhā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhaktānāṃ sthāpane vidhim || 40 || jaṭinaṃ śikhinaṃ vāpi brāhmaṇaṃ parikalpayet| prāñjaliṃ bhāvanāyuktaṃ nāsāntāhitalocanam || 41 || kṣatriyaṃ makuṭopetaṃ vaiśyamudbuddhakuntalam| kuryācchūṃdrānulomādīn romacūḍāsamanvitān || 42 || athavā muṇḍitānvā'pi bhagavaddhyānatatparān| yadākāreṇa deveśaṃ paśyeyustattadākṛtīn || 43 || aṣṭatāloktamārgeṇa dvijātīn parikalpayet| madhyamenaiva śūdrādīn kārayitvā yathāvidhi || 44 || bhaktānāṃ dhruvaberasya devyoścaiva tathaiva ca| pramāṇaṃ pūrvamevokta dhruvaberavaśāttathā || 45 || kṛtvaivaṃ bhaktabimbantu pratiṣṭhāmācaretpunaḥ| asurā vidyādharāḥ pūjā ṛṣayo mānavāstathā| brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyai vaiṣyaiśśūdrairapyantyajātibhiḥ || 47 || tattadbhaktisamāyuktaiḥ taccihraistatparāyaṇaiḥ| kartavyaṃ bhaktabimbānāṃ bhajanaṃ viṣṇumandire || uttarāyāṇakāle tu dakṣiṇe vā tvarānvitaḥ| puṇyarkṣe māsanakṣatre pūrvapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 48 || sthirarāśiṃ pragṛhyaiva ubhaye vā śubhodaye| tasmāttu divasātpūrvamaṅkurānarpayetkramāt || 49 || tṛtīye divase kuryācchilpinā cākṣimocanam| pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktamācārya varayetkramāt || 50 || pramukhe dakṣiṇe vā'pi uttare vā manorame| maṇḍapaṃ vā'tha kūṭaṃ vā prapāṃ vā'pi vidhānataḥ || 51 || aupāsanāgnikuṇḍañca kṛtvā ādhāramācaret| aṅgahomañca hutvā tu pāñcabhaitikasaṃyutam || 52 || nayanonmīlanaṃ kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ| nadyāṃ vā'tha taṭāke vā vāpyāṃ vā'tha kaṭāhake || 53 || adhivāsyaiva tadvimbaṃ beraśuddhiṃ samācaret| pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktāṃ yāgaśālāṃ prakalpayet || 54 || vitānādyairalaṅkatya sarvālaṅkāraśobhitām| tanmadhye sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā bimbādhyardhapramāṇataḥ || 55 || prācyāmāhavanīyañca śvabhraṃ pūrvavadācaret| uttare vāstuhomārthāṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ || 56 || paryagniñcaiva kṛtvā tu prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ caret| āghāraṃ pūrvavaddhutvā vaiṣṇavena samanvitam || 57 || adhivāsagataṃ beraṃ yāgaśālāṃ praveśayet| pūrvoktena vidhāne kumbhapūjāṃ samācaret || 58 || tattadrūpaṃ tathā dhyāyetkumbhamdhye viśeṣataḥ| pañcabhiḥ kalaśaissnāpya bimbaṃ yatnena śodhayet || 59 || vastrapañcakamāstīrya sthāpayetkumbhasaṃyutam| alaṅkatya ca vastrādyairarcayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ || 60 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra badhdvā pratisaraṃ tataḥ| śayane śāyayedveraṃ yato dvāraṃ tataśśiraḥ || 61 || uttarācchādanaṃ kuryāddīpāntañca samarcayet| agniṃ sampariṣiccaiva mūlahomaśca hūyate || 62 || aṣṭāśītiṃ tato hutvā mahāvyāhṛtisaṃyutam| aṣṭākṣareṇa mantraiṇa śataṣṭottaraṃ yajet || 63 || tattanmūrtīḥ svamantreṇa aṣṭottarasahasrakam| nṛtairgītaiśca vādyaiśca rātriśeṣaṃ nayetkramāt || 64 || punaḥ prabhāte dharmātmā snātvā snānavidhānatamaḥ| śayitaṃ beramutthāpya praṇamyaivānumānya ca || 65 || pūrvamālyairalaṅkatya pūjayedaṣṭavigrahaiḥ| antahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā garbhāgāraṃ praveśayet || 66 || pañcaratnaṃ suvarṇañca pīṭhasthāne vinikṣipet| ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ śiṣyo datvodakapurassaram || 67 || muhūrte samanuprāpte yajamānayuto guruḥ| kumbha beraṃ samādāya ālayaṃ samparītya ca || 68 || jīvasthāne niveśyaiva sthāpayitvoktaviṣṭare| ātmasūktaṃ japitvā tu tattadvījaca vinyaset || 69 || tannāmādyakṣara bījaṃ nyasedoṅkāraveṣṭitam| tanmurtimantre sayojya mūlamantrāvasānake || 70 || ghaṭācchaktiṃ samāvāhya beramūrdhani cāhvayet| puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra svastighoṣaṇamācaret || 71 || pūrvoktavigrahaiḥ sarvairarcayitvā nivedya ca| tanniveditaśeṣantu tadbhaktānāṃ pradāpayet || 72 || anuktāni ca sarvāṇi mūrtimantreṇa kārayet| pratiṣṭhāyāmutsave ca nityahome tathaiva ca || 73 || parivārapritiṣṭhāsu bhaktānāṃ sthāpane tathā| bhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ svāhānte ca vadedguruḥ || 74 || viṣṇave nama ityaktvā sarveṣāmāhutīryajet| tadantaryāmiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvahūtiṣu saṃyajet || 75 || viṣṇavālayagatāścaiva parivārāstathaiva ca| bhaktā bhṛtyāśca sarve ca viṣṇurupāśca bhāvitāḥ || 76 || ityūce bhagavān brahmā purā sarvān munīn prati| tacchrutvā munayassarve paryapṛcchan pitāmaham || 77 || brahman viṣṇusvarupāḥ syuḥ parivārāḥ kathaṃ prabho| ityuktassarvalokānāṃ suṣṭā provāca tānmunīm || 78 || śrṛṇudhvaṃ munayassarve yadyūyaṃ paripṛcchatha| viśvavyāpanaśīlatvādviṇurityabhidhīyate || 79 || tasmādviṣṇuṣṇusvaruyāṃśca parivārān vibhāvayet| parivārasya mantrānte tattannāma vadetsudhīḥ || 80 || tattannāmnā na kuryāccetkruddhaḥ syādbhagavān hariḥ| tasmācchāstraṃ samālakṣya viṣṇave sampradāpeyat || 71 || karṣaṇe bhūnarīkṣāyāṃ gogaṇānāṃ nivedane| śilādārvośca grahaṇe madhūcchiṣṭavidhāvapi || 82 || lohasrāve tathā naitye devyośca sthāpane tathā| tayostu pāṇigrahaṇe bhaktānāṃ sthāpane tathā || 83 || jayantyāṃ snapane caiva madhuvalmīkasambhave| kalahādisamudbhūtau vāstuhomāṅgahomayoḥ || 84 || nayanonmīlane caiva adhivāsatraye'pi ca| karmasveteṣu viṃśatsu kāryaḥ śrāmaṇakānalaḥ || 85 || athavā''havanīyagnau hutvā karma pṛthakcaret| śrāmaṇāhavanīyau ca paryāyāviti kecana || 86 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bhaktānī pūjanaṃ budhāḥ| grāmaśāntikarañcaiva bhaktānāmabhivṛddhidam || 87 || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuṅktvā patnīputrāsamanvitaḥ …
